// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\AiAgent.cpp

#include "AiAgent.h"

namespace
{
    juce::var object()
    {
        return juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
    }

    // Tools that only look: they don't change the song.
    bool looksOnly (const juce::String& name)
    {
        return name == "get_song" || name == "get_clip" || name == "find_plugins" || name == "get_plugin_params";
    }
}

AiAgent::AiAgent (Cloud& c, AiTools& t, Hooks h)
    : cloud (c), tools (t), hooks (std::move (h))
{
}

AiAgent::~AiAgent()
{
    *alive = false;   // an answer arriving later finds no one
}

juce::String AiAgent::systemPrompt()
{
    return R"text(You are the AI inside Fanan Web Hub, a DAW like Studio One. You operate the DAW for the user through tools, doing what they ask completely.

How to work:
- Call get_song first to see the song; call it again whenever you need fresh ids.
- Plugins: find them with find_plugins and load only what is installed. Never invent a plugin name. If nothing fits, say what is installed instead.
- Plugin settings: read get_plugin_params (with a filter for big plugins) before set_plugin_params; values are in each parameter's own range.
- Units: bars count from 1; beats are quarter notes; volumes in dB; pan from -1 (left) to 1 (right).
- Writing music: write real, musical parts in key and in time, idiomatic for the style. Drums on an instrument track use General MIDI drum notes (36 kick, 38 snare, 42 closed hi-hat, 46 open hi-hat, 49 crash) unless the instrument is known to map differently.
- Mixing: you cannot hear the audio. Make conventional, moderate moves and say that they are starting points.
- Removing a track: ask the user first; call remove_track with confirmed: true only after they said yes.
- If something can't be done with your tools, say so plainly instead of pretending.

When you're done, answer in a few short lines: what you changed, nothing more.)text";
}

juce::var& AiAgent::currentEntry()
{
    if (entries.isEmpty() || entries.getReference (entries.size() - 1).getProperty ("role", {}).toString() != "assistant")
    {
        auto entry = object();
        entry.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("role", "assistant");
        entry.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("text", juce::String());
        entry.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("steps", juce::Array<juce::var>());
        entries.add (entry);
    }

    return entries.getReference (entries.size() - 1);
}

void AiAgent::trimConversation()
{
    // A long conversation is cut at a request's start, so tool calls keep their results.
    while (messages.size() > 60)
    {
        int cut = -1;

        for (int i = 1; i < messages.size(); ++i)
            if (messages.getReference (i).getProperty ("role", {}).toString() == "user" && messages.getReference (i).getProperty ("content", {}).isString())
                { cut = i; break; }

        if (cut < 0)
            break;

        messages.removeRange (0, cut);
    }
}

void AiAgent::send (const juce::String& text)
{
    const auto request = text.trim();

    if (busy || request.isEmpty())
        return;

    if (! cloud.isConfigured() || ! cloud.isSignedIn())
    {
        error = "Sign in (the account button, top right) to use the AI.";
        if (hooks.stateChanged) hooks.stateChanged();
        return;
    }

    if (cloud.isBlocked())
    {
        error = "The internet is blocked (the toggle at the top right), and the AI works through it.";
        if (hooks.stateChanged) hooks.stateChanged();
        return;
    }

    auto user = object();
    user.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("role", "user");
    user.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("content", request);
    messages.add (user);
    trimConversation();

    auto shown = object();
    shown.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("role", "user");
    shown.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("text", request);
    entries.add (shown);

    busy = true;
    stopping = false;
    changed = false;
    steps = 0;
    error.clear();
    requestText = request;
    requestId = juce::Uuid().toString();

    if (hooks.requestStarted) hooks.requestStarted (request);
    if (hooks.stateChanged) hooks.stateChanged();
    callModel();
}

void AiAgent::callModel()
{
    // The system prompt and the tool list are the same every call: marked for caching.
    auto system = object();
    system.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("type", "text");
    system.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("text", systemPrompt());
    auto cache = object();
    cache.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("type", "ephemeral");
    system.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("cache_control", cache);

    auto toolList = AiTools::definitions();
    juce::Array<juce::var> cachedTools;

    if (const auto* list = toolList.getArray())
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < list->size(); ++i)
        {
            auto copy = juce::JSON::parse (juce::JSON::toString (list->getReference (i), true));

            if (i == list->size() - 1)
                copy.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("cache_control", cache);

            cachedTools.add (copy);
        }
    }

    auto body = object();
    auto* fields = body.getDynamicObject();
    fields->setProperty ("request_id", requestId);
    fields->setProperty ("system", juce::Array<juce::var> { system });
    fields->setProperty ("tools", cachedTools);
    fields->setProperty ("messages", messages);
    fields->setProperty ("max_tokens", 4096);

    cloud.invokeFunction (functionName, body, [this, flag = alive] (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
    {
        if (*flag)
            onAnswer (result, answer);
    });
}

void AiAgent::onAnswer (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer)
{
    if (! busy)
        return;

    if (answer.hasProperty ("fanan"))
        usage = answer.getProperty ("fanan", {});

    if (result.failed())
    {
        finish (result.getErrorMessage());
        return;
    }

    const auto* content = answer.getProperty ("content", {}).getArray();

    if (content == nullptr)
    {
        finish ("The AI's answer was empty.");
        return;
    }

    auto assistant = object();
    assistant.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("role", "assistant");
    assistant.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("content", *content);
    messages.add (assistant);

    juce::Array<juce::var> results;
    auto& entry = currentEntry();

    for (const auto& block : *content)
    {
        const auto type = block.getProperty ("type", {}).toString();

        if (type == "text")
        {
            const auto text = block.getProperty ("text", {}).toString().trim();
            const auto before = entry.getProperty ("text", {}).toString();

            if (text.isNotEmpty())
                entry.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("text", before.isEmpty() ? text : before + "\n\n" + text);
        }
        else if (type == "tool_use")
        {
            const auto name = block.getProperty ("name", {}).toString();
            const auto input = block.getProperty ("input", {});

            // Stopped: what's asked isn't done any more, but every call still gets an answer.
            const auto outcome = stopping ? juce::var() : tools.run (name, input);
            const auto failed = stopping || outcome.hasProperty ("error");

            if (! stopping && ! looksOnly (name) && ! failed)
                changed = true;

            if (const auto line = stopping ? juce::String() : AiTools::describe (name, input, outcome); line.isNotEmpty())
            {
                auto step = object();
                step.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("text", line);
                step.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("ok", ! failed);

                if (auto* steps_ = entry.getProperty ("steps", {}).getArray())
                    steps_->add (step);
            }

            auto toolResult = object();
            auto* r = toolResult.getDynamicObject();
            r->setProperty ("type", "tool_result");
            r->setProperty ("tool_use_id", block.getProperty ("id", {}).toString());
            r->setProperty ("content", stopping ? juce::String ("The user stopped the request.") : juce::JSON::toString (outcome, true));

            if (failed)
                r->setProperty ("is_error", true);

            results.add (toolResult);
        }
    }

    if (hooks.stateChanged) hooks.stateChanged();

    if (results.isEmpty() || answer.getProperty ("stop_reason", {}).toString() != "tool_use")
    {
        finish();
        return;
    }

    auto user = object();
    user.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("role", "user");
    user.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("content", results);
    messages.add (user);

    if (stopping)
    {
        finish ("Stopped.");
        return;
    }

    if (++steps >= maxSteps)
    {
        finish ("Stopped after " + juce::String (maxSteps) + " steps: ask again to carry on.");
        return;
    }

    callModel();
}

void AiAgent::finish (const juce::String& problem)
{
    busy = false;
    stopping = false;
    error = problem;

    // A request that ended mid-way leaves the conversation where the model can pick it up.
    if (messages.size() > 0 && messages.getReference (messages.size() - 1).getProperty ("role", {}).toString() == "user"
        && messages.getReference (messages.size() - 1).getProperty ("content", {}).isArray())
    {
        auto note = object();
        note.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("role", "assistant");
        auto text = object();
        text.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("type", "text");
        text.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("text", "(The request ended here.)");
        note.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("content", juce::Array<juce::var> { text });
        messages.add (note);
    }

    if (hooks.requestEnded) hooks.requestEnded (requestText, changed);
    if (hooks.stateChanged) hooks.stateChanged();
}

void AiAgent::stop()
{
    if (busy)
        stopping = true;   // the answer on its way is the last
}

void AiAgent::clear()
{
    if (busy)
        return;

    messages.clear();
    entries.clear();
    error.clear();
    if (hooks.stateChanged) hooks.stateChanged();
}

juce::var AiAgent::getState() const
{
    auto state = object();
    auto* fields = state.getDynamicObject();
    fields->setProperty ("busy", busy);
    fields->setProperty ("stopping", stopping);
    fields->setProperty ("entries", entries);
    fields->setProperty ("error", error);
    fields->setProperty ("usage", usage);
    fields->setProperty ("steps", steps);
    return state;
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\AiAgent.h

#pragma once

#include "AiTools.h"
#include "Cloud.h"

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <functional>
#include <memory>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The Hub's AI: Claude, driving the DAW with AiTools.

    A request goes to Fanan's server (its aiChat function holds the API key, picks the
    model and counts the user's allowance). The model answers with text and tool calls;
    the tools run here and their results go back, until the model is done. Everything one
    request does is one undo step: the Hub takes the song before and after it.

    Runs on the message thread; only the network waits happen on Cloud's worker.
*/
class AiAgent final
{
public:
    struct Hooks
    {
        std::function<void (const juce::String& request)> requestStarted;   // the Hub keeps the song as it was
        std::function<void (const juce::String& request, bool changed)> requestEnded;   // ... and makes it one undo step
        std::function<void()> stateChanged;                                 // tell the page (and show the song as it is)
    };

    AiAgent (Cloud& cloud, AiTools& tools, Hooks hooks);
    ~AiAgent();

    void send (const juce::String& text);
    void stop();
    void clear();

    bool isBusy() const noexcept                    { return busy; }

    /** For the page: { busy, entries: [{ role, text, steps: [{ text, ok }] }], error, usage }. */
    juce::var getState() const;

    static juce::String systemPrompt();
    static constexpr int maxSteps = 40;   // model calls in one request
    static constexpr const char* functionName = "aiChat";

private:
    void callModel();
    void onAnswer (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& answer);
    void finish (const juce::String& problem = {});
    juce::var& currentEntry();
    void trimConversation();

    Cloud& cloud;
    AiTools& tools;
    Hooks hooks;

    juce::Array<juce::var> messages;   // the conversation, in the model's own format
    juce::Array<juce::var> entries;    // what the page shows
    juce::String requestText, requestId, error;
    juce::var usage;
    bool busy = false, stopping = false, changed = false;
    int steps = 0;
    std::shared_ptr<bool> alive = std::make_shared<bool> (true);

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (AiAgent)
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\AiTools.cpp

#include "AiTools.h"

namespace
{
    juce::var object()
    {
        return juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
    }

    juce::var failure (const juce::String& message)
    {
        auto result = object();
        result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("error", message);
        return result;
    }

    juce::var success()
    {
        auto result = object();
        result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("ok", true);
        return result;
    }

    double number (const juce::var& value, double fallback)
    {
        if (value.isInt() || value.isInt64() || value.isDouble())
            return static_cast<double> (value);

        if (value.isString() && value.toString().trim().containsOnly ("0123456789.-+eE"))
            return value.toString().getDoubleValue();

        return fallback;
    }

    // The tool list, as the model reads it.
    const char* toolJson = R"json([
{"name":"get_song","description":"The whole song at a glance: tempo, time signature, transport, Main's inserts, every track and FX channel with its id, instrument, inserts (with ids), sends, MIDI inputs and clips. Call it first, and again after changes when you need fresh ids.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{}}},
{"name":"get_clip","description":"The notes of one MIDI clip: pitch, start and length in beats from the clip's start, velocity 1-127.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"track_id":{"type":"integer"},"clip_id":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["track_id","clip_id"]}},
{"name":"find_plugins","description":"Search the user's installed plugins by name, vendor or type (e.g. 'serum', 'compressor', 'reverb valhalla'). Use the returned name (or file and plugin_id) to load one.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"},"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["instrument","effect","any"]}},"required":["query"]}},
{"name":"add_track","description":"Add a track. kind: instrument (plays MIDI through an instrument plugin), audio (plays and records audio). For effect returns use add_fx_channel.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["instrument","audio"]},"name":{"type":"string"}},"required":["kind"]}},
{"name":"remove_track","description":"Remove a track or FX channel. Only with confirmed: true, after the user said yes in this conversation; otherwise ask them first.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"track_id":{"type":"integer"},"confirmed":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["track_id","confirmed"]}},
{"name":"set_track","description":"Change a track or FX channel: name, volume_db (-60..10), pan (-1 left..1 right), mute, solo, monitor (hear its live input), record_arm.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"track_id":{"type":"integer"},"name":{"type":"string"},"volume_db":{"type":"number"},"pan":{"type":"number"},"mute":{"type":"boolean"},"solo":{"type":"boolean"},"monitor":{"type":"boolean"},"record_arm":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["track_id"]}},
{"name":"set_main","description":"Main output volume in dB (-60..10).","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"volume_db":{"type":"number"}},"required":["volume_db"]}},
{"name":"load_instrument","description":"Load an instrument plugin onto an instrument track (replacing its instrument). plugin: its name as find_plugins gave it.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"track_id":{"type":"integer"},"plugin":{"type":"string"},"file":{"type":"string"},"plugin_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["track_id"]}},
{"name":"add_effect","description":"Add an effect plugin to a channel's insert chain: channel is a track id, an FX channel id, or \"main\". position: 0 is first; omit to add last. Answers the new insert_id.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"channel":{},"plugin":{"type":"string"},"file":{"type":"string"},"plugin_id":{"type":"string"},"position":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["channel"]}},
{"name":"remove_effect","description":"Remove an insert from a channel. slot \"instrument\" removes a track's instrument (back to the Test Synth).","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"channel":{},"insert_id":{}},"required":["channel","insert_id"]}},
{"name":"move_effect","description":"Move an insert to a position in its chain (0 is first).","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"channel":{},"insert_id":{"type":"integer"},"position":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["channel","insert_id","position"]}},
{"name":"bypass_effect","description":"Switch an insert off (bypassed: true) or on.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"channel":{},"insert_id":{"type":"integer"},"bypassed":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["channel","insert_id","bypassed"]}},
{"name":"get_plugin_params","description":"A plugin's parameters: index, name, value in its own range (min..max) and the value as text. slot: \"instrument\" or an insert id. Use filter (a word in the names) for plugins with many parameters; offset pages through long lists.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"channel":{},"slot":{},"filter":{"type":"string"},"offset":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["channel","slot"]}},
{"name":"set_plugin_params","description":"Set a plugin's parameters, each by index or by name, value in the parameter's own range (see get_plugin_params). Answers each parameter's new value as text.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"channel":{},"slot":{},"changes":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"index":{"type":"integer"},"name":{"type":"string"},"value":{"type":"number"}},"required":["value"]}}},"required":["channel","slot","changes"]}},
{"name":"add_fx_channel","description":"Add an FX channel (a return for reverb, delay...): tracks send to it with add_send. Answers its id; add its effects with add_effect.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"}}}},
{"name":"add_send","description":"Send a track's sound (after its fader) to an FX channel, at level_db (default 0).","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"track_id":{"type":"integer"},"fx_channel_id":{"type":"integer"},"level_db":{"type":"number"}},"required":["track_id","fx_channel_id"]}},
{"name":"add_sidechain","description":"Send a track into a plugin's sidechain input (to duck a bass under the kick, say). The plugin must have a sidechain input (get_song shows has_sidechain) and sit on another channel.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"source_track_id":{"type":"integer"},"channel":{},"slot":{},"level_db":{"type":"number"}},"required":["source_track_id","channel","slot"]}},
{"name":"set_send","description":"Change a send: level_db, on.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"track_id":{"type":"integer"},"send_id":{"type":"integer"},"level_db":{"type":"number"},"on":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["track_id","send_id"]}},
{"name":"remove_send","description":"Remove a send (an FX send or a sidechain send).","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"track_id":{"type":"integer"},"send_id":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["track_id","send_id"]}},
{"name":"write_midi_clip","description":"Write a MIDI clip on an instrument track. start_bar counts from 1; length_bars its length. Each note: pitch (MIDI 0-127, 60 = middle C), start_beat (quarter notes from the clip's start), length_beats, velocity (1-127). replace: remove the track's clips that overlap it first.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"track_id":{"type":"integer"},"start_bar":{"type":"number"},"length_bars":{"type":"number"},"notes":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"pitch":{"type":"integer"},"start_beat":{"type":"number"},"length_beats":{"type":"number"},"velocity":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["pitch","start_beat","length_beats"]}},"replace":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["track_id","start_bar","length_bars","notes"]}},
{"name":"delete_clip","description":"Delete a clip from a track.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"track_id":{"type":"integer"},"clip_id":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["track_id","clip_id"]}},
{"name":"set_tempo","description":"The song's tempo in BPM (20-300).","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"bpm":{"type":"number"}},"required":["bpm"]}},
{"name":"set_time_signature","description":"The song's time signature, e.g. 4/4 or 6/8.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"numerator":{"type":"integer"},"denominator":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["numerator","denominator"]}},
{"name":"transport","description":"play, stop, or rewind (to the start). Optional loop_start_bar and loop_end_bar set and switch on the loop; loop_off switches it off.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["play","stop","rewind","none"]},"loop_start_bar":{"type":"number"},"loop_end_bar":{"type":"number"},"loop_off":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["action"]}},
{"name":"open_plugin_window","description":"Open a plugin's window for the user to see.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"channel":{},"slot":{}},"required":["channel","slot"]}},
{"name":"save_song","description":"Save the song (to its file; a song never saved asks the user where).","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{}}}
])json";
}

AiTools::AiTools (AudioEngine& e, Library& l, Hooks h)
    : engine (e), library (l), hooks (std::move (h))
{
}

juce::var AiTools::definitions()
{
    static const juce::var parsed = juce::JSON::parse (juce::String (toolJson));
    return parsed;
}

double AiTools::quartersPerBar() const
{
    const auto state = engine.getTransport().getState();
    return juce::jmax (0.25, static_cast<double> (state.numerator) * 4.0 / static_cast<double> (juce::jmax (1, state.denominator)));
}

int AiTools::channelOf (const juce::var& value, juce::String& error) const
{
    if (value.toString().trim().equalsIgnoreCase ("main"))
        return AudioEngine::mainChannel;

    const auto id = static_cast<int> (number (value, -1.0));

    if (id == AudioEngine::mainChannel)
        return AudioEngine::mainChannel;

    if (id < 0 || engine.findTrack (id) == nullptr)
    {
        error = "There's no track or FX channel " + value.toString() + ". Call get_song for the ids.";
        return -1;
    }

    return id;
}

Plugin* AiTools::pluginAt (int channel, const juce::var& slot, int& slotId, juce::String& error)
{
    slotId = slot.toString().trim().equalsIgnoreCase ("instrument") ? AudioEngine::instrumentSlot
                                                                    : static_cast<int> (number (slot, -1.0));

    if (slotId < 0)
    {
        error = "slot is \"instrument\" or an insert id.";
        return nullptr;
    }

    if (auto* plugin = engine.getPlugin (channel, slotId))
        return plugin;

    error = slotId == AudioEngine::instrumentSlot ? "That track has no instrument plugin (it plays the Test Synth)."
                                                  : "There's no insert " + juce::String (slotId) + " on that channel.";
    return nullptr;
}

const Library::Entry* AiTools::findEntry (const juce::var& input, const juce::String& wantKind, juce::String& error) const
{
    const auto file = input.getProperty ("file", {}).toString();
    const auto id = input.getProperty ("plugin_id", {}).toString();
    const auto name = input.getProperty ("plugin", {}).toString().trim();

    const auto kindFits = [&wantKind] (const Library::Entry& entry)
    {
        return wantKind == "instrument" ? entry.kind == "instrument" : entry.kind != "instrument";
    };

    const Library::Entry* found = nullptr;

    for (const auto& entry : library.getEntries())
    {
        if (entry.missing || ! kindFits (entry))
            continue;

        if (file.isNotEmpty() && entry.file == file && (id.isEmpty() || entry.id == id))
            return &entry;

        if (name.isNotEmpty() && entry.name.equalsIgnoreCase (name))
            return &entry;

        if (found == nullptr && name.isNotEmpty() && entry.name.containsIgnoreCase (name))
            found = &entry;
    }

    if (found == nullptr)
        error = "No " + (wantKind == "instrument" ? juce::String ("instrument") : juce::String ("effect"))
              + " called \"" + (name.isNotEmpty() ? name : file) + "\" is installed. Use find_plugins to see what is.";

    return found;
}

//==============================================================================
juce::var AiTools::run (const juce::String& name, const juce::var& input)
{
    if (name == "get_song")            return getSong();
    if (name == "get_clip")            return getClip (input);
    if (name == "find_plugins")        return findPlugins (input);
    if (name == "add_track")           return addTrack (input);
    if (name == "remove_track")        return removeTrack (input);
    if (name == "set_track")           return setTrack (input);
    if (name == "set_main")            return setMain (input);
    if (name == "load_instrument")     return loadPlugin (input, true);
    if (name == "add_effect")          return loadPlugin (input, false);
    if (name == "remove_effect")       return removeEffect (input);
    if (name == "move_effect")         return moveEffect (input);
    if (name == "bypass_effect")       return bypassEffect (input);
    if (name == "get_plugin_params")   return getPluginParams (input);
    if (name == "set_plugin_params")   return setPluginParams (input);
    if (name == "add_fx_channel")      return addFxChannel (input);
    if (name == "add_send")            return addSend (input, false);
    if (name == "add_sidechain")       return addSend (input, true);
    if (name == "set_send")            return setSend (input);
    if (name == "remove_send")         return removeSend (input);
    if (name == "write_midi_clip")     return writeMidiClip (input);
    if (name == "delete_clip")         return deleteClip (input);
    if (name == "set_tempo")           return setTempo (input);
    if (name == "set_time_signature")  return setTimeSignature (input);
    if (name == "transport")           return transport (input);

    if (name == "open_plugin_window")
    {
        juce::String error;
        const auto channel = channelOf (input.getProperty ("channel", {}), error);
        int slot = 0;

        if (channel < 0 || pluginAt (channel, input.getProperty ("slot", {}), slot, error) == nullptr)
            return failure (error);

        return hooks.openWindow != nullptr && hooks.openWindow (channel, slot) ? success() : failure ("Its window couldn't open.");
    }

    if (name == "save_song")
    {
        const auto result = hooks.saveSong != nullptr ? hooks.saveSong() : juce::Result::fail ("Saving isn't available.");
        return result.wasOk() ? success() : failure (result.getErrorMessage());
    }

    return failure ("There's no tool called " + name + ".");
}

//==============================================================================
juce::var AiTools::getSong()
{
    const auto state = engine.getTransport().getState();
    const auto qpb = quartersPerBar();
    const auto bar = [qpb] (double ppq) { return std::round ((ppq / qpb + 1.0) * 1000.0) / 1000.0; };

    const auto insertsOf = [] (const EffectChain& chain)
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> list;

        for (int i = 0; i < chain.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto* insert = chain.at (i);
            auto item = object();
            auto* fields = item.getDynamicObject();
            fields->setProperty ("id", insert->id);
            fields->setProperty ("name", insert->plugin != nullptr ? insert->plugin->getDescriptor().name : juce::String ("?"));
            fields->setProperty ("bypassed", insert->bypassed.load());

            if (insert->plugin != nullptr && insert->plugin->hasSidechain())
                fields->setProperty ("has_sidechain", true);

            list.add (item);
        }

        return list;
    };

    auto song = object();
    auto* fields = song.getDynamicObject();
    fields->setProperty ("tempo", state.bpm);
    fields->setProperty ("time_signature", juce::String (state.numerator) + "/" + juce::String (state.denominator));
    fields->setProperty ("playing", state.playing);
    fields->setProperty ("position_bar", bar (state.ppq));

    auto loop = object();
    loop.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("on", state.loopEnabled);
    loop.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("start_bar", bar (state.loopStart));
    loop.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("end_bar", bar (state.loopEnd));
    fields->setProperty ("loop", loop);

    auto main = object();
    main.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("volume_db", engine.getMasterVolume());
    main.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("inserts", insertsOf (engine.getMainInserts()));
    fields->setProperty ("main", main);

    juce::Array<juce::var> tracks, fxChannels;

    for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
    {
        auto item = object();
        auto* t = item.getDynamicObject();
        const auto isFx = track->kind == Track::Kind::fx;
        t->setProperty ("id", track->id);
        t->setProperty ("name", track->name);
        t->setProperty ("kind", track->kind == Track::Kind::audio ? "audio" : isFx ? "fx" : "instrument");
        t->setProperty ("volume_db", track->volumeDb.load());
        t->setProperty ("pan", track->pan.load());
        t->setProperty ("mute", track->mute.load());
        t->setProperty ("solo", track->solo.load());

        if (! isFx)
        {
            t->setProperty ("monitor", track->monitor.load());
            t->setProperty ("record_arm", track->recordArm.load());
        }

        if (track->kind == Track::Kind::instrument)
        {
            if (track->instrument != nullptr)
            {
                auto instrument = object();
                instrument.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("name", track->instrument->getDescriptor().name);
                if (track->instrument->producesMidi()) instrument.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("plays_notes_out", true);
                if (track->instrument->hasSidechain()) instrument.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("has_sidechain", true);
                t->setProperty ("instrument", instrument);
            }
            else
            {
                t->setProperty ("instrument", "Test Synth (built in)");
            }

            juce::Array<juce::var> inputs;
            for (const auto& source : track->midiInputs) inputs.add (source);
            t->setProperty ("midi_inputs", inputs);
        }

        t->setProperty ("inserts", insertsOf (track->inserts));

        juce::Array<juce::var> sends;

        for (const auto& send : track->sends)
        {
            auto s = object();
            s.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("id", send.id);
            s.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("sidechain", send.sidechain);
            s.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("to", send.target);
            if (send.sidechain) s.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("slot", send.slot);
            s.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("level_db", send.levelDb);
            s.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("on", send.on);
            sends.add (s);
        }

        if (! isFx)
        {
            t->setProperty ("sends", sends);

            juce::Array<juce::var> clips;

            for (const auto& clip : engine.getClips (track->id))
            {
                auto c = object();
                c.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("id", clip.id);
                c.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("start_bar", bar (clip.start));
                c.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("length_bars", std::round (clip.length / qpb * 1000.0) / 1000.0);

                if (clip.audioFile.isNotEmpty())
                    c.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("audio", juce::File (clip.audioFile).getFileName());
                else
                    c.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("notes", static_cast<int> (clip.notes.size()));

                clips.add (c);
            }

            t->setProperty ("clips", clips);
        }

        (isFx ? fxChannels : tracks).add (item);
    }

    fields->setProperty ("tracks", tracks);
    fields->setProperty ("fx_channels", fxChannels);
    fields->setProperty ("selected_track", engine.getSelectedTrackId());
    return song;
}

juce::var AiTools::getClip (const juce::var& input)
{
    const auto trackId = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("track_id", {}), -1.0));
    const auto clipId = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("clip_id", {}), -1.0));

    for (const auto& clip : engine.getClips (trackId))
    {
        if (clip.id != clipId)
            continue;

        juce::Array<juce::var> notes;

        for (const auto& note : clip.notes)
        {
            if (note.start < clip.offset || note.start >= clip.offset + clip.length)
                continue;   // hidden by the clip's edges

            auto n = object();
            n.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("pitch", note.pitch);
            n.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("start_beat", note.start - clip.offset);
            n.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("length_beats", note.length);
            n.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("velocity", juce::roundToInt (note.velocity * 127.0f));
            notes.add (n);
        }

        auto result = object();
        result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("notes", notes);
        return result;
    }

    return failure ("There's no clip " + juce::String (clipId) + " on track " + juce::String (trackId) + ".");
}

juce::var AiTools::findPlugins (const juce::var& input)
{
    const auto words = juce::StringArray::fromTokens (input.getProperty ("query", {}).toString().toLowerCase(), true);
    const auto kind = input.getProperty ("kind", "any").toString();
    std::vector<std::pair<int, const Library::Entry*>> scored;

    for (const auto& entry : library.getEntries())
    {
        if (entry.missing)
            continue;

        if (kind == "instrument" && entry.kind != "instrument")
            continue;

        if (kind == "effect" && entry.kind == "instrument")
            continue;

        const auto haystack = (entry.name + " " + entry.vendor + " " + entry.category + " " + entry.features.joinIntoString (" ")).toLowerCase();
        int score = 0;
        bool all = true;

        for (const auto& word : words)
        {
            if (! haystack.contains (word)) { all = false; break; }
            score += entry.name.toLowerCase().contains (word) ? 3 : 1;
        }

        if (all)
            scored.push_back ({ score + (entry.name.equalsIgnoreCase (words.joinIntoString (" ")) ? 10 : 0), &entry });
    }

    std::stable_sort (scored.begin(), scored.end(), [] (const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.first > b.first; });

    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < scored.size() && i < 15; ++i)
    {
        const auto& entry = *scored[i].second;
        auto item = object();
        auto* f = item.getDynamicObject();
        f->setProperty ("name", entry.name);
        f->setProperty ("vendor", entry.vendor);
        f->setProperty ("kind", entry.kind);
        f->setProperty ("type", entry.category);
        f->setProperty ("format", entry.format());
        f->setProperty ("file", entry.file);
        f->setProperty ("plugin_id", entry.id);
        list.add (item);
    }

    auto result = object();
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("plugins", list);

    if (list.isEmpty())
        result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("note", "Nothing installed matches. Try a shorter word or a type (synth, reverb, compressor).");

    return result;
}

juce::var AiTools::addTrack (const juce::var& input)
{
    const auto kind = input.getProperty ("kind", "instrument").toString() == "audio" ? Track::Kind::audio : Track::Kind::instrument;
    const auto id = engine.addTrack (kind);

    if (const auto name = input.getProperty ("name", {}).toString().trim(); name.isNotEmpty())
        engine.setTrackName (id, name);

    auto result = object();
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("track_id", id);
    return result;
}

juce::var AiTools::removeTrack (const juce::var& input)
{
    const auto id = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("track_id", {}), -1.0));

    if (! static_cast<bool> (input.getProperty ("confirmed", false)))
        return failure ("Removing a track needs the user's yes: ask them, then call again with confirmed: true.");

    if (engine.findTrack (id) == nullptr)
        return failure ("There's no track " + juce::String (id) + ".");

    engine.removeTrack (id);
    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::setTrack (const juce::var& input)
{
    const auto id = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("track_id", {}), -1.0));
    auto* track = engine.findTrack (id);

    if (track == nullptr)
        return failure ("There's no track " + juce::String (id) + ".");

    if (input.hasProperty ("name"))       engine.setTrackName (id, input.getProperty ("name", {}).toString());
    if (input.hasProperty ("volume_db"))  track->volumeDb = static_cast<float> (juce::jlimit (-144.0, 10.0, number (input.getProperty ("volume_db", {}), 0.0)));
    if (input.hasProperty ("pan"))        track->pan = static_cast<float> (juce::jlimit (-1.0, 1.0, number (input.getProperty ("pan", {}), 0.0)));
    if (input.hasProperty ("mute"))       track->mute = static_cast<bool> (input.getProperty ("mute", false));
    if (input.hasProperty ("solo"))       track->solo = static_cast<bool> (input.getProperty ("solo", false));
    if (input.hasProperty ("monitor"))    engine.setTrackMonitor (id, static_cast<bool> (input.getProperty ("monitor", false)));
    if (input.hasProperty ("record_arm")) engine.setTrackRecordArm (id, static_cast<bool> (input.getProperty ("record_arm", false)));
    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::setMain (const juce::var& input)
{
    engine.setMasterVolume (static_cast<float> (juce::jlimit (-144.0, 10.0, number (input.getProperty ("volume_db", {}), 0.0))));
    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::loadPlugin (const juce::var& input, bool instrument)
{
    juce::String error;
    const auto channel = instrument ? static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("track_id", {}), -1.0))
                                    : channelOf (input.getProperty ("channel", {}), error);

    if (instrument)
    {
        auto* track = engine.findTrack (channel);

        if (track == nullptr || track->kind != Track::Kind::instrument)
            return failure ("Instruments load onto instrument tracks: there's no instrument track " + input.getProperty ("track_id", {}).toString() + ".");
    }
    else if (channel < 0)
    {
        return failure (error);
    }

    const auto* entry = findEntry (input, instrument ? "instrument" : "effect", error);

    if (entry == nullptr)
        return failure (error);

    const auto position = input.hasProperty ("position") ? static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("position", {}), -1.0)) : -1;
    int used = 0;
    const auto loaded = engine.loadPlugin (channel, juce::File (entry->file), entry->id, position, 0, used);

    if (loaded.failed())
        return failure (entry->name + " couldn't load: " + loaded.getErrorMessage());

    auto result = object();
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("name", entry->name);

    if (! instrument)
        result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("insert_id", used);

    return result;
}

juce::var AiTools::removeEffect (const juce::var& input)
{
    juce::String error;
    const auto channel = channelOf (input.getProperty ("channel", {}), error);

    if (channel < 0)
        return failure (error);

    int slot = 0;

    if (pluginAt (channel, input.getProperty ("insert_id", {}), slot, error) == nullptr)
        return failure (error);

    if (slot == AudioEngine::instrumentSlot)
        engine.clearInstrument (channel);
    else
        engine.removeInsert (channel, slot);

    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::moveEffect (const juce::var& input)
{
    juce::String error;
    const auto channel = channelOf (input.getProperty ("channel", {}), error);
    int slot = 0;

    if (channel < 0 || pluginAt (channel, input.getProperty ("insert_id", {}), slot, error) == nullptr || slot == AudioEngine::instrumentSlot)
        return failure (error.isNotEmpty() ? error : juce::String ("Only inserts move."));

    engine.moveInsert (channel, slot, juce::jmax (0, static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("position", {}), 0.0))));
    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::bypassEffect (const juce::var& input)
{
    juce::String error;
    const auto channel = channelOf (input.getProperty ("channel", {}), error);
    int slot = 0;

    if (channel < 0 || pluginAt (channel, input.getProperty ("insert_id", {}), slot, error) == nullptr || slot == AudioEngine::instrumentSlot)
        return failure (error.isNotEmpty() ? error : juce::String ("Only inserts are switched off."));

    engine.setInsertBypass (channel, slot, static_cast<bool> (input.getProperty ("bypassed", true)));
    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::getPluginParams (const juce::var& input)
{
    juce::String error;
    const auto channel = channelOf (input.getProperty ("channel", {}), error);
    int slot = 0;
    auto* plugin = channel < 0 ? nullptr : pluginAt (channel, input.getProperty ("slot", {}), slot, error);

    if (plugin == nullptr)
        return failure (error);

    const auto filter = input.getProperty ("filter", {}).toString().trim();
    const auto offset = juce::jmax (0, static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("offset", {}), 0.0)));
    const auto& parameters = plugin->getParameters();
    juce::Array<juce::var> list;
    int matching = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int> (parameters.size()); ++i)
    {
        const auto& parameter = parameters[static_cast<size_t> (i)];

        if (parameter.hidden || (filter.isNotEmpty() && ! parameter.name.containsIgnoreCase (filter)))
            continue;

        if (matching++ < offset || list.size() >= 60)
            continue;

        const auto value = plugin->getParameterValue (i);
        auto item = object();
        auto* f = item.getDynamicObject();
        f->setProperty ("index", i);
        f->setProperty ("name", parameter.name);
        f->setProperty ("value", value);
        f->setProperty ("min", parameter.minValue);
        f->setProperty ("max", parameter.maxValue);
        f->setProperty ("text", plugin->getParameterText (i, value));
        if (parameter.stepped) f->setProperty ("stepped", true);
        list.add (item);
    }

    auto result = object();
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("plugin", plugin->getDescriptor().name);
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("matching", matching);
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("params", list);

    if (matching > offset + list.size())
        result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("more", "Call again with offset " + juce::String (offset + list.size()) + " for the rest.");

    return result;
}

juce::var AiTools::setPluginParams (const juce::var& input)
{
    juce::String error;
    const auto channel = channelOf (input.getProperty ("channel", {}), error);
    int slot = 0;
    auto* plugin = channel < 0 ? nullptr : pluginAt (channel, input.getProperty ("slot", {}), slot, error);

    if (plugin == nullptr)
        return failure (error);

    const auto& parameters = plugin->getParameters();
    juce::Array<juce::var> results;

    if (const auto* changes = input.getProperty ("changes", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& change : *changes)
        {
            int index = change.hasProperty ("index") ? static_cast<int> (number (change.getProperty ("index", {}), -1.0)) : -1;

            if (index < 0)
            {
                const auto name = change.getProperty ("name", {}).toString().trim();

                for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int> (parameters.size()) && index < 0; ++i)
                    if (parameters[static_cast<size_t> (i)].name.equalsIgnoreCase (name))
                        index = i;

                for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int> (parameters.size()) && index < 0 && name.isNotEmpty(); ++i)
                    if (parameters[static_cast<size_t> (i)].name.containsIgnoreCase (name))
                        index = i;
            }

            auto item = object();

            if (index < 0 || index >= static_cast<int> (parameters.size()) || parameters[static_cast<size_t> (index)].readOnly)
            {
                item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("error", "No settable parameter " + (change.hasProperty ("name") ? change.getProperty ("name", {}).toString()
                                                                                                                       : change.getProperty ("index", {}).toString()));
                results.add (item);
                continue;
            }

            const auto& parameter = parameters[static_cast<size_t> (index)];
            const auto wanted = juce::jlimit (parameter.minValue, parameter.maxValue, number (change.getProperty ("value", {}), parameter.defaultValue));
            const auto applied = engine.setPluginParameter (channel, slot, index, wanted);
            item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("name", parameter.name);
            item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("value", applied);
            item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("text", plugin->getParameterText (index, applied));
            results.add (item);
        }
    }

    auto result = object();
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("plugin", plugin->getDescriptor().name);
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("changed", results);
    return result;
}

juce::var AiTools::addFxChannel (const juce::var& input)
{
    const auto id = engine.addTrack (Track::Kind::fx);

    if (const auto name = input.getProperty ("name", {}).toString().trim(); name.isNotEmpty())
        engine.setTrackName (id, name);

    auto result = object();
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("fx_channel_id", id);
    return result;
}

juce::var AiTools::addSend (const juce::var& input, bool sidechain)
{
    Track::Send send;
    send.sidechain = sidechain;
    send.levelDb = static_cast<float> (number (input.getProperty ("level_db", {}), 0.0));
    int source = 0;

    if (sidechain)
    {
        juce::String error;
        source = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("source_track_id", {}), -1.0));
        const auto channel = channelOf (input.getProperty ("channel", {}), error);
        int slot = 0;
        auto* plugin = channel < 0 ? nullptr : pluginAt (channel, input.getProperty ("slot", {}), slot, error);

        if (plugin == nullptr)
            return failure (error);

        if (! plugin->hasSidechain())
            return failure (plugin->getDescriptor().name + " has no sidechain input.");

        send.target = channel;
        send.slot = slot;
    }
    else
    {
        source = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("track_id", {}), -1.0));
        send.target = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("fx_channel_id", {}), -1.0));
    }

    const auto id = engine.addSend (source, send);

    if (id == 0)
        return failure (sidechain ? "That sidechain send isn't possible (a track can't key a plugin on itself, and FX channels don't send)."
                                  : "That send isn't possible: check the track and the FX channel ids (FX channels don't send).");

    auto result = object();
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("send_id", id);
    return result;
}

juce::var AiTools::setSend (const juce::var& input)
{
    const auto track = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("track_id", {}), -1.0));
    const auto send = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("send_id", {}), -1.0));

    if (input.hasProperty ("level_db")) engine.setSendLevel (track, send, static_cast<float> (number (input.getProperty ("level_db", {}), 0.0)));
    if (input.hasProperty ("on"))       engine.setSendOn (track, send, static_cast<bool> (input.getProperty ("on", true)));
    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::removeSend (const juce::var& input)
{
    engine.removeSend (static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("track_id", {}), -1.0)),
                       static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("send_id", {}), -1.0)));
    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::writeMidiClip (const juce::var& input)
{
    const auto trackId = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("track_id", {}), -1.0));
    auto* track = engine.findTrack (trackId);

    if (track == nullptr || track->kind != Track::Kind::instrument)
        return failure ("MIDI clips go on instrument tracks: there's no instrument track " + juce::String (trackId) + ".");

    const auto qpb = quartersPerBar();
    MidiClip clip;
    clip.start = juce::jmax (0.0, number (input.getProperty ("start_bar", {}), 1.0) - 1.0) * qpb;
    clip.length = juce::jlimit (0.25, 4096.0, number (input.getProperty ("length_bars", {}), 1.0) * qpb);

    if (const auto* notes = input.getProperty ("notes", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& item : *notes)
        {
            MidiNote note;
            note.pitch = juce::jlimit (0, 127, static_cast<int> (number (item.getProperty ("pitch", {}), 60.0)));
            note.start = juce::jmax (0.0, number (item.getProperty ("start_beat", {}), 0.0));
            note.length = juce::jlimit (1.0 / 64.0, 4096.0, number (item.getProperty ("length_beats", {}), 0.25));
            note.velocity = static_cast<float> (juce::jlimit (1.0, 127.0, number (item.getProperty ("velocity", {}), 100.0)) / 127.0);
            clip.notes.push_back (note);

            if (clip.notes.size() >= 5000)
                break;
        }
    }

    std::sort (clip.notes.begin(), clip.notes.end(), [] (const MidiNote& a, const MidiNote& b) { return a.start < b.start; });

    // replace: the track's clips under it go first
    if (static_cast<bool> (input.getProperty ("replace", false)))
    {
        auto clips = engine.getClips (trackId);
        clips.erase (std::remove_if (clips.begin(), clips.end(), [&clip] (const MidiClip& other)
        {
            return other.start < clip.start + clip.length && clip.start < other.start + other.length;
        }), clips.end());
        engine.setClips (trackId, std::move (clips));
    }

    const auto id = engine.addClip (trackId, std::move (clip));
    auto result = object();
    result.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("clip_id", id);
    return result;
}

juce::var AiTools::deleteClip (const juce::var& input)
{
    const auto trackId = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("track_id", {}), -1.0));
    const auto clipId = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("clip_id", {}), -1.0));
    auto clips = engine.getClips (trackId);
    const auto before = clips.size();
    clips.erase (std::remove_if (clips.begin(), clips.end(), [clipId] (const MidiClip& c) { return c.id == clipId; }), clips.end());

    if (clips.size() == before)
        return failure ("There's no clip " + juce::String (clipId) + " on track " + juce::String (trackId) + ".");

    engine.setClips (trackId, std::move (clips));
    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::setTempo (const juce::var& input)
{
    engine.getTransport().setTempo (juce::jlimit (20.0, 300.0, number (input.getProperty ("bpm", {}), 120.0)));
    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::setTimeSignature (const juce::var& input)
{
    const auto numerator = juce::jlimit (1, 32, static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("numerator", {}), 4.0)));
    const auto denominator = static_cast<int> (number (input.getProperty ("denominator", {}), 4.0));

    if (denominator != 1 && denominator != 2 && denominator != 4 && denominator != 8 && denominator != 16 && denominator != 32)
        return failure ("The denominator is 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 or 32.");

    engine.getTransport().setTimeSignature (numerator, denominator);
    return success();
}

juce::var AiTools::transport (const juce::var& input)
{
    auto& t = engine.getTransport();
    const auto qpb = quartersPerBar();

    if (input.hasProperty ("loop_start_bar") && input.hasProperty ("loop_end_bar"))
    {
        const auto start = juce::jmax (0.0, number (input.getProperty ("loop_start_bar", {}), 1.0) - 1.0) * qpb;
        const auto end = juce::jmax (start + 0.25, (number (input.getProperty ("loop_end_bar", {}), 2.0) - 1.0) * qpb);
        t.setLoop (true, start, end);
    }
    else if (static_cast<bool> (input.getProperty ("loop_off", false)))
    {
        const auto state = t.getState();
        t.setLoop (false, state.loopStart, state.loopEnd);
    }

    const auto action = input.getProperty ("action", "none").toString();

    if (action == "play")        t.setPlaying (true);
    else if (action == "stop")   t.setPlaying (false);
    else if (action == "rewind") t.locate (0.0);

    return success();
}

//==============================================================================
juce::String AiTools::describe (const juce::String& name, const juce::var& input, const juce::var& result)
{
    if (result.hasProperty ("error"))
        return "Couldn't: " + result.getProperty ("error", {}).toString();

    const auto plugin = result.getProperty ("name", input.getProperty ("plugin", {})).toString();

    if (name == "add_track")          return "Added " + input.getProperty ("kind", "instrument").toString() + " track"
                                             + (input.getProperty ("name", {}).toString().isNotEmpty() ? " \"" + input.getProperty ("name", {}).toString() + "\"" : juce::String());
    if (name == "remove_track")       return "Removed a track";
    if (name == "set_track")          return "Changed a track's settings";
    if (name == "set_main")           return "Set Main to " + juce::String (static_cast<double> (input.getProperty ("volume_db", 0.0)), 1) + " dB";
    if (name == "load_instrument")    return "Loaded " + plugin + " as the instrument";
    if (name == "add_effect")         return "Added " + plugin;
    if (name == "remove_effect")      return "Removed an effect";
    if (name == "move_effect")        return "Moved an effect";
    if (name == "bypass_effect")      return static_cast<bool> (input.getProperty ("bypassed", true)) ? "Switched an effect off" : "Switched an effect on";
    if (name == "set_plugin_params")
    {
        const auto* changed = result.getProperty ("changed", {}).getArray();
        return "Set " + juce::String (changed != nullptr ? changed->size() : 0) + " parameter(s) on " + result.getProperty ("plugin", {}).toString();
    }
    if (name == "add_fx_channel")     return "Added an FX channel" + (input.getProperty ("name", {}).toString().isNotEmpty() ? " \"" + input.getProperty ("name", {}).toString() + "\"" : juce::String());
    if (name == "add_send")           return "Added a send";
    if (name == "add_sidechain")      return "Added a sidechain send";
    if (name == "set_send")           return "Changed a send";
    if (name == "remove_send")        return "Removed a send";
    if (name == "write_midi_clip")
    {
        const auto* notes = input.getProperty ("notes", {}).getArray();
        return "Wrote a " + input.getProperty ("length_bars", 1).toString() + "-bar clip with " + juce::String (notes != nullptr ? notes->size() : 0) + " notes";
    }
    if (name == "delete_clip")        return "Deleted a clip";
    if (name == "set_tempo")          return "Tempo " + input.getProperty ("bpm", {}).toString() + " BPM";
    if (name == "set_time_signature") return "Time signature " + input.getProperty ("numerator", {}).toString() + "/" + input.getProperty ("denominator", {}).toString();
    if (name == "transport")          return input.getProperty ("action", "none").toString() == "none" ? "Set the loop" : "Transport: " + input.getProperty ("action", {}).toString();
    if (name == "open_plugin_window") return "Opened a plugin's window";
    if (name == "save_song")          return "Saved the song";
    return {};   // looking only: get_song, get_clip, find_plugins, get_plugin_params
}

#pragma once

#include "AudioEngine.h"
#include "Library.h"

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <functional>

//==============================================================================
/**
    The tools the AI drives the Hub with: each a small action on the song, in the shape
    Claude's tool use expects (a name, a description, a JSON schema for its input).

    Positions are in bars (from 1) and beats (quarter notes), volumes in dB, pan -1..1,
    plugin parameters in each plugin's own range. Plugins are found in the user's library
    by name: the model never loads a file it made up. Removing a track needs confirmed:
    true, which the model only sends after the user said yes.

    Everything runs on the message thread, as the page's own commands do.
*/
class AiTools final
{
public:
    /** What the Hub itself does around the engine. */
    struct Hooks
    {
        std::function<bool (int channel, int slot)> openWindow;
        std::function<juce::Result()> saveSong;
    };

    AiTools (AudioEngine& engine, Library& library, Hooks hooks);

    /** The tool list for the model: [{ name, description, input_schema }]. */
    static juce::var definitions();

    /** Runs one tool: its result, or { error } when it couldn't. */
    juce::var run (const juce::String& name, const juce::var& input);

    /** One line on what a call did, for the page's list of changes ("" for a look-only tool). */
    static juce::String describe (const juce::String& name, const juce::var& input, const juce::var& result);

private:
    juce::var getSong();
    juce::var getClip (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var findPlugins (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var addTrack (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var removeTrack (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var setTrack (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var setMain (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var loadPlugin (const juce::var& input, bool instrument);
    juce::var removeEffect (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var moveEffect (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var bypassEffect (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var getPluginParams (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var setPluginParams (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var addFxChannel (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var addSend (const juce::var& input, bool sidechain);
    juce::var setSend (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var removeSend (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var writeMidiClip (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var deleteClip (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var setTempo (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var setTimeSignature (const juce::var& input);
    juce::var transport (const juce::var& input);

    // The channel a tool names: "main" (or 0) is Main, a number is a track or FX channel.
    int channelOf (const juce::var& value, juce::String& error) const;
    // The plugin slot on a channel: "instrument" (or 0), or an insert's id.
    Plugin* pluginAt (int channel, const juce::var& slot, int& slotId, juce::String& error);
    const Library::Entry* findEntry (const juce::var& input, const juce::String& wantKind, juce::String& error) const;
    double quartersPerBar() const;

    AudioEngine& engine;
    Library& library;
    Hooks hooks;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (AiTools)
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\AudioEngine.cpp

#include "AudioEngine.h"

#include "Vst3Plugin.h"    // JUCE's VST3 host is let go at shutdown
#include "WclapPlugin.h"   // the WebAssembly engine is shut down last

//==============================================================================
// Mixdown
class AudioEngine::MixdownThread final : public juce::Thread
{
public:
    MixdownThread (AudioEngine& e, MixdownSettings s, juce::int64 range, juce::int64 total, double rate, int block)
        : Thread ("Fanan mixdown"), engine (e), settings (std::move (s)), rangeSamples (range), totalSamples (total),
          sampleRate (rate), blockSize (block)
    {
    }

    void run() override
    {
        const bool convert = settings.outputRate > 0.0 && ! juce::approximatelyEqual (settings.outputRate, sampleRate);
        const auto renderFile = convert ? settings.file.getSiblingFile (settings.file.getFileNameWithoutExtension() + ".rendering.wav")
                                        : settings.file;

        // Rendered at the device's rate (float when it's converted afterwards).
        auto writer = makeWriter (renderFile, sampleRate, convert ? 32 : settings.bits);

        if (writer == nullptr)
        {
            result = juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + renderFile.getFullPathName());
            return;
        }

        juce::AudioBuffer<float> buffer (2, blockSize);
        juce::int64 done = 0;
        bool stopped = false;

        while (done < totalSamples)
        {
            if (threadShouldExit())
            {
                writer.reset();
                renderFile.deleteFile();
                result = juce::Result::fail ("Cancelled");
                return;
            }

            // The range ends exactly: the song stops there, and what still sounds rings out.
            if (! stopped && done >= rangeSamples)
            {
                engine.transport.setPlaying (false);
                stopped = true;
            }

            auto count = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (blockSize, totalSamples - done));

            if (! stopped)
                count = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (count, rangeSamples - done));

            engine.renderBlock (nullptr, 0, buffer.getArrayOfWritePointers(), 2, count);
            writer->writeFromAudioSampleBuffer (buffer, 0, count);
            done += count;
            progress.store (static_cast<double> (done) / static_cast<double> (totalSamples) * (convert ? 0.9 : 1.0));
        }

        writer.reset();

        if (convert)
        {
            const auto converted = convertRate (renderFile);
            renderFile.deleteFile();

            if (! converted)
            {
                settings.file.deleteFile();
                result = threadShouldExit() ? juce::Result::fail ("Cancelled")
                                            : juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't convert the mixdown to " + juce::String (settings.outputRate / 1000.0, 1) + " kHz");
                return;
            }
        }

        progress.store (1.0);
        result = juce::Result::ok();
    }

    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatWriter> makeWriter (const juce::File& file, double rate, int bits) const
    {
        file.deleteFile();
        std::unique_ptr<juce::OutputStream> stream = file.createOutputStream();

        if (stream == nullptr)
            return nullptr;

        return juce::WavAudioFormat().createWriterFor (stream, juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions{}
                                                                 .withSampleRate (rate)
                                                                 .withNumChannels (2)
                                                                 .withBitsPerSample (bits)
                                                                 .withSampleFormat (bits == 32 ? juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions::SampleFormat::floatingPoint
                                                                                               : juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions::SampleFormat::integral));
    }

    /** The rendered file at the rate asked for. */
    bool convertRate (const juce::File& rendered)
    {
        juce::AudioFormatManager formats;
        formats.registerBasicFormats();
        std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatReader> reader (formats.createReaderFor (rendered));
        auto writer = makeWriter (settings.file, settings.outputRate, settings.bits);

        if (reader == nullptr || writer == nullptr)
            return false;

        juce::AudioFormatReaderSource source (reader.get(), false);
        juce::ResamplingAudioSource resampler (&source, false, 2);
        resampler.setResamplingRatio (reader->sampleRate / settings.outputRate);
        resampler.prepareToPlay (blockSize, settings.outputRate);

        const auto total = static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround (static_cast<double> (reader->lengthInSamples) * settings.outputRate / reader->sampleRate));
        juce::AudioBuffer<float> buffer (2, blockSize);

        for (juce::int64 done = 0; done < total; done += blockSize)
        {
            if (threadShouldExit())
                return false;

            const auto count = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (blockSize, total - done));
            juce::AudioSourceChannelInfo info (&buffer, 0, count);
            resampler.getNextAudioBlock (info);
            writer->writeFromAudioSampleBuffer (buffer, 0, count);
            progress.store (0.9 + 0.1 * static_cast<double> (done) / static_cast<double> (total));
        }

        resampler.releaseResources();
        return true;
    }

    AudioEngine& engine;
    MixdownSettings settings;
    const juce::int64 rangeSamples, totalSamples;
    const double sampleRate;
    const int blockSize;
    std::atomic<double> progress { 0.0 };
    juce::Result result = juce::Result::fail ("Not finished");
};


#include <iterator>

namespace
{
    constexpr int midiBufferBytes = 4096;
    constexpr int minimumMixSize = 4096;

    /** Every plugin: each track's instrument and inserts, then the Main inserts. */
    template <typename Tracks, typename Function>
    void forEachPlugin (const Tracks& tracks, const EffectChain& mainInserts, Function&& function)
    {
        for (const auto& track : tracks)
        {
            if (track->instrument != nullptr)
                function (*track->instrument);

            for (int i = 0; i < track->inserts.size(); ++i)
                if (auto* insert = track->inserts.at (i); insert->plugin != nullptr)
                    function (*insert->plugin);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < mainInserts.size(); ++i)
            if (auto* insert = mainInserts.at (i); insert->plugin != nullptr)
                function (*insert->plugin);
    }

    // Track colours, assigned in turn as tracks are created.
    constexpr juce::uint32 trackPalette[] = { 0xffe5484d, 0xfff08c2e, 0xffe9c93b, 0xff4cbf67,
                                              0xff3cc0c8, 0xff3e82f7, 0xff9b6cf2, 0xffe85aa8 };

    void storeMax (std::atomic<float>& target, float value) noexcept
    {
        auto current = target.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

        while (value > current
               && ! target.compare_exchange_weak (current, value, std::memory_order_relaxed))
        {
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
AudioEngine::AudioEngine()
{
    // The real sample rate arrives in audioDeviceAboutToStart. Resetting now means MIDI that
    // arrives before the device starts is still accepted.
    midiCollector.reset (48000.0);
    midiCollector.ensureStorageAllocated (static_cast<size_t> (midiBufferBytes));
    midiBuffer.ensureSize (midiBufferBytes);

    // The audio thread orders the tracks in these every block, so they never grow there.
    renderOrder.reserve (1024);
    placed.reserve (1024);

    // A queue per MIDI device, so each track can choose which it hears.
    for (auto& collector : deviceCollectors)
    {
        collector = std::make_unique<juce::MidiMessageCollector>();
        collector->reset (48000.0);
        collector->ensureStorageAllocated (static_cast<size_t> (midiBufferBytes));
    }

    for (auto& buffer : deviceBuffers)
        buffer.ensureSize (midiBufferBytes);

    recordMidi.ensureSize (midiBufferBytes * 2);
    pageCollector.reset (48000.0);
    pageCollector.ensureStorageAllocated (static_cast<size_t> (midiBufferBytes));
    pageBuffer.ensureSize (midiBufferBytes);

    writerThread.startThread();

    // Start with one track, so the keyboard plays straight away.
    addTrack();

    openDevices();
    refreshMidiInputNames();

    deviceManager.addAudioCallback (this);
    deviceManager.addMidiInputDeviceCallback ({}, this);
    deviceManager.addChangeListener (this);
}

AudioEngine::~AudioEngine()
{
    if (mixdown != nullptr)
        mixdown->stopThread (10000);   // a render in progress is stopped (its file removed) first

    deviceManager.removeChangeListener (this);
    deviceManager.removeMidiInputDeviceCallback ({}, this);
    deviceManager.removeAudioCallback (this);
    deviceManager.closeAudioDevice();

    // A recording in progress is written out; then the writer thread can stop.
    for (auto& recording : audioRecordings)
        recording.writer.reset();

    audioRecordings.clear();
    writerThread.stopThread (4000);

    // Every plugin must be gone before the WebAssembly engine stops.
    tracks.clear();
    mainInserts.clear();
    WclapPlugin::shutdownEngine();
    Vst3Plugin::shutdownFormats();
}

//==============================================================================
void AudioEngine::openDevices()
{
    const auto savedState = juce::parseXML (getStateFile());

    // Two inputs to begin with (audio tracks record from them); Audio Settings can enable more.
    deviceManager.initialise (2, 2, savedState.get(), true);

    if (savedState != nullptr)
        return;

    // First launch: prefer an installed ASIO driver, and listen to every MIDI input.
   #if JUCE_WINDOWS
    const auto previousType = deviceManager.getCurrentAudioDeviceType();

    for (auto* type : deviceManager.getAvailableDeviceTypes())
    {
        if (type->getTypeName() != "ASIO")
            continue;

        if (! type->getDeviceNames().isEmpty())
        {
            deviceManager.setCurrentAudioDeviceType ("ASIO", true);

            if (deviceManager.getCurrentAudioDevice() == nullptr && previousType.isNotEmpty())
                deviceManager.setCurrentAudioDeviceType (previousType, true);
        }

        break;
    }
   #endif

    for (const auto& input : juce::MidiInput::getAvailableDevices())
        deviceManager.setMidiInputDeviceEnabled (input.identifier, true);

    assignMidiDeviceSlots();
}

juce::File AudioEngine::getStateFile()
{
    // Kept next to the executable, so the Hub writes nothing outside its build folder.
    return juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile)
               .getSiblingFile ("FananWebHub-audio.xml");
}

void AudioEngine::saveDeviceState()
{
    if (auto xml = deviceManager.createStateXml())
        xml->writeTo (getStateFile());
}

void AudioEngine::refreshMidiInputNames()
{
    // A device plugged in finds its slot, and the tracks that chose it by name hear it again.
    assignMidiDeviceSlots();

    for (const auto& track : tracks)
        resolveMidiInputs (*track);

    enabledMidiInputNames.clear();

    for (const auto& input : juce::MidiInput::getAvailableDevices())
        if (deviceManager.isMidiInputDeviceEnabled (input.identifier))
            enabledMidiInputNames.add (input.name);
}

void AudioEngine::changeListenerCallback (juce::ChangeBroadcaster*)
{
    saveDeviceState();
    refreshMidiInputNames();
}

//==============================================================================
void AudioEngine::queue (juce::MidiMessage message)
{
    message.setTimeStamp (juce::Time::getMillisecondCounterHiRes() * 0.001);
    pageCollector.addMessageToQueue (message);   // the page's notes: for the selected track
}

void AudioEngine::noteOn (int note, float velocity)
{
    // Velocity 0 would turn this into a note-off.
    queue (juce::MidiMessage::noteOn (1, juce::jlimit (0, 127, note), juce::jlimit (0.01f, 1.0f, velocity)));
}

void AudioEngine::noteOff (int note)
{
    queue (juce::MidiMessage::noteOff (1, juce::jlimit (0, 127, note)));
}

void AudioEngine::allNotesOff()
{
    for (int channel = 1; channel <= 16; ++channel)
        queue (juce::MidiMessage::allNotesOff (channel));

    // Tracks that are not monitoring get it too.
    for (const auto& track : tracks)
        track->requestNotesOff();
}

//==============================================================================
AudioEngine::Status AudioEngine::getStatus()
{
    Status status;

    if (auto* device = deviceManager.getCurrentAudioDevice())
    {
        status.deviceOpen = true;
        status.running = device->isPlaying();
        status.typeName = device->getTypeName();
        status.deviceName = device->getName();
        status.sampleRate = device->getCurrentSampleRate();
        status.bufferSize = device->getCurrentBufferSizeSamples();
        status.xruns = device->getXRunCount();

        if (status.sampleRate > 0.0)
        {
            status.bufferMs = 1000.0 * status.bufferSize / status.sampleRate;
            status.outputLatencyMs = 1000.0 * device->getOutputLatencyInSamples() / status.sampleRate;
        }
    }

    status.cpu = deviceManager.getCpuUsage();
    status.peakLeft = peakLeft.exchange (0.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    status.peakRight = peakRight.exchange (0.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    status.hardwareNoteOns = hardwareNoteOnCount.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
    status.notesLow = activeNotesLow.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
    status.notesHigh = activeNotesHigh.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
    status.midiInputs = enabledMidiInputNames;
    status.transport = transport.getState();

    status.trackMeters.reserve (tracks.size());

    for (const auto& track : tracks)
    {
        const auto automated = track->automationMode.load() == static_cast<int> (AutomationMode::read)
                               && std::any_of (track->automation.begin(), track->automation.end(), [] (const AutomationLane& lane)
                                               { return lane.target.kind != AutomationTarget::Kind::parameter; });

        status.trackMeters.push_back ({ track->id,
                                        track->peakLeft.exchange (0.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed),
                                        track->peakRight.exchange (0.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed),
                                        track->inputPeak.exchange (0.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed),
                                        automated, track->volumeDb.load(), track->pan.load() });
    }

    return status;
}

//==============================================================================
Track* AudioEngine::findTrack (int id) const noexcept
{
    for (const auto& track : tracks)
        if (track->id == id)
            return track.get();

    return nullptr;
}

int AudioEngine::addTrack (Track::Kind kind)
{
    const auto id = nextTrackId++;
    // Colours follow the track count, so every song starts with the same first colour.
    const auto colour = trackPalette[tracks.size() % std::size (trackPalette)];

    auto track = std::make_unique<Track> (id, colour, kind);

    if (kind == Track::Kind::audio)
    {
        // Named like Studio One's: Audio 1, Audio 2...
        const auto audioTracks = std::count_if (tracks.begin(), tracks.end(), [] (const auto& t) { return t->kind == Track::Kind::audio; });
        track->name = "Audio " + juce::String (static_cast<int> (audioTracks) + 1);
        track->nameIsAutomatic = false;
        resolveInput (*track);
    }
    else if (kind == Track::Kind::fx)
    {
        // FX 1, FX 2... (Studio One names them after their effect; the user can rename them).
        const auto fxChannels = std::count_if (tracks.begin(), tracks.end(), [] (const auto& t) { return t->kind == Track::Kind::fx; });
        track->name = "FX " + juce::String (static_cast<int> (fxChannels) + 1);
        track->nameIsAutomatic = false;
        track->monitor = false;
    }
    else
    {
        track->name = "Track " + juce::String (static_cast<int> (tracks.size()) + 1);
    }

    // Prepared before the audio thread can see it.
    if (currentSampleRate > 0.0)
        track->prepare (currentSampleRate, currentBlockSize);

    {
        const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (graphLock);
        tracks.push_back (std::move (track));
    }

    // A new track starts with Monitor off: the Monitor button alone switches it on (the page's
    // own notes still play the selected track).
    if (auto* added = findTrack (id))
        added->monitor = false;

    // A new instrument track hears the first MIDI device: the user's keyboard.
    if (kind == Track::Kind::instrument)
    {
        const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (deviceLock);

        if (! deviceSlotNames.isEmpty())
            if (auto* added = findTrack (id))
                added->midiInputs = juce::StringArray (deviceSlotNames[0]);
    }

    if (auto* added = findTrack (id))
        resolveMidiInputs (*added);

    if (kind != Track::Kind::fx)
        selectTrack (id);   // FX channels live in the Console; the selection stays on the tracks

    return id;
}

void AudioEngine::removeTrack (int id)
{
    int index = 0;
    auto removed = detachTrack (id, index);
    removed.reset();   // destroyed here, outside the lock
}

namespace
{
    /** A plugin leaving the graph (removed, replaced, or set aside for undo) closes its window. */
    void hideScreen (Plugin* plugin)
    {
        if (plugin != nullptr)
            plugin->hideNativeScreen();
    }

    void hideScreens (EffectChain& chain)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < chain.size(); ++i)
            hideScreen (chain.at (i)->plugin.get());
    }
}

std::unique_ptr<Track> AudioEngine::detachTrack (int id, int& index)
{
    std::unique_ptr<Track> removed;
    size_t position = 0;

    {
        const juce::SpinLock::ScopedLockType lock (graphLock);

        for (size_t i = 0; i < tracks.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (tracks[i]->id == id)
            {
                removed = std::move (tracks[i]);
                tracks.erase (tracks.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t> (i));
                position = i;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    if (removed == nullptr)
        return nullptr;

    hideScreen (removed->instrument.get());
    hideScreens (removed->inserts);
    index = static_cast<int> (position);

    // The selected track removed: the nearest track takes over, so while there are tracks one
    // is always selected (the next one down, or the one above).
    if (selectedTrackId == id)
    {
        selectedTrackId = 0;

        for (size_t i = position; i < tracks.size() && selectedTrackId == 0; ++i)
            if (tracks[i]->kind != Track::Kind::fx)
                selectedTrackId = tracks[i]->id;

        for (size_t i = position; i-- > 0 && selectedTrackId == 0;)
            if (tracks[i]->kind != Track::Kind::fx)
                selectedTrackId = tracks[i]->id;
    }
