//==============================================================================
/**
    Native audio side of the Hub.

    Owns the audio device (ASIO preferred on Windows), listens to hardware MIDI
    inputs, runs the transport and metronome, and plays the tracks. Notes from the
    web UI and from hardware MIDI meet in one MidiMessageCollector and go to every
    track that is monitoring; selecting a track makes it the one that monitors.

    Signal flow: each track (its clips and live notes, its source, its inserts, its
    fader) mixes into the Main channel, which runs its own inserts and fader before
    the device. The metronome is added after all of that.

    Recording: the audio thread stamps each live note with its song position and
    queues it; updateRecording() files the notes into a clip on every armed track.

    The audio thread holds the graph lock while it renders. The message thread only
    takes that lock for quick pointer swaps (adding or removing a track, installing a
    plugin); anything slow, like loading or destroying a plugin, happens outside it.
*/
class AudioEngine final : public juce::AudioIODeviceCallback,
                          public juce::MidiInputCallback,
                          private juce::ChangeListener
{
public:
    //==============================================================================
    struct TrackMeter
    {
        int id = 0;
        float left = 0.0f, right = 0.0f;
        float input = 0.0f;              // audio tracks: the live input's level
        bool automated = false;          // automation is moving its volume or pan
        float volume = 0.0f, pan = 0.0f; // their values now, when it is
    };

    struct Status
    {
        bool deviceOpen = false;
        bool running = false;
        juce::String typeName;
        juce::String deviceName;
        double sampleRate = 0.0;
        int bufferSize = 0;
        double bufferMs = 0.0;
        double outputLatencyMs = 0.0;
        double cpu = 0.0;
        int xruns = -1;
        float peakLeft = 0.0f;         // Main channel, after its fader
        float peakRight = 0.0f;
        int hardwareNoteOns = 0;
        juce::uint64 notesLow = 0;     // notes 0-63, one bit each
        juce::uint64 notesHigh = 0;    // notes 64-127
        juce::StringArray midiInputs;
        Transport::State transport;
        std::vector<TrackMeter> trackMeters;
    };

    enum class PluginChange { none, changed, failed };

    std::atomic<int> deviceSlotCount { 0 };
    juce::MidiBuffer recordMidi;                                   // audio thread: what the armed track hears

    // The page's own notes (the piano roll's), kept apart: they go to the selected track.
    juce::MidiMessageCollector pageCollector;
    juce::MidiBuffer pageBuffer;
    void assignMidiDeviceSlots();
    void resolveMidiInputs (Track& track);

    // Audio thread: this block's order of the tracks (reserved once, so it never allocates).
    std::vector<Track*> renderOrder;
    std::vector<char> placed;
    bool orderTracks() noexcept;
    void clearSidechains (int numSamples) noexcept;
    void sendFrom (Track& track, int numSamples) noexcept;
    int nextTrackId = 1;
    std::atomic<int> selectedTrackId { 0 };   // the audio thread sends the page's own notes to it

    std::atomic<bool> audioRunning { false };
    double currentSampleRate = 0.0;
    int currentBlockSize = 0;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (AudioEngine)

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\AudioMedia.cpp

#include "AudioMedia.h"

AudioMedia::AudioMedia()
{
    formats.registerBasicFormats();
}

std::shared_ptr<const AudioData> AudioMedia::get (const juce::File& file, double playbackRate, juce::String& error)
{
    const auto key = file.getFullPathName();

    if (const auto found = cache.find (key); found != cache.end() && juce::approximatelyEqual (found->second->playbackRate, playbackRate))
        return found->second;

    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioFormatReader> reader (formats.createReaderFor (file));

    if (reader == nullptr || reader->sampleRate <= 0.0)
    {
        error = file.existsAsFile() ? "Can't read " + file.getFileName() : file.getFullPathName() + " is missing";
        return nullptr;
    }

    const auto channels = juce::jlimit (1, 2, static_cast<int> (reader->numChannels));
    const auto length = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (reader->lengthInSamples, std::numeric_limits<int>::max() / 4));

    juce::AudioBuffer<float> raw (channels, juce::jmax (1, length));
    raw.clear();
    reader->read (&raw, 0, length, 0, true, channels > 1);

    auto data = std::make_shared<AudioData>();
    data->fileRate = reader->sampleRate;
    data->playbackRate = playbackRate > 0.0 ? playbackRate : reader->sampleRate;
    data->lengthSeconds = length / reader->sampleRate;

    // The waveform: the loudest and quietest sample of each bucket, both channels together.
    const auto buckets = (length + AudioData::peakBucket - 1) / AudioData::peakBucket;
    data->peaks.reserve (static_cast<size_t> (buckets) * 2);

    for (int bucket = 0; bucket < buckets; ++bucket)
    {
        const auto start = bucket * AudioData::peakBucket;
        const auto count = juce::jmin (AudioData::peakBucket, length - start);
        float high = 0.0f, low = 0.0f;

        for (int channel = 0; channel < channels; ++channel)
        {
            const auto range = juce::FloatVectorOperations::findMinAndMax (raw.getReadPointer (channel, start), count);
            high = juce::jmax (high, range.getEnd());
            low = juce::jmin (low, range.getStart());
        }

        data->peaks.push_back (static_cast<juce::int8> (juce::jlimit (-127, 127, juce::roundToInt (high * 127.0f))));
        data->peaks.push_back (static_cast<juce::int8> (juce::jlimit (-127, 127, juce::roundToInt (low * 127.0f))));
    }

    // At the device's rate, so playing it is a straight copy.
    if (juce::approximatelyEqual (data->fileRate, data->playbackRate) || length == 0)
    {
        data->samples = std::move (raw);
    }
    else
    {
        const auto ratio = data->fileRate / data->playbackRate;   // file samples per played sample
        const auto outLength = juce::jmax (1, static_cast<int> (std::ceil (length / ratio)));
        data->samples.setSize (channels, outLength);
        data->samples.clear();

        for (int channel = 0; channel < channels; ++channel)
        {
            juce::LagrangeInterpolator interpolator;
            interpolator.process (ratio, raw.getReadPointer (channel), data->samples.getWritePointer (channel), outLength, length, 0);
        }
    }

    cache[key] = data;
    newlyLoaded.push_back (key);
    return data;
}

bool AudioMedia::isAudioFile (const juce::File& file)
{
    return file.existsAsFile() && formats.findFormatForFileExtension (file.getFileExtension()) != nullptr;
}

std::vector<juce::int8> AudioMedia::peaksOf (const AudioData& data, int bucket)
{
    std::vector<juce::int8> peaks;
    const auto length = data.samples.getNumSamples();
    const auto channels = data.samples.getNumChannels();
    bucket = juce::jmax (1, bucket);
    peaks.reserve (static_cast<size_t> ((length + bucket - 1) / bucket) * 2);

    for (int start = 0; start < length; start += bucket)
    {
        const auto count = juce::jmin (bucket, length - start);
        float high = 0.0f, low = 0.0f;

        for (int channel = 0; channel < channels; ++channel)
        {
            const auto range = juce::FloatVectorOperations::findMinAndMax (data.samples.getReadPointer (channel, start), count);
            high = juce::jmax (high, range.getEnd());
            low = juce::jmin (low, range.getStart());
        }

        peaks.push_back (static_cast<juce::int8> (juce::jlimit (-127, 127, juce::roundToInt (high * 127.0f))));
        peaks.push_back (static_cast<juce::int8> (juce::jlimit (-127, 127, juce::roundToInt (low * 127.0f))));
    }

    return peaks;
}

double AudioMedia::lengthOf (const juce::File& file, double playbackRate)
{
    juce::String error;
    const auto data = get (file, playbackRate, error);
    return data != nullptr ? data->lengthSeconds : 0.0;
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\AudioMedia.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_formats/juce_audio_formats.h>

#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    An audio file in memory: its samples at the device's sample rate, ready to play
    without touching the disk, and a peak summary of it for the page's waveforms.
    Shared by every clip that plays the file, and never changed once made.
*/
struct AudioData
{
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> samples;        // at playbackRate, one or two channels
    double playbackRate = 0.0;
    double fileRate = 0.0;
    double lengthSeconds = 0.0;

    static constexpr int peakBucket = 512;   // file samples per peak pair
    std::vector<juce::int8> peaks;           // max then min per bucket, -127..127, channels mixed
};

//==============================================================================
/**
    What an audio track's clips play, flattened for the audio thread the way a
    Sequence flattens MIDI clips: built on the message thread whenever the clips
    change, handed over whole, only ever read by the audio thread.

    Starts are song positions in quarter notes; offsets and lengths are samples of the
    file. The audio thread converts with the tempo of the moment, so audio keeps its
    speed and pitch whatever the tempo does.
*/
struct AudioPlaylist
{
    struct Item
    {
        double startPpq = 0.0;
        juce::int64 offsetSamples = 0;       // where in the file the clip's window starts
        juce::int64 lengthSamples = 0;       // how much of the file the window shows
        float gain = 1.0f;
        juce::int64 fadeInSamples = 0, fadeOutSamples = 0;
        std::shared_ptr<const AudioData> data;
    };

    std::vector<Item> items;
};

//==============================================================================
/** Loads audio files into memory once and shares them. Message thread only. */
class AudioMedia final
{
public:
    AudioMedia();

    /** The file in memory at playbackRate (loaded now if it isn't yet), or null with a reason. */
    std::shared_ptr<const AudioData> get (const juce::File& file, double playbackRate, juce::String& error);

    /** How long a file plays, from memory when it's loaded; 0 when it can't be read. */
    double lengthOf (const juce::File& file, double playbackRate);

    /** Forgets everything, as when the device's sample rate changes. */
    void clear()                                            { cache.clear(); }
    void forget (const juce::File& file)                    { cache.erase (file.getFullPathName()); }

    /** Files loaded since the last call: the page needs their waveforms. */
    std::vector<juce::String> takeNewlyLoaded()             { return std::exchange (newlyLoaded, {}); }

    juce::AudioFormatManager& getFormats() noexcept         { return formats; }

    /** A file the Hub can read as audio (WAV, AIFF, FLAC, Ogg; MP3 where the system has it). */
    bool isAudioFile (const juce::File& file);

    /** Peaks at a finer grain than AudioData::peaks, from the samples in memory: bucket is
        in played samples (at data.playbackRate). For zoomed-in waveforms. */
    static std::vector<juce::int8> peaksOf (const AudioData& data, int bucket);

private:
    juce::AudioFormatManager formats;
    std::map<juce::String, std::shared_ptr<const AudioData>> cache;
    std::vector<juce::String> newlyLoaded;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (AudioMedia)
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Automation.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Automation, as in Studio One: an envelope of points (song position in quarter
    notes, value) for something on a track, joined by straight lines. Before the first
    point the envelope holds the first value; after the last, the last.

    Values are in the target's own units: dB for volume, -1..+1 for pan, and the
    parameter's own range for a plugin parameter.
*/
struct AutomationPoint
{
    double ppq = 0.0;
    double value = 0.0;
};

struct AutomationTarget
{
    enum class Kind { volume, pan, parameter };

    Kind kind = Kind::volume;
    int slot = 0;             // parameter: 0 the instrument, otherwise an insert's id
    uint32_t paramId = 0;     // parameter: its stable id

    bool operator== (const AutomationTarget& other) const noexcept
    {
        return kind == other.kind && (kind != Kind::parameter || (slot == other.slot && paramId == other.paramId));
    }
};

struct AutomationLane
{
    AutomationTarget target;
    std::vector<AutomationPoint> points;   // by position
};

enum class AutomationMode { off, read };

namespace Automation
{
    /** The envelope's value at a song position. */
    inline double valueAt (const std::vector<AutomationPoint>& points, double ppq) noexcept
    {
        if (points.empty())
            return 0.0;

        if (ppq <= points.front().ppq)
            return points.front().value;

        if (ppq >= points.back().ppq)
            return points.back().value;

        const auto after = std::upper_bound (points.begin(), points.end(), ppq,
                                             [] (double position, const AutomationPoint& point) { return position < point.ppq; });
        const auto& b = *after;
        const auto& a = *(after - 1);
        const auto span = b.ppq - a.ppq;
        return span > 0.0 ? a.value + (b.value - a.value) * (ppq - a.ppq) / span : b.value;
    }

    /** Points sorted by position, with nonsense (non-finite) values dropped. */
    inline std::vector<AutomationPoint> tidy (std::vector<AutomationPoint> points)
    {
        points.erase (std::remove_if (points.begin(), points.end(), [] (const AutomationPoint& p)
                                      { return ! std::isfinite (p.ppq) || ! std::isfinite (p.value) || p.ppq < 0.0; }),
                      points.end());
        std::stable_sort (points.begin(), points.end(), [] (const AutomationPoint& a, const AutomationPoint& b) { return a.ppq < b.ppq; });
        return points;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
/**
    A track's automation for the audio thread: built on the message thread when the
    envelopes change, handed over whole, then only used by the audio thread (which
    keeps its own notes in it: the last value it sent, and where a parameter is).
*/
struct AutomationPlayback
{
    struct Entry
    {
        AutomationTarget target;
        std::vector<AutomationPoint> points;
        int parameterIndex = -1;    // audio thread: where the parameter was last found
        double lastValue = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
    };

    std::vector<Entry> entries;
};

# Base44 prompt: the Hub's AI (server side)

Paste everything below the line into Base44's AI chat, in the **Fanan Hub Cloud app** (the same app as the accounts). Then add your Anthropic API key as described after it.

---

Add an AI backend to this app. The Fanan Web Hub desktop app sends AI requests to a backend function; the function calls Anthropic's Claude API with a secret key that never leaves the server, and counts each user's monthly allowance.

**1. User field:** add `ai_plan` to users: text, `free` or `pro`, default `free`. Only admins can change it (users can't edit their own plan).

**2. Entity `AiUsage`** (one record per user per month):
- `user_email`: text
- `month`: text (`YYYY-MM`)
- `requests`: number
- `last_request_id`: text
- `calls_this_request`: number
- `input_tokens`: number
- `output_tokens`: number

Security: no access for regular users at all (the backend function uses the service role). Admins can read everything.

**3. Secret:** a secret named `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, used only by the function below.

**4. Backend function `aiChat`**, exactly this code:

```ts
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk';

// The Fanan Web Hub's AI: forwards the Hub's request to Claude as the signed-in user,
// within their plan's monthly allowance. The API key never leaves this server.
const MODEL = 'claude-sonnet-5';
const ALLOWANCE: Record<string, number> = { free: 30, pro: 1000 };
const MAX_CALLS_PER_REQUEST = 40;
const MAX_TOKENS = 8192;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Sign in to use the AI.' }, { status: 401 });

    const body = await req.json();
    const requestId = String(body.request_id || '');
    if (!requestId || !Array.isArray(body.messages))
      return Response.json({ error: 'That request was malformed.' }, { status: 400 });

    const plan = user.ai_plan === 'pro' ? 'pro' : 'free';
    const allowance = ALLOWANCE[plan];
    const month = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);
    const found = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AiUsage.filter({ user_email: user.email, month });
    const usage = found[0];
    const isNewRequest = !usage || usage.last_request_id !== requestId;
    const used = usage ? (usage.requests || 0) : 0;

    if (isNewRequest && used >= allowance)
      return Response.json({
        error: `You've used this month's ${allowance} AI requests.` + (plan === 'free' ? ' Upgrade for more.' : ''),
        fanan: { used, allowance, plan },
      }, { status: 429 });

    if (!isNewRequest && (usage.calls_this_request || 0) >= MAX_CALLS_PER_REQUEST)
      return Response.json({ error: 'This request took too many steps.', fanan: { used, allowance, plan } }, { status: 429 });

    const answer = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'x-api-key': Deno.env.get('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') ?? '',
        'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
        'content-type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: MODEL,
        max_tokens: Math.min(Number(body.max_tokens) || 4096, MAX_TOKENS),
        system: body.system,
        tools: body.tools,
        messages: body.messages,
      }),
    });
    const data = await answer.json();

    if (!answer.ok)
      return Response.json({ error: data?.error?.message || 'The AI service failed.', fanan: { used, allowance, plan } }, { status: 502 });

    // A new request counts once; every call adds its tokens.
    const fields = {
      user_email: user.email,
      month,
      requests: used + (isNewRequest ? 1 : 0),
      last_request_id: requestId,
      calls_this_request: isNewRequest ? 1 : (usage.calls_this_request || 0) + 1,
      input_tokens: (usage?.input_tokens || 0) + (data.usage?.input_tokens || 0)
        + (data.usage?.cache_read_input_tokens || 0) + (data.usage?.cache_creation_input_tokens || 0),
      output_tokens: (usage?.output_tokens || 0) + (data.usage?.output_tokens || 0),
    };

    if (usage) await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AiUsage.update(usage.id, fields);
    else await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AiUsage.create(fields);

    return Response.json({ ...data, fanan: { used: fields.requests, allowance, plan } });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: String((error as Error)?.message || error) }, { status: 500 });
  }
});
```

**5. Admin page "AI usage"** (admins only): this month's AiUsage records, newest first, with each user's plan, requests, and tokens; and a way to set a user's `ai_plan` by hand.

---

**Afterwards:**
- **Your Anthropic key:** create one at the Claude Console (platform.claude.com) under your Fanan organization, add a payment method there, then paste the key into the app's secret `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Anthropic bills Fanan for all usage.
- **Backend functions need Base44's Builder plan or higher.**
- **To test before payments exist:** set your own account's `ai_plan` to `pro` on the admin page.

# Base44 prompt: Fanan Hub Cloud

Paste everything below the line into Base44's AI chat, in a **new app** (not the serial-generator site).

---

Create a backend-only app called **Fanan Hub Cloud**. It is the cloud for a desktop app (the Fanan Web Hub), which talks to this app through the Base44 API as an external app. No frontend pages are needed beyond Base44's defaults.

**Users and sign-in**
- Anyone can create an account with email and password (public registration).
- New accounts confirm their email with a one-time code sent by email (verify-otp), with resend available.
- Password reset by email must work.
- Do not require a captcha or bot check (Turnstile) on sign-in or registration: the desktop app signs in through the API and cannot show one.

**Entity: HubSong** (one record per song a user saves to the cloud)
- `name`: text, required (the song's name)
- `song`: long text (the song file, JSON as text)
- `media`: array of objects, each with `path` (text), `file_uri` (text), `size` (number), `modified` (number)
- `size_bytes`: number
- `app`: text

**Security for HubSong (row-level)**
- Create: any signed-in user.
- Read, update, delete: only the user who created the record (`created_by` equals the current user's email).
- No access at all for anonymous users. Users must never see or change each other's songs.

**Files**
- Signed-in users can upload private files with `UploadPrivateFile` and get temporary download links with `CreateFileSignedUrl`. Nothing is uploaded publicly.

---

**Afterwards:** open the app in the Base44 editor and copy its **app ID**, the part of the address between `/apps/` and `/editor/`. Send it to me, and I'll build it into the Hub.

# Base44 prompt: Fanan content for the Hub

Paste everything below the line into Base44's AI chat, in the **same Fanan Hub Cloud app** as the accounts prompt.

---

Add published content to this app: loops, samples, songs and plugins that Fanan makes available to everyone using the Fanan Web Hub desktop app. The desktop app reads it through the Base44 API as an external app.

**Entity: FananContent** (one record per published item)
- `title`: text, required
- `kind`: one of `loop`, `sample`, `song`, `plugin`, required
- `description`: text
- `tags`: array of text
- `bpm`: number (loops)
- `key`: text (loops and samples, e.g. "E minor")
- `version`: text, required (e.g. "1.0.2"; raise it when a file is replaced, so users see Update)
- `file_url`: text, required (the public link of the uploaded file)
- `preview_url`: text (optional short audio preview, public link)
- `size_bytes`: number (the file's size)
- `published`: true/false, default false

**Security for FananContent**
- Read: everyone, including anonymous visitors (no sign-in needed).
- Create, update, delete: admins only.

**Admin page: "Publish content"** (admins only)
- A list of all FananContent records, newest first, with their published state.
- A form to add or edit an item: upload the file (public upload, `UploadFile`), which fills `file_url` and `size_bytes` automatically; optionally upload a preview; fill title, kind, description, tags, bpm, key and version; a Published switch.
- Replacing an item's file must also raise its version.

---

**Packaging a song:** zip the song's folder, the `.fsong` file together with its `Media` folder, and upload the zip as the item's file with kind `song`.

**Plugins:** only WCLAP files (`.wclap.tar.gz` or `.wasm`). The Hub installs nothing else.

#pragma once

// Stand-in for wclap-bridge's webview-gui module, with the same API.
//
// The real module opens a plugin's web UI in its own native window. The Hub shows
// plugin UIs inside its own web view instead, so every native-window call here
// answers "not supported". Messages a plugin sends to its UI are still forwarded
// to the host's CLAP_EXT_WEBVIEW extension whenever the host provides one.

#include "clap/all.h"   // includes the draft webview extension

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

namespace webview_gui
{

struct ClapWebviewGui
{
    // Plugin GUI extension handed to the host: reports no native GUI support.
    clap_plugin_gui* extPluginGui;

    // Used by the bridge instead of querying the host directly.
    const clap_host_webview* extHostWebview;

    ClapWebviewGui (const clap_plugin* = nullptr, const clap_host* = nullptr)
    {
        extPluginGui = &pluginGuiProxy;
        extHostWebview = &hostWebviewProxy;
    }

    void init (const clap_plugin*, const clap_host*) {}
    void init() {}

    bool isApiSupported (const char*, bool)            { return false; }
    bool getPreferredApi (const char**, bool*)         { return false; }
    bool create (const char*, bool)                    { return false; }
    void destroy()                                     {}
    bool setScale (double)                             { return true; }

    bool getSize (uint32_t* width, uint32_t* height)
    {
        *width = 640;
        *height = 400;
        return true;
    }

    bool canResize()                                   { return false; }

    bool getResizeHints (clap_gui_resize_hints_t* hints)
    {
        *hints = { false, false, false, 0, 0 };
        return true;
    }

    bool adjustSize (uint32_t*, uint32_t*)             { return false; }
    bool setSize (uint32_t, uint32_t)                  { return false; }
    bool setParent (const clap_window*)                { return false; }
    bool setTransient (const clap_window*)             { return false; }
    void suggestTitle (const char*)                    {}
    bool show()                                        { return false; }
    bool hide()                                        { return false; }

private:
    static bool hostWebviewSend (const clap_host_t* host, const void* buffer, uint32_t size)
    {
        if (host == nullptr || host->get_extension == nullptr)
            return false;

        const auto* ext = static_cast<const clap_host_webview*> (host->get_extension (host, CLAP_EXT_WEBVIEW));
        return ext != nullptr && ext->send != nullptr && ext->send (host, buffer, size);
    }

    static bool guiIsApiSupported (const clap_plugin*, const char*, bool)          { return false; }
    static bool guiGetPreferredApi (const clap_plugin*, const char**, bool*)       { return false; }
    static bool guiCreate (const clap_plugin*, const char*, bool)                  { return false; }
    static void guiDestroy (const clap_plugin*)                                    {}
    static bool guiSetScale (const clap_plugin*, double)                           { return true; }

    static bool guiGetSize (const clap_plugin*, uint32_t* width, uint32_t* height)
    {
        *width = 640;
        *height = 400;
        return true;
    }

    static bool guiCanResize (const clap_plugin*)                                  { return false; }

    static bool guiGetResizeHints (const clap_plugin*, clap_gui_resize_hints_t* hints)
    {
        *hints = { false, false, false, 0, 0 };
        return true;
    }

    static bool guiAdjustSize (const clap_plugin*, uint32_t*, uint32_t*)           { return false; }
    static bool guiSetSize (const clap_plugin*, uint32_t, uint32_t)                { return false; }
    static bool guiSetParent (const clap_plugin*, const clap_window*)              { return false; }
    static bool guiSetTransient (const clap_plugin*, const clap_window*)           { return false; }
    static void guiSuggestTitle (const clap_plugin*, const char*)                  {}
    static bool guiShow (const clap_plugin*)                                       { return false; }
    static bool guiHide (const clap_plugin*)                                       { return false; }

    clap_plugin_gui pluginGuiProxy { guiIsApiSupported, guiGetPreferredApi, guiCreate, guiDestroy,
                                     guiSetScale, guiGetSize, guiCanResize, guiGetResizeHints,
                                     guiAdjustSize, guiSetSize, guiSetParent, guiSetTransient,

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Cloud.cpp

#include "Cloud.h"

namespace
{
    /** The Base44 app that holds Fanan Hub accounts and songs. FananWebHub-cloud.json beside
        the program can name another (and another server, as the tests do). */
    constexpr const char* fananAppId = "6abdbe690c1a2fa318bee483";   // Fanan Hub Cloud on Base44

    juce::var object()
    {
        return juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
    }

    /** What the server said went wrong, in its own words where it gave them. */
    juce::String errorText (int status, const juce::var& body, const juce::String& text)
    {
        for (const auto* key : { "detail", "message", "error" })
        {
            const auto value = body.getProperty (key, {});

            if (value.isString() && value.toString().isNotEmpty())
                return value.toString();

            if (value.isObject() && value.getProperty ("message", {}).toString().isNotEmpty())
                return value.getProperty ("message", {}).toString();
        }

        if (status == 401 || status == 403)
            return "Please sign in again.";

        if (status == 404)
            return "Not found in the Fanan cloud.";

        return "The Fanan cloud answered " + juce::String (status) + (text.isNotEmpty() && text.length() < 120 ? ": " + text : juce::String());
    }

    /** Where a song's audio lives, as the song file names it (relative to the song, or absolute). */
    juce::StringArray mediaPathsIn (const juce::var& song)
    {
        juce::StringArray paths;

        if (const auto* tracks = song.getProperty ("tracks", {}).getArray())
            for (const auto& track : *tracks)
                if (const auto* clips = track.getProperty ("clips", {}).getArray())
                    for (const auto& clip : *clips)
                        if (const auto path = clip.getProperty ("audioFile", {}).toString(); path.isNotEmpty())
                            paths.addIfNotAlreadyThere (path);

        return paths;
    }

    juce::File localMediaFile (const juce::String& path, const juce::File& songFile)
    {
        return juce::File::isAbsolutePath (path) ? juce::File (path) : songFile.getParentDirectory().getChildFile (path);
    }
}

//==============================================================================
Cloud::Settings Cloud::loadSettings()
{
    Settings loaded;
    loaded.appId = fananAppId;

    const auto file = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile).getSiblingFile ("FananWebHub-cloud.json");
    const auto config = juce::JSON::parse (file);

    if (const auto appId = config.getProperty ("appId", {}).toString().trim(); appId.isNotEmpty())
        loaded.appId = appId;

    if (const auto server = config.getProperty ("serverUrl", {}).toString().trim(); server.isNotEmpty())
        loaded.serverUrl = server.trimCharactersAtEnd ("/");

    return loaded;
}

Cloud::Cloud (Settings s, juce::File file)
    : settings (std::move (s)), accountFile (std::move (file))
{
    const auto saved = juce::JSON::parse (accountFile);
    email = saved.getProperty ("email", {}).toString();
    token = saved.getProperty ("token", {}).toString();
}

Cloud::~Cloud()
{
    alive->store (false);                 // no answers after this
    worker.removeAllJobs (true, 20000);   // a job under way finishes first
}

bool Cloud::isSignedIn() const
{
    const juce::ScopedLock lock (accountLock);
    return token.isNotEmpty();
}

juce::String Cloud::getEmail() const
{
    const juce::ScopedLock lock (accountLock);
    return email;
}

juce::String Cloud::currentToken() const
{
    const juce::ScopedLock lock (accountLock);
    return token;
}

void Cloud::setAccount (const juce::String& newEmail, const juce::String& newToken)
{
    const juce::ScopedLock lock (accountLock);
    email = newEmail;
    token = newToken;

    // The session is kept, so the Hub is still signed in next time (like a browser's).
    auto saved = object();
    saved.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("email", email);
    saved.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("token", token);
    accountFile.getParentDirectory().createDirectory();
    accountFile.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (saved));
}

//==============================================================================
void Cloud::run (std::function<void()> job)
{
    ++pending;
    worker.addJob ([this, job = std::move (job)]
    {
        job();
        --pending;
    });
}

void Cloud::answer (const Done& done, juce::Result result, juce::var value)
{
    std::function<void()> call = [alive = alive, done, result = std::move (result), value = std::move (value)]
    {
        if (alive->load() && done != nullptr)
            done (result, value);
    };

    if (deliverer != nullptr)
        deliverer (std::move (call));
    else
        juce::MessageManager::callAsync (std::move (call));
}

void Cloud::report (const Progress& progress, double fraction, const juce::String& text)
{
    if (progress == nullptr)
        return;

    std::function<void()> call = [alive = alive, progress, fraction, text]
    {
        if (alive->load())
            progress (fraction, text);
    };

    if (deliverer != nullptr)
        deliverer (std::move (call));
    else
        juce::MessageManager::callAsync (std::move (call));
}

//==============================================================================
Cloud::Response Cloud::request (const juce::String& method, const juce::String& path, const juce::var& json,
                                const juce::StringPairArray& query, int timeoutMs)
{
    Response response;

    if (blocked.load())
    {
        response.error = "The internet is blocked (the toggle at the top right). Turn it off to use the Fanan cloud.";
        return response;
    }

    juce::URL url (settings.serverUrl + "/api/apps/" + settings.appId + path);

    for (const auto& key : query.getAllKeys())
        url = url.withParameter (key, query[key]);

    const bool hasBody = ! json.isVoid();

    if (hasBody)
        url = url.withPOSTData (juce::JSON::toString (json, true));

    juce::String headers;
    headers << "X-App-Id: " << settings.appId << "\r\nAccept: application/json\r\n";

    if (hasBody)
        headers << "Content-Type: application/json\r\n";

    if (const auto bearer = currentToken(); bearer.isNotEmpty())
        headers << "Authorization: Bearer " << bearer << "\r\n";

    const auto options = juce::URL::InputStreamOptions (hasBody ? juce::URL::ParameterHandling::inPostData
                                                                : juce::URL::ParameterHandling::inAddress)
                             .withExtraHeaders (headers)
                             .withConnectionTimeoutMs (timeoutMs)
                             .withStatusCode (&response.status)
                             .withNumRedirectsToFollow (5)
                             .withHttpRequestCmd (method);

    const auto stream = url.createInputStream (options);

    if (stream == nullptr)
    {
        response.error = "Couldn't reach the Fanan cloud. Check the internet connection.";
        return response;
    }

    const auto text = stream->readEntireStreamAsString();
    response.body = juce::JSON::parse (text);

    if (response.status == 0 || response.status >= 400)
        response.error = errorText (response.status, response.body, text);

    // A session the server no longer accepts is let go: the next step is signing in.
    if (response.status == 401)
        setAccount (getEmail(), {});

    return response;
}

Cloud::Response Cloud::uploadFile (const juce::File& file, const std::function<void (double)>& progress)
{
    Response response;

    if (blocked.load())
    {
        response.error = "The internet is blocked, so " + file.getFileName() + " wasn't uploaded.";
        return response;
    }

    const auto url = juce::URL (settings.serverUrl + "/api/apps/" + settings.appId + "/integration-endpoints/Core/UploadPrivateFile")
                         .withFileToUpload ("file", file, "application/octet-stream");

    juce::String headers;
    headers << "X-App-Id: " << settings.appId << "\r\nAccept: application/json\r\n"
            << "Authorization: Bearer " << currentToken() << "\r\n";

    const auto options = juce::URL::InputStreamOptions (juce::URL::ParameterHandling::inPostData)
                             .withExtraHeaders (headers)
                             .withConnectionTimeoutMs (60000)
                             .withStatusCode (&response.status)
                             .withProgressCallback ([&progress] (int sent, int total)
                             {
                                 if (progress != nullptr && total > 0)
                                     progress (static_cast<double> (sent) / static_cast<double> (total));
                                 return true;
                             });

    const auto stream = url.createInputStream (options);

    if (stream == nullptr)
    {
        response.error = "Couldn't upload " + file.getFileName() + ". Check the internet connection.";
        return response;
    }

    const auto text = stream->readEntireStreamAsString();
    response.body = juce::JSON::parse (text);

    if (response.status == 0 || response.status >= 400)
        response.error = errorText (response.status, response.body, text);
    else if (response.body.getProperty ("file_uri", {}).toString().isEmpty())
        response.error = "The Fanan cloud didn't take " + file.getFileName() + ".";

    return response;
}

bool Cloud::download (const juce::String& address, const juce::File& destination, juce::String& error)
{
    if (blocked.load())
    {
        error = "The internet is blocked.";
        return false;
    }

    int status = 0;
    const auto stream = juce::URL (address).createInputStream (juce::URL::InputStreamOptions (juce::URL::ParameterHandling::inAddress)
                                                                   .withConnectionTimeoutMs (60000)
                                                                   .withStatusCode (&status)
                                                                   .withNumRedirectsToFollow (5));

    if (stream == nullptr || status >= 400)
    {
        error = "Couldn't download " + destination.getFileName() + (status >= 400 ? " (" + juce::String (status) + ")" : juce::String());
        return false;
    }

    destination.getParentDirectory().createDirectory();
    const auto partial = destination.getSiblingFile (destination.getFileName() + ".part");
    partial.deleteFile();

    {
        juce::FileOutputStream out (partial);
        const auto written = out.openedOk() ? out.writeFromInputStream (*stream, -1) : -1;
        out.flush();

        if (written < 0 || out.getStatus().failed())
        {
            error = "Couldn't write " + destination.getFullPathName();
            return false;
        }
    }

    destination.deleteFile();
    return partial.moveFileTo (destination);
}

//==============================================================================
void Cloud::signIn (const juce::String& address, const juce::String& password, Done done)
{
    run ([this, address = address.trim(), password, done]
    {
        auto body = object();
        body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("email", address);
        body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("password", password);
        const auto response = request ("POST", "/auth/login", body);
        const auto access = response.body.getProperty ("access_token", {}).toString();

        if (response.error.isNotEmpty() || access.isEmpty())
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (response.error.isNotEmpty() ? response.error : "The email or password isn't right."));
            return;
        }

        const auto name = response.body.getProperty ("user", {}).getProperty ("email", address).toString();
        setAccount (name, access);

        auto value = object();
        value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("email", name);
        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
    });
}

void Cloud::signUp (const juce::String& address, const juce::String& password, Done done)
{
    run ([this, address = address.trim(), password, done]
    {
        auto body = object();
        body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("email", address);
        body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("password", password);
        const auto response = request ("POST", "/auth/register", body);
        answer (done, response.error.isEmpty() ? juce::Result::ok() : juce::Result::fail (response.error));
    });
}

void Cloud::verifyCode (const juce::String& address, const juce::String& code, Done done)
{
    run ([this, address = address.trim(), code = code.trim(), done]
    {
        auto body = object();
        body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("email", address);
        body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("otp_code", code);
        const auto response = request ("POST", "/auth/verify-otp", body);

        // Some apps sign the account in as the code is checked.
        if (const auto access = response.body.getProperty ("access_token", {}).toString(); access.isNotEmpty() && response.error.isEmpty())
            setAccount (address, access);

        answer (done, response.error.isEmpty() ? juce::Result::ok() : juce::Result::fail (response.error));
    });
}

void Cloud::resendCode (const juce::String& address, Done done)
{
    run ([this, address = address.trim(), done]
    {
        auto body = object();
        body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("email", address);
        const auto response = request ("POST", "/auth/resend-otp", body);
        answer (done, response.error.isEmpty() ? juce::Result::ok() : juce::Result::fail (response.error));
    });
}

void Cloud::requestPasswordReset (const juce::String& address, Done done)
{
    run ([this, address = address.trim(), done]
    {
        auto body = object();
        body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("email", address);
        const auto response = request ("POST", "/auth/reset-password-request", body);
        answer (done, response.error.isEmpty() ? juce::Result::ok() : juce::Result::fail (response.error));
    });
}

void Cloud::signOut()
{
    setAccount (getEmail(), {});
}

//==============================================================================
void Cloud::listSongs (Done done)
{
    run ([this, done]
    {
        juce::StringPairArray query;
        query.set ("sort", "-updated_date");
        query.set ("limit", "500");

        // Only this account's songs (the app's security says so too).
        auto mine = object();
        mine.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("created_by", getEmail());
        query.set ("q", juce::JSON::toString (mine, true));

        const auto response = request ("GET", juce::String ("/entities/") + entityName, {}, query);

        if (response.error.isNotEmpty())
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (response.error));
            return;
        }

        juce::Array<juce::var> songs;

        if (const auto* records = response.body.getArray())
        {
            for (const auto& record : *records)
            {
                auto song = object();
                auto* fields = song.getDynamicObject();
                fields->setProperty ("id", record.getProperty ("id", {}).toString());
                fields->setProperty ("name", record.getProperty ("name", "Untitled").toString());
                fields->setProperty ("updated", record.getProperty ("updated_date", record.getProperty ("created_date", {})).toString());
                fields->setProperty ("size", record.getProperty ("size_bytes", 0));
                songs.add (song);
            }
        }

        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), songs);
    });
}

void Cloud::saveSong (const juce::File& songFile, const juce::String& cloudId, Done done, Progress progress)
{
    run ([this, songFile, cloudId, done, progress]
    {
        const auto text = songFile.loadFileAsString();
        const auto song = juce::JSON::parse (text);

        if (! song.isObject())
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't read " + songFile.getFileName()));
            return;
        }

        // What's up there already: unchanged files are reused, not sent again.
        std::map<juce::String, juce::var> previous;
        auto recordId = cloudId;

        if (recordId.isNotEmpty())
        {
            const auto existing = request ("GET", juce::String ("/entities/") + entityName + "/" + recordId);

            if (existing.status == 404)
                recordId.clear();   // deleted meanwhile: it's saved as a new one
            else if (existing.error.isNotEmpty())
            {
                answer (done, juce::Result::fail (existing.error));
                return;
            }
            else if (const auto* media = existing.body.getProperty ("media", {}).getArray())
                for (const auto& item : *media)
                    previous[item.getProperty ("path", {}).toString()] = item;
        }

        const auto paths = mediaPathsIn (song);
        juce::int64 total = static_cast<juce::int64> (text.getNumBytesAsUTF8()), sent = 0, toSend = 0;

        for (const auto& path : paths)
            toSend += localMediaFile (path, songFile).getSize();

        juce::Array<juce::var> media;

        for (const auto& path : paths)
        {
            const auto file = localMediaFile (path, songFile);

            if (! file.existsAsFile())
                continue;   // a missing file stays missing, as it does locally

            const auto size = file.getSize();
            const auto modified = static_cast<double> (file.getLastModificationTime().toMilliseconds());
            total += size;

            juce::String uri;

            if (const auto found = previous.find (path); found != previous.end()
                && static_cast<juce::int64> (found->second.getProperty ("size", -1)) == size
                && juce::approximatelyEqual (static_cast<double> (found->second.getProperty ("modified", 0.0)), modified))
            {
                uri = found->second.getProperty ("file_uri", {}).toString();
            }

            if (uri.isEmpty())
            {
                report (progress, toSend > 0 ? static_cast<double> (sent) / static_cast<double> (toSend) : 0.0, "Uploading " + file.getFileName());

                const auto uploaded = uploadFile (file, [this, &progress, sent, size, toSend, name = file.getFileName()] (double part)
                {
                    if (toSend > 0)
                        report (progress, (static_cast<double> (sent) + part * static_cast<double> (size)) / static_cast<double> (toSend), "Uploading " + name);
                });

                if (uploaded.error.isNotEmpty())
                {
                    answer (done, juce::Result::fail (uploaded.error));
                    return;
                }

                uri = uploaded.body.getProperty ("file_uri", {}).toString();
                sent += size;
            }

            auto item = object();
            item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("path", path);
            item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("file_uri", uri);
            item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("size", size);
            item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("modified", modified);
            media.add (item);
        }

        report (progress, 1.0, "Saving the song");

        auto record = object();
        auto* fields = record.getDynamicObject();
        fields->setProperty ("name", songFile.getFileNameWithoutExtension());
        fields->setProperty ("song", text);
        fields->setProperty ("media", media);
        fields->setProperty ("size_bytes", total);
        fields->setProperty ("app", "Fanan Web Hub");

        const auto saved = recordId.isNotEmpty() ? request ("PUT", juce::String ("/entities/") + entityName + "/" + recordId, record)
                                                 : request ("POST", juce::String ("/entities/") + entityName, record);

        if (saved.error.isNotEmpty())
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (saved.error));
            return;
        }

        auto value = object();
        value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("id", saved.body.getProperty ("id", recordId).toString());
        value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("name", songFile.getFileNameWithoutExtension());
        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
    });
}

void Cloud::openSong (const juce::String& id, const juce::File& root, Done done, Progress progress)
{
    run ([this, id, root, done, progress]
    {
        const auto fetched = request ("GET", juce::String ("/entities/") + entityName + "/" + id);

        if (fetched.error.isNotEmpty())
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (fetched.error));
            return;
        }

        auto song = juce::JSON::parse (fetched.body.getProperty ("song", {}).toString());

        if (! song.isObject())
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("That song's file is damaged in the cloud."));
            return;
        }

        // A folder of its own: this song's earlier download is reused, anything else is left alone.
        const auto name = juce::File::createLegalFileName (fetched.body.getProperty ("name", "Cloud Song").toString());
        auto folder = root.getChildFile (name);

        for (int n = 2; folder.exists(); ++n)
        {
            const auto previous = juce::JSON::parse (folder.getChildFile (name + ".fsong"));

            if (previous.getProperty ("cloudId", {}).toString() == id)
                break;

            folder = root.getChildFile (name + " (" + juce::String (n) + ")");
        }

        folder.createDirectory();

        // The audio: to the same places relative to the song; files that lived elsewhere go into Media.
        std::map<juce::String, juce::String> moved;

        if (const auto* media = fetched.body.getProperty ("media", {}).getArray())
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < media->size(); ++i)
            {
                const auto& item = media->getReference (i);
                const auto path = item.getProperty ("path", {}).toString();
                const auto local = juce::File::isAbsolutePath (path) ? juce::String ("Media/") + juce::File (path).getFileName() : path;
                const auto target = folder.getChildFile (local);

                if (target.existsAsFile() && target.getSize() == static_cast<juce::int64> (item.getProperty ("size", -1)))
                {
                    moved[path] = local;   // already here from an earlier download
                    continue;
                }

                report (progress, static_cast<double> (i) / static_cast<double> (media->size()), "Downloading " + target.getFileName());

                auto body = object();
                body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("file_uri", item.getProperty ("file_uri", {}).toString());
                body.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("expires_in", 3600);
                const auto link = request ("POST", "/integration-endpoints/Core/CreateFileSignedUrl", body);
                juce::String error;

                if (link.error.isNotEmpty() || ! download (link.body.getProperty ("signed_url", {}).toString(), target, error))
                {
                    answer (done, juce::Result::fail (link.error.isNotEmpty() ? link.error : error));
                    return;
                }

                moved[path] = local;
            }
        }

        // The song, pointing at where its audio now is, and remembering its record.
        if (const auto* tracks = song.getProperty ("tracks", {}).getArray())
            for (const auto& track : *tracks)
                if (const auto* clips = track.getProperty ("clips", {}).getArray())
                    for (const auto& clip : *clips)
                        if (const auto found = moved.find (clip.getProperty ("audioFile", {}).toString()); found != moved.end())
                            clip.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("audioFile", found->second);

        song.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("cloudId", id);
        const auto file = folder.getChildFile (name + ".fsong");

        if (! file.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (song)))
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + file.getFullPathName()));
            return;
        }

        report (progress, 1.0, "Opening");
        auto value = object();
        value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("file", file.getFullPathName());
        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
    });
}

//==============================================================================
namespace
{
    /** The file's own extension from its address, the double ones included (.wclap.tar.gz). */
    juce::String extensionOf (const juce::String& address)
    {
        const auto name = juce::URL (address).getFileName().toLowerCase();

        for (const auto* ending : { ".wclap.tar.gz", ".wclap.tgz", ".tar.gz" })
            if (name.endsWith (ending))
                return ending;

        return juce::File (name).getFileExtension();
    }

    /** Where an item of a kind goes under the content folder. */
    juce::File placeFor (const juce::String& kind, const juce::File& root)
    {
        if (kind == "loop")    return root.getChildFile ("Loops");
        if (kind == "sample")  return root.getChildFile ("Samples");
        if (kind == "song")    return root.getChildFile ("Songs");
        if (kind == "plugin")  return root.getChildFile ("Plugins");
        return root.getChildFile ("Other");
    }

    /** A song's package, unpacked only if every file in it stays inside its folder. */
    juce::Result unpack (const juce::File& package, const juce::File& folder)
    {
        juce::ZipFile zip (package);

        if (zip.getNumEntries() == 0)
            return juce::Result::fail ("The song's package is empty or damaged.");

        for (int i = 0; i < zip.getNumEntries(); ++i)
        {
            const auto* entry = zip.getEntry (i);
            const auto target = folder.getChildFile (entry->filename);

            if (entry->filename.contains ("..") || juce::File::isAbsolutePath (entry->filename) || ! target.isAChildOf (folder))
                return juce::Result::fail ("The song's package tries to write outside its folder, so it wasn't opened.");
        }

        folder.createDirectory();
        return zip.uncompressTo (folder, true);
    }
}

void Cloud::listContent (Done done)
{
    run ([this, done]
    {
        juce::StringPairArray query;
        query.set ("sort", "-created_date");
        query.set ("limit", "500");

        auto published = object();
        published.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("published", true);
        query.set ("q", juce::JSON::toString (published, true));

        const auto response = request ("GET", juce::String ("/entities/") + contentEntityName, {}, query);

        if (response.error.isNotEmpty())
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (response.error));
            return;
        }

        juce::Array<juce::var> items;

        if (const auto* records = response.body.getArray())
        {
            for (const auto& record : *records)
            {
                const auto kind = record.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString().toLowerCase();
                const auto file = record.getProperty ("file_url", {}).toString();

                if (file.isEmpty() || ! juce::StringArray { "loop", "sample", "song", "plugin" }.contains (kind))
                    continue;   // nothing the Hub knows how to use

                auto item = object();
                auto* fields = item.getDynamicObject();
                fields->setProperty ("id", record.getProperty ("id", {}).toString());
                fields->setProperty ("title", record.getProperty ("title", "Untitled").toString());
                fields->setProperty ("kind", kind);
                fields->setProperty ("description", record.getProperty ("description", {}).toString());
                fields->setProperty ("tags", record.getProperty ("tags", juce::Array<juce::var>()));
                fields->setProperty ("bpm", record.getProperty ("bpm", 0));
                fields->setProperty ("key", record.getProperty ("key", {}).toString());
                fields->setProperty ("size", record.getProperty ("size_bytes", 0));
                fields->setProperty ("version", record.getProperty ("version", "1").toString());
                fields->setProperty ("file_url", file);
                fields->setProperty ("preview_url", record.getProperty ("preview_url", {}).toString());
                items.add (item);
            }
        }

        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), items);
    });
}

void Cloud::installContent (const juce::var& item, const juce::File& root, Done done, Progress progress)
{
    run ([this, item, root, done, progress]
    {
        const auto kind = item.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString();
        const auto address = item.getProperty ("file_url", {}).toString();
        const auto title = juce::File::createLegalFileName (item.getProperty ("title", "Untitled").toString());
        const auto place = placeFor (kind, root);
        place.createDirectory();

        juce::String error;
        const auto extension = extensionOf (address);

        // Only what the Hub can use safely is taken: plugins as WCLAP (sandboxed WebAssembly,
        // never native code), loops and samples as audio files, songs as packages.
        if (kind == "plugin" && ! juce::StringArray { ".wclap.tar.gz", ".wclap.tgz", ".wasm" }.contains (extension))
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("Only WCLAP plugins can be installed from Fanan's content."));
            return;
        }

        if ((kind == "loop" || kind == "sample") && ! juce::StringArray { ".wav", ".aif", ".aiff", ".flac", ".ogg", ".mp3" }.contains (extension))
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("That " + kind + " isn't an audio file the Hub can use."));
            return;
        }

        report (progress, 0.0, "Downloading " + title);

        if (kind == "song")
        {
            // A song comes as a package (the song file and its audio), unpacked into its own folder.
            const auto package = place.getChildFile (title + ".download.zip");

            if (! download (address, package, error))
            {
                answer (done, juce::Result::fail (error));
                return;
            }

            const auto folder = place.getChildFile (title);
            const auto unpacked = unpack (package, folder);
            package.deleteFile();

            if (unpacked.failed())
            {
                answer (done, unpacked);
                return;
            }

            const auto songs = folder.findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, true, "*.fsong");

            if (songs.isEmpty())
            {
                answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("The package has no song in it."));
                return;
            }

            auto value = object();
            value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("path", songs.getFirst().getFullPathName());
            answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
            return;
        }

        const auto target = place.getChildFile (title + extension);

        if (! download (address, target, error))
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (error));
            return;
        }

        report (progress, 1.0, "Installed " + title);
        auto value = object();
        value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("path", target.getFullPathName());
        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
    });
}

void Cloud::fetchPreview (const juce::var& item, const juce::File& cache, Done done)
{
    run ([this, item, cache, done]
    {
        auto address = item.getProperty ("preview_url", {}).toString();
        const auto kind = item.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString();

        // Loops and samples can be heard as they are when they have no preview of their own.
        if (address.isEmpty() && (kind == "loop" || kind == "sample"))
            address = item.getProperty ("file_url", {}).toString();

        if (address.isEmpty())
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail ("There's nothing to preview."));
            return;
        }

        const auto file = cache.getChildFile (juce::File::createLegalFileName (item.getProperty ("id", "item").toString()
                                                                                + "-" + item.getProperty ("version", "1").toString())
                                              + extensionOf (address));
        juce::String error;

        if (! file.existsAsFile() && ! download (address, file, error))
        {
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (error));
            return;
        }

        auto value = object();
        value.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("file", file.getFullPathName());
        answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), value);
    });
}

void Cloud::invokeFunction (const juce::String& name, const juce::var& body, Done done)
{
    run ([this, name, body, done]
    {
        const auto response = request ("POST", "/functions/" + name, body, {}, 120000);

        if (response.error.isNotEmpty())
            answer (done, juce::Result::fail (response.error), response.body);
        else
            answer (done, juce::Result::ok(), response.body);
    });
}

void Cloud::deleteSong (const juce::String& id, Done done)
{
    run ([this, id, done]
    {
        const auto response = request ("DELETE", juce::String ("/entities/") + entityName + "/" + id);
        answer (done, response.error.isEmpty() || response.status == 404 ? juce::Result::ok() : juce::Result::fail (response.error));
    });
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Cloud.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>
#include <juce_events/juce_events.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Fanan accounts and cloud songs, on Base44 (the platform Fanan's sites run on).

    Speaks Base44's web API directly, as its JavaScript SDK does: an account signs in with
    email and password; each song is a HubSong record holding the song file, and its
    audio files are uploaded as private files that only a short-lived signed link can
    fetch. The Hub works fully without any of this: it's for keeping and sharing songs.

    Everything that waits on the network runs on a thread of its own; every answer comes
    back on the message thread.
*/
class Cloud final
{
public:
    struct Settings
    {
        juce::String serverUrl { "https://base44.app" };
        juce::String appId;
    };

    /** Settings from FananWebHub-cloud.json beside the program, or the built-in ones. */
    static Settings loadSettings();

    using Done = std::function<void (const juce::Result& result, const juce::var& value)>;
    using Progress = std::function<void (double fraction, const juce::String& text)>;

    Cloud (Settings settings, juce::File accountFile);
    ~Cloud();

    bool isConfigured() const noexcept              { return settings.appId.isNotEmpty(); }

    /** When blocked (the Hub's "Block internet"), every request fails at once, reaching nothing. */
    void setBlocked (bool shouldBlock) noexcept     { blocked.store (shouldBlock); }
    bool isBlocked() const noexcept                 { return blocked.load(); }
    bool isSignedIn() const;
    juce::String getEmail() const;
    bool isBusy() const noexcept                    { return pending.load() > 0; }

    //==============================================================================
    void signIn (const juce::String& email, const juce::String& password, Done done);
    void signUp (const juce::String& email, const juce::String& password, Done done);
    void verifyCode (const juce::String& email, const juce::String& code, Done done);
    void resendCode (const juce::String& email, Done done);
    void requestPasswordReset (const juce::String& email, Done done);
    void signOut();

    //==============================================================================
    /** The signed-in account's songs, newest first: [{ id, name, updated, size }]. */
    void listSongs (Done done);

    /** Uploads a saved song and every audio file it uses (files already up there and
        unchanged aren't sent again). cloudId: the song's record, when it has one.
        Answers { id, name }. */
    void saveSong (const juce::File& songFile, const juce::String& cloudId, Done done, Progress progress);

    /** Downloads a song and its audio into a folder of its own under root, ready to open.
        Answers { file }. */
    void openSong (const juce::String& id, const juce::File& root, Done done, Progress progress);

    void deleteSong (const juce::String& id, Done done);

    /** Calls one of the Fanan app's server functions (POST functions/<name>) as the signed-in
        user; answers its JSON. Waits up to two minutes (the AI's answers take a while). */
    void invokeFunction (const juce::String& name, const juce::var& body, Done done);

    //==============================================================================
    // Fanan's content: what Fanan publishes for everyone (no account needed).

    /** Published items, newest first: [{ id, title, kind, description, tags, bpm, key, size,
        version, file_url, preview_url }]. kind: loop, sample, song or plugin. */
    void listContent (Done done);

    /** Downloads an item into its place under root: Loops, Samples, Songs (a song's package
        unpacked into a folder of its own) or Plugins. Answers { path }: the audio file, the
        song file, or the plugin file. */
    void installContent (const juce::var& item, const juce::File& root, Done done, Progress progress);

    /** An item's short preview, downloaded once into the cache folder. Answers { file }. */
    void fetchPreview (const juce::var& item, const juce::File& cache, Done done);

    static constexpr const char* entityName = "HubSong";
    static constexpr const char* contentEntityName = "FananContent";

    /** How answers reach the message thread (tests without a message loop set their own). */
    void setDeliverer (std::function<void (std::function<void()>)> newDeliverer)   { deliverer = std::move (newDeliverer); }

private:
    struct Response
    {
        int status = 0;
        juce::var body;
        juce::String error;
    };

    Response request (const juce::String& method, const juce::String& path, const juce::var& json = {},
                      const juce::StringPairArray& query = {}, int timeoutMs = 20000);
    Response uploadFile (const juce::File& file, const std::function<void (double)>& progress);
    bool download (const juce::String& url, const juce::File& destination, juce::String& error);

    void run (std::function<void()> job);
    void answer (const Done& done, juce::Result result, juce::var value = {});
    void report (const Progress& progress, double fraction, const juce::String& text);

    juce::String currentToken() const;
    void setAccount (const juce::String& newEmail, const juce::String& newToken);

    const Settings settings;
    const juce::File accountFile;

    mutable juce::CriticalSection accountLock;
    juce::String token, email;

    std::function<void (std::function<void()>)> deliverer;
    std::atomic<bool> blocked { false };
    std::atomic<int> pending { 0 };
    std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> alive = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>> (true);
    juce::ThreadPool worker { juce::ThreadPoolOptions{}.withThreadName ("Fanan cloud").withNumberOfThreads (1) };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Cloud)
};

#include "Edits.h"

//==============================================================================
Edits::Clips Edits::snapshot (const AudioEngine& engine, const std::vector<int>& trackIds)
{
    Clips clips;

    for (const auto id : trackIds)
        if (engine.findTrack (id) != nullptr)
            clips[id] = engine.getClips (id);

    return clips;
}

std::vector<int> Edits::allTrackIds (const AudioEngine& engine)
{
    std::vector<int> ids;

    for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
        ids.push_back (track->id);

    return ids;
}

bool Edits::same (const Clips& a, const Clips& b)
{
    if (a.size() != b.size())
        return false;

    for (const auto& [trackId, clips] : a)
    {
        const auto other = b.find (trackId);

        if (other == b.end() || other->second.size() != clips.size())
            return false;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < clips.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto& x = clips[i];
            const auto& y = other->second[i];

            // Exact on purpose: the same clip copied twice, not two measurements.
            if (x.id != y.id || ! juce::exactlyEqual (x.start, y.start) || ! juce::exactlyEqual (x.length, y.length)
                || ! juce::exactlyEqual (x.offset, y.offset) || x.notes.size() != y.notes.size())
                return false;

            for (size_t n = 0; n < x.notes.size(); ++n)
                if (x.notes[n].pitch != y.notes[n].pitch || ! juce::exactlyEqual (x.notes[n].start, y.notes[n].start)
                    || ! juce::exactlyEqual (x.notes[n].length, y.notes[n].length)
                    || ! juce::exactlyEqual (x.notes[n].velocity, y.notes[n].velocity))
                    return false;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

Edits::TrackName Edits::nameOf (const AudioEngine& engine, int trackId)
{
    if (auto* track = engine.findTrack (trackId))
        return { track->name, track->nameIsAutomatic };

    return {};
}

//==============================================================================
bool Edits::Action::perform()
{
    // The first time is UndoManager::perform, after the change happened: nothing to do.
    if (std::exchange (fresh, false))
        return true;

    redo();
    return true;
}

bool Edits::Action::undo()
{
    revert();
    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
Edits::ClipsChanged::ClipsChanged (AudioEngine& e, Clips beforeChange, Clips afterChange)
    : engine (e), before (std::move (beforeChange)), after (std::move (afterChange))
{
}

int Edits::ClipsChanged::getSizeInUnits()
{
    size_t notes = 0;

    for (const auto* side : { &before, &after })
        for (const auto& [trackId, clips] : *side)
            for (const auto& clip : clips)
                notes += clip.notes.size();

    return 1 + static_cast<int> (notes / 64);
}

void Edits::ClipsChanged::apply (const Clips& clips)
{
    for (const auto& [trackId, trackClips] : clips)
        engine.setClips (trackId, trackClips);
}

}

}

void Edits::TrackRemoved::revert()  { engine.attachTrack (std::move (kept), index); }

{
    if (auto* track = engine.findTrack (id))
    {
        track->name = name.text;
        track->nameIsAutomatic = name.automatic;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
Edits::AutomationChanged::AutomationChanged (AudioEngine& e, int trackId, std::vector<AutomationLane> beforeChange,
                                             std::vector<AutomationLane> afterChange)
    : engine (e), id (trackId), before (std::move (beforeChange)), after (std::move (afterChange))
{
}

int Edits::AutomationChanged::getSizeInUnits()
{
    size_t points = 0;

    for (const auto* lanes : { &before, &after })
        for (const auto& lane : *lanes)
            points += lane.points.size();

    return static_cast<int> (1 + points / 64);
}

                                             TrackName beforeChange, TrackName afterChange)

void Edits::InstrumentChanged::swap (const TrackName& name)
{
    other = engine.swapInstrument (id, std::move (other));

    if (auto* track = engine.findTrack (id))
    {
        track->name = name.text;
        track->nameIsAutomatic = name.automatic;
    }
}

void Edits::InsertAdded::redo()     { engine.attachInsert (channel, std::move (kept), position); }

Edits::InsertRemoved::InsertRemoved (AudioEngine& e, int channelId, int id, int insertPosition, std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> removed)
    : engine (e), channel (channelId), insertId (id), position (insertPosition), kept (std::move (removed))
{
}

void Edits::InsertRemoved::redo()   { kept = engine.detachInsert (channel, insertId, position); }
void Edits::InsertRemoved::revert() { engine.attachInsert (channel, std::move (kept), position); }

Edits::InsertReplaced::InsertReplaced (AudioEngine& e, int channelId, int current, std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> otherInsert, int insertPosition)
    : engine (e), channel (channelId), currentId (current), position (insertPosition), other (std::move (otherInsert))
{
}

void Edits::InsertReplaced::swap()
{
    if (other == nullptr)
        return;

    const auto otherId = other->id;
    int where = position;
    auto out = engine.detachInsert (channel, currentId, where);

    if (out == nullptr)
        return;

    engine.attachInsert (channel, std::move (other), where);
    other = std::move (out);
    currentId = otherId;
}

Edits::InsertMoved::InsertMoved (AudioEngine& e, int channelId, int id, int fromPosition, int toPosition)
    : engine (e), channel (channelId), insertId (id), from (fromPosition), to (toPosition)
{
}

    : engine (e), before (beforeChange), after (afterChange)
{
}

void Edits::TempoChanged::apply (const Timing& timing)
{
    auto& transport = engine.getTransport();
    transport.setTempo (timing.bpm);
    transport.setTimeSignature (timing.numerator, timing.denominator);
}
