// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Edits.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_data_structures/juce_data_structures.h>

#include "AudioEngine.h"

#include <map>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Undo and redo for the song, as juce::UndoableActions for a juce::UndoManager.

    Each action is made after its change has happened and knows how to take it back
    and do it again: the first perform() (from UndoManager::perform) just accepts the
    change, later ones redo it, and undo() reverses it. Whatever an action takes out of
    the song (a removed track, a replaced plugin) stays alive inside it, so bringing it
    back is instant and exact, plugin state and all.

    Like Studio One, it covers editing the song: clips and notes, recording, tracks,
    plugins, tempo and time signature. Mixing (faders, pan, mute, solo, bypass) and
    plugin settings are not part of it.
*/
namespace Edits
{
    /** Some tracks' clips, by track id. */
    using Clips = std::map<int, std::vector<MidiClip>>;

    Clips snapshot (const AudioEngine& engine, const std::vector<int>& trackIds);
    std::vector<int> allTrackIds (const AudioEngine& engine);
    bool same (const Clips& a, const Clips& b);

    struct TrackName
    {
        juce::String text;
        bool automatic = true;       // still following its instrument's name
    };

    TrackName nameOf (const AudioEngine& engine, int trackId);

    //==============================================================================
    class Action : public juce::UndoableAction
    {
    public:
        bool perform() final;
        bool undo() final;

    protected:
        virtual void redo() = 0;
        virtual void revert() = 0;

    private:
        bool fresh = true;           // the change already happened when the action was made
    };

    //==============================================================================
    /** Any clip or note edit, a recording too: the touched tracks' clips before and after. */
    class ClipsChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        ClipsChanged (AudioEngine& engine, Clips before, Clips after);
        int getSizeInUnits() override;

    private:
        void redo() override         { apply (after); }
        void revert() override       { apply (before); }
        void apply (const Clips& clips);

        AudioEngine& engine;
        Clips before, after;
    };

    class TrackAdded final : public Action
    {
    public:
        TrackAdded (AudioEngine& engine, int trackId, int index);

    private:
        void redo() override;
        void revert() override;

        AudioEngine& engine;
        int id, index;
        std::unique_ptr<Track> kept;
    };

    class TrackRemoved final : public Action
    {
    public:
        TrackRemoved (AudioEngine& engine, int trackId, int index, std::unique_ptr<Track> removed);

    private:
        void redo() override;
        void revert() override;

        AudioEngine& engine;
        int id, index;
        std::unique_ptr<Track> kept;
    };

    /** A track's automation envelopes, before and after an edit. */
    /** An AI request: the whole song before it and after it, so everything it did is one
        undo step. restore puts a song (as Song writes it) back into the Hub. */
    class SongSnapshot final : public Action
    {
    public:
        SongSnapshot (std::function<void (const juce::String&)> restoreSong, juce::String beforeSong, juce::String afterSong)
            : restore (std::move (restoreSong)), before (std::move (beforeSong)), after (std::move (afterSong)) {}

        void redo() override     { restore (after); }
        void revert() override   { restore (before); }
        int getSizeInUnits() override   { return static_cast<int> ((before.length() + after.length()) / 1024) + 1; }

    private:
        std::function<void (const juce::String&)> restore;
        const juce::String before, after;
    };

    /** A track's sends, before and after (added, removed, level, on). */
    class SendsChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        SendsChanged (AudioEngine& e, int trackId, std::vector<Track::Send> beforeChange, std::vector<Track::Send> afterChange)
            : engine (e), id (trackId), before (std::move (beforeChange)), after (std::move (afterChange)) {}

        void redo() override     { engine.setSends (id, after); }
        void revert() override   { engine.setSends (id, before); }
        int getSizeInUnits() override   { return 1; }

    private:
        AudioEngine& engine;
        const int id;
        const std::vector<Track::Send> before, after;
    };

    class AutomationChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        AutomationChanged (AudioEngine& engine, int trackId, std::vector<AutomationLane> before, std::vector<AutomationLane> after);

        void redo() override     { engine.setAutomationLanes (id, after); }
        void revert() override   { engine.setAutomationLanes (id, before); }
        int getSizeInUnits() override;

    private:
        AudioEngine& engine;
        const int id;
        const std::vector<AutomationLane> before, after;
    };

    class TrackRenamed final : public Action
    {
    public:
        TrackRenamed (AudioEngine& engine, int trackId, TrackName before, TrackName after);

    private:
        void redo() override         { set (after); }
        void revert() override       { set (before); }
        void set (const TrackName& name);

        AudioEngine& engine;
        int id;
        TrackName before, after;
    };

    /** A track's instrument loaded, replaced or removed; other is the one not on the track. */
    class InstrumentChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        InstrumentChanged (AudioEngine& engine, int trackId, std::unique_ptr<Plugin> other,
                           TrackName before, TrackName after);

    private:
        void redo() override         { swap (after); }
        void revert() override       { swap (before); }
        void swap (const TrackName& name);

        AudioEngine& engine;
        int id;
        std::unique_ptr<Plugin> other;
        TrackName before, after;
    };

    class InsertAdded final : public Action
    {
    public:
        InsertAdded (AudioEngine& engine, int channel, int insertId, int position);

    private:
        void redo() override;
        void revert() override;

        AudioEngine& engine;
        int channel, insertId, position;
        std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> kept;
    };

    class InsertRemoved final : public Action
    {
    public:
        InsertRemoved (AudioEngine& engine, int channel, int insertId, int position, std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> removed);

    private:
        void redo() override;
        void revert() override;

        AudioEngine& engine;
        int channel, insertId, position;
        std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> kept;
    };

    /** An insert swapped for another in the same place; other is the one out of the chain. */
    class InsertReplaced final : public Action
    {
    public:
        InsertReplaced (AudioEngine& engine, int channel, int currentId, std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> other, int position);

    private:
        void redo() override         { swap(); }
        void revert() override       { swap(); }
        void swap();

        AudioEngine& engine;
        int channel, currentId, position;
        std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> other;
    };

    class InsertMoved final : public Action
    {
    public:
        InsertMoved (AudioEngine& engine, int channel, int insertId, int from, int to);

    private:
        void redo() override         { engine.moveInsert (channel, insertId, to); }
        void revert() override       { engine.moveInsert (channel, insertId, from); }

        AudioEngine& engine;
        int channel, insertId, from, to;
    };

    class TempoChanged final : public Action
    {
    public:
        struct Timing
        {
            double bpm = 120.0;
            int numerator = 4, denominator = 4;
        };

        TempoChanged (AudioEngine& engine, Timing before, Timing after);

    private:
        void redo() override         { apply (after); }
        void revert() override       { apply (before); }
        void apply (const Timing& timing);

        AudioEngine& engine;
        Timing before, after;
    };
}

#include "EffectChain.h"

#include <algorithm>

namespace
{
    constexpr int minimumBufferSize = 4096;
}

//==============================================================================
EffectChain::EffectChain()
{
    // Reserved now, so changes made under the engine's lock never allocate.
    inserts.reserve (static_cast<size_t> (maxInserts));
}

EffectChain::~EffectChain()
{
    clear();
}

void EffectChain::clear()
{
    // Last insert first, the reverse of how a signal meets them.
    while (! inserts.empty())
        inserts.pop_back();
}

//==============================================================================
EffectChain::Insert* EffectChain::at (int index) const noexcept
{
    return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, size()) ? inserts[static_cast<size_t> (index)].get() : nullptr;
}

EffectChain::Insert* EffectChain::find (int insertId) const noexcept
{
    return at (indexOf (insertId));
}

int EffectChain::indexOf (int insertId) const noexcept
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < inserts.size(); ++i)
        if (inserts[i]->id == insertId)
            return static_cast<int> (i);

    return -1;
}

bool EffectChain::add (std::unique_ptr<Insert> insert, int position)
{
    if (insert == nullptr || isFull())
        return false;

    const auto where = position < 0 ? size() : juce::jmin (position, size());
    inserts.insert (inserts.begin() + where, std::move (insert));
    return true;
}

std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> EffectChain::remove (int insertId)
{
    const auto index = indexOf (insertId);

    if (index < 0)
        return {};

    auto removed = std::move (inserts[static_cast<size_t> (index)]);
    inserts.erase (inserts.begin() + index);
    return removed;
}

std::unique_ptr<EffectChain::Insert> EffectChain::replace (int insertId, std::unique_ptr<Insert> newInsert)
{
    const auto index = indexOf (insertId);

    if (index < 0 || newInsert == nullptr)
        return {};

    auto old = std::move (inserts[static_cast<size_t> (index)]);
    inserts[static_cast<size_t> (index)] = std::move (newInsert);
    return old;
}

bool EffectChain::move (int insertId, int newPosition)
{
    const auto from = indexOf (insertId);

    if (from < 0)
        return false;

    const auto to = juce::jlimit (0, size() - 1, newPosition);

    if (to > from)
        std::rotate (inserts.begin() + from, inserts.begin() + from + 1, inserts.begin() + to + 1);
    else if (to < from)
        std::rotate (inserts.begin() + to, inserts.begin() + from, inserts.begin() + from + 1);

    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
void EffectChain::prepare (int maxBlockSize)
{
    dry.setSize (2, juce::jmax (maxBlockSize * 2, minimumBufferSize), false, true, true);
}

void EffectChain::process (float* left, float* right, int numSamples,
                           const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t& transport) noexcept
{
    if (left == nullptr || right == nullptr || numSamples <= 0)
        return;

    for (const auto& slot : inserts)
    {
        auto& insert = *slot;
        const bool bypassed = insert.bypassed.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
        auto* plugin = insert.plugin.get();

        // A plugin that could not start passes the signal through untouched.
        if (plugin == nullptr || ! plugin->isActive())
        {
            insert.mix = bypassed ? 0.0f : 1.0f;
            continue;
        }

        if (bypassed && insert.mix <= 0.0f)
            continue;

        if (! bypassed && insert.mix >= 1.0f)
        {
            plugin->process (left, right, left, right, numSamples, midi, &transport);
            continue;
        }

        // Switching: fade from where the mix is now to where it's going, across this block.
        const auto target = bypassed ? 0.0f : 1.0f;

        if (numSamples > dry.getNumSamples())
        {
            insert.mix = target;   // no room for a fade (never with a normal block size)

            if (! bypassed)
                plugin->process (left, right, left, right, numSamples, midi, &transport);

            continue;
        }

        auto* dryLeft = dry.getWritePointer (0);
        auto* dryRight = dry.getWritePointer (1);
        std::copy (left, left + numSamples, dryLeft);
        std::copy (right, right + numSamples, dryRight);

        plugin->process (left, right, left, right, numSamples, midi, &transport);

        const auto step = (target - insert.mix) / static_cast<float> (numSamples);
        auto mix = insert.mix;

        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
        {
            mix += step;
            left[i] = dryLeft[i] + (left[i] - dryLeft[i]) * mix;
            right[i] = dryRight[i] + (right[i] - dryRight[i]) * mix;
        }

        insert.mix = target;
    }
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\EffectChain.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>

#include "Plugin.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    An ordered chain of insert effects, as on a Studio One channel. Every track has
    one, and so does the Main channel.

    The engine changes a chain only while it holds its graph lock, and the audio
    thread processes it under the same lock, so a change is never seen half done.
    Room for every insert is reserved up front: adding, moving or removing one never
    allocates while that lock is held.

    Each insert can be bypassed. Switching fades between the processed and the dry
    signal across one block, so it never clicks.
*/
class EffectChain final
{
public:
    static constexpr int maxInserts = 16;

    struct Insert
    {
        Insert (int insertId, std::unique_ptr<Plugin> effect)
            : id (insertId), plugin (std::move (effect)) {}

        const int id;                              // unique in the engine, so the page can name it
        std::unique_ptr<Plugin> plugin;
        std::atomic<bool> bypassed { false };
        float mix = 1.0f;                          // audio thread: 1 processed, 0 dry

        JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE (Insert)
    };

    EffectChain();
    ~EffectChain();

    //==============================================================================
    // Message thread. The engine holds its graph lock around the changes.
    int size() const noexcept                 { return static_cast<int> (inserts.size()); }
    bool isFull() const noexcept              { return size() >= maxInserts; }
    Insert* at (int index) const noexcept;
    Insert* find (int insertId) const noexcept;
    int indexOf (int insertId) const noexcept;

    /** Adds at position (clamped; -1 means the end). Does nothing when the chain is full. */
    bool add (std::unique_ptr<Insert> insert, int position);

    /** Takes one out; destroy what it returns after letting go of the lock. */
    std::unique_ptr<Insert> remove (int insertId);

    /** Swaps in a new insert at the same position; returns the old one to destroy. */
    std::unique_ptr<Insert> replace (int insertId, std::unique_ptr<Insert> newInsert);

    /** Moves an insert to a new position (clamped). */
    bool move (int insertId, int newPosition);

    /** Destroys every insert. Only while no audio callback can run. */
    void clear();

    //==============================================================================
    // Audio side. prepare() runs while no audio callback is active.
    void prepare (int maxBlockSize);

    /** Runs the inserts in order, in place, on a stereo block. */
    void process (float* left, float* right, int numSamples,
                  const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t& transport) noexcept;

private:
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Insert>> inserts;
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> dry;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (EffectChain)
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\helpers.h

#pragma once

// Stand-in for webview-gui's helpers. wclap-bridge only needs guessMediaType(), used
// when a plugin serves a web UI file without naming its type.

#include <cstring>
#include <string>

namespace webview_gui
{
namespace helpers
{

inline std::string guessMediaType (const char* path)
{
    struct Entry { const char* extension; const char* type; };

    static constexpr Entry types[] = {
        { "html", "text/html;charset=utf-8" },       { "htm",  "text/html;charset=utf-8" },
        { "js",   "text/javascript;charset=utf-8" }, { "mjs",  "text/javascript;charset=utf-8" },
        { "css",  "text/css;charset=utf-8" },        { "json", "application/json" },
        { "txt",  "text/plain;charset=utf-8" },      { "svg",  "image/svg+xml" },
        { "png",  "image/png" },                     { "jpg",  "image/jpeg" },
        { "jpeg", "image/jpeg" },                    { "gif",  "image/gif" },
        { "webp", "image/webp" },                    { "ico",  "image/x-icon" },
        { "wasm", "application/wasm" },              { "woff", "font/woff" },
        { "woff2", "font/woff2" },                   { "ttf",  "font/ttf" },
        { "otf",  "font/otf" },                      { "wav",  "audio/wav" },
        { "mp3",  "audio/mpeg" },                    { "ogg",  "audio/ogg" },
    };

    std::string name (path != nullptr ? path : "");
    name = name.substr (0, name.find_first_of ("?#"));

    const auto slash = name.find_last_of ('/');
    const auto dot = name.find_last_of ('.');

    if (dot == std::string::npos || (slash != std::string::npos && dot < slash))
        return "text/html;charset=utf-8";

    auto extension = name.substr (dot + 1);

    for (auto& c : extension)
        if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z')
            c = static_cast<char> (c - 'A' + 'a');

    for (const auto& entry : types)
        if (extension == entry.extension)
            return entry.type;

    return "application/octet-stream";
}

} // namespace helpers
} // namespace webview_gui

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-ai.js
//
// The AI tab: ask in words, and Claude does it in the Hub (tracks, instruments, effect
// chains, sidechains, plugin settings, notes, tempo). Each request is one undo step
// (Ctrl+Z takes back everything it did). It works through Fanan's server, so it needs
// the user signed in and the internet allowed.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  let state = { busy: false, stopping: false, entries: [], error: "", usage: null, signedIn: false, configured: false, blocked: false };

  const EXAMPLES = [
    "Add a synth on a new track and write an 8-bar chord progression in A minor",
    "Put a compressor on the bass and sidechain it to the kick",
    "Make a reverb FX channel and send the keys to it",
  ];

  function render() {
    const log = $("ai-log");
    const nearBottom = log.scrollHeight - log.scrollTop - log.clientHeight < 40;
    log.replaceChildren();

    if (!state.entries.length) {
      const hello = element("div", "ai-hello");
      hello.appendChild(element("p", "", "Ask for anything you'd do in the Hub. It does it, and Undo takes it all back."));
      for (const text of EXAMPLES) {
        const example = element("button", "ai-example", text);
        example.type = "button";
        example.addEventListener("click", () => { $("ai-input").value = text; $("ai-input").focus(); });
        hello.appendChild(example);
      }
      log.appendChild(hello);
    }

    for (const entry of state.entries) {
      if (entry.role === "user") {
        log.appendChild(element("div", "ai-user", entry.text));
        continue;
      }
      const box = element("div", "ai-assistant");
      if ((entry.steps || []).length) {
        const steps = element("ul", "ai-steps");
        for (const step of entry.steps) {
          const item = element("li", "ai-step" + (step.ok ? "" : " failed"));
          item.append(element("span", "ai-step-mark", step.ok ? "\u2713" : "\u2715"), element("span", "", step.text));
          steps.appendChild(item);
        }
        box.appendChild(steps);
      }
      if (entry.text) box.appendChild(element("div", "ai-text", entry.text));
      log.appendChild(box);
    }

    if (state.busy) log.appendChild(element("div", "ai-working", state.stopping ? "Stopping\u2026" : "Working\u2026"));
    if (state.error) log.appendChild(element("div", "ai-error", state.error));
    if (nearBottom || state.busy) log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;

    // Why it can't work right now, if it can't.
    const reason = !state.configured ? "The AI isn't set up in this build yet."
      : !state.signedIn ? "Sign in to use the AI (the account button, top right)."
      : state.blocked ? "The internet is blocked (top right): the AI works through it."
      : "";
    $("ai-notice").textContent = reason;
    $("ai-notice").hidden = !reason;
    $("ai-input").disabled = Boolean(reason);
    $("ai-send").disabled = Boolean(reason);
    $("ai-send").hidden = state.busy;
    $("ai-stop").hidden = !state.busy;
    $("ai-stop").disabled = state.stopping;
    $("ai-clear").disabled = state.busy || !state.entries.length;

    const usage = state.usage;
    $("ai-usage").textContent = usage && usage.allowance ? `${usage.used} of ${usage.allowance} requests this month` : "";
  }

  function send() {
    const text = $("ai-input").value.trim();
    if (!text || state.busy || $("ai-input").disabled) return;
    Hub.send("aiSend", { text });
    $("ai-input").value = "";
  }

  Hub.on("aiState", (data) => {
    state = { ...state, ...data };
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("aiTab", () => {
    render();
    if (!$("ai-input").disabled) $("ai-input").focus();
  });

  Hub.ai = { state: () => state };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    $("ai-send").addEventListener("click", send);
    $("ai-stop").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("aiStop"));
    $("ai-clear").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("aiClear"));
    $("ai-input").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
        event.preventDefault();
        send();
      }
    });
    render();
  });
})();
