// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-browser.js
//
// The Browser on the right, as in Studio One: instruments and effects from the library
// database, sorted Flat, by Folder, by Vendor or by Type, with Favorites and Recent at
// the top, and search across names, vendors, types and plugin features.
//
//   Drag an item onto a track, a Console strip or the Inspector's inserts, or into the
//   empty space below the tracks to make a new track. Double-click: an instrument makes
//   a new track; an effect joins the inserts of the channel in the Inspector.
//   Right-click an item: favorite, show its file, remove it from the Browser.
//   Plugin Folders (the folder button) are searched for WCLAPs at startup and on Rescan;
//   a plugin whose file has gone shows greyed out until it's back.
//   Files: folders and audio files, from places like Music or the song's Media folder.
//   Preview a file, see its format, double-click it (or Import) to put it on the selected
//   audio track at the playhead, or drag it onto the arrangement.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const BUILTIN = { builtin: true, file: "", id: "test-synth", name: "Test Synth", vendor: "Built-in", kind: "instrument",
                    category: "Synth", folder: "Built-in", features: ["instrument", "synthesizer"] };
  const KIND_TEXT = { instrument: "Instrument", effect: "Effect", noteEffect: "Note FX" };
  const RECENT_COUNT = 10;

  let tab = "instruments";
  let sortBy = "vendor";
  let query = "";
  let chosenKey = "";
  let library = { folders: [], scan: { active: false } };
  let listing = { path: "", parent: "", folders: [], files: [], places: [] };
  let chosenFile = "", fileInfo = null, listed = false;
  // Groups start closed (and close again when a song opens); while searching, all show open.
  const opened = new Set();
  const isOpen = (key) => opened.has(key) || query.trim() !== "";

  const keyOf = (entry) => entry.builtin ? "builtin" : `${entry.file}|${entry.id}`;
  const typeOf = (entry) => entry.category || KIND_TEXT[entry.kind] || "Plugin";
  const inTab = (entry) => tab === "effects" ? entry.kind === "effect" : entry.kind !== "effect";
  const byName = (a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });   // "Synth 2" before "Synth 10"

  function matches(entry, text) {
    if (!text) return true;
    return [entry.name, entry.vendor, typeOf(entry), ...(entry.features || [])].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(text);
  }

  function entriesForTab() {
    const text = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return [BUILTIN, ...Hub.state.library].filter(inTab)
                                          .filter((entry) => matches(entry, text))
                                          .sort((a, b) => byName(a.name, b.name));
  }

  function groupOf(entry) {
    if (sortBy === "folder") return entry.builtin ? "Built-in" : entry.folder || "Added files";
    if (sortBy === "type") return typeOf(entry);
    return entry.vendor;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- items
  function showMenu(entry, x, y) {
    const sameFile = Hub.state.library.filter((other) => other.file === entry.file).length;
    const at = { getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left: x, right: x, top: y, bottom: y }) };

    Hub.popupMenu(at, [
      { label: entry.favorite ? "Remove from Favorites" : "Add to Favorites", value: "favorite" },
      { label: "Show in Explorer", value: "reveal", disabled: entry.missing },
      { label: sameFile > 1 ? `Remove ${entry.fileName} from Browser (${sameFile} plugins)` : "Remove from Browser", value: "remove" }
    ], (value) => {
      if (value === "favorite") Hub.send("setFavorite", { file: entry.file, id: entry.id, favorite: !entry.favorite });
      if (value === "reveal") Hub.send("revealLibraryFile", { file: entry.file });
      if (value === "remove") { chosenKey = ""; Hub.send("removeLibraryFile", { file: entry.file }); }
    });
  }

  function itemFor(entry, nested) {
    const item = element("div", "browser-item" + (nested ? " nested" : "") + (entry.missing ? " missing" : ""));
    item.draggable = !entry.missing;
    item.dataset.key = keyOf(entry);
    item.setAttribute("role", "option");
    item.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(keyOf(entry) === chosenKey));
    item.appendChild(element("span", "browser-icon " + (entry.kind === "effect" ? "fx" : "inst")));
    item.appendChild(element("span", "browser-label", entry.name));
    if (entry.format === "VST3") item.appendChild(element("span", "browser-format", "VST3"));
    if (entry.favorite) item.appendChild(element("span", "browser-star", "★"));
    item.title = entry.builtin ? "Built into the Hub"
               : entry.missing ? `File not found: ${entry.file}`
               : `${entry.vendor} · ${typeOf(entry)} · ${entry.fileName || ""}`;

    item.addEventListener("click", () => {
      chosenKey = keyOf(entry);
      render();
    });

    item.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
      if (entry.missing) return;

      if (entry.kind !== "effect") {
        Hub.dropEntryOn(entry, null);
        return;
      }

      const channel = Hub.state.inspectMain ? Hub.MAIN : (Hub.selectedTrack() ? Hub.state.selected : null);
      Hub.dropEntryOn(entry, channel);
    });

    item.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (entry.builtin) return;
      chosenKey = keyOf(entry);
      render();
      showMenu(entry, event.clientX, event.clientY);
    });

    item.addEventListener("dragstart", (event) => {
      Hub.dragEntry = entry;
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";
      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", entry.name);
    });

    item.addEventListener("dragend", () => { Hub.dragEntry = null; });
    return item;
  }

  function folderRow(key, label, count, extraClass = "") {
    const folder = element("div", "browser-folder" + extraClass);
    folder.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(isOpen(key)));
    folder.appendChild(element("span", "browser-caret"));
    folder.appendChild(element("span", "browser-label", label));
    folder.appendChild(element("span", "browser-count", String(count)));
    folder.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (opened.has(key)) opened.delete(key);
      else opened.add(key);
      render();
    });
    return folder;
  }

  function addGroup(list, key, label, entries, extraClass) {
    list.appendChild(folderRow(key, label, entries.length, extraClass));
    if (isOpen(key))
      for (const entry of entries) list.appendChild(itemFor(entry, true));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the list, the info, the scan
  function renderInfo(entries) {
    const entry = entries.find((item) => keyOf(item) === chosenKey);
    const info = $("browser-info");
    info.hidden = !entry;
    if (!entry) return;

    $("info-icon").className = "browser-icon large " + (entry.kind === "effect" ? "fx" : "inst");
    $("info-name").textContent = entry.name;
    $("info-vendor").textContent = `Vendor: ${entry.vendor}`;
    $("info-kind").textContent = `Category: ${entry.builtin ? "Built-in" : entry.format || "WCLAP"} · ${typeOf(entry)}`;
    $("info-file").textContent = entry.builtin ? ""
                               : entry.missing ? `${entry.fileName || ""} (file not found)`
                               : [entry.version ? `Version ${entry.version}` : "", entry.fileName || ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    $("info-favorite").hidden = Boolean(entry.builtin);
    $("info-favorite").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(Boolean(entry.favorite)));
    $("info-favorite").onclick = () => Hub.send("setFavorite", { file: entry.file, id: entry.id, favorite: !entry.favorite });
    $("info-remove").hidden = Boolean(entry.builtin);
    $("info-remove").onclick = () => {
      chosenKey = "";
      Hub.send("removeLibraryFile", { file: entry.file });
    };
  }

  function renderScan() {
    const scan = library.scan || {};
    $("browser-scan").hidden = !scan.active;
    if (!scan.active) return;
    $("browser-scan-text").textContent = `Scanning ${Math.min(scan.done + 1, scan.total)} of ${scan.total}: ${scan.current || ""}`;
    $("browser-scan-bar").style.width = `${scan.total ? (100 * scan.done) / scan.total : 0}%`;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Files
  const openFolder = (path) => Hub.send("listFolder", { path });

  function importFile(path) {
    const track = Hub.selectedTrack();
    Hub.send("importAudio", { file: path, trackId: track && track.kind === "audio" ? track.id : 0, start: Hub.songPosition() });
  }

  function togglePreview(path) {
    const status = Hub.state.status;
    if (status && status.previewing === path) Hub.send("stopPreview");
    else Hub.send("previewAudio", { path });
  }

  function fileRow(item, folder) {
    const row = element("div", "browser-item file-row" + (folder ? " folder" : ""));
    row.dataset.path = item.path;
    row.setAttribute("role", "option");
    row.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(item.path === chosenFile));
    row.appendChild(element("span", "file-icon", folder ? "📁" : "♪"));
    row.appendChild(element("span", "browser-label", item.name));

    if (folder) {
      row.addEventListener("click", () => { chosenFile = item.path; render(); });
      row.addEventListener("dblclick", () => openFolder(item.path));
      return row;
    }

    const previewing = Hub.state.status && Hub.state.status.previewing === item.path;
    const play = element("button", "file-play", previewing ? "■" : "▶");
    play.type = "button";
    play.title = previewing ? "Stop the preview" : "Preview";
    play.setAttribute("aria-label", previewing ? `Stop ${item.name}` : `Preview ${item.name}`);
    play.addEventListener("click", (event) => { event.stopPropagation(); togglePreview(item.path); });
    row.appendChild(play);
    row.draggable = true;
    row.title = item.path;

    row.addEventListener("click", () => {
      chosenFile = item.path;
      fileInfo = null;
      Hub.send("audioFileInfo", { path: item.path });
      render();
    });
    row.addEventListener("dblclick", () => importFile(item.path));
    row.addEventListener("dragstart", (event) => {
      Hub.dragFile = { path: item.path, name: item.name };
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";
      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", item.name);
    });
    row.addEventListener("dragend", () => { Hub.dragFile = null; });
    return row;
  }

  function describe(info) {
    if (!info || !info.rate) return "Can't read this file";
    const minutes = Math.floor(info.length / 60), seconds = (info.length - minutes * 60).toFixed(1).padStart(4, "0");
    const channels = info.channels === 1 ? "Mono" : info.channels === 2 ? "Stereo" : `${info.channels} channels`;
    return `${info.format} · ${(info.rate / 1000).toFixed(1)} kHz · ${info.float ? "32 bit float" : info.bits + " bit"} · ${channels} · ${minutes}:${seconds}`;
  }

  function renderFiles() {
    if (!listed) { listed = true; openFolder(""); }

    const places = $("files-places");
    places.textContent = "";
    places.add(new Option(listing.path || "…", listing.path || ""));
    for (const place of listing.places || []) places.add(new Option(place.name, place.path));
    places.value = listing.path || "";
    $("files-up").disabled = !listing.parent;
    $("files-path").textContent = listing.path;

    const text = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const keep = (item) => !text || item.name.toLowerCase().includes(text);
    const list = $("files-list");
    list.textContent = "";
    for (const folder of (listing.folders || []).filter(keep)) list.appendChild(fileRow(folder, true));
    for (const file of (listing.files || []).filter(keep)) list.appendChild(fileRow(file, false));
    $("files-none").hidden = list.children.length > 0;

    const chosen = (listing.files || []).find((file) => file.path === chosenFile);
    $("files-info").hidden = !chosen;
    if (chosen) {
      $("files-info-name").textContent = chosen.name;
      $("files-info-format").textContent = fileInfo && fileInfo.path === chosen.path ? describe(fileInfo) : "…";
      const previewing = Hub.state.status && Hub.state.status.previewing === chosen.path;
      $("files-preview").textContent = previewing ? "Stop" : "Preview";
    }
  }

  function render() {
    $("browser").classList.toggle("files", tab === "files");
    $("browser").classList.toggle("fanan", tab === "fanan");
    $("browser").classList.toggle("ai", tab === "ai");
    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-browser-tab]"))
      button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(button.dataset.browserTab === tab));

    if (tab === "files") {
      renderFiles();
      return;
    }

    if (tab === "fanan") {
      Hub.emit("contentTab");   // hub-content.js draws it
      return;
    }

    if (tab === "ai") {
      Hub.emit("aiTab");        // hub-ai.js draws it
      return;
    }

    const entries = entriesForTab();
    const list = $("browser-list");
    list.textContent = "";

    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-sort]"))
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(button.dataset.sort === sortBy));

    // Favorites and Recent come first, as in Studio One (not while searching, and only when not empty).
    if (!query.trim()) {
      const favorites = entries.filter((entry) => entry.favorite);
      const recent = entries.filter((entry) => entry.lastUsed > 0).sort((a, b) => b.lastUsed - a.lastUsed).slice(0, RECENT_COUNT);
      if (favorites.length) addGroup(list, "special:favorites", "Favorites", favorites, " special favorites");
      if (recent.length) addGroup(list, "special:recent", "Recent", recent, " special recent");
    }

    if (sortBy === "flat") {
      for (const entry of entries) list.appendChild(itemFor(entry, false));
    } else {
      const groups = new Map();

      for (const entry of entries) {
        const group = groupOf(entry);
        if (!groups.has(group)) groups.set(group, []);
        groups.get(group).push(entry);
      }

      const order = [...groups.keys()].sort((a, b) => (a === "Built-in") - (b === "Built-in") || byName(a, b));
      for (const group of order) addGroup(list, `${sortBy}:${group}`, group, groups.get(group), "");
    }

    const onlyBuiltin = Hub.state.library.length === 0;
    $("browser-hint").hidden = !onlyBuiltin || query !== "";
    $("browser-none").hidden = entries.length > 0;
    renderInfo(entries);
    renderScan();
    renderFolders();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Plugin Folders dialog
  function renderFolders() {
    const list = $("folder-list");
    list.replaceChildren();

    for (const folder of library.folders || []) {
      const row = element("div", "folder-row");
      const path = element("span", "folder-path", folder);
      path.title = folder;
      const remove = element("button", "icon-button", "×");
      remove.type = "button";
      remove.title = "Remove this folder: its plugins leave the Browser";
      remove.setAttribute("aria-label", `Remove ${folder}`);
      remove.addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("removeLibraryFolder", { folder }));
      row.append(path, remove);
      list.appendChild(row);
    }

    $("folders-empty").hidden = (library.folders || []).length > 0;
  }

  Hub.commands.addLibraryFiles = () => Hub.send("addLibraryFiles");
  Hub.commands.pluginFolders = () => { renderFolders(); $("plugin-folders").hidden = false; };
  Hub.commands.rescanLibrary = () => Hub.send("rescanLibrary", { full: true });

  Hub.on("library", (data) => {
    library = data;
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("folderListing", (data) => {
    listing = data;
    chosenFile = "";
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("audioFileInfo", (info) => {
    fileInfo = info;
    if (tab === "files") render();
  });

  // The preview buttons follow what's playing.
  let previewing = "";
  Hub.on("status", (s) => {
    if ((s.previewing || "") === previewing) return;
    previewing = s.previewing || "";
    if (tab === "files") render();
  });

  Hub.on("song", (data) => {
    if (!data.opened) return;
    opened.clear();
    render();
  });

  Hub.commands.importAudioFiles = () => Hub.send("importAudioFiles");

  /** Shows one of the Browser's tabs (instruments, effects, files, fanan). */
  Hub.showBrowserTab = (name) => {
    tab = name;
    render();
  };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-browser-tab]")) {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        tab = button.dataset.browserTab;
        render();
      });
    }

    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-sort]")) {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sortBy = button.dataset.sort;
        render();
      });
    }

    $("browser-search").addEventListener("input", (event) => {
      query = event.target.value;
      render();
    });

    $("browser-add").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("addLibraryFiles"));
    $("files-places").addEventListener("change", (event) => { openFolder(event.target.value); event.target.blur(); });
    $("files-up").addEventListener("click", () => { if (listing.parent) openFolder(listing.parent); });
    $("files-preview").addEventListener("click", () => { if (chosenFile) togglePreview(chosenFile); });
    $("files-import").addEventListener("click", () => { if (chosenFile) importFile(chosenFile); });
    $("browser-folders").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("pluginFolders"));
    $("browser-rescan").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("rescanLibrary"));
    $("folders-add").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("addLibraryFolder"));
    $("folders-rescan").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("rescanLibrary"));
    $("folders-close").addEventListener("click", () => { $("plugin-folders").hidden = true; });
    $("plugin-folders").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") $("plugin-folders").hidden = true;
    });

    render();
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-cloud.js
//
// Fanan accounts and cloud songs (on Base44, like Fanan's other sites).
//   The account button (top right) signs in, creates an account (confirmed by an emailed
//   code), resets a forgotten password, and signs out.
//   File > Save to Cloud sends the saved song and its audio; File > Open from Cloud lists
//   the account's songs to open or delete. The Hub works fully without an account.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  let account = { configured: false, signedIn: false, email: "", busy: false, cloudSong: false };
  let stage = "signin";   // signin, signup, code, reset (while signed out)
  let pendingEmail = "";
  let confirmDelete = "";

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the account button
  function renderButton() {
    const button = $("account-button");
    if (!account.configured) {
      button.textContent = "Cloud";
      button.title = "The Fanan cloud isn't set up in this build yet";
    } else if (account.signedIn) {
      button.textContent = (account.email[0] || "?").toUpperCase();
      button.title = `Signed in as ${account.email}`;
    } else {
      button.textContent = "Sign in";
      button.title = "Sign in to keep songs in the Fanan cloud";
    }
    button.classList.toggle("signed-in", account.signedIn);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the account window
  function showStage(next) {
    stage = next;
    renderAccount();
  }

  function renderAccount() {
    const signedIn = account.signedIn;
    const views = { configured: account.configured, signedIn, stage };
    $("account-missing").hidden = views.configured;
    $("account-in").hidden = !views.configured || !signedIn;
    for (const name of ["signin", "signup", "code", "reset"])
      $(`account-${name}`).hidden = !views.configured || signedIn || stage !== name;
    $("account-email-shown").textContent = account.email;
    $("account-code-email").textContent = pendingEmail;
    $("account-title").textContent = !account.configured ? "Fanan cloud"
      : signedIn ? "Your account"
      : { signin: "Sign in", signup: "Create an account", code: "Confirm your email", reset: "Reset your password" }[stage];
    for (const button of $("account-dialog").querySelectorAll(".account-go")) button.disabled = account.busy;
  }

  function say(message, error) {
    const line = $("account-status");
    line.textContent = error || message || "";
    line.classList.toggle("error", Boolean(error));
  }

  function openAccount() {
    say("");
    if (!account.signedIn && stage === "code" && !pendingEmail) stage = "signin";
    renderAccount();
    $("account-dialog").hidden = false;
    // The keyboard goes into the window (so Escape and Enter reach it), even with nothing to type.
    const first = $("account-dialog").querySelector(".account-view:not([hidden]) input") || $("account-close");
    first.focus();
  }

  function closeWindow(id) {
    const box = $(id);
    if (box.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
    box.hidden = true;
  }

  function submit() {
    if (account.busy) return;
    say("");
    if (stage === "signin") {
      const email = $("signin-email").value.trim(), password = $("signin-password").value;
      if (!email || !password) return say("", "Type your email and password.");
      pendingEmail = email;
      Hub.send("accountSignIn", { email, password });
    } else if (stage === "signup") {
      const email = $("signup-email").value.trim(), password = $("signup-password").value;
      if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email)) return say("", "That doesn't look like an email address.");
      if (password.length < 8) return say("", "Choose a password of at least 8 characters.");
      if (password !== $("signup-again").value) return say("", "The two passwords are different.");
      pendingEmail = email;
      Hub.send("accountSignUp", { email, password });
    } else if (stage === "code") {
      const code = $("code-value").value.trim();
      if (!code) return say("", "Type the code from the email.");
      Hub.send("accountVerify", { email: pendingEmail, code });
    } else if (stage === "reset") {
      const email = $("reset-email").value.trim();
      if (!email) return say("", "Type your email.");
      Hub.send("accountReset", { email });
    }
    account.busy = true;
    renderAccount();
  }

  Hub.on("account", (a) => {
    const wasSignedIn = account.signedIn;
    account = a;
    if (a.stage) stage = a.stage;
    renderButton();
    renderAccount();
    if (a.message || a.error) say(a.message, a.error);
    // Signed in from the window: it closes, and says so.
    if (!wasSignedIn && a.signedIn && !$("account-dialog").hidden) {
      closeWindow("account-dialog");
      Hub.toast(`Signed in as ${a.email}`);
      stage = "signin";
      for (const input of $("account-dialog").querySelectorAll("input[type=password]")) input.value = "";
    }
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- cloud songs
  function sizeText(bytes) {
    const mb = bytes / (1024 * 1024);
    return mb >= 1 ? `${mb.toFixed(1)} MB` : `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB`;
  }

  function dateText(iso) {
    const time = Date.parse(iso);
    return Number.isNaN(time) ? "" : new Date(time).toLocaleString([], { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" });
  }

  function openCloudSongs() {
    if (!account.signedIn) {
      openAccount();
      say("", "Sign in to see your songs in the cloud.");
      return;
    }
    confirmDelete = "";
    $("cloud-list").replaceChildren(element("p", "muted", "Loading…"));
    $("cloud-status").textContent = "";
    $("cloud-dialog").hidden = false;
    $("cloud-close").focus();
    Hub.send("cloudList");
  }

  Hub.on("cloudSongs", (data) => {
    const list = $("cloud-list");
    list.replaceChildren();
    $("cloud-status").textContent = data.error || "";
    $("cloud-status").classList.toggle("error", Boolean(data.error));
    const songs = data.songs || [];
    if (!songs.length && !data.error) list.appendChild(element("p", "muted", "No songs in the cloud yet. Use File > Save to Cloud."));

    for (const song of songs) {
      const row = element("div", "cloud-row" + (song.id === data.current ? " current" : ""));
      row.dataset.id = song.id;
      const text = element("div", "cloud-text");
      text.append(element("div", "cloud-name", song.name), element("div", "muted small", `${dateText(song.updated)} · ${sizeText(song.size || 0)}`));
      row.appendChild(text);

      if (confirmDelete === song.id) {
        const sure = element("button", "plain-button small danger", "Delete");
        sure.type = "button";
        sure.addEventListener("click", () => { confirmDelete = ""; Hub.send("cloudDelete", { id: song.id }); });
        const keep = element("button", "plain-button small", "Keep");
        keep.type = "button";
        keep.addEventListener("click", () => { confirmDelete = ""; Hub.send("cloudList"); });
        row.append(element("span", "small", "Delete it from the cloud?"), sure, keep);
      } else {
        const open = element("button", "plain-button small primary", "Open");
        open.type = "button";
        open.addEventListener("click", () => {
          closeWindow("cloud-dialog");
          showProgress("Opening from the cloud", song.name);
          Hub.send("cloudOpen", { id: song.id });
        });
        const remove = element("button", "plain-button small", "Delete");
        remove.type = "button";
        remove.title = "Delete it from the cloud (the copy on this computer stays)";
        remove.addEventListener("click", () => {
          confirmDelete = song.id;
          Hub.emit("cloudSongs", data);
        });
        row.append(open, remove);
      }
      list.appendChild(row);
    }
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- progress
  function showProgress(title, text) {
    $("cloud-progress-title").textContent = title;
    $("cloud-progress-text").textContent = text || "";
    $("cloud-fill").style.width = "0%";
    $("cloud-progress").hidden = false;
  }

  Hub.on("cloudProgress", (p) => {
    if ($("cloud-progress").hidden) showProgress(p.action === "save" ? "Saving to the cloud" : "Opening from the cloud", "");
    $("cloud-progress-text").textContent = p.text || "";
    $("cloud-fill").style.width = `${Math.round(Hub.clamp01(p.fraction || 0) * 100)}%`;
  });

  Hub.on("cloudResult", (r) => {
    closeWindow("cloud-progress");
    if (r.ok && r.action === "save") Hub.toast(`Saved “${r.name}” to the cloud`);
    if (!r.ok && r.error) Hub.toast(r.error);
    if (r.action === "delete" && !$("cloud-dialog").hidden) $("cloud-status").textContent = r.error || "";
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands
  Hub.commands.account = openAccount;
  Hub.commands.openFromCloud = openCloudSongs;
  Hub.commands.saveToCloud = () => {
    if (!account.signedIn) {
      openAccount();
      say("", "Sign in to save songs to the cloud.");
      return;
    }
    showProgress("Saving to the cloud", "");
    Hub.send("cloudSave");
  };

  Hub.cloud = { state: () => account, stage: () => stage };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    renderButton();
    $("account-button").addEventListener("click", openAccount);
    $("account-dialog").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter" && event.target.tagName === "INPUT") { event.preventDefault(); submit(); }
    });

    // Escape closes these windows wherever the keyboard is (a button that just went busy drops it).
    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
      const open = ["account-dialog", "cloud-dialog"].find((id) => !$(id).hidden);
      if (!open) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      closeWindow(open);
    }, true);
    for (const button of $("account-dialog").querySelectorAll(".account-go")) button.addEventListener("click", submit);
    for (const link of $("account-dialog").querySelectorAll("[data-stage]"))
      link.addEventListener("click", () => { say(""); showStage(link.dataset.stage); });
    $("account-resend").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("accountResend", { email: pendingEmail }));
    $("account-signout").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("accountSignOut"));
    $("account-close").addEventListener("click", () => closeWindow("account-dialog"));
    $("cloud-close").addEventListener("click", () => closeWindow("cloud-dialog"));
    $("cloud-refresh").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("cloudList"));
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-console.js
//
// The Console (F3), Studio One's mixer: a channel strip for every track and the
// Main channel on the right. Faders use the same scale as the track headers.
// Meters show each channel after its fader, with a peak hold and a clip light.
// Each strip lists its inserts: click one to open it in the Inspector, click its
// light to bypass it, + to add an effect, or drop one from the Browser.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const SCALE = [10, 6, 0, -6, -12, -24, -36, -48, -72];
  const CAP = 32;                     // fader cap height in px; the meters and scale sit inside its travel
  const FALL_DB_PER_SECOND = 26;      // how fast a meter drops
  const HOLD_MS = 1500;               // how long the peak line stays before it falls too
  const FLOOR_DB = -144;

  const strips = new Map();           // track id -> strip (FX channels too)
  const expanded = new Set();         // strips showing their inserts and sends
  let main = null;

  const ICON_MONITOR = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M2 6h3l4-3v10L5 10H2z"/><path d="M11 5.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4"/></svg>';
  const ICON_RECORD = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="4.5"/></svg>';
  const ICON_POWER = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M7.25 1.5h1.5v6h-1.5z"/><path d="M4.2 3.6l1.06 1.06A4.25 4.25 0 1 0 10.74 4.66L11.8 3.6A5.75 5.75 0 1 1 4.2 3.6z"/></svg>';
  const ICON_EXPAND = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M6 3.5l4.5 4.5L6 12.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"/></svg>';
  const ICON_SCREEN = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><rect x="2" y="3" width="12" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/><path d="M2 5.8h12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>';
  const ICON_REMOVE = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M4.5 4.5l7 7M11.5 4.5l-7 7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>';
  const ICON_KEYS = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M1.5 3.5h13v9h-13z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"/><path d="M5 3.5v5M8 3.5v5M11 3.5v5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>';

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- meters
  class Meter {
    constructor(root) {
      this.bars = [...root.querySelectorAll(".bar")].map((bar) => ({
        cover: bar.querySelector(".cover"),
        hold: bar.querySelector(".hold"),
        level: FLOOR_DB, peak: FLOOR_DB, peakAt: 0, shownCover: -1, shownHold: -1
      }));
      this.clip = root.querySelector(".clip");
      this.clipped = false;
      this.clip.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
        this.resetClip();
      });
    }

    /** New peaks from the engine (linear, 1.0 = 0 dBFS). */
    feed(left, right) {
      const now = performance.now();
      [left, right].forEach((gain, index) => {
        const bar = this.bars[index];
        if (!bar) return;
        const db = Hub.gainToDb(gain || 0);
        if (db > bar.level) bar.level = db;
        if (db >= bar.peak) { bar.peak = db; bar.peakAt = now; }
        if (gain >= 1 && !this.clipped) {
          this.clipped = true;
          this.clip.classList.add("on");
        }
      });
    }

    tick(now, seconds) {
      for (const bar of this.bars) {
        bar.level = Math.max(FLOOR_DB, bar.level - FALL_DB_PER_SECOND * seconds);
        if (now - bar.peakAt > HOLD_MS) bar.peak = Math.max(bar.level, bar.peak - FALL_DB_PER_SECOND * seconds);

        // Only touch the page when something visibly moved.
        const cover = Math.round((1 - Hub.dbToFader(bar.level)) * 1000) / 10;
        if (cover !== bar.shownCover) {
          bar.shownCover = cover;
          bar.cover.style.height = cover + "%";
        }

        const hold = bar.peak > Hub.SILENT_DB ? Math.round(Hub.dbToFader(bar.peak) * 1000) / 10 : -1;
        if (hold !== bar.shownHold) {
          bar.shownHold = hold;
          bar.hold.hidden = hold < 0;
          if (hold >= 0) bar.hold.style.bottom = hold + "%";
        }
      }
    }

    resetClip() {
      this.clipped = false;
      this.clip.classList.remove("on");
      for (const bar of this.bars) bar.peak = bar.level;
    }

    highestPeak() {
      return Math.max(...this.bars.map((bar) => bar.peak));
    }
  }

  function meterMarkup() {
    return `<div class="vmeter">
        <span class="clip" title="Clip: the signal went over 0 dB. Click to reset."></span>
        <div class="bar"><div class="cover"></div><div class="hold" hidden></div></div>
        <div class="bar"><div class="cover"></div><div class="hold" hidden></div></div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function scaleMarkup() {
    return `<div class="scale">${SCALE.map((db) =>
      `<span style="bottom:calc(${CAP / 2}px + ${Hub.dbToFader(db).toFixed(4)} * (100% - ${CAP}px))">${db}</span>`).join("")}</div>`;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- faders
  /** A vertical fader you drag (Shift for fine), scroll, arrow-key, or double-click to 0 dB. */
  function makeFader(fader, get, set) {
    let drag = null;
    const travel = () => Math.max(40, fader.clientHeight - CAP);
    const move = (delta) => set(Hub.faderToDb(Hub.clamp01(Hub.dbToFader(get()) + delta)));

    fader.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.button !== 0) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      fader.focus();
      if (fader.setPointerCapture) fader.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      drag = { y: event.clientY, position: Hub.dbToFader(get()), pointer: event.pointerId, fine: event.shiftKey };
      fader.classList.add("active");
    });

    fader.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointer) return;

      // Changing Shift mid-drag restarts from here, so the cap never jumps.
      if (event.shiftKey !== drag.fine) {
        drag = { y: event.clientY, position: Hub.dbToFader(get()), pointer: drag.pointer, fine: event.shiftKey };
        return;
      }

      const scale = drag.fine ? 0.1 : 1;
      set(Hub.faderToDb(Hub.clamp01(drag.position + (drag.y - event.clientY) / travel() * scale)));
    });

    const end = (event) => {
      if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointer) return;
      drag = null;
      fader.classList.remove("active");
    };

    fader.addEventListener("pointerup", end);
    fader.addEventListener("pointercancel", end);
    fader.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", end);
    fader.addEventListener("dblclick", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      set(0);
    });

    fader.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      move((event.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1) * (event.shiftKey ? 0.002 : 0.01));
    }, { passive: false });

    fader.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      const steps = { ArrowUp: 0.005, ArrowDown: -0.005, PageUp: 0.05, PageDown: -0.05 };
      if (!(event.key in steps)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      move(steps[event.key]);
    });
  }

  function showFader(fader, readout, db) {
    const position = Hub.dbToFader(db);
    fader.style.setProperty("--pos", position.toFixed(4));
    fader.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", db.toFixed(1));
    fader.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", Hub.dbText(db));
    readout.textContent = Hub.dbText(db);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- inserts on a strip
  function insertsMarkup() {
    return `<div class="strip-inserts">
        <div class="strip-insert-list"></div>
        <button class="strip-add" title="Add an effect" aria-label="Add an effect">+ Insert</button>
      </div>`;
  }

  /** Wires a strip's inserts area to its channel (a track id or Hub.MAIN). */
  function setupInserts(area, channel) {
    area.querySelector(".strip-add").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      Hub.addEffectMenu(event.currentTarget, channel);
    });

    area.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const item = event.target.closest(".strip-insert-item");
      if (!item) return;
      event.stopPropagation();
      const insertId = Number(item.dataset.insertId);

      if (event.target.closest(".mini-power")) {
        const power = item.querySelector(".mini-power");
        const bypass = power.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true";
        power.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!bypass));
        item.classList.toggle("bypassed", bypass);
        Hub.send("bypassInsert", { trackId: channel, insertId, bypass });
        return;
      }

      Hub.openScreen(channel, insertId);   // its window, as in Fender Studio
    });
  }

  /** Strips are narrow: drop a leading "[Pack]" tag, so "[Basics] Chorus" shows as "Chorus". */
  const shortName = (name) => name.replace(/^\[[^\]]*\]\s*/, "") || name;

  function showInserts(area, inserts, channel) {
    const key = inserts.map((i) => `${i.insertId}:${i.bypass ? 1 : 0}:${i.name}`).join(",");
    if (area.dataset.key === key) return;
    area.dataset.key = key;

    const list = area.querySelector(".strip-insert-list");
    list.textContent = "";

    for (const insert of inserts) {
      const item = element("div", "strip-insert-item");
      item.dataset.insertId = String(insert.insertId);
      item.classList.toggle("bypassed", Boolean(insert.bypass));
      const power = element("button", "mini-power");
      power.innerHTML = ICON_POWER;
      power.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!insert.bypass));
      power.setAttribute("aria-label", insert.bypass ? `Switch ${insert.name} on` : `Bypass ${insert.name}`);
      const name = element("button", "strip-insert-name", shortName(insert.name));
      name.title = `${insert.name}: click to edit it in the Inspector, double-click to open its screen`;
      name.addEventListener("dblclick", () => Hub.openScreen(channel, insert.insertId));
      item.append(power, name);
      list.appendChild(item);
    }

    area.querySelector(".strip-add").hidden = inserts.length >= Hub.MAX_INSERTS;
  }

  /** Browser plugins dropped on a strip: effects join its inserts, instruments replace its instrument. */
  function setupStripDrop(root, channel) {
    const accepts = () => Boolean(Hub.dragEntry) && (channel !== Hub.MAIN || Hub.dragEntry.kind === "effect");

    root.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
      if (!accepts()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (event.dataTransfer) event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "copy";
      root.classList.add("drop-target");
    });

    root.addEventListener("dragleave", (event) => {
      if (!root.contains(event.relatedTarget)) root.classList.remove("drop-target");
    });

    root.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
      root.classList.remove("drop-target");
      if (!accepts()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      Hub.dropEntryOn(Hub.dragEntry, channel);
      Hub.dragEntry = null;
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the expanded panel: inserts and sends
  /** Wires a strip's panel: its inserts (like Fender Studio's: on/off, name, the plugin's
      screen), its sends (to FX channels, or to a plugin's sidechain), the expand toggle. */
  function setupPanel(strip, channel) {
    const root = strip.root;

    root.querySelector(".strip-expand").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (expanded.has(channel)) expanded.delete(channel);
      else expanded.add(channel);
      root.classList.toggle("expanded", expanded.has(channel));
      event.currentTarget.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(expanded.has(channel)));
    });

    root.querySelector(".panel-add").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      Hub.addEffectMenu(event.currentTarget, channel);
    });

    root.querySelector(".panel-insert-list").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const item = event.target.closest(".panel-insert");
      if (!item) return;
      event.stopPropagation();
      const insertId = Number(item.dataset.insertId);

      if (event.target.closest(".panel-power")) {
        const power = item.querySelector(".panel-power");
        const bypass = power.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true";
        power.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!bypass));
        item.classList.toggle("bypassed", bypass);
        Hub.send("bypassInsert", { trackId: channel, insertId, bypass });
      } else if (event.target.closest(".panel-insert-remove")) {
        Hub.send("removeInsert", { trackId: channel, insertId });
      } else {
        Hub.openScreen(channel, insertId);   // the UI button and the name both open it
      }
    });

    setupInsertReorder(root.querySelector(".panel-insert-list"), channel);

    root.querySelector(".panel-add-send").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      sendMenu(event.currentTarget, channel);
    });

    const sends = root.querySelector(".panel-send-list");
    sends.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const row = event.target.closest(".panel-send");
      if (!row) return;
      event.stopPropagation();
      const sendId = Number(row.dataset.sendId);

      if (event.target.closest(".panel-send-on")) {
        const button = row.querySelector(".panel-send-on");
        const on = button.getAttribute("aria-pressed") !== "true";
        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
        row.classList.toggle("off", !on);
        Hub.send("setSend", { trackId: channel, sendId, on });
      } else if (event.target.closest(".panel-send-remove")) {
        Hub.send("removeSend", { trackId: channel, sendId });
      }
    });

    // The level: the engine follows the drag; one step goes into the history when it's let go.
    sends.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      const slider = event.target.closest(".panel-send-level");
      if (slider) slider.dataset.from = String(Hub.faderToDb(Number(slider.value)));
    });
    sends.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
      const slider = event.target.closest(".panel-send-level");
      if (!slider) return;
      const row = slider.closest(".panel-send");
      const db = Hub.faderToDb(Number(slider.value));
      row.querySelector(".panel-send-db").textContent = sendDbText(db);
      Hub.send("setSend", { trackId: channel, sendId: Number(row.dataset.sendId), level: db, commit: false });
    });
    sends.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      const slider = event.target.closest(".panel-send-level");
      if (!slider) return;
      const row = slider.closest(".panel-send");
      const db = Hub.faderToDb(Number(slider.value));
      const message = { trackId: channel, sendId: Number(row.dataset.sendId), level: db, commit: true };
      if (slider.dataset.from !== undefined) message.from = Number(slider.dataset.from);
      delete slider.dataset.from;
      Hub.send("setSend", message);
    });
    sends.addEventListener("dblclick", (event) => {
      const slider = event.target.closest(".panel-send-level");
      if (!slider) return;
      const row = slider.closest(".panel-send");
      Hub.send("setSend", { trackId: channel, sendId: Number(row.dataset.sendId), level: 0, commit: true });
    });

    root.querySelector(".panel-remove").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      Hub.send("removeTrack", { id: channel });
    });
  }

  /** Inserts reorder by dragging their banners (a line shows where one lands). */
  function setupInsertReorder(list, channel) {
    let dragging = null;   // { insertId, from }
    let line = null;

    const rows = () => [...list.querySelectorAll(".panel-insert")];
    const indexAt = (clientY) => {
      const all = rows();
      const at = all.findIndex((row) => { const r = row.getBoundingClientRect(); return clientY < r.top + r.height / 2; });
      return at < 0 ? all.length : at;
    };
    const clearLine = () => { if (line) line.remove(); line = null; };

    list.addEventListener("dragstart", (event) => {
      const row = event.target.closest(".panel-insert");
      if (!row) return;
      dragging = { insertId: Number(row.dataset.insertId), from: rows().indexOf(row) };
      row.classList.add("dragging");
      if (event.dataTransfer) {
        event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
        event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", row.dataset.insertId);
      }
    });

    list.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
      if (!dragging) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (event.dataTransfer) event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "move";
      const index = indexAt(event.clientY);
      clearLine();
      line = element("div", "drop-line");
      const all = rows();
      if (index < all.length) list.insertBefore(line, all[index]);
      else if (all.length) all[all.length - 1].after(line);
    });

    list.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
      if (!dragging) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const index = indexAt(event.clientY);
      const position = index > dragging.from ? index - 1 : index;
      if (position !== dragging.from) Hub.send("moveInsert", { trackId: channel, insertId: dragging.insertId, position });
      clearLine();
    });

    list.addEventListener("dragend", () => {
      list.querySelectorAll(".dragging").forEach((row) => row.classList.remove("dragging"));
      dragging = null;
      clearLine();
    });
  }

  /** Where a track can send: FX channels (or a new one), and every plugin in the song with a
      sidechain input on another channel, for ducking. */
  function sendMenu(anchor, channel) {
    const track = Hub.trackById(channel);
    if (!track) return;
    const sends = track.sends || [];
    const items = [];

    const fxChannels = (Hub.state.fxChannels || []).filter((fx) => !sends.some((s) => !s.sidechain && s.target === fx.id));
    if (fxChannels.length) items.push({ group: "FX Channels" });
    for (const fx of fxChannels) items.push({ label: fx.name, value: { target: fx.id } });
    items.push({ label: "New FX Channel", value: { newFx: true } });

    const targets = (Hub.state.sidechainTargets || []).filter((t) => t.channel !== channel
      && !sends.some((s) => s.sidechain && s.target === t.channel && s.slot === t.slot));
    items.push({ group: targets.length ? "Sidechain" : "Sidechain: no plugin with a sidechain input yet" });
    for (const t of targets) items.push({ label: `${t.name} \u00b7 ${t.channelName}`, value: { target: t.channel, slot: t.slot, sidechain: true } });

    Hub.popupMenu(anchor, items, (pick) => {
      if (pick.newFx) Hub.send("addFxChannel", { from: channel });
      else Hub.send("addSend", { trackId: channel, target: pick.target, slot: pick.slot || 0, sidechain: Boolean(pick.sidechain) });
    });
  }

  function showPanelInserts(list, inserts, channel) {
    const key = inserts.map((i) => `${i.insertId}:${i.bypass ? 1 : 0}:${i.name}`).join(",");
    if (list.dataset.key === key) return;
    list.dataset.key = key;
    list.textContent = "";

    for (const insert of inserts) {
      const item = element("div", "panel-insert" + (insert.bypass ? " bypassed" : ""));
      item.dataset.insertId = String(insert.insertId);
      const power = element("button", "panel-power");
      power.type = "button";
      power.innerHTML = ICON_POWER;
      power.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!insert.bypass));
      power.setAttribute("aria-label", insert.bypass ? `Switch ${insert.name} on` : `Switch ${insert.name} off`);
      power.title = insert.bypass ? "Off: click to switch it on" : "On: click to switch it off";
      const name = element("button", "panel-insert-name", shortName(insert.name));
      name.type = "button";
      name.title = `${insert.name}${insert.sidechain ? " (has a sidechain input)" : ""}: click to edit it in the Inspector`;
      name.title = `${insert.name}: click to open it; drag to reorder`;
      const ui = element("button", "panel-ui");
      ui.type = "button";
      ui.innerHTML = ICON_SCREEN;
      ui.title = `Show ${insert.name}`;
      ui.setAttribute("aria-label", `Show ${insert.name}`);
      const remove = element("button", "panel-insert-remove");
      remove.type = "button";
      remove.innerHTML = ICON_REMOVE;
      remove.title = `Remove ${insert.name}`;
      remove.setAttribute("aria-label", `Remove ${insert.name}`);
      item.draggable = true;
      item.append(power, name, ui, remove);
      list.appendChild(item);
    }

    if (!inserts.length) list.appendChild(element("p", "panel-note", "Drop an effect here"));
  }

  /** The narrow send row shows the number only ("-13.5"); the full reading is its tooltip. */
  const sendDbText = (db) => Hub.dbText(db).replace(" dB", "");

  function showSends(list, track) {
    const sends = track.sends || [];
    const key = sends.map((s) => `${s.id}:${s.on ? 1 : 0}:${s.level.toFixed(2)}:${s.name}`).join(",");
    if (list.dataset.key === key || list.contains(document.activeElement)) return;
    list.dataset.key = key;
    list.textContent = "";

    for (const send of sends) {
      const row = element("div", "panel-send" + (send.sidechain ? " sidechain" : "") + (send.on ? "" : " off"));
      row.dataset.sendId = String(send.id);
      const top = element("div", "panel-send-top");
      const name = element("span", "panel-send-name", send.name);
      name.title = send.sidechain ? `Sidechain: into ${send.name}` : `To ${send.name}`;
      const on = element("button", "panel-send-on");
      on.type = "button";
      on.innerHTML = ICON_POWER;
      on.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(send.on));
      on.setAttribute("aria-label", `${send.on ? "Switch off" : "Switch on"} the send to ${send.name}`);
      const remove = element("button", "panel-send-remove");
      remove.type = "button";
      remove.innerHTML = ICON_REMOVE;
      remove.setAttribute("aria-label", `Remove the send to ${send.name}`);
      top.append(on, name, remove);
      const bottom = element("div", "panel-send-bottom");
      const level = element("input", "panel-send-level");
      level.type = "range";
      level.min = "0";
      level.max = "1";
      level.step = "0.001";
      level.value = String(Hub.dbToFader(send.level));
      level.setAttribute("aria-label", `Send level to ${send.name}`);
      level.title = "Double-click for 0 dB";
      const db = element("output", "panel-send-db", sendDbText(send.level));
      db.title = Hub.dbText(send.level);
      bottom.append(level, db);
      row.append(top, bottom);
      list.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (!sends.length) list.appendChild(element("p", "panel-note", "No sends"));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- channel strips
  function createStrip(track) {
    const root = element("div", "strip");
    root.dataset.id = String(track.id);
    root.innerHTML = `
      ${insertsMarkup()}
      <div class="strip-pan">
        <input type="range" data-control="pan" min="-1" max="1" step="0.01" aria-label="Pan">
        <output></output>
      </div>
      <div class="strip-buttons">
        <button class="tbtn" data-action="mute" aria-pressed="false" title="Mute">M</button>
        <button class="tbtn" data-action="solo" aria-pressed="false" title="Solo">S</button>
        <button class="tbtn arm" data-action="recordArm" aria-pressed="false" title="Record arm">${ICON_RECORD}</button>
        <button class="tbtn monitor" data-action="monitor" aria-pressed="false" title="Monitor">${ICON_MONITOR}</button>
      </div>
      <output class="strip-db"></output>
      <div class="strip-body">
        <div class="fader" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="Volume" aria-valuemin="-72" aria-valuemax="10"><div class="fader-cap"></div></div>
        ${meterMarkup()}
        ${scaleMarkup()}
      </div>
      <div class="strip-number"><span></span>${ICON_KEYS}<button class="strip-expand" type="button" aria-pressed="false"
        title="Show inserts and sends" aria-label="Show inserts and sends">${ICON_EXPAND}</button></div>
      <div class="strip-name" title="Double-click to rename"></div>
      <div class="strip-panel">
        <div class="panel-inserts">
          <div class="panel-head"><span>Inserts</span><button class="panel-add" type="button" title="Add an effect (or drop one from the Browser)" aria-label="Add an effect">+</button></div>
          <div class="panel-list panel-insert-list"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="panel-sends">
          <div class="panel-head"><span>Sends</span><button class="panel-add-send" type="button" title="Send to an FX channel, or to a plugin's sidechain" aria-label="Add a send">+</button></div>
          <div class="panel-list panel-send-list"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="panel-fx">
          <div class="panel-head"><span>FX Channel</span></div>
          <p class="panel-note">Tracks send to it; it plays into Main.</p>
          <button class="panel-remove" type="button">Remove</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;

    const strip = {
      root,
      fader: root.querySelector(".fader"),
      readout: root.querySelector(".strip-db"),
      pan: root.querySelector('[data-control="pan"]'),
      meter: new Meter(root.querySelector(".vmeter"))
    };

    const id = track.id;
    const current = () => Hub.trackById(id);

    makeFader(strip.fader, () => (current() ? current().volume : 0), (db) => {
      showFader(strip.fader, strip.readout, db);
      Hub.setTrackValue(id, "volume", db, strip.fader);
    });

    strip.pan.addEventListener("input", () => {
      const value = Number(strip.pan.value);
      strip.pan.nextElementSibling.textContent = Hub.panText(value);
      Hub.setTrackValue(id, "pan", value, strip.pan);
    });

    strip.pan.addEventListener("dblclick", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      strip.pan.value = "0";
      strip.pan.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    });

    root.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const button = event.target.closest("[data-action]");

      if (button) {
        const action = button.dataset.action;
        const on = button.getAttribute("aria-pressed") !== "true";
        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
        Hub.send("trackSettings", { id, [action]: on });
        return;
      }

      // FX channels aren't tracks to select (the selection is where the keyboard plays).
      const track = current();
      if (!event.target.closest("input, .fader, .clip, .strip-inserts, .strip-panel, .strip-expand") && track && track.kind !== "fx")
        Hub.selectTrack(id);
    });

    setupInserts(root.querySelector(".strip-inserts"), id);
    setupStripDrop(root, id);
    setupPanel(strip, id);

    root.querySelector(".strip-name").addEventListener("dblclick", (event) => {
      const track = current();
      if (track) Hub.inlineRename(event.currentTarget, track.name, (value) => Hub.send("trackSettings", { id, name: value }));
    });

    return strip;
  }

  function updateStrip(strip, track) {
    const root = strip.root;
    root.style.setProperty("--track-colour", track.colour);
    root.classList.toggle("fx", track.kind === "fx");
    root.classList.toggle("expanded", expanded.has(track.id));
    root.querySelector(".strip-expand").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(expanded.has(track.id)));
    showPanelInserts(root.querySelector(".panel-insert-list"), track.inserts || [], track.id);
    showSends(root.querySelector(".panel-send-list"), track);
    root.classList.toggle("selected", !Hub.state.inspectMain && track.id === Hub.state.selected);
    showInserts(root.querySelector(".strip-inserts"), track.inserts || [], track.id);

    for (const action of ["mute", "solo", "recordArm", "monitor"])
      root.querySelector(`[data-action="${action}"]`).setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(Boolean(track[action])));

    showValues(strip, track);

    root.querySelector(".strip-number span").textContent = track.kind === "fx" ? "FX" : String(track.number);
    const name = root.querySelector(".strip-name");
    if (!name.querySelector("input")) name.textContent = track.name;
  }

  /** Fader and pan, unless the user is working that control right now. */
  function showValues(strip, track) {
    if (!strip.fader.classList.contains("active")) showFader(strip.fader, strip.readout, track.volume);
    if (document.activeElement !== strip.pan) strip.pan.value = String(track.pan);
    strip.pan.nextElementSibling.textContent = Hub.panText(track.pan);
  }

  function renderStrips() {
    const list = $("console-strips");
    const alive = new Set();

    [...Hub.state.tracks, ...(Hub.state.fxChannels || [])].forEach((track, index) => {
      let strip = strips.get(track.id);

      if (!strip) {
        strip = createStrip(track);
        strips.set(track.id, strip);
      }

      updateStrip(strip, track);
      alive.add(track.id);
      if (list.children[index] !== strip.root) list.insertBefore(strip.root, list.children[index] || null);
    });

    for (const [id, strip] of strips) {
      if (!alive.has(id)) {
        strip.root.remove();
        strips.delete(id);
      }
    }

    $("console-empty").hidden = Hub.state.tracks.length + (Hub.state.fxChannels || []).length > 0;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Main
  function createMain() {
    const root = $("console-main");
    root.innerHTML = `
      <div class="strip main-strip">
        ${insertsMarkup()}
        <div class="main-peaks" title="Highest peak since the last reset. Click to reset.">
          <output class="peak"></output><output class="peak"></output>
        </div>
        <div class="strip-buttons">
          <button class="tbtn" data-action="mute" aria-pressed="false" title="Mute Main (the metronome keeps playing)">M</button>
        </div>
        <output class="strip-db"></output>
        <div class="strip-body">
          <div class="fader" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="Main volume" aria-valuemin="-72" aria-valuemax="10"><div class="fader-cap"></div></div>
          ${meterMarkup()}
          ${scaleMarkup()}
        </div>
        <div class="strip-number"><span>Out</span></div>
        <div class="strip-name">Main</div>
      </div>`;

    const strip = {
      root: root.firstElementChild,
      fader: root.querySelector(".fader"),
      readout: root.querySelector(".strip-db"),
      meter: new Meter(root.querySelector(".vmeter")),
      peaks: [...root.querySelectorAll(".main-peaks .peak")],
      highest: [FLOOR_DB, FLOOR_DB]
    };

    makeFader(strip.fader, () => Hub.state.master.volume, (db) => {
      showFader(strip.fader, strip.readout, db);
      Hub.setMasterValue("volume", db, strip.fader);
    });

    strip.root.querySelector('[data-action="mute"]').addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const on = event.currentTarget.getAttribute("aria-pressed") !== "true";
      event.currentTarget.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
      Hub.setMasterValue("mute", on, event.currentTarget);
    });

    strip.root.querySelector(".main-peaks").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      strip.highest = [FLOOR_DB, FLOOR_DB];
      strip.meter.resetClip();
      showPeaks();
    });

    // Clicking Main shows its inserts in the Inspector.
    strip.root.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      if (!event.target.closest("button, .fader, .clip, .strip-inserts, .main-peaks")) Hub.inspectMain();
    });

    setupInserts(strip.root.querySelector(".strip-inserts"), Hub.MAIN);
    setupStripDrop(strip.root, Hub.MAIN);
    return strip;
  }

  function showPeaks() {
    main.highest.forEach((db, index) => {
      main.peaks[index].textContent = db <= Hub.SILENT_DB ? "-∞" : db.toFixed(1);
      main.peaks[index].classList.toggle("over", db >= 0);
    });
  }

  function renderMain() {
    const master = Hub.state.master;
    main.root.classList.toggle("selected", Hub.state.inspectMain);
    showInserts(main.root.querySelector(".strip-inserts"), master.inserts || [], Hub.MAIN);
    main.root.querySelector('[data-action="mute"]').setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(Boolean(master.mute)));
    if (!main.fader.classList.contains("active")) showFader(main.fader, main.readout, master.volume);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- animation
  let lastFrame = 0;

  function animate(now) {
    const seconds = lastFrame ? Math.min(0.1, (now - lastFrame) / 1000) : 0;
    lastFrame = now;

    if (!document.body.classList.contains("hide-console")) {
      for (const strip of strips.values()) strip.meter.tick(now, seconds);
      main.meter.tick(now, seconds);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- events
  Hub.on("tracks", () => {
    renderStrips();
    renderMain();
  });

  Hub.on("selection", () => {
    for (const [id, strip] of strips) strip.root.classList.toggle("selected", !Hub.state.inspectMain && id === Hub.state.selected);
    main.root.classList.toggle("selected", Hub.state.inspectMain);
  });

  // A fader moved somewhere else (a track header): show it here too.
  Hub.on("trackValue", ({ id, source }) => {
    const strip = strips.get(id);
    const track = Hub.trackById(id);
    if (strip && track && !strip.root.contains(source)) showValues(strip, track);
  });

  Hub.on("status", (s) => {
    for (const meter of s.trackMeters || []) {
      const strip = strips.get(meter.id);
      if (strip) strip.meter.feed(meter.left, meter.right);

      // Automation moves the faders here too.
      const track = strip && meter.volume !== undefined ? Hub.trackById(meter.id) : null;
      if (track) {
        track.volume = meter.volume;
        track.pan = meter.pan;
        showValues(strip, track);
      }
    }

    main.meter.feed(s.peakLeft, s.peakRight);

    const left = Hub.gainToDb(s.peakLeft || 0), right = Hub.gainToDb(s.peakRight || 0);
    if (left > main.highest[0] || right > main.highest[1]) {
      main.highest = [Math.max(main.highest[0], left), Math.max(main.highest[1], right)];
      showPeaks();
    }
  });

  Hub.commands.resetClips = () => {
    for (const strip of strips.values()) strip.meter.resetClip();
    main.meter.resetClip();
  };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    main = createMain();
    showPeaks();
    renderStrips();
    renderMain();
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-content.js
//
// The Browser's Fanan tab: what Fanan publishes (loops, samples, songs, WCLAP plugins),
// for everyone, no account needed. ▶ previews an item; Install downloads it into
// Documents\Fanan Web Hub\Fanan Content: loops and samples then show in the Files tab,
// songs open, plugins appear in the Browser. Update appears when Fanan has a newer one.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const KINDS = [["all", "All"], ["loop", "Loops"], ["sample", "Samples"], ["song", "Songs"], ["plugin", "Plugins"]];
  let items = [], error = "", configured = true, loaded = false, kind = "all";
  const previews = new Map();    // id -> preview file
  const progress = new Map();    // id -> fraction while installing

  function sizeText(bytes) {
    const mb = (bytes || 0) / (1024 * 1024);
    return mb >= 1 ? `${mb.toFixed(1)} MB` : `${Math.max(1, Math.round((bytes || 0) / 1024))} KB`;
  }

  function metaOf(item) {
    const parts = [{ loop: "Loop", sample: "Sample", song: "Song", plugin: "Plugin" }[item.kind]];
    if (item.bpm) parts.push(`${item.bpm} BPM`);
    if (item.key) parts.push(item.key);
    parts.push(sizeText(item.size));
    return parts.join(" · ");
  }

  function actionOf(item) {
    if (progress.has(item.id)) return null;
    if (item.update) return ["Update", "Fanan has a newer version"];
    if (!item.installed) return ["Install", item.kind === "plugin" ? "Install it into the Browser" : "Download it to this computer"];
    if (item.kind === "song") return ["Open", "Open the song"];
    if (item.kind === "plugin") return null;
    return ["Show", "Show it in the Files tab"];
  }

  function render() {
    const list = $("fanan-list");
    list.replaceChildren();
    for (const chip of $("fanan-kinds").children) chip.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(chip.dataset.kind === kind));

    if (!configured || error) {
      list.appendChild(element("p", "browser-note", error || "Fanan's content isn't set up in this build yet."));
      return;
    }
    if (!loaded) {
      list.appendChild(element("p", "browser-note", "Loading Fanan's content…"));
      return;
    }

    const text = $("browser-search").value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const shown = items.filter((item) => (kind === "all" || item.kind === kind)
      && (!text || [item.title, item.description, ...(item.tags || [])].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(text)));
    if (!shown.length) list.appendChild(element("p", "browser-note", items.length ? "Nothing found." : "Nothing published yet."));

    const previewing = Hub.state.status && Hub.state.status.previewing;
    for (const item of shown) {
      const row = element("div", "fanan-item");
      row.dataset.id = item.id;
      const text = element("div", "fanan-text");
      const title = element("div", "fanan-title", item.title);
      if (item.installed && !item.update) title.appendChild(element("span", "fanan-badge", "Installed"));
      text.append(title, element("div", "muted small", metaOf(item)));
      if (item.description) text.appendChild(element("div", "fanan-description small", item.description));
      if (progress.has(item.id)) {
        const bar = element("div", "export-bar fanan-bar");
        const fill = element("i");
        fill.style.width = `${Math.round(progress.get(item.id) * 100)}%`;
        bar.appendChild(fill);
        text.appendChild(bar);
      }
      row.appendChild(text);

      if (item.kind !== "plugin") {
        const playing = previews.has(item.id) && previewing === previews.get(item.id);
        const play = element("button", "file-play fanan-play", playing ? "■" : "▶");
        play.type = "button";
        play.title = playing ? "Stop the preview" : "Preview";
        play.setAttribute("aria-label", `${playing ? "Stop" : "Preview"} ${item.title}`);
        play.addEventListener("click", () => {
          if (playing) Hub.send("stopPreview");
          else Hub.send("contentPreview", { id: item.id });
        });
        row.appendChild(play);
      }

      const action = actionOf(item);
      if (action) {
        const button = element("button", "plain-button small" + (action[0] === "Install" || action[0] === "Update" ? " primary" : ""), action[0]);
        button.type = "button";
        button.title = action[1];
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          if (action[0] === "Install" || action[0] === "Update") {
            progress.set(item.id, 0);
            render();
            Hub.send("contentInstall", { id: item.id });
          } else {
            if (action[0] === "Show" && Hub.showBrowserTab) Hub.showBrowserTab("files");
            Hub.send("contentOpen", { id: item.id });
          }
        });
        row.appendChild(button);
      }
      $("fanan-list").appendChild(row);
    }
  }

  Hub.on("contentTab", () => {
    if (!loaded && !error) Hub.send("contentList");
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("fananContent", (data) => {
    items = data.items || [];
    error = data.error || "";
    configured = data.configured !== false;
    loaded = true;
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("contentProgress", (p) => {
    progress.set(p.id, Hub.clamp01(p.fraction || 0));
    const fill = document.querySelector(`.fanan-item[data-id="${p.id}"] .fanan-bar i`);
    if (fill) fill.style.width = `${Math.round(progress.get(p.id) * 100)}%`;
    else render();
  });

  Hub.on("contentResult", (r) => {
    progress.delete(r.id);
    if (!r.ok) Hub.toast(r.error || "That didn't work.");
    else if (r.kind === "plugin") Hub.toast(`Installed “${r.title}”: it's in the Browser's Instruments and Effects`);
    else if (r.kind === "song") Hub.toast(`Installed “${r.title}”: click Open to play it`);
    else Hub.toast(`Installed “${r.title}”: it's in Files, under Fanan Content`);
    render();
  });

  Hub.on("contentPreviewing", (p) => {
    previews.set(p.id, p.file);
    render();
  });

  // The preview buttons follow what's playing.
  let previewing = "";
  Hub.on("status", (s) => {
    if ((s.previewing || "") === previewing) return;
    previewing = s.previewing || "";
    if (loaded && $("browser").classList.contains("fanan")) render();
  });

  Hub.fananContent = { items: () => items };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const chips = $("fanan-kinds");
    for (const [value, label] of KINDS) {
      const chip = element("button", "fanan-kind", label);
      chip.type = "button";
      chip.dataset.kind = value;
      chip.addEventListener("click", () => { kind = value; render(); });
      chips.appendChild(chip);
    }
    $("fanan-refresh").addEventListener("click", () => { loaded = false; error = ""; render(); Hub.send("contentList"); });
    $("browser-search").addEventListener("input", () => { if ($("browser").classList.contains("fanan")) render(); });
  });
})();
