// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-core.js
//
// Shared by every part of the page: the bridge to the native engine, shared state,
// the fader law, menus, keyboard shortcuts and the panel toggles (Browser, Console,
// Editor).

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const backend = window.__JUCE__ && window.__JUCE__.backend;
  const handlers = {};

  // Inputs that don't take text: the DAW's shortcuts still work while one of these has focus.
  const NOT_TEXT_INPUTS = new Set(["button", "checkbox", "radio", "range", "color", "file", "submit", "reset", "image", "hidden"]);

  const Hub = window.Hub = {
    state: { tracks: [], selected: 0, inspectMain: false, selectedClips: [], focus: "arrange", master: { volume: 0, mute: false, inserts: [] },
             inputs: [], inputChannels: [], recordBits: 24, peaks: {}, finePeaks: {},
             library: [], transport: null, status: null },

    /** Channel 0 is the Main channel in every message to and from the engine. */
    MAIN: 0,
    commands: {},

    $: (id) => document.getElementById(id),

    /** Sends an event to the native engine. */
    send(eventId, payload = {}) {
      if (backend) backend.emitEvent(eventId, payload);
    },

    /** Listens to engine events (status, tracks, library, param) and page events. */
    on(eventId, handler) {
      (handlers[eventId] = handlers[eventId] || []).push(handler);
    },

    /** Each listener runs on its own: an error in one part of the page can't stop the others. */
    emit(eventId, data) {
      for (const handler of handlers[eventId] || []) {
        try {
          handler(data);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`Hub: a "${eventId}" listener failed`, error);
        }
      }
    },

    run(command) {
      const action = Hub.commands[command];
      if (action) action();
    },

    clamp: (value, min, max) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value)),
    clamp01: (value) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value)),

    /** Typing into a field must not play notes or trigger shortcuts. */
    /** Is the keyboard writing text here (a sign-in form, a name, the AI box)? Then the DAW's
        shortcuts keep out of its way. Every field that takes text counts: email, password,
        codes, numbers, addresses. Buttons, boxes and sliders don't, so Space still plays. */
    isTyping(target) {
      if (!(target instanceof Element)) return false;
      if (target.isContentEditable || target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) return true;
      return target instanceof HTMLInputElement && !NOT_TEXT_INPUTS.has(target.type);
    },

    element(tag, className, text) {
      const node = document.createElement(tag);
      if (className) node.className = className;
      if (text !== undefined) node.textContent = text;
      return node;
    },

    /** A clip and its track, by the clip's id (ids are unique across tracks). */
    findClip(clipId) {
      for (const track of Hub.state.tracks) {
        const clip = (track.clips || []).find((c) => c.id === clipId);
        if (clip) return { track, clip };
      }
      return null;
    },

    selectedTrack() {
      return Hub.state.tracks.find((track) => track.id === Hub.state.selected) || null;
    },

    trackById(id) {
      return Hub.state.tracks.find((track) => track.id === id)
          || (Hub.state.fxChannels || []).find((channel) => channel.id === id) || null;
    },

    dbText(db) {
      return db <= Hub.SILENT_DB ? "-∞ dB" : `${db > 0 ? "+" : ""}${db.toFixed(1)} dB`;
    },

    /** Changes one fader setting of a track and tells every view (header, Console) about it. */
    setTrackValue(id, key, value, source) {
      const track = Hub.trackById(id);
      if (track) track[key] = value;
      Hub.send("trackSettings", { id, [key]: value });
      Hub.emit("trackValue", { id, key, value, source });
    },

    setMasterValue(key, value, source) {
      Hub.state.master[key] = value;
      Hub.send("masterSettings", { [key]: value });
      Hub.emit("masterValue", { key, value, source });
    },

    /** Selects a track at once on the page; the engine confirms with a tracks update. */
    selectTrack(id) {
      if (!id) return;
      const trackChanged = id !== Hub.state.selected;
      if (!trackChanged && !Hub.state.inspectMain) return;
      Hub.state.inspectMain = false;
      Hub.state.selected = id;
      Hub.emit("selection");
      if (trackChanged) Hub.send("selectTrack", { id });
    },

    /** Marks the Main channel as the one in focus (its strip shows it). The keyboard keeps playing the selected track. */
    inspectMain() {
      if (Hub.state.inspectMain) return;
      Hub.state.inspectMain = true;
      Hub.emit("selection");
    },

    /** The inserts of a channel: a track id, or Hub.MAIN. */
    insertsOf(channel) {
      if (channel === Hub.MAIN) return Hub.state.master.inserts || [];
      const track = Hub.trackById(channel);
      return track ? track.inserts || [] : [];
    },

    effects() {
      return Hub.state.library.filter((entry) => entry.kind === "effect" && !entry.missing)
                              .sort((a, b) => a.vendor.localeCompare(b.vendor) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    },

    /** A small menu under anchor; items are {label, value} or {group}. Picks call onPick(value). */
    popupMenu(anchor, items, onPick) {
      document.querySelectorAll(".popup-menu").forEach((menu) => menu.remove());
      const menu = document.createElement("div");
      menu.className = "popup-menu";
      menu.setAttribute("role", "menu");

      for (const item of items) {
        if (item.group) {
          menu.appendChild(Hub.element("div", "popup-group", item.group));
          continue;
        }

        const button = Hub.element("button", "", item.label);
        button.setAttribute("role", "menuitem");
        button.disabled = Boolean(item.disabled);
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          close();
          onPick(item.value);
        });
        menu.appendChild(button);
      }

      const close = () => {
        menu.remove();
        document.removeEventListener("mousedown", outside, true);
        window.removeEventListener("keydown", escape, true);
      };
      const outside = (event) => { if (!menu.contains(event.target)) close(); };
      const escape = (event) => { if (event.key === "Escape") { event.stopPropagation(); close(); } };

      document.body.appendChild(menu);
      const r = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
      const width = menu.offsetWidth || 220, height = menu.offsetHeight || 0;
      menu.style.left = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerWidth - width - 4, r.left)) + "px";
      menu.style.top = (r.bottom + height + 4 > window.innerHeight ? Math.max(4, r.top - height - 2) : r.bottom + 2) + "px";
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", outside, true);
      window.addEventListener("keydown", escape, true);
      return menu;
    },

    /** The "+" menu: every effect in the Browser, grouped by vendor, added to a channel. */
    addEffectMenu(anchor, channel, position = -1) {
      const effects = Hub.effects();
      const items = [];
      let vendor = null;

      for (const entry of effects) {
        if (entry.vendor !== vendor) {
          vendor = entry.vendor;
          items.push({ group: vendor });
        }
        items.push({ label: entry.name, value: entry });
      }

      if (!effects.length) items.push({ label: "No effects yet: add WCLAP files to the Browser", value: null, disabled: true });
      if (Hub.insertsOf(channel).length >= Hub.MAX_INSERTS) items.unshift({ label: "This channel is full (16 inserts)", value: null, disabled: true });

      return Hub.popupMenu(anchor, items, (entry) => {
        if (entry) Hub.send("loadPlugin", { trackId: channel, file: entry.file, pluginId: entry.id, position });
      });
    },

    /** Turns a label into a text field; Enter or leaving it commits, Escape cancels. */
    inlineRename(label, current, commit) {
      const input = document.createElement("input");
      input.type = "text";
      input.value = current;
      input.setAttribute("aria-label", "Name");
      label.textContent = "";
      label.appendChild(input);
      input.focus();
      input.select();

      const finish = (save) => {
        if (!input.isConnected) return;
        const value = input.value.trim();
        input.remove();
        label.textContent = save && value ? value : current;
        if (save && value && value !== current) commit(value);
      };

      input.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
        if (event.key === "Enter") finish(true);
        if (event.key === "Escape") finish(false);
        event.stopPropagation();
      });
      input.addEventListener("blur", () => finish(true));
    },

    panText(pan) {
      if (Math.abs(pan) < 0.005) return "<C>";
      const amount = Math.round(Math.abs(pan) * 100);
      return pan < 0 ? `${amount}L` : `${amount}R`;
    },

    toast(text) {
      const toast = Hub.$("toast");
      if (!text) return;
      toast.textContent = text;
      toast.hidden = false;
      clearTimeout(Hub._toastTimer);
      Hub._toastTimer = setTimeout(() => { toast.hidden = true; }, 7000);
    },

    start() {
      if (backend) {
        for (const id of ["status", "tracks", "library", "param", "song", "songFolder", "audioPeaks", "audioPeaksFine", "folderListing", "audioFileInfo", "pluginScreen", "screenMessages", "mixdown", "mixdownFolder", "webTabOpened", "webTabState", "webTabClosed", "webTabsRestore", "account", "cloudSongs", "cloudProgress", "cloudResult", "fananContent", "contentProgress", "contentResult", "contentPreviewing", "pluginScan", "internetBlocked", "aiState"])
          backend.addEventListener(id, (data) => Hub.emit(id, data));
      }

      Hub.emit("ready");
      Hub.send("uiReady");
    }
  };

  // The clip selection is a list of clip ids; selectedClip is the one picked last, as
  // {trackId, clipId}, for anything that works on a single clip (the Editor's F2).
  Object.defineProperty(Hub.state, "selectedClip", {
    get() {
      const id = this.selectedClips[this.selectedClips.length - 1];
      const found = id === undefined ? null : Hub.findClip(id);
      return found ? { trackId: found.track.id, clipId: id } : null;
    },
    set(value) {
      this.selectedClips = value ? [value.clipId] : [];
    }
  });

  // Finer waveforms arrive when a zoomed-in view asks for them.
  Hub.on("audioPeaksFine", (data) => {
    if (!data || !data.file) return;
    Hub.state.finePeaks[data.file] = data;
    if (Hub.arrange) Hub.arrange.redraw();
  });

  // Waveforms arrive once per audio file.
  Hub.on("audioPeaks", (data) => {
    if (!data || !data.file) return;
    Hub.state.peaks[data.file] = data;
    if (Hub.arrange) Hub.arrange.redraw();
  });

  Hub.on("tracks", (data) => {
    Hub.state.tracks = data.tracks || [];
    Hub.state.fxChannels = data.fxChannels || [];            // in the Console only
    Hub.state.sidechainTargets = data.sidechainTargets || []; // plugins with a sidechain input
    Hub.state.inputs = data.inputs || Hub.state.inputs;
    Hub.state.inputChannels = data.inputChannels || Hub.state.inputChannels;
    Hub.state.recordBits = data.recordBits || Hub.state.recordBits;
    Hub.state.selected = data.selected || 0;
    if (data.master) Hub.state.master = data.master;
    if (data.notice) Hub.toast(data.notice);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- fader law
  // Studio One's fader scale: +10 dB at the top, 0 dB about three quarters up,
  // then ever wider steps down to -72 dB and off.
  Hub.MAX_INSERTS = 16;
  Hub.SILENT_DB = -72;
  Hub.MAX_DB = 10;
  const OFF_DB = -144;   // what the page sends for "off": below -72 the engine is silent
  const LAW = [[0, OFF_DB], [0.05, -72], [0.14, -48], [0.24, -36], [0.36, -24], [0.52, -12],
               [0.64, -6], [0.78, 0], [0.91, 6], [1, 10]];

  /** Fader position (0 bottom .. 1 top) to dB. */
  Hub.faderToDb = (position) => {
    const p = Hub.clamp01(position);
    for (let i = 1; i < LAW.length; i++) {
      const [p1, d1] = LAW[i];
      if (p <= p1) {
        const [p0, d0] = LAW[i - 1];
        return d0 + (d1 - d0) * (p - p0) / (p1 - p0);
      }
    }
    return Hub.MAX_DB;
  };

  /** dB to fader position; also used to place meter levels on the same scale. */
  Hub.dbToFader = (db) => {
    if (!(db > OFF_DB)) return 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < LAW.length; i++) {
      const [p1, d1] = LAW[i];
      if (db <= d1) {
        const [p0, d0] = LAW[i - 1];
        return p0 + (p1 - p0) * (db - d0) / (d1 - d0);
      }
    }
    return 1;
  };

  Hub.gainToDb = (gain) => gain > 0 ? 20 * Math.log10(gain) : OFF_DB;

  Hub.on("library", (data) => {
    Hub.state.library = data.entries || [];
    if (data.notice) Hub.toast(data.notice);
  });

  Hub.on("status", (data) => {
    Hub.state.status = data;
    if (data.transport) Hub.state.transport = data.transport;
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- panels
  const PANELS = { toggleBrowser: "hide-browser", toggleEditor: "hide-editor",
                   toggleConsole: "hide-console" };

  // Like Studio One, the Editor and the Console share the space at the bottom.
  const SHARES_WITH = { toggleEditor: "hide-console", toggleConsole: "hide-editor" };

  for (const [command, bodyClass] of Object.entries(PANELS)) {
    Hub.commands[command] = () => {
      const hidden = document.body.classList.toggle(bodyClass);
      if (!hidden && SHARES_WITH[command]) document.body.classList.add(SHARES_WITH[command]);
      Hub.emit("layout");
    };
  }

  Hub.commands.audioSetup = () => Hub.send("openAudioSettings");

  function syncPanelButtons() {
    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-panel]")) {
      const hidden = document.body.classList.contains(PANELS[button.dataset.panel]);
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!hidden));
    }
  }

  Hub.on("layout", syncPanelButtons);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- menus
  function setupMenus() {
    const bar = Hub.$("menubar");
    let openMenu = null;

    const close = () => {
      if (!openMenu) return;
      openMenu.classList.remove("open");
      openMenu.querySelector(".menu-title").setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      openMenu = null;
    };

    const open = (menu) => {
      close();
      openMenu = menu;
      menu.classList.add("open");
      menu.querySelector(".menu-title").setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    };

    bar.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const title = event.target.closest(".menu-title");

      if (title) {
        const menu = title.parentElement;
        if (menu === openMenu) close(); else open(menu);
        return;
      }

      const item = event.target.closest("[data-command]");

      if (item && !item.disabled) {
        close();
        Hub.run(item.dataset.command);
      }
    });

    bar.addEventListener("mouseover", (event) => {
      if (!openMenu) return;
      const menu = event.target.closest(".menu");
      if (menu && menu !== openMenu) open(menu);
    });

    document.addEventListener("mousedown", (event) => {
      if (openMenu && !bar.contains(event.target)) close();
    });

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") close();
    });

    window.addEventListener("blur", close);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- shortcuts
  // Studio One's defaults.
  const SHORTCUTS = {
    Space: "togglePlay",
    Home: "returnToZero",
    NumpadMultiply: "toggleRecord",
    Delete: "deleteSelection",
    Backspace: "deleteSelection",
    KeyC: "toggleMetronome",
    NumpadDivide: "toggleLoop",
    F2: "toggleEditor",
    F3: "toggleConsole",
    F5: "toggleBrowser"
  };

  Hub.isShortcut = (code) => code in SHORTCUTS;

  // The page itself never zooms: Ctrl + wheel and Ctrl + = / - / 0 zoom the arrangement.
  const ZOOM_KEYS = { Equal: "zoomIn", NumpadAdd: "zoomIn", Minus: "zoomOut", NumpadSubtract: "zoomOut", Digit0: "zoomReset", Numpad0: "zoomReset" };

  window.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
    if (event.ctrlKey) event.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    if (event.ctrlKey && !event.altKey && event.code in ZOOM_KEYS) {
      event.preventDefault();
      Hub.run(ZOOM_KEYS[event.code]);
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    if (Hub.isTyping(event.target) || event.ctrlKey || event.altKey || event.metaKey) return;

    const command = SHORTCUTS[event.code];
    if (!command) return;

    // Also keeps F5 from reloading the page and Space from clicking a focused button.
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!event.repeat) Hub.run(command);
  });

  window.addEventListener("keyup", (event) => {
    if (event.code === "Space" && !Hub.isTyping(event.target)) event.preventDefault();
  });

  // Panel toggle buttons in the transport bar
  document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    const button = event.target.closest("[data-panel]");
    if (button) Hub.run(button.dataset.panel);
  });

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    setupMenus();
    syncPanelButtons();
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-editor.js
//
// The Editor (F2): Studio One's piano roll for one MIDI clip. Double-click a clip in
// the arrangement to open it.
//
//   Arrow (1)   click a note to select it (Shift or Ctrl adds or removes), drag a box
//               to select several, drag notes to move them, drag a note's right edge
//               to change its length. Double-click empty space to add a note.
//   Pencil (5)  click to add a note, drag to set its length.
//   Eraser (4)  click or drag over notes to delete them.
//   Keys        Delete removes the selected notes, Ctrl+A selects all, Q quantizes,
//               Up/Down transpose (Shift: an octave), Left/Right move by the grid.
//   Velocity    drag in the lane under the notes to set velocities.
//   Keyboard    click the keys on the left to hear a note.
//
// The editor works on a copy of the clip's notes at song positions and sends the
// whole list to the engine when the mouse is released.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  const ROW = 12;                                           // pixels per semitone
  const MIN_ZOOM = 8, MAX_ZOOM = 1200, DEFAULT_ZOOM = 96;   // pixels per quarter note
  const QUANTIZE = [["1/1", 4], ["1/2", 2], ["1/4", 1], ["1/8", 0.5], ["1/16", 0.25], ["1/32", 0.125], ["1/64", 0.0625]];
  const BLACK = new Set([1, 3, 6, 8, 10]);
  const NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"];
  const TOOL_KEYS = { Digit1: "arrow", Digit5: "pencil", Digit4: "eraser" };

  const ed = {
    trackId: 0, clipId: 0, clipStart: 0, clipLength: 0, clipOffset: 0,
    notes: [],                     // the notes the clip shows: {pitch, start (song position), length, velocity 1-127, selected}
    hidden: [],                    // notes a trim has hidden: kept as they are, [pitch, content start, length, velocity]
    zoom: DEFAULT_ZOOM, tool: "arrow", snap: true, quantize: 0.25, velocity: 100, audition: true,
    lastLength: 0, drag: null, pendingReload: false
  };

  const grid = () => $("editor-grid");
  const isOpen = () => ed.clipId !== 0 && !document.body.classList.contains("hide-editor");
  const track = () => Hub.trackById(ed.trackId);
  const clipOf = () => { const t = track(); return t ? (t.clips || []).find((c) => c.id === ed.clipId) || null : null; };
  const noteName = (n) => NAMES[n % 12] + (Math.floor(n / 12) - 1);
  const keyOf = (n) => `${n.pitch}|${n.start.toFixed(5)}|${n.length.toFixed(5)}`;
  const selected = () => ed.notes.filter((n) => n.selected);

  function timing() {
    const t = Hub.transportInfo();
    const beat = 4 / t.denominator;
    return { beat, bar: t.numerator * beat };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- snapping
  const step = () => (ed.snap ? ed.quantize : 0);
  const snapFloor = (t) => { const s = step(); return s ? Math.floor(t / s + 1e-9) * s : t; };
  const snapRound = (t) => { const s = step(); return s ? Math.round(t / s) * s : t; };
  const minLength = () => step() || 1 / 64;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
  /** A pointer event as a position in the grid's content: pixels, song time and pitch. */
  function point(event) {
    const box = grid();
    const r = box.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = event.clientX - r.left + box.scrollLeft;
    const y = event.clientY - r.top + box.scrollTop;
    return { x, y, time: Math.max(0, x / ed.zoom), pitch: Hub.clamp(127 - Math.floor(y / ROW), 0, 127) };
  }

  function noteAt(p) {
    for (let i = ed.notes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const n = ed.notes[i];
      if (n.pitch === p.pitch && p.time >= n.start && p.time < n.start + n.length) return n;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** On the right edge, where dragging changes the length. */
  function onEnd(n, p) {
    const endX = (n.start + n.length) * ed.zoom;
    return endX - p.x <= Math.min(6, (n.length * ed.zoom) / 3);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- engine
  /** Takes the clip's notes from the engine, keeping the selection on the same notes. */
  function load() {
    const clip = clipOf();

    if (!clip) {
      ed.clipId = 0;
      ed.notes = [];
      render();
      return;
    }

    const keep = new Set(selected().map(keyOf));
    ed.clipStart = clip.start;
    ed.clipLength = clip.length;
    ed.clipOffset = clip.offset || 0;
    ed.notes = [];
    ed.hidden = [];

    // Only what the clip shows is edited here; what a trim hid stays as it is.
    for (const [pitch, start, length, velocity] of clip.notes || []) {
      if (start >= ed.clipOffset && start < ed.clipOffset + clip.length)
        ed.notes.push({ pitch, start: clip.start + start - ed.clipOffset, length, velocity, selected: false });
      else
        ed.hidden.push([pitch, start, length, velocity]);
    }

    for (const n of ed.notes) n.selected = keep.has(keyOf(n));

    $("editor-title").textContent = `${track().name} · bar ${Math.floor(clip.start / timing().bar + 1e-9) + 1}`;
    updateSize();
    render();
  }

  function commit() {
    ed.notes.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || a.pitch - b.pitch);
    const message = { trackId: ed.trackId, clipId: ed.clipId };

    // Notes taken past the clip's edges grow it to whole bars, like Studio One's parts.
    let first = ed.clipStart, last = ed.clipStart + ed.clipLength;
    for (const n of ed.notes) { first = Math.min(first, n.start); last = Math.max(last, n.start + n.length); }

    if (first < ed.clipStart - 1e-9 || last > ed.clipStart + ed.clipLength + 1e-9) {
      const { bar } = timing();
      const start = Math.max(0, Math.floor(first / bar + 1e-9) * bar);
      const end = Math.ceil(last / bar - 1e-9) * bar;
      ed.clipOffset += start - ed.clipStart;
      ed.clipStart = start;
      ed.clipLength = end - start;
      Object.assign(message, { start, length: ed.clipLength, offset: ed.clipOffset });
    }

    message.notes = ed.notes.map((n) => [n.pitch, n.start - ed.clipStart + ed.clipOffset, n.length, Math.round(n.velocity)])
                            .concat(ed.hidden);
    Hub.send("setClipNotes", message);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- audition
  let sounding = null, auditionTimer = 0;

  function stopAudition() {
    clearTimeout(auditionTimer);
    if (sounding === null) return;
    Hub.send("noteOff", { note: sounding });
    sounding = null;
  }

  function audition(pitch, velocity) {
    if (!ed.audition) return;
    stopAudition();
    sounding = pitch;
    Hub.send("noteOn", { note: pitch, velocity: velocity / 127 });
    auditionTimer = setTimeout(stopAudition, 220);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
  function sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height) {
    const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale)), h = Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale));
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;
      canvas.style.width = width + "px";
      canvas.style.height = height + "px";
    }
    const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (context) context.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
    return context;
  }

  /** Grid steps from a 64th note up to many bars; the finest (no finer than finest) at least minPx wide. */
  function gridStep(minPx, finest = 0) {
    const { beat, bar } = timing();
    const list = [0.0625, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5].filter((s) => s < beat && Math.abs(beat / s - Math.round(beat / s)) < 1e-9);
    list.push(beat);
    if (bar > beat) list.push(bar);
    for (let m = 2; m <= 1024; m *= 2) list.push(bar * m);
    return list.find((s) => s >= finest - 1e-9 && s * ed.zoom >= minPx) || list[list.length - 1];
  }

  /** "5", "5.2" or "5.2.3" for a position, as fine as the label step needs. */
  function positionLabel(t, labelStep) {
    const { beat, bar } = timing();
    const barIndex = Math.floor(t / bar + 1e-9);
    const inBar = t - barIndex * bar;
    if (labelStep >= bar - 1e-9 || inBar < 1e-9) return String(barIndex + 1);
    const beatIndex = Math.floor(inBar / beat + 1e-9);
    const inBeat = inBar - beatIndex * beat;
    if (labelStep >= beat - 1e-9 || inBeat < 1e-9) return `${barIndex + 1}.${beatIndex + 1}`;
    return `${barIndex + 1}.${beatIndex + 1}.${Math.floor(inBeat / 0.25 + 1e-9) + 1}`;
  }

  function drawGrid() {
    const box = grid();
    const width = box.clientWidth, height = box.clientHeight;
    const context = sizeCanvas($("editor-canvas"), width, height);
    if (!context) return;

    const sx = box.scrollLeft, sy = box.scrollTop;
    const { beat, bar } = timing();

    // Pitch rows: black keys darker, a line under every C.
    const firstRow = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sy / ROW)), lastRow = Math.min(127, Math.ceil((sy + height) / ROW));
    for (let row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; row++) {
      const pitch = 127 - row, y = row * ROW - sy;
      context.fillStyle = BLACK.has(pitch % 12) ? "#232427" : "#2b2c30";
      context.fillRect(0, y, width, ROW);
      if (pitch % 12 === 0) {
        context.fillStyle = "#3f4147";
        context.fillRect(0, y + ROW - 1, width, 1);
      }
    }

    // Time lines, as fine as the zoom allows.
    const fine = gridStep(10);
    const on = (t, unit) => Math.abs(t / unit - Math.round(t / unit)) < 1e-9;
    for (let i = Math.floor(sx / ed.zoom / fine); i <= Math.ceil((sx + width) / ed.zoom / fine); i++) {
      const t = i * fine, x = Math.round(t * ed.zoom - sx) + 0.5;
      context.strokeStyle = on(t, bar) ? "#4a4d53" : on(t, beat) ? "#383a3f" : "#303236";
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(x, 0);
      context.lineTo(x, height);
      context.stroke();
    }

    // Outside the clip is dimmed.
    const c0 = ed.clipStart * ed.zoom - sx, c1 = (ed.clipStart + ed.clipLength) * ed.zoom - sx;
    context.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38)";
    if (c0 > 0) context.fillRect(0, 0, Math.min(c0, width), height);
    if (c1 < width) context.fillRect(Math.max(c1, 0), 0, width - Math.max(c1, 0), height);

    // Notes in the track's colour, stronger with velocity; selected ones outlined white.
    const colour = (track() || {}).colour || "#3e82f7";
    for (const n of ed.notes) {
      const x = n.start * ed.zoom - sx, w = Math.max(3, n.length * ed.zoom), y = (127 - n.pitch) * ROW - sy;
      if (x > width || x + w < 0 || y > height || y + ROW < 0) continue;
      context.globalAlpha = 0.45 + 0.55 * (n.velocity / 127);
      context.fillStyle = colour;
      context.fillRect(x, y + 1, w, ROW - 2);
      context.globalAlpha = 1;
      context.strokeStyle = n.selected ? "#ffffff" : "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)";
      context.lineWidth = n.selected ? 1.5 : 1;
      context.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 1.5, w - 1, ROW - 3);
    }
    context.lineWidth = 1;

    // The selection box while dragging one.
    const d = ed.drag;
    if (d && d.kind === "box") {
      const x = Math.min(d.from.x, d.to.x) - sx, y = Math.min(d.from.y, d.to.y) - sy;
      context.fillStyle = "rgba(45, 124, 246, 0.15)";
      context.fillRect(x, y, Math.abs(d.to.x - d.from.x), Math.abs(d.to.y - d.from.y));
      context.strokeStyle = "#2d7cf6";
      context.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, Math.abs(d.to.x - d.from.x), Math.abs(d.to.y - d.from.y));
    }
  }

  function drawKeys() {
    const canvas = $("editor-keys");
    const width = canvas.parentElement.clientWidth, height = grid().clientHeight;
    const context = sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height);
    if (!context) return;

    const sy = grid().scrollTop;
    const lit = new Set((Hub.state.status && Hub.state.status.notes) || []);
    context.font = "9px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif";
    context.textBaseline = "middle";

    for (let row = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sy / ROW)); row <= Math.min(127, Math.ceil((sy + height) / ROW)); row++) {
      const pitch = 127 - row, y = row * ROW - sy;
      const black = BLACK.has(pitch % 12);
      context.fillStyle = lit.has(pitch) ? "#9fc2ff" : "#e6e6e8";
      context.fillRect(0, y, width, ROW);
      if (black) {
        context.fillStyle = lit.has(pitch) ? "#2d7cf6" : "#1c1c1f";
        context.fillRect(0, y + 1, width * 0.6, ROW - 2);
      }
      // Lines between white keys: under E and under B, where no black key sits between.
      if (pitch % 12 === 0 || pitch % 12 === 5) {
        context.fillStyle = "#9ea2a8";
        context.fillRect(0, y + ROW - 1, width, 1);
      }
      if (pitch % 12 === 0) {
        context.fillStyle = "#55585e";
        context.fillText(noteName(pitch), width - 26, y + ROW / 2);
      }
    }
  }

  function drawRuler() {
    const canvas = $("editor-ruler");
    const width = grid().clientWidth, height = canvas.parentElement.clientHeight;
    const context = sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height);
    if (!context) return;

    const sx = grid().scrollLeft;
    const { beat, bar } = timing();
    context.fillStyle = "#1d1e21";
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // The clip's extent along the top.
    const c0 = ed.clipStart * ed.zoom - sx, c1 = (ed.clipStart + ed.clipLength) * ed.zoom - sx;
    context.fillStyle = (track() || {}).colour || "#3e82f7";
    context.fillRect(c0, 0, c1 - c0, 3);

    context.font = "11px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif";
    context.textBaseline = "top";
    const tick = gridStep(8), label = gridStep(56, 0.25);
    const on = (t, unit) => Math.abs(t / unit - Math.round(t / unit)) < 1e-9;

    for (let i = Math.floor(sx / ed.zoom / tick); i <= Math.ceil((sx + width) / ed.zoom / tick); i++) {
      const t = i * tick, x = Math.round(t * ed.zoom - sx) + 0.5;
      const labelled = on(t, label);
      context.strokeStyle = on(t, bar) ? "#8e939a" : "#55585e";
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(x, labelled ? 6 : height - 5);
      context.lineTo(x, height);
      context.stroke();
      if (labelled) {
        context.fillStyle = on(t, bar) ? "#d6d7d9" : "#8e939a";
        context.fillText(positionLabel(t, label), x + 3, 5);
      }
    }
    context.fillStyle = "#3b3d42";
    context.fillRect(0, height - 1, width, 1);
  }

  function drawVelocity() {
    const canvas = $("editor-velocity");
    const width = grid().clientWidth, height = canvas.parentElement.clientHeight;
    const context = sizeCanvas(canvas, width, height);
    if (!context) return;

    const sx = grid().scrollLeft;
    context.fillStyle = "#222326";
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    context.fillStyle = "#34363b";
    context.fillRect(0, Math.round(height / 2), width, 1);

    const colour = (track() || {}).colour || "#3e82f7";
    for (const n of ed.notes) {
      const x = n.start * ed.zoom - sx;
      if (x < -4 || x > width) continue;
      const h = (n.velocity / 127) * (height - 4);
      context.fillStyle = n.selected ? "#ffffff" : colour;
      context.fillRect(x, height - h, 3, h);
      context.fillRect(x - 1, height - h - 1, 5, 3);
    }
  }

  function placePlayhead() {
    const playhead = $("editor-playhead");
    const x = Hub.songPosition() * ed.zoom - grid().scrollLeft;
    playhead.hidden = !isOpen() || x < 0 || x > grid().clientWidth;
    playhead.style.transform = `translateX(${Math.round(x)}px)`;
  }

  function render() {
    const open = ed.clipId !== 0;
    $("editor").classList.toggle("empty", !open);
    document.querySelectorAll("#editor [data-tool]").forEach((b) => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.tool === ed.tool)));
    grid().dataset.tool = ed.tool;
    if (!open || document.body.classList.contains("hide-editor")) return;
    drawGrid();
    drawKeys();
    drawRuler();
    drawVelocity();
    placePlayhead();
  }

  function updateSize() {
    const { bar } = timing();
    const quarters = Math.max(200 * bar, ed.clipStart + ed.clipLength + 32 * bar);
    $("editor-size").style.width = Math.ceil(quarters * ed.zoom) + "px";
    $("editor-size").style.height = 128 * ROW + "px";
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- editing gestures
  function erase(p) {
    const n = noteAt(p);
    if (!n) return;
    ed.notes.splice(ed.notes.indexOf(n), 1);
    ed.drag.erased = true;
  }

  function addNote(p, length) {
    for (const n of ed.notes) n.selected = false;
    const note = { pitch: p.pitch, start: snapFloor(p.time), length, velocity: ed.velocity, selected: true };
    ed.notes.push(note);
    audition(note.pitch, note.velocity);
    return note;
  }

  function onPointerDown(event) {
    if (event.button !== 0 || event.target !== $("editor-canvas") || !ed.clipId) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const p = point(event);
    const hit = noteAt(p);
    const additive = event.shiftKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
    if (grid().setPointerCapture) grid().setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

    if (ed.tool === "eraser") {
      ed.drag = { kind: "erase", pointer: event.pointerId, erased: false };
      erase(p);
      render();
      return;
    }

    if (hit) {
      if (additive) {
        hit.selected = !hit.selected;
        if (!hit.selected) { render(); return; }
      } else if (!hit.selected) {
        for (const n of ed.notes) n.selected = false;
        hit.selected = true;
      }

      audition(hit.pitch, hit.velocity);
      const origin = new Map(selected().map((n) => [n, { start: n.start, pitch: n.pitch, length: n.length }]));
      ed.drag = { kind: onEnd(hit, p) ? "resize" : "move", pointer: event.pointerId, grab: p, anchor: hit, origin, changed: false, pitch: hit.pitch };
      render();
      return;
    }

    if (ed.tool === "pencil") {
      const note = addNote(p, ed.lastLength || step() || 0.25);
      ed.drag = { kind: "draw", pointer: event.pointerId, note };
      render();
      return;
    }

    // Arrow on empty space: a selection box.
    if (!additive) for (const n of ed.notes) n.selected = false;
    ed.drag = { kind: "box", pointer: event.pointerId, from: p, to: p, before: new Set(selected()) };
    render();
  }

  function onPointerMove(event) {
    const d = ed.drag;

    if (!d) {
      if (event.target !== $("editor-canvas")) return;
      const p = point(event), hit = noteAt(p);
      grid().style.cursor = ed.tool === "eraser" ? "not-allowed"
                          : hit ? (onEnd(hit, p) ? "ew-resize" : "move")
                          : ed.tool === "pencil" ? "crosshair" : "default";
      return;
    }

    if (event.pointerId !== d.pointer) return;
    const p = point(event);

    if (d.kind === "move") {
      // The grabbed note's start lands on the grid; the others keep their distance from it.
      const from = d.origin.get(d.anchor);
      let dt = snapRound(from.start + p.time - d.grab.time) - from.start;
      let dp = Math.round((d.grab.y - p.y) / ROW);
      let lowest = 127, highest = 0, earliest = Infinity;
      for (const o of d.origin.values()) { lowest = Math.min(lowest, o.pitch); highest = Math.max(highest, o.pitch); earliest = Math.min(earliest, o.start); }
      dp = Hub.clamp(dp, -lowest, 127 - highest);
      dt = Math.max(dt, -earliest);
      for (const [n, o] of d.origin) { n.start = o.start + dt; n.pitch = o.pitch + dp; }
      d.changed = d.changed || Math.abs(dt) > 1e-9 || dp !== 0;
      if (d.anchor.pitch !== d.pitch) { d.pitch = d.anchor.pitch; audition(d.anchor.pitch, d.anchor.velocity); }
    } else if (d.kind === "resize") {
      const from = d.origin.get(d.anchor);
      const end = snapRound(from.start + from.length + p.time - d.grab.time);
      const change = end - (from.start + from.length);
      for (const [n, o] of d.origin) n.length = Math.max(minLength(), o.length + change);
      d.changed = d.changed || Math.abs(change) > 1e-9;
    } else if (d.kind === "draw") {
      d.note.length = Math.max(minLength(), snapRound(p.time) - d.note.start);
    } else if (d.kind === "erase") {
      erase(p);
    } else if (d.kind === "box") {
      d.to = p;
      const x0 = Math.min(d.from.x, p.x), x1 = Math.max(d.from.x, p.x), y0 = Math.min(d.from.y, p.y), y1 = Math.max(d.from.y, p.y);
      for (const n of ed.notes) {
        const nx0 = n.start * ed.zoom, nx1 = (n.start + n.length) * ed.zoom, ny0 = (127 - n.pitch) * ROW, ny1 = ny0 + ROW;
        n.selected = d.before.has(n) || (nx1 > x0 && nx0 < x1 && ny1 > y0 && ny0 < y1);
      }
    }

    render();
  }

  function onPointerUp(event) {
    const d = ed.drag;
    if (!d || event.pointerId !== d.pointer) return;
    ed.drag = null;

    if (d.kind === "draw") {
      ed.lastLength = d.note.length;
      commit();
    } else if ((d.kind === "move" || d.kind === "resize") && d.changed) {
      if (d.kind === "resize") ed.lastLength = d.anchor.length;
      commit();
    } else if (d.kind === "erase" && d.erased) {
      commit();
    }

    // An update from the engine that arrived mid-drag is taken now.
    if (ed.pendingReload) {
      ed.pendingReload = false;
      load();
    }

    render();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- velocity lane
  let velocityDrag = null;

  function paintVelocity(event) {
    const canvas = $("editor-velocity");
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = event.clientX - r.left + grid().scrollLeft;
    const value = Hub.clamp(Math.round((1 - (event.clientY - r.top) / (r.height || 1)) * 127), 1, 127);
    const pool = selected().length ? selected() : ed.notes;

    for (const n of pool) {
      if (Math.abs(n.start * ed.zoom - x) <= 4 && n.velocity !== value) {
        n.velocity = value;
        velocityDrag.changed = true;
      }
    }

    render();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands
  function deleteSelected() {
    const before = ed.notes.length;
    ed.notes = ed.notes.filter((n) => !n.selected);
    if (ed.notes.length !== before) { commit(); render(); }
  }

  function quantize() {
    const pool = selected().length ? selected() : ed.notes;
    if (!pool.length) return;
    for (const n of pool) n.start = Math.max(0, Math.round(n.start / ed.quantize) * ed.quantize);
    commit();
    render();
  }

  function transpose(amount) {
    const pool = selected();
    if (!pool.length) return;
    const lowest = Math.min(...pool.map((n) => n.pitch)), highest = Math.max(...pool.map((n) => n.pitch));
    const change = Hub.clamp(amount, -lowest, 127 - highest);
    if (!change) return;
    for (const n of pool) n.pitch += change;
    if (pool.length === 1) audition(pool[0].pitch, pool[0].velocity);
    commit();
    render();
  }

  function nudge(direction) {
    const pool = selected();
    if (!pool.length) return;
    const amount = ed.quantize * direction;
    if (Math.min(...pool.map((n) => n.start)) + amount < -1e-9) return;
    for (const n of pool) n.start += amount;
    commit();
    render();
  }

  function setTool(tool) {
    ed.tool = tool;
    render();
  }

  /** Opens a clip in the Editor, zoomed to fit and scrolled to its notes. */
  Hub.openEditor = (trackId, clipId) => {
    ed.trackId = trackId;
    ed.clipId = clipId;
    ed.notes = [];
    document.body.classList.remove("hide-editor");
    document.body.classList.add("hide-console");
    Hub.emit("layout");
    Hub.selectTrack(trackId);
    Hub.state.focus = "editor";

    const clip = clipOf();
    if (!clip) { ed.clipId = 0; render(); return; }

    // Shown and given its full height before measuring, so the width we fit the clip
    // into is the one left once the vertical scrollbar is there.
    $("editor").classList.remove("empty");
    ed.clipStart = clip.start;
    ed.clipLength = clip.length;
    updateSize();
    const box = grid();
    if (box.clientWidth > 0) ed.zoom = Hub.clamp((box.clientWidth - 48) / Math.max(clip.length, 1), MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM);
    load();

    const pitches = ed.notes.map((n) => n.pitch);
    const centre = pitches.length ? (Math.min(...pitches) + Math.max(...pitches)) / 2 : 60;
    box.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, clip.start * ed.zoom - 24);
    box.scrollTop = Math.max(0, (127 - centre) * ROW - box.clientHeight / 2);
    render();
  };

  Hub.editor = { state: ed, open: Hub.openEditor, isOpen };

  function setZoom(zoom, anchorX) {
    const box = grid();
    const anchor = anchorX === undefined ? box.clientWidth / 2 : anchorX;
    const time = (box.scrollLeft + anchor) / ed.zoom;
    ed.zoom = Hub.clamp(zoom, MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM);
    updateSize();
    box.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, time * ed.zoom - anchor);
    render();
  }

  Hub.commands.deleteNotes = deleteSelected;
  Hub.commands.quantizeNotes = () => { if (isOpen()) quantize(); };
  Hub.commands.selectAllNotes = () => {
    if (!isOpen()) return;
    for (const n of ed.notes) n.selected = true;
    render();
  };

  // F2 (and the Editor button) opens the clip selected in the arrangement, if there is one.
  const toggleEditorPanel = Hub.commands.toggleEditor;
  Hub.commands.toggleEditor = () => {
    const opening = document.body.classList.contains("hide-editor");
    toggleEditorPanel();
    const chosen = Hub.state.selectedClip;
    if (opening && chosen && (chosen.trackId !== ed.trackId || chosen.clipId !== ed.clipId)) Hub.openEditor(chosen.trackId, chosen.clipId);
    else render();
  };

  // Delete acts on what you last worked with: notes in the Editor, or clips.
  Hub.commands.deleteSelection = () => {
    if (isOpen() && Hub.state.focus === "editor") deleteSelected();
    else Hub.run("deleteClip");
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- wiring
  Hub.on("tracks", () => {
    if (!ed.clipId) return;
    if (ed.drag) { ed.pendingReload = true; return; }
    load();
  });

  Hub.on("status", () => {
    if (isOpen()) drawKeys();   // keys light up with the notes that sound
  });

  Hub.on("layout", () => requestAnimationFrame(render));
  Hub.on("transportEdited", render);

  function animate() {
    if (isOpen()) {
      const box = grid();
      // Autoscroll follows the playhead here too, when it's on.
      if (Hub.arrange && Hub.arrange.view.follow && Hub.transportInfo().playing && !ed.drag && box.clientWidth > 0) {
        const x = Hub.songPosition() * ed.zoom;
        if (x > box.scrollLeft + box.clientWidth * 0.95 || x < box.scrollLeft) box.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, x - box.clientWidth * 0.05);
      }
      placePlayhead();
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const quantizeSelect = $("editor-quantize");
    for (const [label, value] of QUANTIZE) quantizeSelect.add(new Option(label, String(value), false, value === ed.quantize));

    quantizeSelect.addEventListener("change", () => { ed.quantize = Number(quantizeSelect.value); quantizeSelect.blur(); render(); });
    $("editor-snap").addEventListener("change", (event) => { ed.snap = event.target.value === "on"; event.target.blur(); });
    $("editor-velocity-value").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      ed.velocity = Hub.clamp(Math.round(Number(event.target.value)) || ed.velocity, 1, 127);
      event.target.value = String(ed.velocity);
    });
    $("editor-audition").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      ed.audition = !ed.audition;
      event.currentTarget.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(ed.audition));
    });
    $("editor-quantize-now").addEventListener("click", quantize);
    $("editor-close").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("toggleEditor"));
    document.querySelectorAll("#editor [data-tool]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => setTool(button.dataset.tool)));

    const box = grid();
    box.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    box.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
    box.addEventListener("pointerup", onPointerUp);
    box.addEventListener("pointercancel", onPointerUp);
    box.addEventListener("scroll", render);

    // Double-click empty space with the Arrow: a new note.
    box.addEventListener("dblclick", (event) => {
      if (event.target !== $("editor-canvas") || ed.tool !== "arrow" || !ed.clipId) return;
      const p = point(event);
      if (noteAt(p)) return;
      addNote(p, ed.lastLength || step() || 0.25);
      commit();
      render();
    });

    // Ctrl + wheel zooms around the mouse.
    for (const area of [box, $("editor-ruler-wrap"), $("editor-velocity-wrap")]) {
      area.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
        if (!event.ctrlKey) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        setZoom(ed.zoom * (event.deltaY < 0 ? 1.2 : 1 / 1.2), event.clientX - box.getBoundingClientRect().left);
      }, { passive: false });
    }

    // The keyboard: click a key to hear it.
    const keys = $("editor-keys");
    let keyHeld = null;
    keys.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      const r = keys.getBoundingClientRect();
      const pitch = Hub.clamp(127 - Math.floor((event.clientY - r.top + box.scrollTop) / ROW), 0, 127);
      keyHeld = pitch;
      Hub.send("noteOn", { note: pitch, velocity: ed.velocity / 127 });
    });
    const release = () => { if (keyHeld !== null) { Hub.send("noteOff", { note: keyHeld }); keyHeld = null; } };
    keys.addEventListener("pointerup", release);
    keys.addEventListener("pointerleave", release);
    keys.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => { box.scrollTop += event.deltaY; event.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });

    // The velocity lane.
    const lane = $("editor-velocity");
    lane.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.button !== 0 || !ed.clipId) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (lane.setPointerCapture) lane.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      velocityDrag = { pointer: event.pointerId, changed: false };
      paintVelocity(event);
    });
    lane.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => { if (velocityDrag && event.pointerId === velocityDrag.pointer) paintVelocity(event); });
    const endVelocity = (event) => {
      if (!velocityDrag || event.pointerId !== velocityDrag.pointer) return;
      const changed = velocityDrag.changed;
      velocityDrag = null;
      if (changed) commit();
    };
    lane.addEventListener("pointerup", endVelocity);
    lane.addEventListener("pointercancel", endVelocity);

    // Which area Delete, Ctrl+A and the arrows act on: the one last clicked.
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.target.closest("#editor")) Hub.state.focus = "editor";
      else if (event.target.closest("#workspace")) Hub.state.focus = "arrange";
    }, true);

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (!isOpen() || Hub.state.focus !== "editor" || Hub.isTyping(event.target) || event.altKey) return;

      if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.code === "KeyA") {
        event.preventDefault();
        Hub.run("selectAllNotes");
        return;
      }

      if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) return;

      if (event.code in TOOL_KEYS) { setTool(TOOL_KEYS[event.code]); return; }
      if (event.code === "KeyQ") { event.preventDefault(); quantize(); return; }
      if (event.code === "ArrowUp" || event.code === "ArrowDown") {
        event.preventDefault();
        transpose((event.code === "ArrowUp" ? 1 : -1) * (event.shiftKey ? 12 : 1));
        return;
      }
      if (event.code === "ArrowLeft" || event.code === "ArrowRight") {
        event.preventDefault();
        nudge(event.code === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1);
      }
    });

    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(render).observe(box);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-export.js
//
// Song > Export Mixdown (Ctrl+E), after Studio One's: the song rendered to a WAV file,
// faster than real time.
//   Name / Location   the song's name, in its Mixdown folder ("…" picks another)
//   Format            WAV 16 bit, 24 bit or 32 bit float
//   Sample Rate       the device's, or converted to another
//   Range             the whole song, or between the loop's locators
//   Tail              seconds after the range for effects to ring out
// A progress window follows, with Cancel; then the file, and Show in Explorer.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  let song = { name: "", mixdownFolder: "" };
  let folder = "", folderChosen = false, running = false, lastFile = "";

  /** Where the song ends: its last clip or envelope point. */
  function songEnd() {
    let end = 0;
    for (const track of Hub.state.tracks) {
      for (const clip of track.clips || []) end = Math.max(end, clip.start + clip.length);
      for (const lane of track.automation || []) if (lane.points.length) end = Math.max(end, lane.points[lane.points.length - 1][0]);
    }
    return end;
  }

  function barOf(ppq) {
    const t = Hub.transportInfo();
    const perBar = (t.numerator || 4) * 4 / (t.denominator || 4);
    return Math.floor(ppq / perBar + 1e-9) + 1;
  }

  function open() {
    if (running) return;
    const t = Hub.transportInfo();
    const status = Hub.state.status;
    const deviceRate = status && status.deviceOpen ? status.sampleRate : 0;

    $("export-name").value = song.name || "Mixdown";
    if (!folderChosen) folder = song.mixdownFolder || "";
    $("export-folder").textContent = folder;
    $("export-folder").title = folder;

    const rate = $("export-rate");
    rate.textContent = "";
    rate.add(new Option(deviceRate ? `${(deviceRate / 1000).toFixed(1)} kHz (the device's)` : "The device's rate", "0"));
    for (const value of [44100, 48000, 88200, 96000])
      if (value !== deviceRate) rate.add(new Option(`${(value / 1000).toFixed(1)} kHz`, String(value)));

    const end = songEnd();
    const hasSong = end > 0, hasLoop = t.loopEnd > t.loopStart;
    const songChoice = document.querySelector('input[name="export-range"][value="song"]');
    const loopChoice = document.querySelector('input[name="export-range"][value="loop"]');
    songChoice.disabled = !hasSong;
    loopChoice.disabled = !hasLoop;
    $("export-song-range").textContent = hasSong ? `Song (bars 1 – ${barOf(end - 1e-6)})` : "Song (empty)";
    $("export-loop-range").textContent = hasLoop ? `Loop (bars ${barOf(t.loopStart)} – ${barOf(t.loopEnd - 1e-6)})` : "Loop (no locators)";
    if (songChoice.disabled && !loopChoice.disabled) loopChoice.checked = true;
    if (loopChoice.disabled) songChoice.checked = true;

    const nothing = !hasSong && !hasLoop;
    $("export-problem").hidden = !nothing;
    $("export-problem").textContent = nothing ? "The song is empty: there's nothing to export." : "";
    $("export-ok").disabled = nothing;

    $("export-dialog").hidden = false;
    $("export-name").focus();
    $("export-name").select();
  }

  /** Hides a window, and lets go of the keyboard if it was in it (or shortcuts would think we're typing). */
  function hide(id) {
    const box = $(id);
    if (box.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
    box.hidden = true;
  }

  function close() {
    hide("export-dialog");
  }

  function start() {
    const range = document.querySelector('input[name="export-range"]:checked');
    if (!range || range.disabled) return;
    const name = $("export-name").value.trim() || song.name || "Mixdown";
    close();
    running = true;
    lastFile = "";
    showProgress("Exporting…", `${name}.wav`, 0, "");
    $("export-show").hidden = true;
    $("export-stop").textContent = "Cancel";
    Hub.send("exportMixdown", {
      name,
      folder,
      bits: Number($("export-bits").value),
      rate: Number($("export-rate").value),
      range: range.value,
      tail: Math.min(30, Math.max(0, Number($("export-tail").value) || 0)),
      reveal: $("export-reveal").checked
    });
  }

  function showProgress(title, file, fraction, message) {
    $("export-progress-title").textContent = title;
    if (file) $("export-file").textContent = file;
    $("export-fill").style.width = `${Math.round(Hub.clamp01(fraction) * 100)}%`;
    $("export-message").textContent = message;
    $("export-progress").hidden = false;
  }

  Hub.on("song", (s) => {
    song = { name: s.name || "", mixdownFolder: s.mixdownFolder || "" };
    if (s.opened) folderChosen = false;   // another song: its own Mixdown folder
  });

  Hub.on("mixdownFolder", (data) => {
    folder = data.path;
    folderChosen = true;
    $("export-folder").textContent = folder;
    $("export-folder").title = folder;
  });

  Hub.on("mixdown", (m) => {
    if (m.file) lastFile = m.file;
    if (m.state === "running") {
      running = true;
      showProgress("Exporting…", m.name, m.progress || 0, "");
      return;
    }
    running = false;
    if (m.state === "cancelled") {
      hide("export-progress");
      return;
    }
    $("export-stop").textContent = "Close";
    if (m.state === "done") {
      showProgress("Exported", m.name, 1, `Saved to ${m.file}`);
      $("export-show").hidden = false;
    } else {
      showProgress("The export didn't finish", m.name, 0, m.error || "Something went wrong.");
    }
  });

  Hub.commands.exportMixdown = open;

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    $("export-ok").addEventListener("click", start);
    $("export-cancel").addEventListener("click", close);
    $("export-browse").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("chooseMixdownFolder", { folder }));
    $("export-dialog").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); close(); }
      if (event.key === "Enter" && event.target.tagName !== "BUTTON") { event.preventDefault(); start(); }
    });
    $("export-stop").addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (running) Hub.send("cancelMixdown");
      else hide("export-progress");
    });
    $("export-show").addEventListener("click", () => { if (lastFile) Hub.send("revealLibraryFile", { file: lastFile }); });

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && !event.shiftKey && !event.altKey && event.code === "KeyE" && !Hub.isTyping(event.target)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        open();
      }
    });
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-inspector.js
//
// The Inspector (F4): the selected track's instrument and inserts, or the Main
// channel's inserts. Each insert can be switched off (bypass), opened to show its
// parameters, removed, or dragged to a new place in the chain. Effects dragged from
// the Browser drop into the list where you let go; + adds one from a menu.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const SCREEN_ICON = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><rect x="1.5" y="2.5" width="13" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/><path d="M1.5 5.5h13" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>';

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const POWER = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M7.25 1.5h1.5v6h-1.5z"/><path d="M4.2 3.6l1.06 1.06A4.25 4.25 0 1 0 10.74 4.66L11.8 3.6A5.75 5.75 0 1 1 4.2 3.6z"/></svg>';

  const expanded = new Set();     // insert ids showing their parameters
  const views = new Map();        // "instrument" or an insert id -> { signature, params }
  let listKey = "";               // the insert list as last built; rebuilt only when it changes
  let dragInsert = null;          // { channel, insertId, from } while an insert is being dragged

  const shownChannel = () => Hub.state.inspectMain ? Hub.MAIN : (Hub.selectedTrack() ? Hub.state.selected : null);

  function setFill(input) {
    const min = Number(input.min), max = Number(input.max);
    input.style.setProperty("--fill", Hub.clamp01(max > min ? (Number(input.value) - min) / (max - min) : 0) * 100 + "%");
  }

  function roleText(plugin) {
    return { instrument: "Instrument", effect: "Effect", noteEffect: "Note effect" }[plugin.role] || plugin.role;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- parameters
  /** Sliders for a plugin's parameters. Returns index -> {input, value} for later updates. */
  function paramsView(container, channel, insertId, plugin) {
    const list = element("div", "params");
    const rows = new Map();

    if (plugin.params.length === 0) list.appendChild(element("p", "slot-hint", "This plugin has no parameters."));

    for (const p of plugin.params) {
      const row = element("div", "param");
      const name = element("span", "param-name", p.name);
      name.title = p.name;
      const input = element("input");
      input.type = "range";
      input.min = String(p.min);
      input.max = String(p.max);
      input.step = p.stepped ? "1" : String((p.max - p.min) / 1000 || 0.001);
      input.value = String(p.value);
      input.disabled = p.readOnly;
      input.setAttribute("aria-label", p.name);
      input.addEventListener("input", () => {
        setFill(input);
        Hub.send("setParam", { trackId: channel, insertId, index: p.index, value: Number(input.value) });
      });
      const value = element("span", "param-value", p.text);
      value.title = p.text;
      row.append(name, input, value);
      list.appendChild(row);
      rows.set(p.index, { input, value });
      setFill(input);
    }

    container.appendChild(list);
    return rows;
  }

  /** The same plugin as shown: refresh values in place, so a slider being dragged isn't rebuilt. */
  function refreshParams(rows, plugin) {
    for (const p of plugin.params) {
      const row = rows.get(p.index);
      if (!row) continue;
      if (document.activeElement !== row.input) {
        row.input.value = String(p.value);
        setFill(row.input);
      }
      row.value.textContent = p.text;
    }
  }

  const signature = (channel, plugin) => `${channel}|${plugin.file}|${plugin.id}|${plugin.params.map((p) => p.index).join(".")}`;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- instrument
  /** Audio tracks: which input the track hears and records (made on first use). */
  function renderInput(track) {
    let section = $("insp-input");
    if (!section) {
      section = element("section", "insp-section");
      section.id = "insp-input";
      section.innerHTML = '<h3 class="insp-heading">Input</h3><select id="insp-input-select" aria-label="Input"></select>'
                        + '<p class="muted small">Song Setup (Song menu) names the inputs and their channels.</p>';
      $("insp-instrument").after(section);
      $("insp-input-select").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
        const selected = Hub.selectedTrack();
        if (selected) Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: selected.id, input: Number(event.target.value) });
      });
    }
    section.hidden = !track || track.kind !== "audio";
    if (section.hidden) return;
    const select = $("insp-input-select");
    select.textContent = "";
    (Hub.state.inputs || []).forEach((input, index) => select.add(new Option(input.name, String(index))));
    select.value = String(track.input || 0);
  }

  function renderInstrument(track) {
    const section = $("insp-instrument");
    renderInput(track);
    section.hidden = !track || track.kind === "audio";
    if (section.hidden) return;

    const body = section.querySelector(".slot-body");
    const plugin = track.instrument;
    const sig = plugin ? signature(track.id, plugin) : `${track.id}|none`;
    const view = views.get("instrument");

    if (view && view.signature === sig) {
      if (plugin) refreshParams(view.params, plugin);
      return;
    }

    body.textContent = "";

    if (!plugin) {
      body.appendChild(element("div", "slot-name", "Test Synth"));
      body.appendChild(element("p", "slot-hint", "Built-in. Drag an instrument from the Browser onto the track to replace it."));
      views.set("instrument", { signature: sig, params: new Map() });
      return;
    }

    const head = element("div", "slot-head");
    const instrumentName = element("div", "slot-name", plugin.name);
    instrumentName.title = "Double-click to open its screen";
    instrumentName.addEventListener("dblclick", () => Hub.openScreen(track.id, 0));
    head.appendChild(instrumentName);
    head.appendChild(screenButton(track.id, 0, plugin));
    const remove = element("button", "slot-remove", "×");
    remove.title = "Remove, back to the Test Synth";
    remove.setAttribute("aria-label", remove.title);
    remove.addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("clearInstrument", { trackId: track.id }));
    head.appendChild(remove);
    body.appendChild(head);

    const details = [plugin.vendor, roleText(plugin)];
    if (plugin.outputs === 1) details.push("mono");
    body.appendChild(element("div", "slot-meta", details.filter(Boolean).join(" · ")));

    if (plugin.plugins.length > 1) {
      const choice = element("select", "slot-choice");
      choice.setAttribute("aria-label", "Plugin in this file");
      for (const entry of plugin.plugins) choice.add(new Option(entry.name, entry.id, false, entry.id === plugin.id));
      choice.addEventListener("change", () => {
        choice.blur();
        Hub.send("loadPlugin", { trackId: track.id, file: plugin.file, pluginId: choice.value });
      });
      body.appendChild(choice);
    }

    views.set("instrument", { signature: sig, params: paramsView(body, track.id, 0, plugin) });
  }

  /** Opens a plugin's screen: its own (web or native), or the Hub's controls. */
  function screenButton(channel, slot, plugin) {
    const button = element("button", "slot-screen");
    button.innerHTML = SCREEN_ICON;
    const own = plugin && (plugin.screen === "web" || plugin.screen === "native");
    button.title = own ? "Open its screen" : "Open its controls in a window";
    button.setAttribute("aria-label", `${button.title}: ${plugin ? plugin.name : ""}`);
    button.addEventListener("click", () => Hub.openScreen(channel, slot));
    return button;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- inserts
  function insertRow(channel, insert, index) {
    const row = element("div", "insert");
    row.dataset.insertId = String(insert.insertId);
    row.draggable = true;
    row.classList.toggle("bypassed", Boolean(insert.bypass));

    const head = element("div", "insert-head");

    const power = element("button", "insert-power");
    power.innerHTML = POWER;
    power.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!insert.bypass));
    power.title = insert.bypass ? "Off (bypassed). Click to switch it on." : "On. Click to bypass.";
    power.setAttribute("aria-label", power.title);
    power.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const bypass = power.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true";
      power.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!bypass));
      row.classList.toggle("bypassed", bypass);
      Hub.send("bypassInsert", { trackId: channel, insertId: insert.insertId, bypass });
    });

    const isOpen = expanded.has(insert.insertId);
    const expand = element("button", "insert-expand");
    expand.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(isOpen));
    expand.setAttribute("aria-label", "Show parameters");
    const toggle = () => {
      if (expanded.has(insert.insertId)) expanded.delete(insert.insertId); else expanded.add(insert.insertId);
      listKey = "";
      render();
    };
    expand.addEventListener("click", toggle);

    const name = element("span", "insert-name", `${index + 1}  ${insert.name}`);
    name.title = `${insert.name} · ${insert.vendor}. Double-click to open its screen; drag to reorder.`;
    name.addEventListener("dblclick", () => Hub.openScreen(channel, insert.insertId));

    const remove = element("button", "slot-remove", "×");
    remove.title = "Remove this insert";
    remove.setAttribute("aria-label", remove.title);
    remove.addEventListener("click", () => {
      expanded.delete(insert.insertId);
      Hub.send("removeInsert", { trackId: channel, insertId: insert.insertId });
    });

    head.append(power, expand, name, screenButton(channel, insert.insertId, insert), remove);
    row.appendChild(head);

    const body = element("div", "insert-body");
    body.hidden = !isOpen;
    const details = [insert.vendor, roleText(insert)];
    if (insert.outputs === 1) details.push("mono");
    body.appendChild(element("div", "slot-meta", details.filter(Boolean).join(" · ")));

    if (insert.plugins.length > 1) {
      const choice = element("select", "slot-choice");
      choice.setAttribute("aria-label", "Plugin in this file");
      for (const entry of insert.plugins) choice.add(new Option(entry.name, entry.id, false, entry.id === insert.id));
      choice.addEventListener("change", () => {
        choice.blur();
        Hub.send("loadPlugin", { trackId: channel, file: insert.file, pluginId: choice.value, replaceInsertId: insert.insertId });
      });
      body.appendChild(choice);
    }

    const params = isOpen ? paramsView(body, channel, insert.insertId, insert) : new Map();
    row.appendChild(body);
    views.set(insert.insertId, { signature: signature(channel, insert), params });

    row.addEventListener("dragstart", (event) => {
      dragInsert = { channel, insertId: insert.insertId, from: index };
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", insert.name);
      row.classList.add("dragging");
    });

    row.addEventListener("dragend", () => {
      dragInsert = null;
      row.classList.remove("dragging");
      showDropLine(-1);
    });

    return row;
  }

  function renderInserts(channel, inserts) {
    $("insp-insert-count").textContent = `${inserts.length}/${Hub.MAX_INSERTS}`;
    $("insp-insert-empty").hidden = inserts.length > 0;

    const key = channel + "|" + inserts.map((i) =>
      `${i.insertId}:${i.bypass ? 1 : 0}:${signature(channel, i)}:${expanded.has(i.insertId) ? 1 : 0}`).join(",");

    if (key === listKey) {
      for (const insert of inserts) {
        const view = views.get(insert.insertId);
        if (view) refreshParams(view.params, insert);
      }
      return;
    }

    listKey = key;

    for (const id of [...views.keys()])
      if (id !== "instrument") views.delete(id);

    const list = $("insp-insert-list");
    list.textContent = "";
    inserts.forEach((insert, index) => list.appendChild(insertRow(channel, insert, index)));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- dropping into the list
  /** Which gap the pointer is over: 0 is above the first insert. */
  function dropIndex(clientY) {
    const rows = [...$("insp-insert-list").querySelectorAll(".insert")];

    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const r = rows[i].getBoundingClientRect();
      if (clientY < r.top + r.height / 2) return i;
    }

    return rows.length;
  }

  function showDropLine(index) {
    const list = $("insp-insert-list");
    list.querySelectorAll(".drop-line").forEach((line) => line.remove());
    if (index < 0) return;
    const rows = list.querySelectorAll(".insert");
    list.insertBefore(element("div", "drop-line"), rows[index] || null);
  }

  function setupDrops() {
    const zone = $("insp-inserts");

    const accepts = () => {
      const channel = shownChannel();
      if (channel === null) return false;
      if (dragInsert) return dragInsert.channel === channel;
      return Boolean(Hub.dragEntry) && Hub.dragEntry.kind === "effect";
    };

    zone.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
      if (!accepts()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (event.dataTransfer) event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = dragInsert ? "move" : "copy";
      showDropLine(dropIndex(event.clientY));
    });

    zone.addEventListener("dragleave", (event) => {
      if (!zone.contains(event.relatedTarget)) showDropLine(-1);
    });

    zone.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
      if (!accepts()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      const channel = shownChannel();
      const index = dropIndex(event.clientY);
      showDropLine(-1);

      if (dragInsert) {
        // Dropping below itself counts the gap it leaves behind.
        const position = index > dragInsert.from ? index - 1 : index;
        if (position !== dragInsert.from) Hub.send("moveInsert", { trackId: channel, insertId: dragInsert.insertId, position });
        dragInsert = null;
        return;
      }

      Hub.dropEntryOn(Hub.dragEntry, channel, index);
      Hub.dragEntry = null;
    });

    // An instrument dropped on the instrument section replaces it.
    const instrument = $("insp-instrument");

    instrument.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
      if (!Hub.dragEntry || Hub.dragEntry.kind === "effect" || Hub.state.inspectMain) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      instrument.classList.add("drop-target");
    });

    instrument.addEventListener("dragleave", () => instrument.classList.remove("drop-target"));

    instrument.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
      if (!Hub.dragEntry || Hub.dragEntry.kind === "effect" || Hub.state.inspectMain) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      instrument.classList.remove("drop-target");
      Hub.dropEntryOn(Hub.dragEntry, Hub.state.selected);
      Hub.dragEntry = null;
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the whole Inspector
  function render() {
    const main = Hub.state.inspectMain;
    const track = main ? null : Hub.selectedTrack();
    const channel = main ? Hub.MAIN : (track ? track.id : null);
    const inspector = $("inspector");

    inspector.classList.toggle("empty", channel === null);
    inspector.classList.toggle("main", main);
    if (channel === null) return;

    const name = $("insp-name");
    name.disabled = main;
    if (document.activeElement !== name) name.value = main ? "Main" : track.name;
    $("insp-swatch").style.background = main ? "#5b5e65" : track.colour;

    renderInstrument(track);

    const state = main ? Hub.state.master : track;
    renderInserts(channel, state.inserts || []);

    const status = $("insp-status");
    status.textContent = state.loading ? `Loading ${state.loading}…` : (state.message || "");
    status.classList.toggle("error", Boolean(state.message) && !state.loading);
  }

  Hub.on("tracks", render);
  Hub.on("selection", render);
  Hub.on("library", render);

  Hub.on("param", (reply) => {
    if (reply.trackId !== shownChannel()) return;
    const view = views.get(reply.insertId ? reply.insertId : "instrument");
    const row = view && view.params.get(reply.index);
    if (row) {
      row.value.textContent = reply.text;
      row.value.title = reply.text;
    }
  });

  /** Opens an insert's parameters in the Inspector (from the Console). */
  Hub.showInsert = (channel, insertId) => {
    expanded.add(insertId);
    listKey = "";
    if (channel === Hub.MAIN) Hub.inspectMain(); else Hub.selectTrack(channel);
    if (document.body.classList.contains("hide-inspector")) Hub.run("toggleInspector");
    render();
  };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const name = $("insp-name");

    name.addEventListener("change", () => {
      const track = Hub.selectedTrack();
      const value = name.value.trim();
      if (!Hub.state.inspectMain && track && value && value !== track.name) Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: track.id, name: value });
    });

    name.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") name.blur();
    });

    $("insp-remove").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("removeTrack"));
    $("insp-add-insert").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const channel = shownChannel();
      if (channel !== null) Hub.addEffectMenu(event.currentTarget, channel);
    });

    setupDrops();
    render();
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-keyboard.js
//
// On-screen keyboard (F6). Plays the monitoring track(s), same as a hardware MIDI
// keyboard. The A to L row of the computer keyboard plays too; Z and X shift octaves.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"];
  const noteName = (n) => NAMES[n % 12] + (Math.floor(n / 12) - 1);
  const RANGE = 36;                  // three octaves, C to C
  const LOWEST_BASE = 12, HIGHEST_BASE = 84;
  let base = 48;                     // C3

  const held = new Map();            // note -> number of local holders
  const pointerNotes = new Map();    // pointerId -> note
  const keyNotes = new Map();        // KeyboardEvent.code -> note
  let engineNotes = new Set();       // notes the engine reports sounding (includes hardware MIDI)

  // Physical key positions, so it works with any keyboard layout (Hebrew included).
  const KEY_OFFSETS = {
    KeyA: 0, KeyW: 1, KeyS: 2, KeyE: 3, KeyD: 4, KeyF: 5, KeyT: 6, KeyG: 7, KeyY: 8,
    KeyH: 9, KeyU: 10, KeyJ: 11, KeyK: 12, KeyO: 13, KeyL: 14, KeyP: 15, Semicolon: 16, Quote: 17
  };

  function keyboard() { return $("keyboard"); }

  function paintKeys() {
    for (const key of keyboard().children) {
      const note = Number(key.dataset.note);
      key.classList.toggle("down", held.has(note) || engineNotes.has(note));
    }
  }

  function hold(note, velocity) {
    held.set(note, (held.get(note) || 0) + 1);
    Hub.send("noteOn", { note, velocity });
    paintKeys();
  }

  function unhold(note) {
    const count = (held.get(note) || 0) - 1;
    if (count > 0) held.set(note, count); else held.delete(note);
    Hub.send("noteOff", { note });
    paintKeys();
  }

  function releaseAll() {
    for (const note of pointerNotes.values()) unhold(note);
    for (const note of keyNotes.values()) unhold(note);
    pointerNotes.clear();
    keyNotes.clear();
  }

  function build() {
    const board = keyboard();
    board.textContent = "";
    let whiteIndex = 0;

    for (let note = base; note <= base + RANGE; note++) {
      const isBlack = [1, 3, 6, 8, 10].includes(note % 12);
      const key = element("div", "key " + (isBlack ? "black" : "white"));
      key.dataset.note = String(note);

      if (isBlack) {
        key.style.left = `calc(${whiteIndex} * var(--w) - var(--bw) / 2)`;
      } else {
        key.style.left = `calc(${whiteIndex} * var(--w))`;
        whiteIndex++;
        if (note % 12 === 0) key.appendChild(element("span", "label", noteName(note)));
      }

      board.appendChild(key);
    }

    $("octave-range").textContent = `${noteName(base)}–${noteName(base + RANGE)}`;
    paintKeys();
  }

  function shiftOctave(direction) {
    const next = base + direction * 12;
    if (next < LOWEST_BASE || next > HIGHEST_BASE) return;
    releaseAll();
    base = next;
    build();
  }

  // Lower on the key plays louder, like a real key.
  function velocityAt(event, key) {
    const r = key.getBoundingClientRect();
    return 0.35 + 0.65 * Hub.clamp01((event.clientY - r.top) / (r.height || 1));
  }

  function renderTarget() {
    const monitoring = Hub.state.tracks.filter((track) => track.monitor).map((track) => track.name);
    $("kb-target").textContent = monitoring.length ? "→ " + monitoring.join(", ") : "→ no track is monitoring";
    $("kb-target").title = $("kb-target").textContent;
  }

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    const board = keyboard();

    board.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      const key = event.target.closest(".key");
      if (!key) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      const note = Number(key.dataset.note);
      pointerNotes.set(event.pointerId, note);
      hold(note, velocityAt(event, key));
    });

    // Dragging across keys plays each one in turn.
    board.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!pointerNotes.has(event.pointerId)) return;
      const hit = document.elementFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY);
      const key = hit && hit.closest ? hit.closest(".key") : null;
      const note = key ? Number(key.dataset.note) : null;
      const current = pointerNotes.get(event.pointerId);
      if (note === current) return;

      unhold(current);

      if (note === null) {
        pointerNotes.delete(event.pointerId);
        return;
      }

      pointerNotes.set(event.pointerId, note);
      hold(note, velocityAt(event, key));
    });

    const endPointer = (event) => {
      const note = pointerNotes.get(event.pointerId);
      if (note === undefined) return;
      pointerNotes.delete(event.pointerId);
      unhold(note);
    };

    window.addEventListener("pointerup", endPointer);
    window.addEventListener("pointercancel", endPointer);

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.repeat || event.ctrlKey || event.altKey || event.metaKey) return;
      if (Hub.isTyping(event.target) || event.target instanceof HTMLSelectElement) return;
      if (Hub.isShortcut(event.code)) return;
      if (event.code === "KeyZ") { shiftOctave(-1); return; }
      if (event.code === "KeyX") { shiftOctave(1); return; }

      const offset = KEY_OFFSETS[event.code];
      if (offset === undefined || keyNotes.has(event.code)) return;
      event.preventDefault();

      const note = base + 12 + offset;   // computer keys start at the middle octave
      keyNotes.set(event.code, note);
      hold(note, 0.8);
    });

    window.addEventListener("keyup", (event) => {
      const note = keyNotes.get(event.code);
      if (note === undefined) return;
      keyNotes.delete(event.code);
      unhold(note);
    });

    window.addEventListener("blur", releaseAll);

    $("panic").addEventListener("click", () => { releaseAll(); Hub.send("allNotesOff"); });
    $("oct-down").addEventListener("click", () => shiftOctave(-1));
    $("oct-up").addEventListener("click", () => shiftOctave(1));

    build();
    renderTarget();
  });

  Hub.on("tracks", renderTarget);

  Hub.on("status", (s) => {
    engineNotes = new Set(s.notes || []);
    paintKeys();
  });
})();
