// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-scan.js
//
// The scanning page. Plugins are read at every start (new and changed ones) and on every
// rescan, always with this page in front: at startup it comes before the welcome page,
// which appears only once the scan is finished. Each plugin is read by a copy of the Hub
// of its own, so one that crashes or hangs is reported here and can't take the Hub down.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  let scan = { state: "starting", startup: true, total: 0, done: 0, problems: [] };
  let finishing = null;

  const plural = (n, one, many) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

  function render() {
    const running = scan.state === "running" || scan.state === "starting";
    const fraction = scan.total > 0 ? scan.done / scan.total : running ? 0 : 1;
    $("scan-title").textContent = running ? (scan.startup ? "Checking your plugins" : "Scanning plugins") : "Plugins checked";
    $("scan-fill").style.width = `${Math.round(fraction * 100)}%`;
    $("scan-bar").setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String(Math.round(fraction * 100)));

    if (scan.state === "starting") {
      $("scan-sub").textContent = "Starting…";
      $("scan-count").textContent = "";
      $("scan-current").textContent = "";
    } else if (running) {
      $("scan-sub").textContent = scan.total === 1 ? "1 new or changed plugin file to read." : `${scan.total} new or changed plugin files to read.`;
      $("scan-count").textContent = `${Math.min(scan.done + 1, scan.total)} of ${scan.total}`;
      $("scan-current").textContent = scan.current ? `Reading ${scan.current}` : "";
    } else {
      const parts = [plural(scan.plugins || 0, "plugin ready", "plugins ready")];
      if (scan.found > 0) parts.push(`${scan.found} new`);
      if (scan.problems.length) parts.push(`${plural(scan.problems.length, "file", "files")} couldn't be read`);
      if (scan.state === "cancelled") parts.push("the rest are read next time");
      $("scan-sub").textContent = parts.join(" · ");
      $("scan-count").textContent = "";
      $("scan-current").textContent = "";
    }

    const list = $("scan-problem-list");
    list.replaceChildren();
    for (const problem of scan.problems) {
      const item = element("li");
      item.append(element("span", "scan-problem-name", problem.name), element("span", "scan-problem-why", problem.error));
      list.appendChild(item);
    }
    $("scan-problems").hidden = scan.problems.length === 0;

    const skip = $("scan-skip");
    skip.hidden = !running || scan.state === "starting";
    skip.textContent = scan.startup ? "Skip" : "Cancel";
    skip.title = scan.startup ? "Go on now: the rest are read at the next start" : "Stop scanning: the rest are read next time";
    $("scan-continue").hidden = running || scan.problems.length === 0;
  }

  function show() {
    clearTimeout(finishing);
    finishing = null;
    $("scan-page").hidden = false;
  }

  /** The scan is over: the page steps aside, and at startup the welcome page comes up. */
  function finish() {
    clearTimeout(finishing);
    finishing = null;
    const box = $("scan-page");
    if (box.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
    box.hidden = true;
    document.body.classList.remove("booting");
  }

  Hub.on("pluginScan", (s) => {
    scan = { ...s, problems: s.problems || [] };

    if (s.state === "running") {
      show();
      render();
      return;
    }

    // Done or cancelled.
    const wasShowing = !$("scan-page").hidden;
    render();

    if (scan.problems.length) {
      // Nothing fails unseen: the list stays until Continue.
      show();
      $("scan-continue").focus();
    } else if (!wasShowing || s.total === 0) {
      finish();   // nothing was read (all up to date): straight on
    } else {
      finishing = setTimeout(finish, 700);   // a moment to see it finished
    }
  });

  Hub.scan = { state: () => scan, finish };

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    render();
    $("scan-skip").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("cancelScan"));
    $("scan-continue").addEventListener("click", finish);

    // While the page is up, keys don't reach the Hub behind it (Escape would close the welcome
    // page before it appeared); the page's own buttons still take Tab, Enter and Space.
    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      const box = $("scan-page");
      if (box.hidden || (event.target instanceof Node && box.contains(event.target))) return;
      if (event.key === "Tab") return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }, true);
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-screens.js
//
// Plugin screens: floating windows inside the Hub's page, like Studio One's plugin windows.
//   web      a WCLAP's own page (CLAP's webview extension), in a sandboxed frame. The plugin
//            serves its files; its messages pass both ways as ArrayBuffers (postMessage).
//   generic  plugins without a screen of their own: the Hub's controls for their parameters.
//   native   VST3 editors open in a window of their own; nothing to show here.
// Drag a window by its title, resize it from its corner; a click brings it to the front.
// A window closes by itself when its plugin is removed.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const windows = new Map();   // "channel:slot" -> { root, frame, channel, slot, kind, params }
  const TITLE = 28;
  let topZ = 50, opened = 0;

  const keyOf = (channel, slot) => `${channel}:${slot}`;

  /** The plugin in a slot: the instrument (slot 0) or an insert, from the tracks the page has. */
  function pluginAt(channel, slot) {
    if (channel === Hub.MAIN) return (Hub.state.master.inserts || []).find((i) => i.insertId === slot) || null;
    const track = Hub.trackById(channel);
    if (!track) return null;
    if (slot === 0) return track.instrument || null;
    return (track.inserts || []).find((i) => i.insertId === slot) || null;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- bytes <-> base64
  function toBase64(bytes) {
    let text = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) text += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
    return btoa(text);
  }

  function fromBase64(base64) {
    const text = atob(base64);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(text.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) bytes[i] = text.charCodeAt(i);
    return bytes;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- windows
  function bringToFront(win) {
    win.root.style.zIndex = String(++topZ);
  }

  function close(key, tellEngine = true) {
    const win = windows.get(key);
    if (!win) return;
    windows.delete(key);
    win.root.remove();
    if (tellEngine && win.kind === "web") Hub.send("closePluginScreen", { channel: win.channel, slot: win.slot });
  }

  function makeWindow(key, channel, slot, kind, title, width, height) {
    const root = element("div", "screen-window");
    root.dataset.key = key;
    root.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
    root.setAttribute("aria-label", title);

    const bar = element("div", "screen-title");
    const name = element("span", "screen-name", title);
    const shut = element("button", "screen-close", "×");
    shut.type = "button";
    shut.title = "Close";
    shut.setAttribute("aria-label", `Close ${title}`);
    shut.addEventListener("click", () => close(key));
    bar.append(name, shut);

    const body = element("div", "screen-body");
    const grip = element("div", "screen-resize");
    root.append(bar, body, grip);

    // Over the arrangement, clear of the track headers, cascaded.
    const w = Math.min(Math.max(width, 260), window.innerWidth - 40);
    const h = Math.min(Math.max(height, 120), window.innerHeight - 80) + TITLE;
    const n = opened++ % 8;
    const headers = $("tracks-area");
    const clear = headers ? headers.getBoundingClientRect().right + 24 : 260;
    root.style.left = `${Math.max(10, Math.min(clear + 60 + n * 28, window.innerWidth - w - 10))}px`;
    root.style.top = `${Math.max(10, Math.min(100 + n * 28, window.innerHeight - h - 10))}px`;
    root.style.width = `${w}px`;
    root.style.height = `${h}px`;

    const win = { root, body, channel, slot, kind, frame: null, params: new Map() };
    root.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => bringToFront(win), true);

    // Move by the title bar.
    bar.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.target === shut) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      const startX = event.clientX, startY = event.clientY;
      const left = root.offsetLeft, top = root.offsetTop;
      root.classList.add("dragging");
      const move = (e) => {
        root.style.left = `${Math.min(Math.max(left + e.clientX - startX, -root.offsetWidth + 80), window.innerWidth - 80)}px`;
        root.style.top = `${Math.min(Math.max(top + e.clientY - startY, 0), window.innerHeight - TITLE)}px`;
      };
      const up = () => {
        root.classList.remove("dragging");
        window.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
        window.removeEventListener("pointerup", up);
      };
      window.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
    });

    // Resize by the corner.
    grip.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const startX = event.clientX, startY = event.clientY;
      const startW = root.offsetWidth, startH = root.offsetHeight;
      root.classList.add("dragging");
      const move = (e) => {
        root.style.width = `${Math.max(220, startW + e.clientX - startX)}px`;
        root.style.height = `${Math.max(TITLE + 80, startH + e.clientY - startY)}px`;
      };
      const up = () => {
        root.classList.remove("dragging");
        window.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
        window.removeEventListener("pointerup", up);
      };
      window.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
    });

    $("screens").appendChild(root);
    windows.set(key, win);
    bringToFront(win);
    return win;
  }

  /** The Hub's own controls, for plugins without a screen. */
  function fillGeneric(win, plugin) {
    const list = element("div", "params screen-params");
    const params = (plugin && plugin.params) || [];
    if (!params.length) list.appendChild(element("p", "slot-hint", "This plugin has no parameters."));

    for (const p of params) {
      const row = element("div", "param");
      const name = element("span", "param-name", p.name);
      name.title = p.name;
      const input = element("input");
      input.type = "range";
      input.min = String(p.min);
      input.max = String(p.max);
      input.step = p.stepped ? "1" : String((p.max - p.min) / 1000 || 0.001);
      input.value = String(p.value);
      input.disabled = Boolean(p.readOnly);
      input.setAttribute("aria-label", p.name);
      input.addEventListener("input", () => {
        Hub.send("setParam", { trackId: win.channel, insertId: win.slot, index: p.index, value: Number(input.value) });
      });
      const value = element("span", "param-value", p.text);
      row.append(name, input, value);
      list.appendChild(row);
      win.params.set(p.index, { input, value });
    }

    win.body.replaceChildren(list);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- opening
  /** Opens (or brings forward) the screen of the plugin in a slot. */
  Hub.openScreen = (channel, slot) => {
    const existing = windows.get(keyOf(channel, slot));
    if (existing) {
      bringToFront(existing);
      return;
    }
    Hub.send("openPluginScreen", { channel, slot });
  };

  Hub.on("pluginScreen", (reply) => {
    const key = keyOf(reply.channel, reply.slot);
    if (reply.kind === "native" || windows.has(key)) return;

    if (reply.kind === "web") {
      const win = makeWindow(key, reply.channel, reply.slot, "web", reply.title, reply.width || 640, reply.height || 420);
      const frame = element("iframe", "screen-frame");
      // Its own origin: a plugin's page can talk to its plugin, but can't reach into the Hub.
      frame.setAttribute("sandbox", "allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups");
      frame.title = reply.title;
      frame.src = reply.url;
      win.frame = frame;
      win.body.replaceChildren(frame);
      return;
    }

    const win = makeWindow(key, reply.channel, reply.slot, "generic", reply.title, 420, 300);
    fillGeneric(win, pluginAt(reply.channel, reply.slot));
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- messages
  // From a plugin's page: window.parent.postMessage(ArrayBuffer or typed array).
  window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
    for (const win of windows.values()) {
      if (!win.frame || event.source !== win.frame.contentWindow) continue;
      const data = event.data;
      let bytes = null;
      if (data instanceof ArrayBuffer) bytes = new Uint8Array(data);
      else if (ArrayBuffer.isView(data)) bytes = new Uint8Array(data.buffer, data.byteOffset, data.byteLength);
      else if (typeof data === "string") bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(data);
      if (bytes) Hub.send("screenMessage", { channel: win.channel, slot: win.slot, data: toBase64(bytes) });
      return;
    }
  });

  // To a plugin's page: each message as an ArrayBuffer.
  Hub.on("screenMessages", (batch) => {
    const win = windows.get(keyOf(batch.channel, batch.slot));
    if (!win || !win.frame || !win.frame.contentWindow) return;
    for (const message of batch.messages || []) win.frame.contentWindow.postMessage(fromBase64(message).buffer, "*");
  });

  // Generic controls follow the plugin's parameters.
  Hub.on("param", (reply) => {
    const win = windows.get(keyOf(reply.trackId, reply.insertId || 0));
    const row = win && win.params.get(reply.index);
    if (row) row.value.textContent = reply.text;
  });

  // A plugin that has gone takes its window with it.
  Hub.on("tracks", () => {
    for (const [key, win] of [...windows]) {
      const plugin = pluginAt(win.channel, win.slot);
      if (!plugin) {
        close(key, false);
        continue;
      }
      if (win.kind === "generic") {
        for (const p of plugin.params || []) {
          const row = win.params.get(p.index);
          if (row && document.activeElement !== row.input) {
            row.input.value = String(p.value);
            row.value.textContent = p.text;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  Hub.screens = { windows, close, pluginAt };
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-setup.js
//
// Song Setup (Song menu), after Studio One's Session Setup:
//   General   the format recordings are written in (16 bit, 24 bit, 32 bit float) and
//             the sample rate the device runs at.
//   Audio I/O the song's inputs: each has a name, is mono or stereo, and takes its
//             channels from the device's active inputs. Audio tracks pick one.
// Nothing changes until OK.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  let draft = { inputs: [], recordBits: 24 };

  function channelNames() {
    const names = Hub.state.inputChannels || [];
    return names.length ? names : ["In 1", "In 2"];
  }

  function channelSelect(value, label) {
    const select = element("select", "setup-channel");
    select.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
    channelNames().forEach((name, index) => select.add(new Option(`${index + 1}: ${name}`, String(index))));
    if (value >= channelNames().length) select.add(new Option(`${value + 1}: (not active)`, String(value)));
    select.value = String(value);
    return select;
  }

  function renderInputs() {
    const list = $("setup-inputs");
    list.replaceChildren();

    draft.inputs.forEach((input, index) => {
      const row = element("div", "setup-row");

      const name = element("input", "setup-name");
      name.type = "text";
      name.value = input.name;
      name.setAttribute("aria-label", "Input name");
      name.addEventListener("input", () => { input.name = name.value; });

      const type = element("select", "setup-type");
      type.setAttribute("aria-label", "Mono or stereo");
      type.add(new Option("Mono", "mono"));
      type.add(new Option("Stereo", "stereo"));
      type.value = input.right >= 0 ? "stereo" : "mono";
      type.addEventListener("change", () => {
        input.right = type.value === "stereo" ? Math.min(input.left + 1, channelNames().length - 1) : -1;
        if (input.right === input.left) input.right = input.left + 1;
        renderInputs();
      });

      const left = channelSelect(input.left, input.right >= 0 ? "Left channel" : "Channel");
      left.addEventListener("change", () => { input.left = Number(left.value); });
      row.append(name, type, left);

      if (input.right >= 0) {
        const right = channelSelect(input.right, "Right channel");
        right.addEventListener("change", () => { input.right = Number(right.value); });
        row.appendChild(right);
      } else {
        row.appendChild(element("span", "setup-channel"));
      }

      const remove = element("button", "icon-button", "×");
      remove.type = "button";
      remove.title = "Remove this input";
      remove.setAttribute("aria-label", `Remove ${input.name}`);
      remove.addEventListener("click", () => { draft.inputs.splice(index, 1); renderInputs(); });
      row.appendChild(remove);
      list.appendChild(row);
    });

    $("setup-inputs-empty").hidden = draft.inputs.length > 0;
  }

  function addInput(stereo) {
    const count = draft.inputs.length + 1;
    draft.inputs.push(stereo ? { name: `Input ${count} L+R`, left: 0, right: 1 } : { name: `Input ${count}`, left: 0, right: -1 });
    renderInputs();
  }

  function showTab(name) {
    for (const tab of document.querySelectorAll("#song-setup [data-setup-tab]"))
      tab.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(tab.dataset.setupTab === name));
    $("setup-general").hidden = name !== "general";
    $("setup-io").hidden = name !== "io";
  }

  function open() {
    draft = {
      inputs: (Hub.state.inputs || []).map((input) => ({ name: input.name, left: input.left, right: input.right })),
      recordBits: Hub.state.recordBits || 24
    };
    $("setup-bits").value = String(draft.recordBits);
    const status = Hub.state.status;
    $("setup-rate").textContent = status && status.deviceOpen ? `${(status.sampleRate / 1000).toFixed(1)} kHz (the audio device's)` : "No audio device";
    renderInputs();
    showTab("general");
    $("song-setup").hidden = false;
  }

  function apply() {
    draft.recordBits = Number($("setup-bits").value) || 24;
    Hub.send("songSetup", draft);
    closeSetup();
  }

  /** Closes it, letting go of the keyboard (or shortcuts would think we're still typing). */
  function closeSetup() {
    const box = $("song-setup");
    if (box.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
    box.hidden = true;
  }

  Hub.commands.songSetup = open;

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    for (const tab of document.querySelectorAll("#song-setup [data-setup-tab]"))
      tab.addEventListener("click", () => showTab(tab.dataset.setupTab));
    $("setup-add-mono").addEventListener("click", () => addInput(false));
    $("setup-add-stereo").addEventListener("click", () => addInput(true));
    $("setup-ok").addEventListener("click", apply);
    $("setup-cancel").addEventListener("click", () => { closeSetup(); });
    $("song-setup").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); closeSetup(); }
    });
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-song.js
//
// Songs: the Start page, the New Song dialog, and File > New / Open / Save / Save As.
// The engine owns the song and its file; this shows what it reports (the song's name,
// unsaved changes, recent songs) and asks it for the rest. The arrangement's view
// settings (zoom, snap and so on) are kept with the song.
//
//   Ctrl+N new song, Ctrl+O open, Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+Shift+S save as.
//   Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z redo (the engine keeps the history; Edit > Undo
//   and Redo show the step's name, like "Undo Move Clips").

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  let song = { name: "Untitled", path: "", changed: false, busy: "", folder: "", user: "", recent: [] };
  let newSongFolder = "";
  let viewTimer = 0;

  /** "4 weeks ago", as the Start page lists recent files. */
  function ago(ms) {
    if (!ms) return "";
    const seconds = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - ms) / 1000);
    const units = [["year", 31536000], ["month", 2592000], ["week", 604800], ["day", 86400], ["hour", 3600], ["minute", 60]];
    for (const [unit, size] of units) {
      const count = Math.floor(seconds / size);
      if (count >= 1) return `${count} ${unit}${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} ago`;
    }
    return "just now";
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Start page
  function renderRecent() {
    const list = $("recent-list");
    const filter = $("start-search").value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const items = (song.recent || []).filter((item) => !filter || item.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter));
    list.replaceChildren();

    for (const item of items) {
      const row = element("button", "recent-item" + (item.exists ? "" : " missing"));
      row.type = "button";
      row.title = item.exists ? item.path : `${item.path} (not found)`;
      row.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M3 1.5h7l3 3v10H3z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"/></svg><span class="recent-name"></span><span class="recent-time"></span>';
      row.querySelector(".recent-name").textContent = item.name;
      row.querySelector(".recent-time").textContent = item.exists ? ago(item.time) : "not found";
      row.disabled = !item.exists;
      row.addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("openSong", { path: item.path }));
      list.append(row);
    }

    $("recent-empty").hidden = items.length > 0;
  }

  function renderSetup(s) {
    const open = s && s.deviceOpen;
    $("setup-device").textContent = open ? s.deviceName : "No audio device";
    $("setup-rate").textContent = open ? `${(s.sampleRate / 1000).toFixed(1)} kHz` : "–";
    $("setup-buffer").textContent = open ? `${s.bufferSize} samples` : "–";
  }

  function showStart(show) {
    $("start-page").hidden = !show;
    if (show) {
      $("start-search").value = "";
      renderRecent();
      renderSetup(Hub.state.status);
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- New Song dialog
  function today() {
    const d = new Date();
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }

  function showNewSong() {
    newSongFolder = song.folder;
    $("new-song-name").value = `${today()} ${song.user || ""}`.trim();
    $("new-song-folder").textContent = newSongFolder;
    $("new-song-bpm").value = "120";
    $("new-song-numerator").value = "4";
    $("new-song-denominator").value = "4";
    $("new-song").hidden = false;
    $("new-song-name").focus();
    $("new-song-name").select();
  }

  function createSong() {
    const name = $("new-song-name").value.trim();
    if (!name) { $("new-song-name").focus(); return; }
    const bpm = Hub.clamp(Number($("new-song-bpm").value) || 120, 20, 300);
    const numerator = Hub.clamp(Math.round(Number($("new-song-numerator").value)) || 4, 1, 32);
    Hub.send("newSong", { name, folder: newSongFolder, bpm, numerator, denominator: Number($("new-song-denominator").value) || 4 });
    $("new-song").hidden = true;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands
  function sendView() {
    clearTimeout(viewTimer);
    if (Hub.arrange) Hub.send("songView", { view: Hub.arrange.getView() });
  }

  Hub.commands.newSong = showNewSong;
  Hub.commands.openSong = () => Hub.send("openSong", {});
  Hub.commands.saveSong = () => { sendView(); Hub.send("saveSong"); };
  Hub.commands.saveSongAs = () => { sendView(); Hub.send("saveSongAs"); };
  Hub.commands.showStartPage = () => showStart(true);
  Hub.commands.closeSong = () => Hub.send("closeSong");

  /** The Start page closed by the user: the song behind it is the project now. */
  function closeStart() {
    showStart(false);
    Hub.send("startPageClosed");
  }

  let firstSong = true;   // the first news of the song since this page loaded
  Hub.commands.undo = () => Hub.send("undo");
  Hub.commands.redo = () => Hub.send("redo");

  function renderHistory() {
    for (const [id, verb, step] of [["menu-undo", "Undo", song.undo], ["menu-redo", "Redo", song.redo]]) {
      const item = $(id);
      item.querySelector(".menu-label").textContent = step ? `${verb} ${step}` : verb;
      item.disabled = !step;
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- from the engine
  Hub.on("song", (data) => {
    song = data;
    Hub.state.song = data;
    renderHistory();
    $("busy").hidden = !data.busy;
    $("busy-text").textContent = data.busy || "";

    // A song was opened or made: its view settings, and the Start page and dialog go.
    if (data.opened) {
      if (Hub.arrange) Hub.arrange.applyView(data.view);
      showStart(false);
      $("new-song").hidden = true;
    }

    // No project open (Close Project): the Start page is the place. A page that loaded again
    // while a project was open goes straight back to it.
    if (data.welcome === true && data.opened) showStart(true);
    if (firstSong && data.welcome === false) showStart(false);
    firstSong = false;

    if (!$("start-page").hidden) renderRecent();
  });

  Hub.on("songFolder", (data) => {
    if (!data.path) return;
    newSongFolder = data.path;
    $("new-song-folder").textContent = newSongFolder;
  });

  Hub.on("status", (s) => { if (!$("start-page").hidden) renderSetup(s); });

  // The view settings reach the engine a moment after they change, ready for the next save.
  Hub.on("viewChanged", () => {
    clearTimeout(viewTimer);
    viewTimer = setTimeout(sendView, 300);
  });

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    $("start-new").addEventListener("click", showNewSong);
    $("start-open").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("openSong"));
    $("start-close").addEventListener("click", closeStart);
    $("start-search").addEventListener("input", renderRecent);
    $("setup-configure").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("openAudioSettings"));

    $("new-song-ok").addEventListener("click", createSong);
    $("new-song-cancel").addEventListener("click", () => { $("new-song").hidden = true; });
    $("new-song-browse").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("chooseSongFolder", { folder: newSongFolder }));
    $("new-song").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); createSong(); }
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); $("new-song").hidden = true; }
    });

    // The File shortcuts work anywhere, even while typing, and never reach the browser's own.
    // Undo and redo leave a text field's own undo alone while you type in it.
    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (!(event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) || event.altKey) return;
      const history = { KeyZ: event.shiftKey ? "redo" : "undo", KeyY: "redo" }[event.code];

      if (history) {
        if (Hub.isTyping(event.target)) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        Hub.run(history);
        return;
      }

      const command = { KeyN: "newSong", KeyO: "openSong", KeyS: event.shiftKey ? "saveSongAs" : "saveSong" }[event.code];
      if (!command) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      Hub.run(command);
    });

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape" && !$("start-page").hidden && $("new-song").hidden) closeStart();
    });

    showStart(true);   // like Studio One, the Start page greets you
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-tracks.js
//
// Track list: the track headers on the left of the Song page. Plugins dragged
// from the Browser drop onto a track (an instrument replaces its instrument, an
// effect joins the end of its inserts) or into the empty space below the tracks
// (a new track). The arrangement lives in hub-arrange.js, the Inspector in
// hub-inspector.js.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const BUILTIN_KEY = "builtin:test-synth";
  const LOADING_KEY = "loading:";

  const rows = new Map();           // track id -> row element
  let dropTarget = null;

  const pluginKey = (file, id) => `${file}|${id}`;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- icons
  const ICON_MONITOR = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M2 6h3l4-3v10L5 10H2z"/><path d="M11 5.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4"/></svg>';
  const ICON_WAVE = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M1 8h2M4 4v8M6 2v12M8 5v6M10 3v10M12 6v4M14 7.5v1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/></svg>';
  const ICON_RECORD = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="4.5"/></svg>';
  const ICON_KEYS = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M1.5 3.5h13v9h-13z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"/><path d="M5 3.5v5M8 3.5v5M11 3.5v5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>';

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- track list
  function instrumentOptions(select, track) {
    // An instrument on its way (dropped, or picked here) shows already, while it loads.
    const loadingName = (track.loading || "").replace(/\.(vst3|wasm|wclap\.tar\.gz|wclap\.tgz|wclap)$/i, "");
    const current = loadingName ? LOADING_KEY : track.instrument ? pluginKey(track.instrument.file, track.instrument.id) : BUILTIN_KEY;
    const entries = Hub.state.library.filter((entry) => entry.kind !== "effect");
    const signature = current + "#" + loadingName + "#" + entries.map((entry) => pluginKey(entry.file, entry.id)).join(",");

    if (select.dataset.signature !== signature) {
      select.dataset.signature = signature;
      select.textContent = "";
      select.add(new Option("Test Synth", BUILTIN_KEY));

      for (const entry of entries)
        select.add(new Option(entry.name, pluginKey(entry.file, entry.id)));

      if (track.instrument && !loadingName && !entries.some((entry) => pluginKey(entry.file, entry.id) === current))
        select.add(new Option(track.instrument.name, current));

      if (loadingName) {
        const loading = new Option(`${loadingName} (loading…)`, LOADING_KEY);
        loading.disabled = true;
        select.add(loading);
      }
    }

    // Always the track's own instrument, also when one is dropped on the track while this list
    // still has the keyboard focus from an earlier pick.
    select.value = current;
  }

  function createRow(track) {
    const row = element("div", "track");
    row.dataset.id = String(track.id);
    row.innerHTML = `
      <div class="track-colour"></div>
      <div class="track-body">
        <div class="track-top">
          <span class="track-number"></span>
          <button class="tbtn" data-action="mute" aria-pressed="false" title="Mute">M</button>
          <button class="tbtn" data-action="solo" aria-pressed="false" title="Solo">S</button>
          <button class="tbtn arm" data-action="recordArm" aria-pressed="false" title="Record arm: record on this track">${ICON_RECORD}</button>
          <button class="tbtn monitor" data-action="monitor" aria-pressed="false" title="Monitor: play this track from your keyboard">${ICON_MONITOR}</button>
          <span class="track-name" title="Double-click to rename"></span>
          <button class="track-kind" type="button">${ICON_KEYS}</button>
        </div>
        <div class="track-meter"><i></i></div>
        <label class="track-fader"><span>Vol</span><input type="range" data-control="volume" min="0" max="1" step="0.001"><output></output></label>
        <label class="track-fader pan-row"><span>Pan</span><input type="range" data-control="pan" min="-1" max="1" step="0.01"><output></output></label>
        <select class="track-instrument" data-control="instrument" aria-label="Instrument"></select>
        <button class="track-midi" type="button" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false"
          title="MIDI in: the MIDI devices and tracks this instrument hears"></button>
        <select class="track-input" data-control="input" aria-label="Input" title="The input this track hears and records"></select>
        <div class="track-auto-row">
          <select class="track-auto" data-control="autoTarget" aria-label="Automation" title="What this track's envelope controls"></select>
          <button class="tbtn track-auto-mode" aria-pressed="true" title="Read: the envelope moves the control during playback. Click for Off.">R</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="track-resize" title="Drag to resize this track; double-click for the standard height"></div>`;
    return row;
  }

  /** The Automation View target menu: Volume, Pan, and every parameter of the track's plugins. */
  function autoOptions(select, track) {
    const automated = new Set((track.automation || []).map((lane) => Hub.arrange.laneKey(lane)));
    const plugins = [];
    if (track.instrument) plugins.push([0, track.instrument]);
    for (const insert of track.inserts || []) plugins.push([insert.insertId, insert]);
    const mark = (key, name) => (automated.has(key) ? "● " : "") + name;
    const signature = JSON.stringify([...automated, ...plugins.map(([slot, p]) => [slot, p.name, (p.params || []).map((x) => x.id)])]);

    if (select.dataset.signature !== signature) {
      select.textContent = "";
      select.add(new Option(mark("volume", "Volume"), "volume"));
      select.add(new Option(mark("pan", "Pan"), "pan"));
      for (const [slot, plugin] of plugins) {
        const group = document.createElement("optgroup");
        group.label = plugin.name;
        for (const p of plugin.params || []) {
          const key = `param:${slot}:${p.id}`;
          group.appendChild(new Option(mark(key, p.name), key));
        }
        if (group.children.length) select.appendChild(group);
      }
      select.dataset.signature = signature;
    }
    if (document.activeElement !== select) select.value = Hub.arrange.autoTarget(track.id);
    const mode = select.parentElement.querySelector(".track-auto-mode");
    mode.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(track.autoMode !== "off"));
    mode.textContent = track.autoMode === "off" ? "Off" : "R";
  }

  /** An audio track's input choice: the song's inputs (Song Setup). */
  function inputOptions(select, track) {
    const inputs = Hub.state.inputs || [];
    const signature = inputs.map((input) => input.name).join("|");
    if (select.dataset.signature !== signature) {
      select.textContent = "";
      inputs.forEach((input, index) => select.add(new Option(input.name, String(index))));
      select.dataset.signature = signature;
    }
    if (document.activeElement !== select) select.value = String(track.input || 0);
  }

  function updateRow(row, track) {
    row.style.setProperty("--track-colour", track.colour);
    row.classList.toggle("selected", track.id === Hub.state.selected);
    row.classList.toggle("audio", track.kind === "audio");
    // The kind icon: on an instrument track, the keyboard opens the instrument's window.
    const kindIcon = row.querySelector(".track-kind");
    kindIcon.innerHTML = track.kind === "audio" ? ICON_WAVE : ICON_KEYS;
    const hasWindow = track.kind !== "audio" && Boolean(track.instrument);
    kindIcon.disabled = !hasWindow;
    kindIcon.classList.toggle("no-window", track.kind !== "audio" && !hasWindow);
    kindIcon.title = track.kind === "audio" ? "Audio track" : hasWindow ? `Open ${track.instrument.name}` : "The Test Synth has no window";
    kindIcon.setAttribute("aria-label", kindIcon.title);
    row.classList.toggle("busy", Boolean(track.loading));
    row.querySelector(".track-number").textContent = String(track.number);

    const name = row.querySelector(".track-name");
    if (!name.querySelector("input")) {
      name.textContent = track.loading ? `Loading ${track.loading}…` : track.name;
      name.title = track.name + " · double-click to rename";
    }

    for (const action of ["mute", "solo", "recordArm", "monitor"])
      row.querySelector(`[data-action="${action}"]`).setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(Boolean(track[action])));

    showFaders(row, track);

    if (track.kind === "audio")
      inputOptions(row.querySelector('[data-control="input"]'), track);
    else
      instrumentOptions(row.querySelector('[data-control="instrument"]'), track);
    autoOptions(row.querySelector('[data-control="autoTarget"]'), track);
    showMidiSummary(row.querySelector(".track-midi"), track);

    // A height of its own (dragged), or the view's size from the style sheet.
    if (!row.classList.contains("resizing")) row.style.height = track.height > 0 ? `${track.height}px` : "";
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- MIDI in
  /** A track's MIDI sources by name: devices as they are, tracks as "Track 2 · Domina". */
  function midiSourceName(source) {
    if (!source.startsWith("track:")) return source;
    const from = Hub.trackById(Number(source.slice(6)));
    return from ? `${from.name}${from.instrument ? " \u00b7 " + from.instrument.name : ""}` : "A removed track";
  }

  function showMidiSummary(button, track) {
    const sources = track.midiInputs || [];
    button.textContent = sources.length === 0 ? "No MIDI in"
      : sources.length === 1 ? `MIDI: ${midiSourceName(sources[0])}` : `MIDI: ${sources.length} inputs`;
    button.title = sources.length ? `MIDI in: ${sources.map(midiSourceName).join(", ")}` : "MIDI in: none. Click to choose a MIDI device or a track";
  }

  /** The MIDI in list: every MIDI device, and the tracks whose plugins play notes (a MIDI-out
      instrument, an arpeggiator); ticked ones are marked x. It stays open for several. */
  function openMidiMenu(button, trackId) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".popup-menu").forEach((menu) => menu.remove());
    const menu = element("div", "popup-menu midi-menu");
    menu.setAttribute("role", "menu");
    button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

    const render = () => {
      const track = Hub.trackById(trackId);
      if (!track) return;
      const chosen = new Set(track.midiInputs || []);
      const devices = [...((Hub.state.status && Hub.state.status.midiInputs) || [])];
      for (const source of chosen) if (!source.startsWith("track:") && !devices.includes(source)) devices.push(source);
      const players = Hub.state.tracks.filter((t) => t.id !== trackId && t.kind === "instrument" && t.instrument && t.instrument.midiOut);

      menu.replaceChildren();
      const add = (value, label, missing) => {
        const on = chosen.has(value);
        const item = element("button", "midi-choice" + (missing ? " missing" : ""));
        item.type = "button";
        item.setAttribute("role", "menuitemcheckbox");
        item.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(on));
        item.append(element("span", "midi-box", on ? "\u2715" : ""), element("span", "midi-label", label));
        item.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
          const list = (track.midiInputs || []).filter((s) => s !== value);
          if (!on) list.push(value);
          track.midiInputs = list;   // shown at once; the engine confirms
          showMidiSummary(button, track);
          render();
          Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: trackId, midiInputs: list });
        });
        menu.appendChild(item);
      };

      menu.appendChild(element("div", "popup-group", "MIDI devices"));
      if (!devices.length) menu.appendChild(element("div", "midi-empty", "No MIDI device connected"));
      const connected = (Hub.state.status && Hub.state.status.midiInputs) || [];
      for (const device of devices) add(device, connected.includes(device) ? device : `${device} (not connected)`, !connected.includes(device));

      menu.appendChild(element("div", "popup-group", "Tracks"));
      if (!players.length) menu.appendChild(element("div", "midi-empty", "No track's plugin plays notes itself"));
      for (const player of players) add(`track:${player.id}`, midiSourceName(`track:${player.id}`), false);
    };

    render();
    document.body.appendChild(menu);
    const r = button.getBoundingClientRect();
    const height = menu.offsetHeight || 0;
    menu.style.left = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerWidth - (menu.offsetWidth || 220) - 4, r.left)) + "px";
    menu.style.top = (r.bottom + height + 4 > window.innerHeight ? Math.max(4, r.top - height - 2) : r.bottom + 2) + "px";

    const close = () => {
      menu.remove();
      button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", outside, true);
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", escape, true);
    };
    const outside = (event) => { if (!menu.contains(event.target) && event.target !== button) close(); };
    const escape = (event) => { if (event.key === "Escape") { event.stopPropagation(); close(); } };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", outside, true);
    window.addEventListener("keydown", escape, true);
    return menu;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- resizing a track by its bottom edge
  function setupResizing(list) {
    list.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      const edge = event.target.closest(".track-resize");
      if (!edge || event.button !== 0) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const row = edge.closest(".track");
      const track = Hub.trackById(Number(row.dataset.id));
      if (!track) return;

      const startY = event.clientY, startHeight = row.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      row.classList.add("resizing");
      edge.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

      const move = (e) => {
        const height = Math.round(Math.max(56, Math.min(600, startHeight + e.clientY - startY)));
        track.height = height;
        row.style.height = `${height}px`;
        if (Hub.arrange) { Hub.arrange.updateSizes(); Hub.arrange.redraw(); }
      };
      const up = () => {
        edge.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
        edge.removeEventListener("pointerup", up);
        edge.removeEventListener("pointercancel", up);
        row.classList.remove("resizing");
        Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: track.id, height: track.height || 0 });
      };
      edge.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
      edge.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
      edge.addEventListener("pointercancel", up);
    });

    list.addEventListener("dblclick", (event) => {
      const edge = event.target.closest(".track-resize");
      if (!edge) return;
      const row = edge.closest(".track");
      const track = Hub.trackById(Number(row.dataset.id));
      if (!track) return;
      track.height = 0;
      row.style.height = "";
      if (Hub.arrange) { Hub.arrange.updateSizes(); Hub.arrange.redraw(); }
      Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: track.id, height: 0 });
    });
  }

  /** Volume and pan in a header row, unless the user is dragging that control right now. */
  function showFaders(row, track) {
    const volume = row.querySelector('[data-control="volume"]');
    const pan = row.querySelector('[data-control="pan"]');
    if (document.activeElement !== volume) volume.value = String(Hub.dbToFader(track.volume));
    if (document.activeElement !== pan) pan.value = String(track.pan);
    volume.nextElementSibling.textContent = Hub.dbText(track.volume);
    pan.nextElementSibling.textContent = Hub.panText(track.pan);
  }

  function renderTrackList() {
    const list = $("track-rows");
    const alive = new Set();

    Hub.state.tracks.forEach((track, index) => {
      let row = rows.get(track.id);

      if (!row) {
        row = createRow(track);
        rows.set(track.id, row);
      }

      updateRow(row, track);
      alive.add(track.id);

      if (list.children[index] !== row) list.insertBefore(row, list.children[index] || null);
    });

    for (const [id, row] of rows) {
      if (!alive.has(id)) {
        row.remove();
        rows.delete(id);
      }
    }

    $("track-empty").hidden = Hub.state.tracks.length > 0;
    Hub.arrange.updateSizes();
  }

  function trackIdFrom(target) {
    const row = target.closest(".track");
    return row ? Number(row.dataset.id) : 0;
  }

  function startRename(nameElement, track) {
    Hub.inlineRename(nameElement, track.name, (value) => Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: track.id, name: value }));
  }

  function setupTrackList() {
    const list = $("track-rows");
    setupResizing(list);

    list.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const midi = event.target.closest(".track-midi");
      if (!midi) return;
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (midi.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true") document.querySelectorAll(".midi-menu").forEach((m) => m.remove());
      else openMidiMenu(midi, trackIdFrom(midi));
    });

    list.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const id = trackIdFrom(event.target);
      if (!id) return;

      const kindIcon = event.target.closest(".track-kind");

      if (kindIcon) {
        Hub.openScreen(id, 0);   // the instrument's window, as the Inspector opens it
        return;
      }

      const button = event.target.closest("[data-action]");

      if (button) {
        const action = button.dataset.action;
        const on = button.getAttribute("aria-pressed") !== "true";
        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
        Hub.send("trackSettings", { id, [action]: on });
        return;
      }

      if (!event.target.closest("input, select")) Hub.selectTrack(id);
    });

    list.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
      const control = event.target.dataset.control;
      if (control !== "volume" && control !== "pan") return;
      const raw = Number(event.target.value);
      const value = control === "volume" ? Hub.faderToDb(raw) : raw;
      event.target.nextElementSibling.textContent = control === "volume" ? Hub.dbText(value) : Hub.panText(value);
      Hub.setTrackValue(trackIdFrom(event.target), control, value, event.target);
    });

    // Double-click a fader to reset it, as in Studio One.
    list.addEventListener("dblclick", (event) => {
      const control = event.target.dataset && event.target.dataset.control;

      if (control === "volume" || control === "pan") {
        event.target.value = control === "volume" ? String(Hub.dbToFader(0)) : "0";
        event.target.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
        return;
      }

      const name = event.target.closest(".track-name");
      const track = name && Hub.trackById(trackIdFrom(name));
      if (track) startRename(name, track);
    });

    list.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const mode = event.target.closest(".track-auto-mode");
      if (!mode) return;
      const row = mode.closest(".track");
      Hub.send("setAutomationMode", { trackId: Number(row.dataset.id), mode: mode.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true" ? "off" : "read" });
    });

    list.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      if (event.target.dataset.control === "autoTarget") {
        const row = event.target.closest(".track");
        Hub.arrange.setAutoTarget(Number(row.dataset.id), event.target.value);
        event.target.blur();
        return;
      }
      if (event.target.dataset.control === "input") {
        const row = event.target.closest(".track");
        Hub.send("trackSettings", { id: Number(row.dataset.id), input: Number(event.target.value) });
        event.target.blur();
        return;
      }
      if (event.target.dataset.control !== "instrument") return;
      const id = trackIdFrom(event.target);
      const value = event.target.value;
      event.target.blur();

      if (value === BUILTIN_KEY) {
        Hub.send("clearInstrument", { trackId: id });
        return;
      }

      const entry = Hub.state.library.find((item) => pluginKey(item.file, item.id) === value);
      if (entry) Hub.send("loadPlugin", { trackId: id, file: entry.file, pluginId: entry.id });
    });

    // Like Studio One's Add Tracks: an instrument track or an audio track.
    $("add-track").addEventListener("click", () => {
      Hub.popupMenu($("add-track"), [
        { label: "Instrument Track", value: "addTrack" },
        { label: "Audio Track", value: "addAudioTrack" }
      ], (command) => Hub.run(command));
    });

    // The track list follows the arrangement's vertical scrolling.
    $("tracklist").addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
      $("lanes").scrollTop += event.deltaY;
      event.preventDefault();
    }, { passive: false });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- drag and drop from the Browser
  function setDropTarget(target) {
    if (dropTarget === target) return;
    if (dropTarget) dropTarget.classList.remove("drop-target");
    dropTarget = target;
    if (dropTarget) dropTarget.classList.add("drop-target");
  }

  function dropTrackFor(event) {
    const row = event.target.closest && event.target.closest(".track");
    if (row) return Hub.trackById(Number(row.dataset.id));
    if (event.currentTarget === $("lanes")) return Hub.arrange.trackAt(event.clientY);
    return null;
  }

  /**
      Puts a Browser entry on a channel: a track id, Hub.MAIN, or null for a new track.
      position places an effect among the channel's inserts (-1: the end).
  */
  function dropEntryOn(entry, channel, position = -1) {
    const newTrack = channel === null || channel === undefined;

    if (entry.builtin) {
      if (newTrack) Hub.send("addTrack");
      else if (channel !== Hub.MAIN) Hub.send("clearInstrument", { trackId: channel });
      return;
    }

    if (newTrack) Hub.send("addTrack", { file: entry.file, pluginId: entry.id });
    else Hub.send("loadPlugin", { trackId: channel, file: entry.file, pluginId: entry.id, position });
  }

  Hub.dropEntryOn = dropEntryOn;

  function setupDropTargets() {
    for (const area of [$("tracklist"), $("lanes")]) {
      area.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
        if (!Hub.dragEntry && !Hub.dragFile) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "copy";
        const track = dropTrackFor(event);
        setDropTarget(track ? rows.get(track.id) : $("track-space"));
      });

      area.addEventListener("dragleave", (event) => {
        if (!area.contains(event.relatedTarget)) setDropTarget(null);
      });

      area.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
        // An audio file from the Browser's Files tab: onto an audio track where it's dropped
        // (at the playhead when dropped on a track header), or onto a new audio track.
        if (Hub.dragFile) {
          event.preventDefault();
          const track = dropTrackFor(event);
          const onLanes = event.currentTarget === $("lanes");
          const start = onLanes ? Hub.arrange.snap(Hub.arrange.ppqAt(event.clientX)) : Hub.songPosition();
          Hub.send("importAudio", { file: Hub.dragFile.path, trackId: track && track.kind === "audio" ? track.id : 0, start });
          Hub.dragFile = null;
          setDropTarget(null);
          return;
        }

        if (!Hub.dragEntry) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        const track = dropTrackFor(event);
        setDropTarget(null);
        dropEntryOn(Hub.dragEntry, track ? track.id : null);
        Hub.dragEntry = null;
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener("dragend", () => setDropTarget(null));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands, events
  Hub.commands.addTrack = () => Hub.send("addTrack");
  Hub.commands.addAudioTrack = () => Hub.send("addTrack", { kind: "audio" });

  Hub.commands.removeTrack = () => {
    const track = Hub.selectedTrack();
    if (track) Hub.send("removeTrack", { id: track.id });
  };

  function renderAll() {
    renderTrackList();   // also redraws the lanes, so the selection shows there too
  }

  Hub.on("tracks", renderAll);
  Hub.on("selection", renderAll);

  // A fader moved somewhere else (the Console): show it here too.
  Hub.on("trackValue", ({ id, source }) => {
    const row = rows.get(id);
    const track = Hub.trackById(id);
    if (row && track && !row.contains(source)) showFaders(row, track);
  });
  Hub.on("library", renderTrackList);

  Hub.on("status", (s) => {
    for (const meter of s.trackMeters || []) {
      const row = rows.get(meter.id);
      if (!row) continue;
      // An audio track that's armed or monitoring shows its input: set the level before recording.
      const track = Hub.trackById(meter.id);
      const hearing = track && track.kind === "audio" && (track.recordArm || track.monitor);
      const db = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(meter.left, meter.right, hearing ? meter.input || 0 : 0, 1e-6));
      row.querySelector(".track-meter i").style.width = Hub.clamp01((db + 60) / 60) * 100 + "%";

      // Automation moves the fader and pan while the song plays.
      if (track && meter.volume !== undefined) {
        track.volume = meter.volume;
        track.pan = meter.pan;
        showFaders(row, track);
      }
    }
  });

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    setupTrackList();
    setupDropTargets();
    renderAll();
  });
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-transport.js
//
// The transport bar along the bottom of the window, laid out like Studio One's:
// performance and device readouts, the time display, transport buttons, loop
// locators, timing, tempo and metronome, then the panel toggles.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $ } = Hub;
  const DENOMINATORS = [2, 4, 8, 16];

  let transport = { playing: false, ppq: 0, bpm: 120, numerator: 4, denominator: 4,
                    loop: false, loopStart: 0, loopEnd: 16, metronome: false, metronomeVolume: 0.6 };
  let receivedAt = 0;
  let showSeconds = false;
  let lastNoteOns = null;
  let ledTimer = 0;
  const tapTimes = [];

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- formatting
  /** Studio One's bars display: bar.beat.sixteenth.ticks, as in 00001.01.01.00 */
  function formatBars(ppq, numerator, denominator) {
    const beatLength = 4 / denominator;
    const position = Math.max(0, ppq) + 1e-9;
    const bar = Math.floor(position / (numerator * beatLength));
    const inBar = position - bar * numerator * beatLength;
    const beat = Math.min(numerator - 1, Math.floor(inBar / beatLength));
    const perBeat = Math.max(1, 16 / denominator);
    const sixteenthLength = beatLength / perBeat;
    const inBeat = inBar - beat * beatLength;
    const sixteenth = Math.min(perBeat - 1, Math.floor(inBeat / sixteenthLength));
    const ticks = Math.min(99, Math.floor((inBeat - sixteenth * sixteenthLength) / sixteenthLength * 100));
    const pad = (value, width) => String(value).padStart(width, "0");
    return `${pad(bar + 1, 5)}.${pad(beat + 1, 2)}.${pad(sixteenth + 1, 2)}.${pad(ticks, 2)}`;
  }

  /**
      Reads a position typed Studio One's way: "5", "5.3", "5.3.2", "5.3.2.50" or the
      display's own "00005.03.02.50" (bar.beat.sixteenth.ticks, counted from 1).
      Returns quarter notes, or null when the text isn't a position.
  */
  function parseBars(text, numerator, denominator) {
    const parts = String(text).trim().split(/[.:\s]+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length === 0 || parts.length > 4 || parts.some((part) => !/^\d+$/.test(part))) return null;

    const [bar, beat = 1, sixteenth = 1, ticks = 0] = parts.map(Number);
    const beatLength = 4 / denominator;
    const perBeat = Math.max(1, 16 / denominator);
    if (bar < 1 || beat < 1 || beat > numerator || sixteenth < 1 || sixteenth > perBeat || ticks > 99) return null;

    const sixteenthLength = beatLength / perBeat;
    return (bar - 1) * numerator * beatLength + (beat - 1) * beatLength + (sixteenth - 1) * sixteenthLength + ticks / 100 * sixteenthLength;
  }

  function formatSeconds(seconds) {
    const millis = Math.floor(Math.max(0, seconds) * 1000);
    const hours = Math.floor(millis / 3600000);
    const minutes = Math.floor(millis / 60000) % 60;
    const secs = Math.floor(millis / 1000) % 60;
    const pad = (value, width) => String(value).padStart(width, "0");
    return `${pad(hours, 2)}:${pad(minutes, 2)}:${pad(secs, 2)}.${pad(millis % 1000, 3)}`;
  }

  // Leaves a control alone while the user is working with it.
  function showValue(element, value) {
    if (document.activeElement !== element && element.value !== value) element.value = value;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- position between status updates
  /** Song position now, advanced smoothly between the engine's 20-per-second updates. */
  Hub.songPosition = () => {
    if (!transport.playing) return transport.ppq;

    let ppq = transport.ppq + (performance.now() - receivedAt) * transport.bpm / 60000;
    const { loopStart, loopEnd } = transport;

    if (transport.loop && transport.ppq < loopEnd && ppq >= loopEnd && loopEnd > loopStart)
      ppq = loopStart + (ppq - loopEnd) % (loopEnd - loopStart);

    return ppq;
  };

  Hub.transportInfo = () => transport;
  Hub.formatBars = formatBars;
  Hub.parseBars = (text) => parseBars(text, transport.numerator, transport.denominator);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- rendering
  // Like Studio One, Play lights up while playing; Stop is its own button.
  function renderPlaying(playing) {
    $("play").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(playing));
  }

  function renderTime() {
    const ppq = Hub.songPosition();
    $("time-value").textContent = showSeconds ? formatSeconds(ppq * 60 / transport.bpm)
                                              : formatBars(ppq, transport.numerator, transport.denominator);
    $("time-unit").textContent = showSeconds ? "Seconds" : "Bars";
  }

  function renderLocators() {
    const start = formatBars(transport.loopStart, transport.numerator, transport.denominator);
    const end = formatBars(transport.loopEnd, transport.numerator, transport.denominator);
    $("locator-l").textContent = start;
    $("locator-r").textContent = end;
    showValue($("loop-start"), start);
    showValue($("loop-end"), end);
  }

  function render(t) {
    const wasPlaying = transport.playing;
    transport = t;
    receivedAt = performance.now();

    if (t.playing !== wasPlaying) renderPlaying(t.playing);

    renderTime();
    renderLocators();
    showValue($("tempo"), t.bpm.toFixed(2));
    showValue($("sig-num"), String(t.numerator));
    showValue($("sig-den"), String(t.denominator));
    $("loop").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(t.loop));
    $("metronome").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(t.metronome));
    $("record").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(Boolean(t.recording)));
    document.body.classList.toggle("recording", Boolean(t.recording) && t.playing);

    const volume = $("metronome-volume");
    showValue(volume, String(Math.round(t.metronomeVolume * 100)));
    volume.style.setProperty("--fill", volume.value + "%");
  }

  function renderStatus(s) {
    const cpu = Math.round((s.cpu || 0) * 100);
    $("cpu-fill").style.width = Hub.clamp(cpu, 0, 100) + "%";
    $("cpu-text").textContent = cpu + "%";
    $("perf").title = `Audio CPU ${cpu}%` + (s.xruns >= 0 ? ` · ${s.xruns} dropouts` : "");

    if (s.deviceOpen) {
      const khz = s.sampleRate / 1000;
      $("device-name").textContent = s.deviceName;
      $("device-detail").textContent = `${Number.isInteger(khz) ? khz : khz.toFixed(1)} kHz · ${s.bufferSize} · ${s.outputLatencyMs.toFixed(1)} ms`;
      $("device").title = `${s.typeName} · ${s.deviceName}\nBuffer ${s.bufferSize} samples (${s.bufferMs.toFixed(1)} ms), output latency ${s.outputLatencyMs.toFixed(1)} ms`;
    } else {
      $("device-name").textContent = "No audio device";
      $("device-detail").textContent = "Open Audio Setup";
      $("device").title = "Choose a driver and device";
    }

    const level = (peak) => Hub.clamp01((20 * Math.log10(Math.max(peak || 0, 1e-6)) + 60) / 60) * 100 + "%";
    $("main-l").style.width = level(s.peakLeft);
    $("main-r").style.width = level(s.peakRight);

    const inputs = s.midiInputs || [];
    $("midi-led").title = inputs.length ? "MIDI inputs: " + inputs.join(", ") : "No MIDI inputs enabled (File → Audio Setup)";

    if (lastNoteOns !== null && s.hardwareNoteOns !== lastNoteOns) {
      $("midi-led").classList.add("on");
      clearTimeout(ledTimer);
      ledTimer = setTimeout(() => $("midi-led").classList.remove("on"), 150);
    }

    lastNoteOns = s.hardwareNoteOns;
    if (s.transport) render(s.transport);
  }

  function tick() {
    if (transport.playing) renderTime();
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- actions
  Hub.commands.togglePlay = () => {
    transport.playing = !transport.playing;
    renderPlaying(transport.playing);
    Hub.send("transport", { action: "toggle" });
  };

  Hub.commands.play = () => {
    transport.playing = true;
    renderPlaying(true);
    Hub.send("transport", { action: "play" });
  };

  // Like Studio One: Stop while stopped returns to zero.
  Hub.commands.stop = () => {
    if (transport.playing) {
      transport.playing = false;
      transport.recording = false;
      $("record").setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
      renderPlaying(false);
      Hub.send("transport", { action: "stop" });
    } else {
      Hub.run("returnToZero");
    }
  };

  Hub.commands.returnToZero = () => {
    transport.ppq = 0;
    receivedAt = performance.now();
    renderTime();
    Hub.send("transport", { action: "start" });
  };

  // Like Studio One: Record starts playback when stopped; pressed while recording it
  // punches out and playback goes on.
  Hub.commands.toggleRecord = () => {
    transport.recording = !transport.recording;
    $("record").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(transport.recording));
    if (transport.recording && !transport.playing) {
      transport.playing = true;
      renderPlaying(true);
    }
    Hub.send("transport", { action: "record" });
  };

  Hub.commands.toggleLoop = () => {
    transport.loop = !transport.loop;
    $("loop").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(transport.loop));
    Hub.send("transport", { loop: transport.loop });
    Hub.emit("transportEdited");
  };

  Hub.commands.toggleMetronome = () => {
    transport.metronome = !transport.metronome;
    $("metronome").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(transport.metronome));
    Hub.send("transport", { metronome: transport.metronome });
  };

  /** Moves the song position, as when clicking in the ruler. */
  Hub.locate = (ppq) => {
    transport.ppq = Math.max(0, ppq);
    receivedAt = performance.now();
    renderTime();
    Hub.send("transport", { action: "locate", ppq: transport.ppq });
  };

  function sendTempo(bpm) {
    const value = Math.round(Hub.clamp(bpm, 20, 300) * 100) / 100;
    $("tempo").value = value.toFixed(2);
    transport.bpm = value;
    Hub.send("transport", { bpm: value });
    Hub.emit("transportEdited");
  }

  function tapTempo() {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (tapTimes.length && now - tapTimes[tapTimes.length - 1] > 2000) tapTimes.length = 0;
    tapTimes.push(now);
    if (tapTimes.length > 5) tapTimes.shift();
    if (tapTimes.length < 2) return;
    sendTempo(60000 * (tapTimes.length - 1) / (tapTimes[tapTimes.length - 1] - tapTimes[0]));
  }

  /** Sets the loop range in quarter notes; optionally switches looping on or off too. */
  Hub.setLoop = (start, end, enabled) => {
    if (!(end > start) || start < 0) return;
    transport.loopStart = start;
    transport.loopEnd = end;
    const message = { loopStart: start, loopEnd: end };

    if (enabled !== undefined) {
      transport.loop = enabled;
      message.loop = enabled;
      $("loop").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(enabled));
    }

    renderLocators();
    Hub.send("transport", message);
    Hub.emit("transportEdited");
  };

  // L is where the loop starts, R where it ends. Anything that isn't a position, or an R
  // that isn't after L, puts the fields back as they were.
  function sendLocators() {
    const start = parseBars($("loop-start").value, transport.numerator, transport.denominator);
    const end = parseBars($("loop-end").value, transport.numerator, transport.denominator);

    if (start === null || end === null || end <= start) {
      $("loop-start").value = formatBars(transport.loopStart, transport.numerator, transport.denominator);
      $("loop-end").value = formatBars(transport.loopEnd, transport.numerator, transport.denominator);
      return;
    }

    Hub.setLoop(start, end);
  }

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    for (let beats = 1; beats <= 16; beats++) $("sig-num").add(new Option(String(beats), String(beats)));
    for (const unit of DENOMINATORS) $("sig-den").add(new Option(String(unit), String(unit)));
    $("sig-num").value = "4";
    $("sig-den").value = "4";
    renderPlaying(false);
    renderTime();
    renderLocators();

    $("play").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("play"));
    $("stop").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("stop"));
    $("to-start").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("returnToZero"));
    $("loop").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("toggleLoop"));
    $("record").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("toggleRecord"));
    $("metronome").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("toggleMetronome"));
    $("tap").addEventListener("click", tapTempo);
    $("device").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("audioSetup"));

    $("time").addEventListener("click", () => {
      showSeconds = !showSeconds;
      renderTime();
    });

    $("metronome-volume").addEventListener("input", (event) => {
      event.target.style.setProperty("--fill", event.target.value + "%");
      Hub.send("transport", { metronomeVolume: Number(event.target.value) / 100 });
    });

    $("tempo").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      const bpm = Number(event.target.value);
      sendTempo(Number.isFinite(bpm) && bpm > 0 ? bpm : transport.bpm);
    });

    for (const id of ["sig-num", "sig-den"]) {
      $(id).addEventListener("change", (event) => {
        event.target.blur();
        transport.numerator = Number($("sig-num").value);
        transport.denominator = Number($("sig-den").value);
        renderLocators();
        Hub.send("transport", { numerator: transport.numerator, denominator: transport.denominator });
        Hub.emit("transportEdited");
      });
    }

    $("loop-start").addEventListener("change", sendLocators);
    $("loop-end").addEventListener("change", sendLocators);

    // L and R show song positions; clicking one turns it into a bar-number field.
    for (const input of [$("loop-start"), $("loop-end")]) {
      const locator = input.closest(".locator");

      locator.querySelector(".locator-pos").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        locator.classList.add("editing");
        input.focus();
        input.select();
      });

      input.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape") {
          input.value = formatBars(input === $("loop-start") ? transport.loopStart : transport.loopEnd, transport.numerator, transport.denominator);
          input.blur();
        } else if (event.key === "Enter") {
          input.blur();
        }
      });

      input.addEventListener("blur", () => locator.classList.remove("editing"));
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  });

  Hub.on("status", renderStatus);
})();

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\hub-web.js
//
// Web browsing tabs, above everything: Studio (the DAW) first, then web pages.
//   Each web tab is a real browser view (WebView2) laid over the content area; the
//   transport stays below it, so the song can be played while browsing.
//   Address bar: a web address, or words to search for.
//   Keys: Ctrl+T new tab, Ctrl+W close, Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab next / previous,
//   Ctrl+1 Studio and Ctrl+2..9 the web tabs, Ctrl+L the address bar,
//   Alt+Left / Alt+Right back and forward, F5 or Ctrl+R reload.

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const { $, element } = Hub;
  const tabs = [];            // { id, url, title, loading, error }
  let active = "studio";      // "studio" or a web tab's id

  const SEARCH = "https://www.google.com/search?q=";
  const QUICK = [["YouTube", "https://www.youtube.com"], ["KVR Audio", "https://www.kvraudio.com"],
                 ["Bandcamp", "https://bandcamp.com"], ["Wikipedia", "https://www.wikipedia.org"]];

  /** What was typed, as an address: a URL as it is, a bare address with https://, words as a search. */
  function toUrl(text) {
    const typed = text.trim();
    if (!typed) return "";
    if (/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(typed) || /^(about|data):/i.test(typed)) return typed;
    if (!/\s/.test(typed) && (/^localhost(:\d+)?(\/.*)?$/i.test(typed) || /^[\w-]+(\.[\w-]+)+(:\d+)?([/?#].*)?$/.test(typed))) return "https://" + typed;
    return SEARCH + encodeURIComponent(typed);
  }

  const tabOf = (id) => tabs.find((t) => t.id === id) || null;
  const labelOf = (tab) => tab.title || (tab.url ? tab.url.replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?/, "").replace(/\/$/, "") : "New tab");

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the strip
  function renderStrip() {
    const strip = $("tab-strip");
    for (const button of [...strip.querySelectorAll(".hub-tab.web")]) button.remove();
    const add = $("tab-new");

    for (const tab of tabs) {
      const button = element("button", "hub-tab web" + (tab.loading ? " loading" : ""));
      button.dataset.tab = String(tab.id);
      button.setAttribute("role", "tab");
      button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(active === tab.id));
      button.title = tab.url || "New tab";
      button.appendChild(element("span", "tab-title", labelOf(tab)));
      const shut = element("span", "tab-close", "×");
      shut.setAttribute("role", "button");
      shut.setAttribute("aria-label", `Close ${labelOf(tab)}`);
      button.appendChild(shut);
      strip.insertBefore(button, add);
    }

    $("tab-studio").setAttribute("aria-selected", String(active === "studio"));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the web area
  /** Where the page shows the active tab's view (in CSS pixels, which are the window's own). */
  function placeView() {
    const tab = tabOf(active);
    const overlay = [...document.querySelectorAll(".modal"), $("start-page"), $("scan-page")].some((box) => box && !box.hidden);
    if (!tab || !tab.url || overlay) {
      Hub.send("webTabHide");
      return;
    }
    const r = $("web-content").getBoundingClientRect();
    Hub.send("webTabShow", { id: tab.id, x: Math.round(r.left), y: Math.round(r.top), width: Math.round(r.width), height: Math.round(r.height) });
  }

  function renderWebArea() {
    const tab = tabOf(active);
    if (!tab) return;
    const address = $("web-address");
    if (document.activeElement !== address) address.value = tab.url;
    $("web-reload").textContent = tab.loading ? "✕" : "⟳";
    $("web-reload").title = tab.loading ? "Stop" : "Reload (F5)";
    $("web-reload").setAttribute("aria-label", tab.loading ? "Stop" : "Reload");
    $("web-start").hidden = Boolean(tab.url);
    $("web-error").hidden = !tab.error;
    $("web-error").textContent = tab.error ? `This page couldn't load: ${tab.error}` : "";
  }

  function activate(id) {
    const tab = id === "studio" ? null : tabOf(id);
    active = tab ? tab.id : "studio";
    const web = active !== "studio";
    document.body.classList.toggle("web-mode", web);
    $("web-area").hidden = !web;
    // The arrangement's keys (Delete and the like) rest while a web page is in front.
    if (web) Hub.state.focus = "web";
    else if (Hub.state.focus === "web") Hub.state.focus = "arrange";
    renderStrip();

    if (!web) {
      Hub.send("webTabHide");
      return;
    }

    renderWebArea();
    placeView();
    if (!tab.url) {
      $("web-address").focus();
      $("web-address").select();
    }
  }

  function navigate(text) {
    const tab = tabOf(active);
    const url = toUrl(text);
    if (!tab || !url) return;
    tab.url = url;
    tab.error = "";
    tab.loading = true;
    Hub.send("webTabNavigate", { id: tab.id, url });
    $("web-address").blur();
    renderStrip();
    renderWebArea();
    placeView();
  }

  function close(id) {
    Hub.send("webTabClose", { id });
  }

  function cycle(step) {
    const order = ["studio", ...tabs.map((t) => t.id)];
    const at = order.indexOf(active);
    activate(order[(at + step + order.length) % order.length]);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- from the engine
  Hub.on("webTabOpened", (data) => {
    tabs.push({ id: data.id, url: data.url || "", title: data.title || "", loading: Boolean(data.url), error: "" });
    if (data.activate) activate(data.id);
    else renderStrip();
  });

  Hub.on("webTabsRestore", (data) => {
    for (const saved of data.tabs || []) tabs.push({ id: saved.id, url: saved.url, title: saved.title || "", loading: false, error: "" });
    renderStrip();
  });

  Hub.on("webTabState", (data) => {
    const tab = tabOf(data.id);
    if (!tab) return;
    tab.url = data.url || tab.url;
    tab.loading = Boolean(data.loading);
    if (data.title) tab.title = data.title;
    if (data.loading) tab.error = "";
    if (data.error) tab.error = data.error;
    renderStrip();
    if (active === tab.id) renderWebArea();
  });

  Hub.on("webTabClosed", (data) => {
    const index = tabs.findIndex((t) => t.id === data.id);
    if (index < 0) return;
    tabs.splice(index, 1);
    if (active === data.id) activate(tabs.length ? tabs[Math.min(index, tabs.length - 1)].id : "studio");
    else renderStrip();
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands and keys
  Hub.commands.newTab = () => Hub.send("webTabNew", { url: "" });
  Hub.commands.closeTab = () => { if (active !== "studio") close(active); };
  Hub.commands.showStudio = () => activate("studio");

  Hub.web = { tabs, activate, toUrl, active: () => active };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- block internet
  let internetBlocked = false;

  function renderNetToggle() {
    const button = $("net-toggle");
    button.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(internetBlocked));
    button.classList.toggle("blocked", internetBlocked);
    button.querySelector(".net-label").textContent = internetBlocked ? "Internet off" : "Internet on";
    button.title = internetBlocked ? "Internet blocked: no plugin, tab or the cloud can reach the network. Click to allow it."
                                   : "Internet on. Click to block it (plugins, tabs and the cloud).";
  }

  Hub.on("internetBlocked", (data) => {
    internetBlocked = Boolean(data.blocked);
    renderNetToggle();
    if (internetBlocked) Hub.toast("Internet blocked");
  });

  Hub.netBlocked = () => internetBlocked;

  Hub.on("ready", () => {
    renderNetToggle();
    $("net-toggle").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("setInternetBlocked", { blocked: !internetBlocked }));
    $("tab-studio").addEventListener("click", () => activate("studio"));
    $("tab-new").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.run("newTab"));
    $("tab-strip").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const button = event.target.closest(".hub-tab.web");
      if (!button) return;
      const id = Number(button.dataset.tab);
      if (event.target.closest(".tab-close")) close(id);
      else activate(id);
    });
    $("tab-strip").addEventListener("auxclick", (event) => {
      const button = event.target.closest(".hub-tab.web");
      if (button && event.button === 1) close(Number(button.dataset.tab));
    });

    $("web-back").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("webTabCommand", { id: active, command: "back" }));
    $("web-forward").addEventListener("click", () => Hub.send("webTabCommand", { id: active, command: "forward" }));
    $("web-reload").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const tab = tabOf(active);
      if (tab) Hub.send("webTabCommand", { id: active, command: tab.loading ? "stop" : "reload" });
    });
    $("web-address").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); navigate(event.target.value); }
      if (event.key === "Escape") { const tab = tabOf(active); event.target.value = tab ? tab.url : ""; event.target.blur(); }
    });
    $("web-address").addEventListener("focus", (event) => event.target.select());

    const quick = $("web-quick");
    for (const [name, url] of QUICK) {
      const link = element("button", "web-quick-link", name);
      link.type = "button";
      link.title = url;
      link.addEventListener("click", () => navigate(url));
      quick.appendChild(link);
    }

    // The view follows the content area as the window changes.
    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(() => { if (active !== "studio") placeView(); }).observe($("web-content"));
    window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (active !== "studio") placeView(); });

    // A dialog opened while browsing needs the page in front: the view steps aside meanwhile.
    const watch = new MutationObserver(() => { if (active !== "studio") placeView(); });
    for (const box of [...document.querySelectorAll(".modal"), $("start-page"), $("scan-page")]) if (box) watch.observe(box, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["hidden"] });

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      const ctrl = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
      const web = active !== "studio";
      let handled = true;

      if (ctrl && !event.altKey && event.code === "KeyT") Hub.run("newTab");
      else if (ctrl && !event.altKey && event.code === "KeyW" && web) close(active);
      else if (ctrl && event.code === "Tab") cycle(event.shiftKey ? -1 : 1);
      else if (ctrl && !event.shiftKey && !event.altKey && /^Digit[1-9]$/.test(event.code)) {
        const n = Number(event.code.slice(5));
        if (n === 1) activate("studio");
        else if (tabs[n - 2]) activate(tabs[n - 2].id);
        else handled = false;
      }
      else if (ctrl && !event.altKey && event.code === "KeyL" && web) { $("web-address").focus(); $("web-address").select(); }
      else if (web && event.altKey && event.code === "ArrowLeft") Hub.send("webTabCommand", { id: active, command: "back" });
      else if (web && event.altKey && event.code === "ArrowRight") Hub.send("webTabCommand", { id: active, command: "forward" });
      else if (web && (event.code === "F5" || (ctrl && event.code === "KeyR"))) Hub.send("webTabCommand", { id: active, command: "reload" });
      else handled = false;

      if (handled) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      }
    }, true);
  });
})();
