        const auto home = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userHomeDirectory);
        startFolder = home.getChildFile ("Downloads").isDirectory() ? home.getChildFile ("Downloads") : home;
    }

    choosingFile = true;
    fileChooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Add plugins to the Browser: VST3, or WCLAP (.wasm, .wclap.tar.gz)", startFolder, "*.wasm;*.gz;*.tgz;*.vst3");

    const auto chooserFlags = juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode
                            | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles
                            | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectMultipleItems;

    fileChooser->launchAsync (chooserFlags, [safeThis = juce::Component::SafePointer<MainComponent> (this)] (const juce::FileChooser& chooser)
    {
        if (safeThis == nullptr)
            return;

        safeThis->choosingFile = false;
        const auto files = chooser.getResults();

        if (files.isEmpty())
            return;

        safeThis->lastPluginFolder = files.getFirst().getParentDirectory();

        // Listed, then read by the scan (with its page showing), never inside the Hub.
        for (const auto& file : files)
            safeThis->library.addFile (file);

        safeThis->startLibraryScan (false);
    });
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::handleTransport (const juce::var& event)
{
    // A mixdown owns the song while it renders.
    if (engine.isMixdownRunning())
        return;

    auto& transport = engine.getTransport();
    const auto previous = transport.getState();
    const auto action = event.getProperty ("action", {}).toString();

    if (action == "record")
    {
        // Record toggles: on starts playback too; off punches out and playback goes on.
        if (engine.isRecording())
        {
            engine.stopRecording();
        }
        else
        {
            engine.startRecording();

            // The undo step's "before", taken now: an audio take has already begun.
            std::vector<int> armed;

            for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
                if (track->recordArm.load())
                    armed.push_back (track->id);

            takeBefore = Edits::snapshot (engine, armed);
            takeRunning = true;
        }

        pushTracks();   // the selected track may have just been armed
    }

    if (action == "toggle")      transport.togglePlaying();
    else if (action == "play")   transport.setPlaying (true);
    else if (action == "stop")   transport.setPlaying (false);
    else if (action == "start")  transport.locate (0.0);
    else if (action == "locate") transport.locate (static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("ppq", 0.0)));

    for (const auto* setting : { "bpm", "numerator", "denominator", "loop", "loopStart", "loopEnd", "metronome", "metronomeVolume" })
        if (event.hasProperty (setting))
            markChanged();

    if (event.hasProperty ("bpm"))
        transport.setTempo (static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("bpm", 120.0)));

    const auto state = transport.getState();

    if (event.hasProperty ("numerator") || event.hasProperty ("denominator"))
        transport.setTimeSignature (static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("numerator", state.numerator)),
                                    static_cast<int> (event.getProperty ("denominator", state.denominator)));

    // Loop start and end are song positions in quarter notes, as the ruler draws them.
    if (event.hasProperty ("loop") || event.hasProperty ("loopStart") || event.hasProperty ("loopEnd"))
        transport.setLoop (static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("loop", state.loopEnabled)),
                           static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("loopStart", state.loopStart)),
                           static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("loopEnd", state.loopEnd)));

    if (event.hasProperty ("metronome") || event.hasProperty ("metronomeVolume"))
        transport.setMetronome (static_cast<bool> (event.getProperty ("metronome", state.metronomeEnabled)),
                                static_cast<float> (static_cast<double> (event.getProperty ("metronomeVolume", state.metronomeVolume))));

    // Tempo and time signature are edits; the loop and the metronome are not.
    const auto now = transport.getState();
    const bool signatureChanged = now.numerator != previous.numerator || now.denominator != previous.denominator;

    if (signatureChanged || ! juce::exactlyEqual (now.bpm, previous.bpm))
        addToHistory (signatureChanged ? "Change Time Signature" : "Change Tempo",
                      new Edits::TempoChanged (engine, { previous.bpm, previous.numerator, previous.denominator },
                                               { now.bpm, now.numerator, now.denominator }));
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::showAudioSettings()
{
    if (settingsWindow == nullptr)
        settingsWindow = std::make_unique<AudioSettingsWindow> (engine.getDeviceManager());

    if (! settingsWindow->isVisible())
        settingsWindow->centreAroundComponent (this, settingsWindow->getWidth(), settingsWindow->getHeight());

    settingsWindow->setVisible (true);
    settingsWindow->toFront (true);
}

//==============================================================================
void MainComponent::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (backgroundColour);

    if (webViewError.isNotEmpty())
    {
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xffd9dadc));
        g.setFont (juce::FontOptions (16.0f));
        g.drawFittedText (webViewError, getLocalBounds().reduced (40), juce::Justification::centred, 4);
    }
}

void MainComponent::resized()
{
    if (webView != nullptr)
        webView->setBounds (getLocalBounds());
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\MainComponent.h

#pragma once

//==============================================================================
/**
    Hosts the web UI (WebView2 on Windows) and bridges it to the native AudioEngine.

    Web -> native events
        uiReady, noteOn {note, velocity}, noteOff {note}, allNotesOff, openAudioSettings,
        transport {action?, ppq?, bpm?, numerator?, denominator?, loop?, loopStart?, loopEnd?,
                   metronome?, metronomeVolume?}   (positions in quarter notes),
        addTrack {file?, pluginId?}, removeTrack {id}, selectTrack {id},
        trackSettings {id, name?, volume?, pan?, mute?, solo?, monitor?, recordArm?}, masterSettings {volume?, mute?},
        loadPlugin {trackId, file, pluginId, position?, replaceInsertId?}, clearInstrument {trackId},
        removeInsert {trackId, insertId}, moveInsert {trackId, insertId, position},
        bypassInsert {trackId, insertId, bypass}, setParam {trackId, insertId, index, value},
        newSong {name, folder, bpm, numerator, denominator}, openSong {path?}, saveSong, saveSongAs,
        songView {view}, chooseSongFolder {folder},
        addLibraryFolder, removeLibraryFolder {folder}, rescanLibrary {full}, setFavorite {file, id, favorite},
        revealLibraryFile {file},
        deleteClip {trackId, clipId},
        setClipNotes {trackId, clipId, notes: [[pitch, start, length, velocity], ...], start?, length?, offset?},
        clipEdits {edits: [{op: move|copy|range|split|delete|add, trackId, clipId, toTrackId?, start?, length?,
                            at?, offset?, notes?}, ...]}   applied in order, then one tracks update,
        transport action "record" toggles recording,
        addLibraryFiles, removeLibraryFile {file}

    trackId 0 is the Main channel. insertId 0 is a track's instrument.

    Native -> web events
        status   20 times a second once the page reports uiReady

        library  whenever the Browser's plugin list changes: plugins (with type, features,

        song     the song's name, file and unsaved changes, recent songs; with "opened" and its

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Plugin.cpp

#include "Plugin.h"

#include "Vst3Plugin.h"
#include "WclapPlugin.h"

bool Plugin::isVst3 (const juce::File& file)
{
    return file.getFileName().endsWithIgnoreCase (".vst3");
}

std::unique_ptr<Plugin> Plugin::load (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error)
{
    if (isVst3 (file))
        return Vst3Plugin::load (file, pluginId, error);

    return WclapPlugin::load (file, pluginId, error);
}

std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor> Plugin::describe (const juce::File& file, juce::String& error)
{
    if (isVst3 (file))
        return Vst3Plugin::describe (file, error);

    // A WCLAP lists its plugins as it loads.
    const auto plugin = WclapPlugin::load (file, {}, error);
    return plugin != nullptr ? plugin->getPluginsInFile() : std::vector<Descriptor> {};
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Plugin.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>
#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <clap/clap.h>

#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    A hosted plugin, whatever its format: a WCLAP (a CLAP plugin compiled to WebAssembly)
    or a native VST3. Tracks, insert chains, songs, undo and the page all work with this;
    only loading needs to know the format, and Plugin::load picks it from the file.

    Threads: loading, activating, state and parameters on the message thread; process()
    on the audio thread, while the engine holds its graph lock.
*/
class Plugin
{
public:
    struct Descriptor
    {
        juce::String id, name, vendor, version;
        juce::StringArray features;   // CLAP feature words; VST3 categories are translated to them
    };

    struct Parameter
    {
        uint32_t id = 0;              // stable across sessions: songs keep values by it
        void* cookie = nullptr;       // WCLAP: the plugin's own handle for it
        juce::String name;
        double minValue = 0.0, maxValue = 1.0, defaultValue = 0.0;
        bool stepped = false, hidden = false, readOnly = false;
    };

    enum class Role
    {
        instrument,   // makes sound from notes, replaces the test synth
        effect,       // processes the sound before it
        noAudio       // no audio output: gets notes, the test synth stays audible
    };

    /** What a plugin asked of the host since last time (WCLAP plugins ask; others don't). */
    struct Requests
    {
        bool callback = false, rescan = false, restart = false, flush = false, processError = false;
    };

    virtual ~Plugin() = default;

    //==============================================================================
    /** Loads the plugin with this id from a file: a .vst3, or a WCLAP (.wasm, a .wclap
        bundle folder or a .wclap.tar.gz). An empty id means the file's first plugin. */
    static std::unique_ptr<Plugin> load (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error);

    /** Every plugin in a file, for the Browser's library. */
    static std::vector<Descriptor> describe (const juce::File& file, juce::String& error);

    static bool isVst3 (const juce::File& file);

    //==============================================================================
    virtual juce::String getFormatName() const = 0;                 // "WCLAP" or "VST3"
    virtual const Descriptor& getDescriptor() const noexcept = 0;
    virtual const std::vector<Descriptor>& getPluginsInFile() const noexcept = 0;
    virtual const juce::File& getSourceFile() const noexcept = 0;
    virtual Role getRole() const noexcept = 0;
    virtual int getMainInputChannels() const noexcept = 0;
    virtual int getMainOutputChannels() const noexcept = 0;

    // State, for songs.
    virtual bool canSaveState() const noexcept = 0;
    virtual bool saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination) = 0;
    virtual bool loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source) = 0;
    virtual bool consumeStateChanged() noexcept = 0;               // any thread

    // Parameters.
    virtual const std::vector<Parameter>& getParameters() const noexcept = 0;
    virtual int findParameter (uint32_t id) const noexcept = 0;
    virtual double getParameterValue (int index) const noexcept = 0;
    virtual double readParameterValue (int index) = 0;
    virtual juce::String getParameterText (int index, double value) = 0;
    virtual double queueParameter (int index, double value) = 0;

    /** Automation, on the audio thread, just before process(): sets the parameter with this
        stable id. indexHint is where it was last time; it's corrected if the plugin changed. */
    virtual void setParameterFromAudio (uint32_t paramId, int& indexHint, double value) noexcept
    {
        juce::ignoreUnused (paramId, indexHint, value);
    }

    // Audio.
    virtual bool activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize) = 0;
    virtual void deactivate() = 0;
    virtual bool isActive() const noexcept = 0;
    virtual void stopProcessing() {}

    /** One block. Inputs may be null (instruments) and outputs may be null (note effects);
        an input may be the same buffer as its output (effects work in place). */
    virtual void process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                          int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t* transport) noexcept = 0;

    //==============================================================================
    // The plugin's own screen, on the message thread.
    //   web     a page the Hub shows in a window of its own page, fed with the plugin's
    //           files and messages (CLAP's webview extension; WCLAP plugins)
    //   native  a window of its own (VST3 editors), owned by the plugin
    //   none    no screen: the Hub shows its generic controls instead
    enum class ScreenKind { none, web, native };

    virtual ScreenKind getScreenKind() const noexcept                    { return ScreenKind::none; }

    /** Web: where the screen starts (a path the plugin serves itself, or a full URL). */
    virtual juce::String getScreenUri()                                   { return {}; }

    /** Web: one of the screen's files, by absolute path ("/index.html"). */
    virtual bool getScreenResource (const juce::String&, juce::String&, juce::MemoryBlock&) { return false; }

    /** Web: whether the page has the screen open (messages flow only while it does). */
    virtual void setScreenOpen (bool)                                     {}

    /** Web: a message from the screen to the plugin. */
    virtual bool sendToPlugin (const void*, size_t)                       { return false; }

    /** Web: the plugin's messages for its screen since the last call. */
    virtual std::vector<juce::MemoryBlock> takeScreenMessages()           { return {}; }

    /** The screen's preferred size, when the plugin has one. */
    virtual bool getScreenSize (int&, int&)                               { return false; }

    /** Native: shows the plugin's own window (made the first time), or hides it. */
    virtual bool showNativeScreen (const juce::String&)                   { return false; }
    virtual void hideNativeScreen()                                       {}

    // Upkeep on the message thread: only WCLAP plugins need it.
    virtual Requests takeRequests() noexcept                           { return {}; }
    virtual void runOnMainThread()                                     {}
    virtual void rescanParameters()                                    {}
    virtual void flushQueuedParameters()                               {}
    virtual bool getError (juce::String&) const                        { return false; }

    //==============================================================================
    // Sidechain: a second audio input some plugins have (compressors, duckers), which other
    // tracks can send to. The engine clears and fills it on the audio thread before
    // process(); it stays silent while nothing sends to it.
    virtual bool hasSidechain() const noexcept                     { return false; }

    float* getSidechainChannel (int channel) noexcept
    {
        return channel >= 0 && channel < sidechain.getNumChannels() ? sidechain.getWritePointer (channel) : nullptr;
    }

    int getSidechainCapacity() const noexcept                       { return sidechain.getNumSamples(); }

    void clearSidechain (int numSamples) noexcept
    {
        const auto samples = juce::jmin (numSamples, sidechain.getNumSamples());

        for (int channel = 0; channel < sidechain.getNumChannels(); ++channel)
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (sidechain.getWritePointer (channel), samples);
    }

    //==============================================================================
    // MIDI out: a plugin that plays notes itself (an arpeggiator, a MIDI-out instrument) can
    // drive other tracks' instruments. Its notes from the last block, on the audio thread.
    virtual bool producesMidi() const noexcept                      { return false; }
    const juce::MidiBuffer& getMidiOutput() const noexcept          { return midiOutput; }

protected:
    juce::MidiBuffer midiOutput;   // sized as the plugin activates

    /** Sized as the plugin activates (not on the audio thread), when it has a sidechain. */
    void prepareSidechain (int maxBlockSize)
    {
        sidechain.setSize (2, juce::jmax (1, maxBlockSize), false, true, false);
        sidechain.clear();
    }

    juce::AudioBuffer<float> sidechain;
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PluginScanner.cpp

#include "PluginScanner.h"
#include "Vst3Plugin.h"

PluginScanner::PluginScanner (std::vector<juce::File> filesToRead, int timeout, juce::File workerProgram)
    : juce::Thread ("Fanan plugin scanner"),
      files (std::move (filesToRead)), timeoutSeconds (juce::jmax (1, timeout)), worker (std::move (workerProgram))
{
}

PluginScanner::~PluginScanner()
{
    // A copy still reading is stopped on the way out (run() kills it when asked to stop).
    signalThreadShouldExit();
    stopThread (10000);
}

void PluginScanner::start()
{
    startThread();
}

void PluginScanner::cancel()
{
    cancelled = true;
    signalThreadShouldExit();
}

juce::String PluginScanner::getCurrent() const
{
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (lock);
    return current;
}

std::vector<PluginScanner::Outcome> PluginScanner::takeOutcomes()
{
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (lock);
    std::vector<Outcome> taken;
    taken.swap (outcomes);
    return taken;
}

void PluginScanner::run()
{
    for (const auto& file : files)
    {
        if (threadShouldExit())
            break;

        {
            const juce::ScopedLock sl (lock);
            current = file.getFileName();
        }

        auto outcome = read (file);

        if (threadShouldExit() && outcome.error.isNotEmpty())
            break;   // stopped while reading it: it isn't judged, it's read next time

        {
            const juce::ScopedLock sl (lock);
            outcomes.push_back (std::move (outcome));
        }

        ++done;
    }

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock sl (lock);
        current.clear();
    }

    finished = true;
}

PluginScanner::Outcome PluginScanner::read (const juce::File& file)
{
    Outcome outcome;
    outcome.file = file;

    const auto result = juce::File::createTempFile (".json");
    juce::ChildProcess child;

    if (! child.start (juce::StringArray { worker.getFullPathName(), workerFlag, file.getFullPathName(), result.getFullPathName() }, 0))
    {
        outcome.error = "The scanner couldn't start.";
        return outcome;
    }

    // Waits for the copy, a little at a time, so a cancel or a hung plugin doesn't hold the Hub up.
    const auto deadline = juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() + static_cast<juce::uint32> (timeoutSeconds) * 1000u;

    while (child.isRunning())
    {
        if (threadShouldExit())
        {
            child.kill();
            result.deleteFile();
            outcome.error = "Cancelled.";
            return outcome;
        }

        if (juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() > deadline)
        {
            child.kill();
            result.deleteFile();
            outcome.error = "It didn't answer within " + juce::String (timeoutSeconds) + (timeoutSeconds == 1 ? " second" : " seconds")
                          + ", so it was stopped.";
            return outcome;
        }

        wait (20);
    }

    // The answer counts even if the copy crashed on its way out afterwards (some plugins do).
    const auto answer = juce::JSON::parse (result);
    result.deleteFile();

    if (! answer.isObject())
    {
        outcome.error = "It crashed while being read.";
        return outcome;
    }

    if (const auto* list = answer.getProperty ("plugins", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& item : *list)
            outcome.plugins.push_back (fromVar (item));

    if (outcome.plugins.empty())
        outcome.error = answer.getProperty ("error", "It holds no plugins.").toString();

    return outcome;
}

//==============================================================================
bool PluginScanner::isWorkerCommandLine (const juce::String& commandLine)
{
    return commandLine.contains (workerFlag);
}

int PluginScanner::runWorker (const juce::StringArray& arguments)
{
    const auto at = arguments.indexOf (workerFlag);

    if (at < 0 || at + 2 >= arguments.size())
        return 2;

    const juce::File plugin (arguments[at + 1].unquoted());
    const juce::File output (arguments[at + 2].unquoted());

    // This copy exists only to read this one plugin: if the plugin crashes, only this copy goes.
    juce::String error;
    const auto found = Plugin::describe (plugin, error);

    juce::Array<juce::var> list;

    for (const auto& descriptor : found)
        list.add (toVar (descriptor));

    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr answer (new juce::DynamicObject());
    answer->setProperty ("plugins", list);
    answer->setProperty ("error", error);
    const auto written = output.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (answer.get())));

    // The VST3 host is let go properly, as the Hub does on its way out.
    Vst3Plugin::shutdownFormats();
    return written ? 0 : 3;
}

juce::var PluginScanner::toVar (const Plugin::Descriptor& descriptor)
{
    juce::DynamicObject::Ptr item (new juce::DynamicObject());
    item->setProperty ("id", descriptor.id);
    item->setProperty ("name", descriptor.name);
    item->setProperty ("vendor", descriptor.vendor);
    item->setProperty ("version", descriptor.version);

    juce::Array<juce::var> features;

    for (const auto& feature : descriptor.features)
        features.add (feature);

    item->setProperty ("features", features);
    return juce::var (item.get());
}

Plugin::Descriptor PluginScanner::fromVar (const juce::var& value)
{
    Plugin::Descriptor descriptor;
    descriptor.id = value.getProperty ("id", {}).toString();
    descriptor.name = value.getProperty ("name", {}).toString();
    descriptor.vendor = value.getProperty ("vendor", {}).toString();
    descriptor.version = value.getProperty ("version", {}).toString();

    if (const auto* features = value.getProperty ("features", {}).getArray())
        for (const auto& feature : *features)
            descriptor.features.add (feature.toString());

    return descriptor;
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\PluginScanner.h

#pragma once

#include "Plugin.h"

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Reads plugin files the safe way, as Colosseum does: never inside the Hub.

    Each plugin is read by a copy of the Hub started just for it
    (FananWebHub.exe --scan-plugin <plugin> <result.json>): it loads that one plugin,
    writes what it holds, and exits. A plugin that crashes or hangs takes only that copy
    down (after 30 seconds it's stopped), and is reported; the Hub itself never loads a
    plugin while scanning.

    The reading runs on a thread of its own; the Hub asks for progress and results from
    its own timer (no calls from this thread into the Hub).
*/
class PluginScanner final : private juce::Thread
{
public:
    struct Outcome
    {
        juce::File file;
        std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor> plugins;
        juce::String error;            // why it couldn't be read, when it couldn't
    };

    /** worker: the program that reads a plugin (the Hub itself, unless a test says otherwise). */
    explicit PluginScanner (std::vector<juce::File> files,
                            int timeoutSeconds = 30,
                            juce::File worker = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile));
    ~PluginScanner() override;

    void start();
    void cancel();

    bool isFinished() const noexcept        { return finished.load(); }
    bool wasCancelled() const noexcept      { return cancelled.load(); }
    int getTotal() const noexcept           { return static_cast<int> (files.size()); }
    int getDone() const noexcept            { return done.load(); }
    juce::String getCurrent() const;

    /** What has been read since the last call. */
    std::vector<Outcome> takeOutcomes();

    //==============================================================================
    /** The reading copy's side: true when the command line asks for it. */
    static bool isWorkerCommandLine (const juce::String& commandLine);

    /** Reads the plugin named on the command line and writes the result; returns the exit code. */
    static int runWorker (const juce::StringArray& arguments);

    static juce::var toVar (const Plugin::Descriptor& descriptor);
    static Plugin::Descriptor fromVar (const juce::var& value);

    static constexpr const char* workerFlag = "--scan-plugin";

private:

    juce::String current;

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Sequence.cpp

#include "Sequence.h"

#include <algorithm>

namespace
{
    constexpr juce::uint8 noteOn = 0x90, noteOff = 0x80;
}

//==============================================================================
std::unique_ptr<const Sequence> Sequence::build (const std::vector<MidiClip>& clips)
{
    auto sequence = std::make_unique<Sequence>();
    auto& events = sequence->events;

    for (const auto& clip : clips)
    {
        if (clip.isAudio())
            continue;

        for (const auto& note : clip.notes)
        {
            // Only notes the clip shows play; a note running over the clip's end is cut there.
            if (! clip.shows (note) || note.pitch < 0 || note.pitch > 127)
                continue;

            const auto on = clip.songPosition (note.start);
            const auto off = juce::jmin (on + juce::jmax (note.length, minimumNoteLength), clip.start + clip.length);
            const auto pitch = static_cast<juce::uint8> (note.pitch);
            const auto velocity = static_cast<juce::uint8> (juce::jlimit (1, 127, juce::roundToInt (note.velocity * 127.0f)));

            events.push_back ({ on, noteOn, pitch, velocity });
            events.push_back ({ off, noteOff, pitch, 0 });
        }
    }

    // By time; at the same time a note-off comes first, so a repeated note plays again.
    std::stable_sort (events.begin(), events.end(), [] (const Event& a, const Event& b)
    {
        if (a.ppq < b.ppq) return true;
        if (b.ppq < a.ppq) return false;
        return a.status == noteOff && b.status != noteOff;
    });

    return sequence;
}

//==============================================================================
void Sequencer::releaseAll (juce::MidiBuffer& out, int sampleOffset) noexcept
{
    for (int pitch = 0; pitch < 128; ++pitch)
    {
        if (! sounding.test (static_cast<size_t> (pitch)))
            continue;

        const juce::uint8 message[] = { noteOff, static_cast<juce::uint8> (pitch), 0 };
        out.addEvent (message, 3, sampleOffset);
    }

    sounding.reset();
}

void Sequencer::render (const Sequence* sequence, const Transport& transport, juce::MidiBuffer& out) noexcept
{
    if (releaseRequested.exchange (false))
        releaseAll (out, 0);

    const auto segments = transport.getNumSegments();

    if (segments == 0)
    {
        if (wasPlaying)
            releaseAll (out, 0);          // stopped

        wasPlaying = false;
        return;
    }

    const auto perSample = transport.getPpqPerSample();

    for (int i = 0; i < segments; ++i)
    {
        const auto& segment = transport.getSegment (i);

        // A jump (the loop going round, a locate while playing) releases what was playing.
        if (wasPlaying && std::abs (segment.from - expected) > 1.0e-6)
            releaseAll (out, segment.offset);

        wasPlaying = true;
        expected = segment.to;

        if (sequence == nullptr || perSample <= 0.0)
            continue;

        const auto& events = sequence->getEvents();
        auto event = std::lower_bound (events.begin(), events.end(), segment.from,
                                       [] (const Sequence::Event& e, double ppq) { return e.ppq < ppq; });

        for (; event != events.end() && event->ppq < segment.to; ++event)
        {
            const auto pitch = static_cast<size_t> (event->data1 & 0x7f);

            if (event->status == noteOff)
            {
                if (! sounding.test (pitch))
                    continue;             // started before playback began here: nothing to end

                sounding.reset (pitch);
            }
            else
            {
                sounding.set (pitch);
            }

            const auto within = static_cast<int> ((event->ppq - segment.from) / perSample);
            const juce::uint8 message[] = { event->status, event->data1, event->data2 };
            out.addEvent (message, 3, segment.offset + juce::jlimit (0, segment.length - 1, within));
        }
    }
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Sequence.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>

#include "Transport.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <bitset>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/** One note in a clip. Times are quarter notes on the clip's own content timeline. */
struct MidiNote
{
    int pitch = 60;
    double start = 0.0;
    double length = 0.25;
    float velocity = 0.8f;             // 0..1
};

/**
    A MIDI clip on a track (Studio One calls it a part): a window onto its notes.

    The clip shows its content from offset to offset + length, placed at start in the
    song. Trimming a clip moves that window without touching the notes, so notes
    outside it are hidden, not lost, and come back when the clip is dragged longer.
    A note plays when its start is inside the window; it's cut at the clip's end.
*/
struct MidiClip
{
    int id = 0;
    double start = 0.0;                // song position of the clip's left edge, quarter notes
    double length = 4.0;
    double offset = 0.0;               // content position shown at the left edge
    std::vector<MidiNote> notes;       // content positions, sorted by start

    // An audio clip plays a window of a file instead of notes. Audio keeps its speed
    // whatever the tempo, so its window is in seconds; length above is the same window in
    // quarter notes at the current tempo, kept up to date by the engine.
    juce::String audioFile;            // set: an audio clip
    double audioOffset = 0.0;          // seconds into the file where the window starts
    double audioLength = 0.0;          // seconds of the file the window shows
    double audioGainDb = 0.0;          // the clip's own volume, as on Studio One's events
    double fadeIn = 0.0, fadeOut = 0.0;   // seconds

    bool isAudio() const noexcept                                  { return audioFile.isNotEmpty(); }

    double songPosition (double contentPosition) const noexcept   { return start + contentPosition - offset; }
    double contentPosition (double songPosition) const noexcept   { return songPosition - start + offset; }
    bool shows (const MidiNote& note) const noexcept              { return note.start >= offset && note.start < offset + length; }
};

//==============================================================================
/**
    Everything a track's clips play, flattened into one list of note events sorted by
    song position. Built on the message thread whenever the clips change and handed
    to the audio thread whole; the audio thread only ever reads it.
*/
class Sequence final
{
public:
    struct Event
    {
        double ppq = 0.0;
        juce::uint8 status = 0, data1 = 0, data2 = 0;
    };

    static std::unique_ptr<const Sequence> build (const std::vector<MidiClip>& clips);

    const std::vector<Event>& getEvents() const noexcept     { return events; }

    static constexpr double minimumNoteLength = 1.0 / 128.0;   // quarter notes

private:
    std::vector<Event> events;
};

//==============================================================================
/**
    Plays a Sequence into a block's MIDI, following the transport's plan for the
    block. It remembers the notes it has started, so stopping, locating or looping
    back never leaves one hanging. Audio thread only, apart from requestRelease().
*/
class Sequencer final
{
public:
    void render (const Sequence* sequence, const Transport& transport, juce::MidiBuffer& out) noexcept;

    /** Releases every note it started, at the start of the next block (any thread). */
    void requestRelease() noexcept        { releaseRequested.store (true); }

private:
    void releaseAll (juce::MidiBuffer& out, int sampleOffset) noexcept;

    std::bitset<128> sounding;
    std::atomic<bool> releaseRequested { false };
    bool wasPlaying = false;
    double expected = 0.0;             // where the next block should start if nothing jumps
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Song.cpp

#include "Song.h"

namespace
{
    //==============================================================================
    juce::var object()
    {
        return juce::var (new juce::DynamicObject());
    }

    double number (const juce::var& value, double fallback)
    {
        if (! (value.isDouble() || value.isInt() || value.isInt64()))
            return fallback;

        const auto result = static_cast<double> (value);
        return std::isfinite (result) ? result : fallback;
    }

    //==============================================================================
    // Plugins: the file, the id, the plugin's own state, and its parameter values.
    juce::var pluginToVar (Plugin& plugin)
    {
        auto item = object();
        auto* fields = item.getDynamicObject();
        fields->setProperty ("file", plugin.getSourceFile().getFullPathName());
        fields->setProperty ("pluginId", plugin.getDescriptor().id);
        fields->setProperty ("name", plugin.getDescriptor().name);

        juce::MemoryBlock state;

        if (plugin.saveState (state))
            fields->setProperty ("state", juce::Base64::toBase64 (state.getData(), state.getSize()));

        juce::Array<juce::var> values;
        const auto& parameters = plugin.getParameters();

        for (size_t i = 0; i < parameters.size(); ++i)
            values.add (juce::Array<juce::var> { static_cast<juce::int64> (parameters[i].id),
                                                 plugin.readParameterValue (static_cast<int> (i)) });

        fields->setProperty ("params", values);
        return item;
    }

    /** Loads a saved plugin onto a channel; returns its insert id (0 for an instrument), or -1. */
    int restorePlugin (AudioEngine& engine, int channel, const juce::var& item, juce::StringArray& problems)
    {
        const auto name = item.getProperty ("name", "A plugin").toString();
        const juce::File file (item.getProperty ("file", {}).toString());

        if (! juce::File::isAbsolutePath (file.getFullPathName()) || ! file.exists())
        {
            problems.add (name + " is missing: " + file.getFullPathName());
            return -1;
        }

        int insertId = 0;
        const auto result = engine.loadPlugin (channel, file, item.getProperty ("pluginId", {}).toString(),
                                               -1, AudioEngine::instrumentSlot, insertId);

        if (result.failed())
        {
            problems.add (result.getErrorMessage());
            return -1;
        }

        auto* plugin = engine.getPlugin (channel, insertId);

        if (plugin == nullptr)
            return insertId;

        // The plugin's own state first; its parameter values when it has none (or it won't load).
        bool restored = false;
        const auto stateText = item.getProperty ("state", {}).toString();

        if (stateText.isNotEmpty() && plugin->canSaveState())
        {
            juce::MemoryOutputStream decoded;

            if (juce::Base64::convertFromBase64 (decoded, stateText))
                restored = plugin->loadState (decoded.getMemoryBlock());
        }

        if (! restored)
        {
            if (const auto* values = item.getProperty ("params", {}).getArray())
            {
                for (const auto& pair : *values)
                {
                    const auto* entry = pair.getArray();

                    if (entry == nullptr || entry->size() < 2)
                        continue;

                    const auto index = plugin->findParameter (static_cast<clap_id> (static_cast<juce::int64> ((*entry)[0])));

                    if (index >= 0)
                        engine.setPluginParameter (channel, insertId, index, number ((*entry)[1], 0.0));
                }
            }
        }

        return insertId;
    }

    juce::var insertsToVar (const EffectChain& chain)
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> list;

        for (int i = 0; i < chain.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (auto* insert = chain.at (i); insert != nullptr && insert->plugin != nullptr)
            {
                auto item = pluginToVar (*insert->plugin);
                item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("bypass", insert->bypassed.load());
                list.add (item);
            }
        }

        return list;
    }

    void restoreInserts (AudioEngine& engine, int channel, const juce::var& list, juce::StringArray& problems)
    {
        if (const auto* inserts = list.getArray())
        {
            for (const auto& item : *inserts)
            {
                const auto insertId = restorePlugin (engine, channel, item, problems);

                if (insertId > 0 && static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("bypass", false)))
                    engine.setInsertBypass (channel, insertId, true);
            }
        }
    }

    //==============================================================================
    /** Relative to the song's folder when it's inside it, so a song folder can move whole. */
    juce::String mediaPath (const juce::String& path, const juce::File& songFile)
    {
        const juce::File file (path);
        const auto folder = songFile.getParentDirectory();

        if (songFile != juce::File() && file.isAChildOf (folder))
            return file.getRelativePathFrom (folder).replaceCharacter ('\\', '/');

        return path;
    }

    juce::File mediaFile (const juce::String& path, const juce::File& songFile)
    {
        if (juce::File::isAbsolutePath (path) || songFile == juce::File())
            return juce::File (path);

        return songFile.getParentDirectory().getChildFile (path);
    }

    juce::var clipToVar (const MidiClip& clip, const juce::File& songFile)
    {
        juce::Array<juce::var> notes;

        for (const auto& note : clip.notes)
            notes.add (juce::Array<juce::var> { note.pitch, note.start, note.length,
                                                juce::jlimit (1, 127, juce::roundToInt (note.velocity * 127.0f)) });

        auto item = object();
        auto* fields = item.getDynamicObject();
        fields->setProperty ("start", clip.start);
        fields->setProperty ("length", clip.length);
        fields->setProperty ("offset", clip.offset);
        fields->setProperty ("notes", notes);

        if (clip.isAudio())
        {
            fields->setProperty ("audioFile", mediaPath (clip.audioFile, songFile));
            fields->setProperty ("audioOffset", clip.audioOffset);
            fields->setProperty ("audioLength", clip.audioLength);
            fields->setProperty ("gain", clip.audioGainDb);
            fields->setProperty ("fadeIn", clip.fadeIn);
            fields->setProperty ("fadeOut", clip.fadeOut);
        }

        return item;
    }

    MidiClip clipFromVar (const juce::var& item, const juce::File& songFile)
    {
        MidiClip clip;
        const auto audioFile = item.getProperty ("audioFile", {}).toString();

        if (audioFile.isNotEmpty())
        {
            clip.audioFile = mediaFile (audioFile, songFile).getFullPathName();
            clip.audioOffset = number (item.getProperty ("audioOffset", {}), 0.0);
            clip.audioLength = number (item.getProperty ("audioLength", {}), 0.0);
            clip.audioGainDb = juce::jlimit (-60.0, 12.0, number (item.getProperty ("gain", {}), 0.0));
            clip.fadeIn = juce::jmax (0.0, number (item.getProperty ("fadeIn", {}), 0.0));
            clip.fadeOut = juce::jmax (0.0, number (item.getProperty ("fadeOut", {}), 0.0));
        }

        clip.start = juce::jmax (0.0, number (item.getProperty ("start", {}), 0.0));
        clip.length = number (item.getProperty ("length", {}), 4.0);
        clip.offset = number (item.getProperty ("offset", {}), 0.0);

        if (const auto* notes = item.getProperty ("notes", {}).getArray())
        {
            for (const auto& value : *notes)
            {
                if (const auto* fields = value.getArray(); fields != nullptr && fields->size() >= 4)
                    clip.notes.push_back ({ static_cast<int> (number ((*fields)[0], -1.0)),
                                            number ((*fields)[1], 0.0),
                                            number ((*fields)[2], 0.25),
                                            static_cast<float> (number ((*fields)[3], 100.0) / 127.0) });
            }
        }

        return clip;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::File Song::getDefaultFolder()
{
    return juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userDocumentsDirectory)
               .getChildFile ("Fanan Web Hub").getChildFile ("Songs");
}

juce::var Song::capture (AudioEngine& engine, const juce::String& name, const juce::var& view, const juce::File& songFile)
{
    auto song = object();
    auto* fields = song.getDynamicObject();
    fields->setProperty ("format", formatName);
    fields->setProperty ("version", formatVersion);
    fields->setProperty ("name", name);

    const auto state = engine.getTransport().getState();
    auto transport = object();
    auto* transportFields = transport.getDynamicObject();
    transportFields->setProperty ("bpm", state.bpm);
    transportFields->setProperty ("numerator", state.numerator);
    transportFields->setProperty ("denominator", state.denominator);
    transportFields->setProperty ("loop", state.loopEnabled);
    transportFields->setProperty ("loopStart", state.loopStart);
    transportFields->setProperty ("loopEnd", state.loopEnd);
    transportFields->setProperty ("metronome", state.metronomeEnabled);
    transportFields->setProperty ("metronomeVolume", static_cast<double> (state.metronomeVolume));
    transportFields->setProperty ("position", state.ppq);
    fields->setProperty ("transport", transport);

    juce::Array<juce::var> inputs;

    for (const auto& input : engine.getInputs())
    {
        auto item = object();
        item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("name", input.name);
        item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("left", input.left);
        item.getDynamicObject()->setProperty ("right", input.right);
        inputs.add (item);
    }

    fields->setProperty ("inputs", inputs);
    fields->setProperty ("recordBits", engine.getRecordBits());

    auto main = object();
    auto* mainFields = main.getDynamicObject();
    mainFields->setProperty ("volume", static_cast<double> (engine.getMasterVolume()));
    mainFields->setProperty ("mute", engine.isMasterMuted());
    mainFields->setProperty ("inserts", insertsToVar (engine.getMainInserts()));
    fields->setProperty ("main", main);

    juce::Array<juce::var> tracks;
    int selectedIndex = 0;

    for (const auto& track : engine.getTracks())
    {
        if (track->id == engine.getSelectedTrackId())
            selectedIndex = tracks.size();

        auto item = object();
        auto* trackFields = item.getDynamicObject();
        trackFields->setProperty ("kind", track->kind == Track::Kind::audio ? "audio" : track->kind == Track::Kind::fx ? "fx" : "instrument");
        trackFields->setProperty ("autoMode", track->automationMode.load() == static_cast<int> (AutomationMode::off) ? "off" : "read");

        // Envelopes; a plugin parameter's insert is named by its place in the chain, since
        // insert ids are made afresh when a song opens.
        juce::Array<juce::var> lanes;

        for (const auto& lane : track->automation)
        {
            auto laneItem = object();
            auto* laneFields = laneItem.getDynamicObject();
            const auto& target = lane.target;
            laneFields->setProperty ("target", target.kind == AutomationTarget::Kind::volume ? "volume"
                                               : target.kind == AutomationTarget::Kind::pan ? "pan" : "param");

            if (target.kind == AutomationTarget::Kind::parameter)
            {
                laneFields->setProperty ("insert", target.slot == AudioEngine::instrumentSlot ? -1 : track->inserts.indexOf (target.slot));
                laneFields->setProperty ("param", static_cast<juce::int64> (target.paramId));
            }

            juce::Array<juce::var> points;

            for (const auto& point : lane.points)
                points.add (juce::Array<juce::var> { point.ppq, point.value });

            laneFields->setProperty ("points", points);
            lanes.add (laneItem);
        }

        trackFields->setProperty ("automation", lanes);
        trackFields->setProperty ("input", track->input);
        trackFields->setProperty ("name", track->name);
        trackFields->setProperty ("nameIsAutomatic", track->nameIsAutomatic);
        trackFields->setProperty ("colour", juce::String::toHexString (static_cast<juce::int64> (track->colour)).paddedLeft ('0', 8));   // AARRGGBB
        trackFields->setProperty ("volume", static_cast<double> (track->volumeDb.load()));
        trackFields->setProperty ("pan", static_cast<double> (track->pan.load()));
        trackFields->setProperty ("mute", track->mute.load());
        trackFields->setProperty ("solo", track->solo.load());
        trackFields->setProperty ("monitor", track->monitor.load());
        trackFields->setProperty ("recordArm", track->recordArm.load());
        trackFields->setProperty ("instrument", track->instrument != nullptr ? pluginToVar (*track->instrument) : juce::var());
        trackFields->setProperty ("inserts", insertsToVar (track->inserts));

        // Sends, their destinations named by place (tracks by index, inserts by position),
        // since ids are made afresh when a song opens.
        juce::Array<juce::var> sendList;
        const auto& allTracks = engine.getTracks();

        for (const auto& send : track->sends)
        {
            auto sendItem = object();
            auto* sendFields = sendItem.getDynamicObject();
            sendFields->setProperty ("sidechain", send.sidechain);
            sendFields->setProperty ("level", send.levelDb);
            sendFields->setProperty ("on", send.on);

            int targetIndex = -1;

            for (size_t i = 0; i < allTracks.size(); ++i)
                if (allTracks[i]->id == send.target)
                    targetIndex = static_cast<int> (i);

            if (send.sidechain && send.target == AudioEngine::mainChannel)
            {
                sendFields->setProperty ("main", true);
                sendFields->setProperty ("insert", engine.getMainInserts().indexOf (send.slot));
            }
            else if (targetIndex >= 0)
            {
                sendFields->setProperty ("track", targetIndex);

                if (send.sidechain)
                    sendFields->setProperty ("insert", send.slot == AudioEngine::instrumentSlot
                                                           ? -1 : allTracks[static_cast<size_t> (targetIndex)]->inserts.indexOf (send.slot));
            }
            else
            {
                continue;   // its destination is gone
            }

            sendList.add (sendItem);
        }

        trackFields->setProperty ("sends", sendList);
        trackFields->setProperty ("height", track->height);

        // MIDI in: devices by name; other tracks by their place in the song.
        juce::Array<juce::var> midiList;

        for (const auto& input : track->midiInputs)
        {
            if (input.startsWith ("track:"))
            {
                const auto sourceId = input.substring (6).getIntValue();

                for (size_t i = 0; i < allTracks.size(); ++i)
                    if (allTracks[i]->id == sourceId)
                        midiList.add ("track:" + juce::String (static_cast<int> (i)));
            }
            else
            {
                midiList.add (input);
            }
        }

        trackFields->setProperty ("midiInputs", midiList);

        juce::Array<juce::var> clips;

        for (const auto& clip : track->clips)
            clips.add (clipToVar (clip, songFile));

        trackFields->setProperty ("clips", clips);
        tracks.add (item);
    }

    fields->setProperty ("tracks", tracks);
    fields->setProperty ("selectedTrack", selectedIndex);
    fields->setProperty ("view", view);
    return song;
}

juce::Result Song::restore (AudioEngine& engine, const juce::var& song, juce::StringArray& problems, const juce::File& songFile)
{
    // Checked before anything is cleared, so a bad file leaves the current song alone.
    if (song.getProperty ("format", {}).toString() != formatName)
        return juce::Result::fail ("That file isn't a Fanan Web Hub song.");

    if (static_cast<int> (song.getProperty ("version", 0)) > formatVersion)
        return juce::Result::fail ("That song was saved by a newer version of Fanan Web Hub.");

    engine.clearSong();

    const auto transportData = song.getProperty ("transport", {});
    auto& transport = engine.getTransport();
    const auto defaults = transport.getState();
    transport.setTempo (number (transportData.getProperty ("bpm", {}), 120.0));
    transport.setTimeSignature (static_cast<int> (number (transportData.getProperty ("numerator", {}), 4.0)),
                                static_cast<int> (number (transportData.getProperty ("denominator", {}), 4.0)));
    transport.setLoop (static_cast<bool> (transportData.getProperty ("loop", false)),
                       number (transportData.getProperty ("loopStart", {}), 0.0),
                       number (transportData.getProperty ("loopEnd", {}), 16.0));
    transport.setMetronome (static_cast<bool> (transportData.getProperty ("metronome", false)),
                            static_cast<float> (number (transportData.getProperty ("metronomeVolume", {}), defaults.metronomeVolume)));
    transport.locate (number (transportData.getProperty ("position", {}), 0.0));

    if (const auto* inputList = song.getProperty ("inputs", {}).getArray())
    {
        std::vector<AudioEngine::SongInput> inputs;

        for (const auto& item : *inputList)
            inputs.push_back ({ item.getProperty ("name", "Input").toString(),
                                static_cast<int> (number (item.getProperty ("left", {}), 0.0)),
                                static_cast<int> (number (item.getProperty ("right", {}), -1.0)) });

        engine.setInputs (std::move (inputs));
    }

    engine.setRecordBits (static_cast<int> (number (song.getProperty ("recordBits", {}), 24.0)));

    const auto mainData = song.getProperty ("main", {});
    engine.setMasterVolume (static_cast<float> (number (mainData.getProperty ("volume", {}), 0.0)));
    engine.setMasterMute (static_cast<bool> (mainData.getProperty ("mute", false)));
    restoreInserts (engine, AudioEngine::mainChannel, mainData.getProperty ("inserts", {}), problems);

    std::vector<int> ids;
    std::vector<bool> monitors;

    if (const auto* tracks = song.getProperty ("tracks", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (const auto& item : *tracks)
        {
            const auto kindName = item.getProperty ("kind", {}).toString();
            const auto audio = kindName == "audio";
            const auto id = engine.addTrack (audio ? Track::Kind::audio : kindName == "fx" ? Track::Kind::fx : Track::Kind::instrument);
            ids.push_back (id);

            if (audio)
                engine.setTrackInput (id, static_cast<int> (number (item.getProperty ("input", {}), 0.0)));

            const auto instrument = item.getProperty ("instrument", {});

            if (instrument.isObject())
                restorePlugin (engine, id, instrument, problems);

            restoreInserts (engine, id, item.getProperty ("inserts", {}), problems);

            // After the instrument, which renames a track that still has its automatic name.
            auto* track = engine.findTrack (id);
            const auto name = item.getProperty ("name", {}).toString();

            if (name.isNotEmpty())
                track->name = name;

            track->nameIsAutomatic = static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("nameIsAutomatic", false));

            const auto colour = item.getProperty ("colour", {}).toString();

            if (colour.length() == 8 && colour.containsOnly ("0123456789abcdefABCDEF"))
                track->colour = static_cast<juce::uint32> (colour.getHexValue64());

            track->volumeDb.store (static_cast<float> (juce::jlimit (-144.0, 10.0, number (item.getProperty ("volume", {}), 0.0))));
            track->pan.store (static_cast<float> (juce::jlimit (-1.0, 1.0, number (item.getProperty ("pan", {}), 0.0))));
            track->mute.store (static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("mute", false)));
            track->solo.store (static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("solo", false)));
            monitors.push_back (static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("monitor", false)));
            engine.setTrackRecordArm (id, static_cast<bool> (item.getProperty ("recordArm", false)));

            // Envelopes, once the track's plugins are in (inserts are found by their place).
            if (const auto* lanes = item.getProperty ("automation", {}).getArray())
            {
                std::vector<AutomationLane> restored;
                const auto* restoredTrack = engine.findTrack (id);

                for (const auto& laneItem : *lanes)
                {
                    AutomationLane lane;
                    const auto kind = laneItem.getProperty ("target", {}).toString();
                    lane.target.kind = kind == "pan" ? AutomationTarget::Kind::pan
                                     : kind == "param" ? AutomationTarget::Kind::parameter : AutomationTarget::Kind::volume;

                    if (lane.target.kind == AutomationTarget::Kind::parameter)
                    {
                        const auto place = static_cast<int> (number (laneItem.getProperty ("insert", {}), -1.0));
                        const auto* insert = restoredTrack != nullptr && place >= 0 ? restoredTrack->inserts.at (place) : nullptr;

                        if (place >= 0 && insert == nullptr)
                            continue;   // its insert didn't load

                        lane.target.slot = place < 0 ? AudioEngine::instrumentSlot : insert->id;
                        lane.target.paramId = static_cast<uint32_t> (static_cast<juce::int64> (laneItem.getProperty ("param", 0)));
                    }

                    if (const auto* points = laneItem.getProperty ("points", {}).getArray())
                        for (const auto& point : *points)
                            if (const auto* pair = point.getArray(); pair != nullptr && pair->size() == 2)
                                lane.points.push_back ({ number ((*pair)[0], -1.0), number ((*pair)[1], 0.0) });

                    restored.push_back (std::move (lane));
                }

                engine.setAutomationLanes (id, std::move (restored));
            }

            engine.setAutomationMode (id, item.getProperty ("autoMode", "read").toString() == "off" ? AutomationMode::off : AutomationMode::read);

            if (const auto* clips = item.getProperty ("clips", {}).getArray())
            {
                for (const auto& value : *clips)
                {
                    const auto clip = clipFromVar (value, songFile);

                    if (clip.isAudio() && ! juce::File (clip.audioFile).existsAsFile())
                        problems.add ("An audio file is missing: " + clip.audioFile);

                    engine.addClip (id, clip);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Sends and MIDI inputs, once every track is there (either can name a track further down).
    if (const auto* songTracks = song.getProperty ("tracks", {}).getArray())
    {
        for (int t = 0; t < songTracks->size() && t < static_cast<int> (ids.size()); ++t)
        {
            const auto& songTrack = songTracks->getReference (t);

            if (auto* restoredTrack = engine.findTrack (ids[static_cast<size_t> (t)]))
                restoredTrack->height = juce::jlimit (0, 1000, static_cast<int> (number (songTrack.getProperty ("height", {}), 0.0)));

            // A song from before per-track MIDI keeps what a new track takes (the first MIDI device).
            if (const auto* midiItems = songTrack.getProperty ("midiInputs", {}).getArray())
            {
                juce::StringArray midiInputs;

                for (const auto& item : *midiItems)
                {
                    const auto text = item.toString();

                    if (text.startsWith ("track:"))
                    {
                        const auto index = text.substring (6).getIntValue();

                        if (index >= 0 && index < static_cast<int> (ids.size()))
                            midiInputs.add ("track:" + juce::String (ids[static_cast<size_t> (index)]));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        midiInputs.add (text);
                    }
                }

                engine.setTrackMidiInputs (ids[static_cast<size_t> (t)], midiInputs);
            }

            const auto* sendItems = songTracks->getReference (t).getProperty ("sends", {}).getArray();

            if (sendItems == nullptr)
                continue;

            std::vector<Track::Send> restored;

            for (const auto& sendItem : *sendItems)
            {
                Track::Send send;
                send.id = static_cast<int> (restored.size()) + 1;
                send.sidechain = static_cast<bool> (sendItem.getProperty ("sidechain", false));
                send.levelDb = static_cast<float> (number (sendItem.getProperty ("level", {}), 0.0));
                send.on = static_cast<bool> (sendItem.getProperty ("on", true));
                const auto place = static_cast<int> (number (sendItem.getProperty ("insert", {}), -1.0));

                if (static_cast<bool> (sendItem.getProperty ("main", false)))
                {
                    const auto* insert = place >= 0 ? engine.getMainInserts().at (place) : nullptr;

                    if (insert == nullptr)
                        continue;

                    send.target = AudioEngine::mainChannel;
                    send.slot = insert->id;
                }
                else
                {
                    const auto index = static_cast<int> (number (sendItem.getProperty ("track", {}), -1.0));

                    if (index < 0 || index >= static_cast<int> (ids.size()))
                        continue;

                    send.target = ids[static_cast<size_t> (index)];

                    if (send.sidechain)
                    {
                        auto* targetTrack = engine.findTrack (send.target);
                        const auto* insert = targetTrack != nullptr && place >= 0 ? targetTrack->inserts.at (place) : nullptr;

                        if (place >= 0 && insert == nullptr)
                            continue;

                        send.slot = place < 0 ? AudioEngine::instrumentSlot : insert->id;
                    }
                }

                restored.push_back (send);
            }

            engine.setSends (ids[static_cast<size_t> (t)], std::move (restored));
        }
    }

    if (! ids.empty())
    {
        const auto selected = static_cast<size_t> (juce::jlimit (0, static_cast<int> (ids.size()) - 1,
                                                                 static_cast<int> (song.getProperty ("selectedTrack", 0))));
        engine.selectTrack (ids[selected]);

        // Each track's own monitoring, as the song saved it.
        for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); ++i)
            engine.setTrackMonitor (ids[i], monitors[i]);
    }

    return juce::Result::ok();
}

#pragma once

//==============================================================================
/**
    Song files (.fsong): a song as JSON, enough to put it back exactly as it was.

    Inside: the transport settings, the song's audio inputs and record format, the Main
    channel, and every track (instrument or audio) with its settings, its instrument or
    input, its inserts, and its clips: notes, or a window onto an audio file. Audio files
    inside the song's folder are kept as paths relative to it, so the folder can move. A plugin is
    kept as the file it came from and its id, plus its own saved state (the CLAP state
    extension) and its parameter values, which are used when it can't save a state.
    The page's view settings (zoom, snap and so on) ride along under "view".

    Like Studio One, each new song gets its own folder: Songs\<name>\<name>.fsong.
*/
namespace Song
{
    inline constexpr const char* fileExtension = ".fsong";
    inline constexpr const char* formatName = "Fanan Web Hub Song";
    inline constexpr int formatVersion = 1;

    /** Documents\Fanan Web Hub\Songs: where new songs go unless told otherwise. */
    juce::File getDefaultFolder();

    /** The engine's song, ready for juce::JSON. view is whatever the page wants back on load. */
    juce::var capture (AudioEngine& engine, const juce::String& name, const juce::var& view,
                       const juce::File& songFile = {});

    /** Replaces the engine's song with this one. Something that isn't a song this version
        can read fails without touching the engine. Otherwise the song loads, and anything
        that couldn't come back (a plugin file that has gone, say) is listed in problems.
        Message thread. */
    juce::Result restore (AudioEngine& engine, const juce::var& song, juce::StringArray& problems,
                          const juce::File& songFile = {});
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Track.cpp

#include "Track.h"

#include <cmath>

namespace
{
    //==============================================================================
    // Test instrument. Fast attack and a bright start, so latency is easy to judge by ear.
    struct TestSound final : public juce::SynthesiserSound
    {
        bool appliesToNote (int) override      { return true; }
        bool appliesToChannel (int) override   { return true; }
    };

    class TestVoice final : public juce::SynthesiserVoice
    {
    public:
        bool canPlaySound (juce::SynthesiserSound* sound) override
        {
            return dynamic_cast<TestSound*> (sound) != nullptr;
        }

        void startNote (int midiNoteNumber, float velocity, juce::SynthesiserSound*, int) override
        {
            const auto sampleRate = getSampleRate();

            phase = 0.0;
            phaseDelta = juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi
                         * juce::MidiMessage::getMidiNoteInHertz (midiNoteNumber) / sampleRate;
            gain = 0.14f * velocity;
            brightness = 1.0;
            brightnessDecay = std::exp (-1.0 / (0.25 * sampleRate));

            envelope.setSampleRate (sampleRate);
            envelope.setParameters ({ 0.001f, 0.35f, 0.45f, 0.18f });
            envelope.noteOn();
        }

        void stopNote (float, bool allowTailOff) override
        {
            if (allowTailOff)
            {
                envelope.noteOff();
            }
            else
            {
                envelope.reset();
                clearCurrentNote();
            }
        }

        void pitchWheelMoved (int) override {}
        void controllerMoved (int, int) override {}

        void renderNextBlock (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& output, int startSample, int numSamples) override
        {
            if (! isVoiceActive())
                return;

            const auto numChannels = output.getNumChannels();

            while (--numSamples >= 0)
            {
                const auto partials = std::sin (phase)
                                    + brightness * (0.5 * std::sin (2.0 * phase) + 0.25 * std::sin (3.0 * phase));

                const auto sample = static_cast<float> (partials) * gain * envelope.getNextSample();

                for (int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; ++channel)
                    output.addSample (channel, startSample, sample);

                phase += phaseDelta;

                if (phase >= juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi)
                    phase -= juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi;

                brightness *= brightnessDecay;
                ++startSample;

                if (! envelope.isActive())
                {
                    clearCurrentNote();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

    private:
        juce::ADSR envelope;
        double phase = 0.0;
        double phaseDelta = 0.0;
        double brightness = 1.0;
        double brightnessDecay = 1.0;
        float gain = 0.0f;
    };

    constexpr int numTestVoices = 16;
    constexpr int minimumBufferSize = 4096;

    void storeMax (std::atomic<float>& target, float value) noexcept
    {
        auto current = target.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);

        while (value > current && ! target.compare_exchange_weak (current, value, std::memory_order_relaxed))
        {
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
Track::Track (int trackId, juce::uint32 colourArgb, Kind trackKind)
    : id (trackId), kind (trackKind), colour (colourArgb)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < numTestVoices; ++i)
        synth.addVoice (new TestVoice());

    synth.addSound (new TestSound());

    // Built once, so releasing notes never allocates on the audio thread.
    for (int channel = 1; channel <= 16; ++channel)
    {
        notesOffMidi.addEvent (juce::MidiMessage::allSoundOff (channel), 0);
        notesOffMidi.addEvent (juce::MidiMessage::allNotesOff (channel), 0);
    }

    releaseMidi.ensureSize (8192);
    blockMidi.ensureSize (8192);

    // Start at the fader position, so a new track does not fade in.
    lastGainLeft = lastGainRight = 1.0f;
}

Track::~Track()
{
    // The plugins go with the members, on the message thread: the inserts, then the instrument.
}

//==============================================================================
void Track::prepare (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize)
{
    synth.setCurrentPlaybackSampleRate (sampleRate);
    buffer.setSize (2, juce::jmax (maxBlockSize * 2, minimumBufferSize), false, true, true);
    buffer.clear();
    busInput.setSize (2, juce::jmax (maxBlockSize * 2, minimumBufferSize), false, true, true);
    busInput.clear();
    liveMidi.ensureSize (16384);
    inserts.prepare (maxBlockSize);
}

void Track::render (const juce::MidiBuffer& live, const float* const* inputs, int numInputs, bool recording,
                    const Transport& songTransport, const clap_event_transport_t& transport, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    renderedSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, buffer.getNumSamples());

    if (renderedSamples <= 0)
        return;

    buffer.clear (0, renderedSamples);

    // An FX channel: what the sends brought in, through its inserts.
    if (kind == Kind::fx)
    {
        const auto samples = juce::jmin (renderedSamples, busInput.getNumSamples());
        buffer.copyFrom (0, 0, busInput, 0, 0, samples);
        buffer.copyFrom (1, 0, busInput, 1, 0, samples);
        blockMidi.clear();
        inserts.process (buffer.getWritePointer (0), buffer.getWritePointer (1), renderedSamples, blockMidi, transport);
        return;
    }

    if (kind == Kind::audio)
    {
        auto* left = buffer.getWritePointer (0);
        auto* right = buffer.getWritePointer (1);
        playClips (songTransport, left, right);

        const auto channel = [inputs, numInputs] (int index) -> const float*
        {
            return inputs != nullptr && juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, numInputs) ? inputs[index] : nullptr;
        };

        const auto* inLeft = channel (inputLeft.load (std::memory_order_relaxed));
        const auto rightIndex = inputRight.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const auto* inRight = rightIndex >= 0 ? channel (rightIndex) : nullptr;

        if (inLeft != nullptr)
        {
            if (inRight == nullptr)
                inRight = inLeft;   // mono: the same on both sides

            const auto peakOf = [this] (const float* data)
            {
                const auto range = juce::FloatVectorOperations::findMinAndMax (data, renderedSamples);
                return juce::jmax (-range.getStart(), range.getEnd());
            };

            inputPeak.store (juce::jmax (inputPeak.load (std::memory_order_relaxed), peakOf (inLeft), peakOf (inRight)),
                             std::memory_order_relaxed);

            if (monitor.load (std::memory_order_relaxed))
            {
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (left, inLeft, renderedSamples);
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::add (right, inRight, renderedSamples);
            }

            // The writer copies into its own queue; a background thread does the disk.
            if (recording && recorder != nullptr)
            {
                const float* data[] = { inLeft, inRight };
                recorder->write (data, renderedSamples);
            }
        }

        inserts.process (left, right, renderedSamples, blockMidi, transport);
        return;
    }

    // This block's notes: the clips' first, then the live ones.
    blockMidi.clear();
    sequencer.render (sequence.get(), songTransport, blockMidi);

    if (! live.isEmpty())
        blockMidi.addEvents (live, 0, -1, 0);

    const auto& midi = blockMidi;

    // Releasing: silence the test synth at once (it may not be the one rendering) and send
    // any plugin instrument all-notes-off first, then this block's live notes, so a note
    // played in the same block is not lost.
    const bool releaseNotes = notesOffRequested.exchange (false);

    if (releaseNotes)
    {
        synth.allNotesOff (0, false);
        releaseMidi.clear();
        releaseMidi.addEvents (notesOffMidi, 0, -1, 0);
        releaseMidi.addEvents (midi, 0, -1, 0);
    }

    const auto& events = releaseNotes ? releaseMidi : midi;
    auto* left = buffer.getWritePointer (0);
    auto* right = buffer.getWritePointer (1);

    auto* source = instrument != nullptr && instrument->isActive() ? instrument.get() : nullptr;

    if (source != nullptr && source->getRole() == Plugin::Role::instrument)
    {
        source->process (nullptr, nullptr, left, right, renderedSamples, events, &transport);
    }
    else
    {
        synth.renderNextBlock (buffer, events, 0, renderedSamples);

        // A note effect hears the notes; the test synth stays audible.
        if (source != nullptr)
            source->process (left, right, nullptr, nullptr, renderedSamples, events, &transport);
    }

    inserts.process (left, right, renderedSamples, events, transport);
}

void Track::sendInto (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, float gain, float& lastGain) const noexcept
{
    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, renderedSamples);

    if (numSamples <= 0 || left == nullptr || right == nullptr)
        return;

    // The fader's own ramp from this block (so a send follows fader moves and mutes without a
    // click), times the send's level, ramped too.
    const auto count = static_cast<float> (numSamples);
    const auto stepLeft = (lastGainLeft - rampFromLeft) / count;
    const auto stepRight = (lastGainRight - rampFromRight) / count;
    const auto stepSend = (gain - lastGain) / count;

    const auto* sourceLeft = buffer.getReadPointer (0);
    const auto* sourceRight = buffer.getReadPointer (1);
    auto faderLeft = rampFromLeft, faderRight = rampFromRight, send = lastGain;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        faderLeft += stepLeft;
        faderRight += stepRight;
        send += stepSend;
        left[i] += sourceLeft[i] * faderLeft * send;
        right[i] += sourceRight[i] * faderRight * send;
    }

    lastGain = gain;
}

void Track::playClips (const Transport& songTransport, float* left, float* right) noexcept
{
    const auto* list = playlist.get();
    const auto segments = songTransport.getNumSegments();
    const auto perSample = songTransport.getPpqPerSample();

    if (list == nullptr || list->items.empty() || segments == 0 || perSample <= 0.0)
        return;

    constexpr juce::int64 fade = 64;   // samples: clip edges ramp in and out, so they never click

    for (int s = 0; s < segments; ++s)
    {
        const auto& segment = songTransport.getSegment (s);

        for (const auto& item : list->items)
        {
            if (item.data == nullptr || item.lengthSamples <= 0)
                continue;

            const auto endPpq = item.startPpq + static_cast<double> (item.lengthSamples) * perSample;

            if (endPpq <= segment.from || item.startPpq >= segment.to)
                continue;

            const auto first = juce::jmax (0, static_cast<int> (std::ceil ((item.startPpq - segment.from) / perSample - 1.0e-6)));
            const auto last = juce::jmin (segment.length, static_cast<int> (std::ceil ((endPpq - segment.from) / perSample - 1.0e-6)));

            const auto& samples = item.data->samples;
            const auto* sourceLeft = samples.getReadPointer (0);
            const auto* sourceRight = samples.getReadPointer (samples.getNumChannels() > 1 ? 1 : 0);
            const auto available = static_cast<juce::int64> (samples.getNumSamples());

            auto intoClip = static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround ((segment.from + first * perSample - item.startPpq) / perSample));

            for (int i = first; i < last; ++i, ++intoClip)
            {
                const auto source = item.offsetSamples + intoClip;

                if (intoClip < 0 || intoClip >= item.lengthSamples || source < 0 || source >= available)
                    continue;

                auto gain = item.gain;
                const auto untilEnd = item.lengthSamples - intoClip;

                if (intoClip < fade)
                    gain *= static_cast<float> (intoClip) / static_cast<float> (fade);
                else if (untilEnd < fade)
                    gain *= static_cast<float> (untilEnd) / static_cast<float> (fade);

                // The clip's own fades: quarter-sine curves, which sound even as they pass.
                if (intoClip < item.fadeInSamples)
                    gain *= static_cast<float> (std::sin (juce::MathConstants<double>::halfPi * static_cast<double> (intoClip) / static_cast<double> (item.fadeInSamples)));

                if (untilEnd < item.fadeOutSamples)
                    gain *= static_cast<float> (std::sin (juce::MathConstants<double>::halfPi * static_cast<double> (untilEnd) / static_cast<double> (item.fadeOutSamples)));

                left[segment.offset + i] += sourceLeft[source] * gain;
                right[segment.offset + i] += sourceRight[source] * gain;
            }
        }
    }
}

void Track::mixInto (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, bool audible) noexcept
{
    numSamples = juce::jmin (numSamples, renderedSamples);

    if (numSamples <= 0 || left == nullptr)
        return;

    const auto db = volumeDb.load();
    const auto gain = db <= silentDb ? 0.0f : juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (db);
    const auto balance = juce::jlimit (-1.0f, 1.0f, pan.load());

    const auto targetLeft = audible ? gain * (balance > 0.0f ? 1.0f - balance : 1.0f) : 0.0f;
    const auto targetRight = audible ? gain * (balance < 0.0f ? 1.0f + balance : 1.0f) : 0.0f;

    // Ramp across the block so fader moves and mutes never click.
    const auto stepLeft = (targetLeft - lastGainLeft) / static_cast<float> (numSamples);
    const auto stepRight = (targetRight - lastGainRight) / static_cast<float> (numSamples);

    const auto* sourceLeft = buffer.getReadPointer (0);
    const auto* sourceRight = buffer.getReadPointer (1);

    auto gainLeft = lastGainLeft;
    auto gainRight = lastGainRight;
    float peakL = 0.0f, peakR = 0.0f;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        gainLeft += stepLeft;
        gainRight += stepRight;

        const auto sampleLeft = sourceLeft[i] * gainLeft;
        const auto sampleRight = sourceRight[i] * gainRight;

        if (right != nullptr)
        {
            left[i] += sampleLeft;
            right[i] += sampleRight;
        }
        else
        {
            left[i] += 0.5f * (sampleLeft + sampleRight);
        }

        peakL = juce::jmax (peakL, std::abs (sampleLeft));
        peakR = juce::jmax (peakR, std::abs (sampleRight));
    }

    rampFromLeft = lastGainLeft;
    rampFromRight = lastGainRight;
    lastGainLeft = targetLeft;
    lastGainRight = targetRight;

    storeMax (peakLeft, peakL);
    storeMax (peakRight, peakR);
}
