// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Track.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>

#include "AudioMedia.h"
#include "Automation.h"
#include "EffectChain.h"
#include "Sequence.h"
#include "Transport.h"
#include "Plugin.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <memory>

//==============================================================================
/**
    One track, of one of two kinds:
      instrument  MIDI clips and live notes into a sound source (the built-in test
                  synth or a WCLAP instrument);
      audio       audio clips and a live input from the audio device, which it can
                  monitor and record.
    Either way, then a chain of insert effects and the fader settings.

    The engine owns the tracks. Fader settings are atomics the page may change at
    any time. Plugins are swapped only by the engine, while it holds its graph lock,
    so the audio thread never sees a half-installed plugin.
*/
class Track final
{
public:
    // fx: an FX channel (Studio One's): no clips of its own, it plays what tracks send to it.
    enum class Kind { instrument, audio, fx };

    /** A send: a copy of the track's sound (after its fader) to an FX channel, or to a
        plugin's sidechain input (a compressor ducking under the kick, say). */
    struct Send
    {
        int id = 0;
        bool sidechain = false;
        int target = 0;            // an FX channel's track id; for a sidechain, the channel the plugin is on
        int slot = 0;              // sidechain: 0 the channel's instrument, otherwise an insert's id
        float levelDb = 0.0f;
        bool on = true;
        float lastGain = 0.0f;     // audio thread: where the level's ramp left off
    };

    Track (int id, juce::uint32 colourArgb, Kind kind = Kind::instrument);
    ~Track();

    //==============================================================================
    const int id;
    const Kind kind;
    juce::String name;             // message thread
    bool nameIsAutomatic = true;   // renamed after its instrument until the user names it
    juce::uint32 colour = 0;       // ARGB, message thread

    std::atomic<float> volumeDb { 0.0f };
    std::atomic<float> pan { 0.0f };           // -1 left .. +1 right
    std::atomic<bool> mute { false }, solo { false }, monitor { false }, recordArm { false };
    std::atomic<float> peakLeft { 0.0f }, peakRight { 0.0f };

    static constexpr float silentDb = -72.0f;  // at or below this the fader is closed
    static constexpr float maxDb = 10.0f;      // top of the fader, as on Studio One

    //==============================================================================
    // Plugins. Null instrument: the test synth plays. The inserts follow in order.
    std::unique_ptr<Plugin> instrument;
    EffectChain inserts;

    //==============================================================================
    // Clips. The message thread owns the clips; after a change the engine builds a new
    // Sequence and swaps it in under its graph lock, and the audio thread plays that.
    std::vector<MidiClip> clips;
    std::unique_ptr<const Sequence> sequence;
    Sequencer sequencer;

    //==============================================================================
    // Audio tracks. input is which of the engine's inputs the track hears; inputLeft and
    // inputRight are where that is among the device's active input channels (right -1:
    // mono). The playlist is swapped, and the recorder set, under the engine's graph lock.
    int input = 0;                                   // message thread
    std::atomic<int> inputLeft { -1 }, inputRight { -1 };
    std::atomic<float> inputPeak { 0.0f };
    std::unique_ptr<const AudioPlaylist> playlist;
    juce::AudioFormatWriter::ThreadedWriter* recorder = nullptr;

    //==============================================================================
    // Automation. The envelopes are the message thread's; the playback copy is swapped in
    // under the engine's graph lock and applied by the audio thread at each block.
    std::vector<AutomationLane> automation;

    // Sends: the message thread's list, and the audio thread's copy (swapped under the graph lock).
    std::vector<Send> sends;
    std::vector<Send> audioSends;
    int nextSendId = 1;

    /** What the FX channel plays: tracks' sends add into it each block (an FX channel's own). */
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> busInput;

    // MIDI in: what the track's instrument hears. MIDI devices by name, and other tracks'
    // plugins that play notes themselves ("track:<id>"). The message thread's list, and the
    // audio thread's resolved copies (swapped under the graph lock).
    juce::StringArray midiInputs;
    std::vector<int> midiDeviceSlots, midiSourceTracks;
    juce::MidiBuffer liveMidi;       // audio thread: this block's notes in

    int height = 0;                  // its height in the arrangement; 0 follows the view's size
    std::atomic<int> automationMode { static_cast<int> (AutomationMode::read) };
    std::unique_ptr<AutomationPlayback> automationPlayback;

    /** Held notes are released in the next block (used when the track stops listening). */
    void requestNotesOff() noexcept { notesOffRequested.store (true); }

    //==============================================================================
    // Audio side. prepare() runs while no audio callback is active.
    void prepare (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize);

    /** Plays the clips and the live notes (instrument) or the clips and the live input
        (audio) through the source and the inserts, into the track's own buffer. live is
        empty unless the track is monitoring or armed. inputs are the device's active
        input channels; recording says whether an audio track's recorder takes this block. */
    void render (const juce::MidiBuffer& live, const float* const* inputs, int numInputs, bool recording,
                 const Transport& transport, const clap_event_transport_t& position, int numSamples) noexcept;

    /** Adds the rendered block to the output with the fader settings applied. right may be null. */
    void mixInto (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, bool audible) noexcept;

    /** Adds the block as mixInto() just did (after the fader and pan) to a send's destination,
        at the send's level; lastGain carries the level's ramp between blocks. */
    void sendInto (float* left, float* right, int numSamples, float gain, float& lastGain) const noexcept;

private:
    void playClips (const Transport& transport, float* left, float* right) noexcept;

    juce::Synthesiser synth;
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> buffer;
    juce::MidiBuffer notesOffMidi, releaseMidi, blockMidi;
    std::atomic<bool> notesOffRequested { false };
    float lastGainLeft = 0.0f, lastGainRight = 0.0f;
    float rampFromLeft = 0.0f, rampFromRight = 0.0f;   // this block's fader ramp, for the sends
    int renderedSamples = 0;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Track)
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Transport.cpp

#include "Transport.h"

#include <cmath>

namespace
{
    constexpr double clickLengthSeconds = 0.06;
    constexpr double clickAttackSeconds = 0.0004;
    constexpr double clickDecaySeconds = 0.010;
    constexpr double accentFrequency = 1500.0;
    constexpr double beatFrequency = 1000.0;

    clap_beattime toBeatTime (double quarterNotes) noexcept
    {
        return static_cast<clap_beattime> (std::llround (quarterNotes * static_cast<double> (CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR)));
    }

    clap_sectime toSecTime (double seconds) noexcept
    {
        return static_cast<clap_sectime> (std::llround (seconds * static_cast<double> (CLAP_SECTIME_FACTOR)));
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void Transport::setPlaying (bool shouldPlay) noexcept
{
    if (! shouldPlay)
        recordSetting.store (false);   // stopping ends recording

    requestedPlaying.store (shouldPlay ? 1 : 0);
}

void Transport::togglePlaying() noexcept
{
    // A request the audio thread hasn't picked up yet counts as the current state,
    // so two quick toggles cancel out instead of both reading "stopped".
    const auto pending = requestedPlaying.load();
    const bool current = pending >= 0 ? pending == 1 : playingNow.load();
    setPlaying (! current);
}

void Transport::setRecording (bool shouldRecord) noexcept
{
    recordSetting.store (shouldRecord);
}

void Transport::locate (double ppq) noexcept
{
    requestedLocate.store (juce::jmax (0.0, ppq));
}

void Transport::setTempo (double newBpm) noexcept
{
    if (std::isfinite (newBpm))
        tempoSetting.store (juce::jlimit (minTempo, maxTempo, newBpm));
}

void Transport::setTimeSignature (int newNumerator, int newDenominator) noexcept
{
    if (! isValidDenominator (newDenominator))
        return;

    numeratorSetting.store (juce::jlimit (1, 32, newNumerator));
    denominatorSetting.store (newDenominator);
}

void Transport::setLoop (bool enabled, double startPpq, double endPpq) noexcept
{
    if (! std::isfinite (startPpq) || ! std::isfinite (endPpq))
        return;

    startPpq = juce::jlimit (0.0, maxPosition - minLoopLength, startPpq);
    endPpq = juce::jlimit (startPpq + minLoopLength, maxPosition, endPpq);

    loopStartSetting.store (startPpq);
    loopEndSetting.store (endPpq);
    loopSetting.store (enabled);
}

void Transport::setMetronome (bool enabled, float volume) noexcept
{
    if (std::isfinite (volume))
        metronomeVolumeSetting.store (juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, volume));

    metronomeSetting.store (enabled);
}

Transport::State Transport::getState() const noexcept
{
    State state;
    state.playing = playingNow.load();
    state.ppq = positionNow.load();
    state.bpm = tempoSetting.load();
    state.numerator = numeratorSetting.load();
    state.denominator = denominatorSetting.load();
    state.loopEnabled = loopSetting.load();
    state.loopStart = loopStartSetting.load();
    state.loopEnd = loopEndSetting.load();
    state.metronomeEnabled = metronomeSetting.load();
    state.metronomeVolume = metronomeVolumeSetting.load();
    state.recording = recordSetting.load();
    return state;
}

bool Transport::isValidDenominator (int value) noexcept
{
    return value == 1 || value == 2 || value == 4 || value == 8 || value == 16 || value == 32;
}

//==============================================================================
void Transport::prepare (double newSampleRate) noexcept
{
    sampleRate = newSampleRate;
    clickSamplesLeft = 0;
    numClicks = 0;
}

void Transport::beginBlock (clap_event_transport_t& out, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    const auto locateTo = requestedLocate.exchange (std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN());

    if (! std::isnan (locateTo))
        position = locateTo;

    const auto request = requestedPlaying.exchange (-1);

    if (request >= 0)
        playing = request == 1;

    bpm = tempoSetting.load();
    numerator = numeratorSetting.load();
    denominator = denominatorSetting.load();
    loopEnabled = loopSetting.load();
    loopStart = loopStartSetting.load();
    loopEnd = loopEndSetting.load();
    metronomeEnabled = metronomeSetting.load();
    metronomeVolume = metronomeVolumeSetting.load();
    recording = recordSetting.load();

    playingNow.store (playing);
    positionNow.store (position);
    planBlock (numSamples);

    // Describe the block start for plugins (tempo-synced effects, arpeggiators and so on).
    const auto secondsPerQuarter = 60.0 / bpm;
    const auto bar = std::floor (position / barLength() + 1.0e-9);

    out = {};
    out.header.size = static_cast<uint32_t> (sizeof (clap_event_transport_t));
    out.header.time = 0;
    out.header.space_id = CLAP_CORE_EVENT_SPACE_ID;
    out.header.type = CLAP_EVENT_TRANSPORT;
    out.header.flags = 0;

    out.flags = CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_TEMPO | CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_BEATS_TIMELINE
              | CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_SECONDS_TIMELINE | CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_TIME_SIGNATURE;

    if (playing)
        out.flags |= CLAP_TRANSPORT_IS_PLAYING;

    if (loopActive())
        out.flags |= CLAP_TRANSPORT_IS_LOOP_ACTIVE;

    out.song_pos_beats = toBeatTime (position);
    out.song_pos_seconds = toSecTime (position * secondsPerQuarter);
    out.tempo = bpm;
    out.tempo_inc = 0.0;
    out.loop_start_beats = toBeatTime (loopStart);
    out.loop_end_beats = toBeatTime (loopEnd);
    out.loop_start_seconds = toSecTime (loopStart * secondsPerQuarter);
    out.loop_end_seconds = toSecTime (loopEnd * secondsPerQuarter);
    out.bar_start = toBeatTime (bar * barLength());
    out.bar_number = static_cast<int32_t> (bar);
    out.tsig_num = static_cast<uint16_t> (numerator);
    out.tsig_denom = static_cast<uint16_t> (denominator);
}

void Transport::endBlock (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    numClicks = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSegments; ++i)
    {
        const auto& segment = segments[static_cast<size_t> (i)];
        collectClicks (segment.from, segment.to, segment.offset, segment.length);
    }

    if (numSegments > 0)
        position = plannedEnd;

    renderClicks (left, right, numSamples);
    positionNow.store (position);
}

//==============================================================================
void Transport::planBlock (int numSamples) noexcept
{
    numSegments = 0;
    ppqPerSample = sampleRate > 0.0 ? bpm / (60.0 * sampleRate) : 0.0;

    if (! playing || ppqPerSample <= 0.0 || numSamples <= 0)
        return;

    const auto looping = loopActive();
    auto from = position;
    int offset = 0;
    int remaining = numSamples;

    // Each segment consumes at least one sample. Even the shortest loop allowed at the
    // fastest tempo fits a normal block in far fewer segments than the cap.
    while (remaining > 0 && numSegments < maxSegments)
    {
        const auto to = from + remaining * ppqPerSample;
        auto& segment = segments[static_cast<size_t> (numSegments++)];

        if (looping && from < loopEnd && to >= loopEnd)
        {
            // The tolerance keeps a distance that is a whole number of samples (in exact
            // arithmetic) from rounding up one sample late.
            const auto toEnd = juce::jlimit (1, remaining, static_cast<int> (std::ceil ((loopEnd - from) / ppqPerSample - 1.0e-6)));
            segment = { from, loopEnd, offset, toEnd };
            offset += toEnd;
            remaining -= toEnd;
            from = loopStart;
        }
        else
        {
            segment = { from, to, offset, remaining };
            from = to;
            remaining = 0;
        }
    }

    // Out of segments (a pathological loop): the rest of the block continues without jumping.
    if (remaining > 0)
    {
        auto& last = segments[static_cast<size_t> (numSegments - 1)];
        last.length += remaining;
        from = last.to = last.from + last.length * ppqPerSample;
    }

    plannedEnd = from;
}

void Transport::collectClicks (double from, double to, int offset, int length) noexcept
{
    if (! metronomeEnabled || length <= 0)
        return;

    const auto beat = beatLength();

    for (auto index = static_cast<juce::int64> (std::ceil (from / beat - 1.0e-9)); static_cast<double> (index) * beat < to; ++index)
    {
        if (numClicks >= maxClicksPerBlock)
            return;

        const auto sample = static_cast<int> (std::llround ((static_cast<double> (index) * beat - from) / ppqPerSample));

        clicks[static_cast<size_t> (numClicks++)] = { offset + juce::jlimit (0, length - 1, sample),
                                                     index % numerator == 0 };
    }
}

void Transport::startClick (bool accent) noexcept
{
    clickSamplesLeft = static_cast<int> (clickLengthSeconds * sampleRate);
    clickTime = 0.0;
    clickPhase = 0.0;
    clickPhaseStep = juce::MathConstants<double>::twoPi * (accent ? accentFrequency : beatFrequency) / sampleRate;
    clickGain = metronomeVolume * (accent ? 0.5f : 0.32f);
}

void Transport::renderClicks (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept
{
    if (numClicks == 0 && clickSamplesLeft <= 0)
        return;

    const auto timeStep = 1.0 / sampleRate;
    int nextClick = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        while (nextClick < numClicks && clicks[static_cast<size_t> (nextClick)].sample == i)
            startClick (clicks[static_cast<size_t> (nextClick++)].accent);

        if (clickSamplesLeft <= 0)
        {
            if (nextClick >= numClicks)
                return;

            continue;
        }

        const auto envelope = (1.0 - std::exp (-clickTime / clickAttackSeconds)) * std::exp (-clickTime / clickDecaySeconds);
        const auto sample = static_cast<float> (clickGain * envelope * std::sin (clickPhase));

        if (left != nullptr)
            left[i] += sample;

        if (right != nullptr && right != left)
            right[i] += sample;

        clickPhase += clickPhaseStep;
        clickTime += timeStep;
        --clickSamplesLeft;
    }
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Transport.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <clap/clap.h>

#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <limits>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Song position, tempo, time signature, loop, record and metronome.

    The message thread sends requests (play, stop, locate, settings). The audio thread
    applies them at the start of each block and works out which stretches of the song
    the block covers (more than one when it loops back). Tracks play their clips from
    that plan, recording stamps live notes with it, and the metronome clicks on it, so
    all three agree to the sample. Everything the two threads share is atomic, so
    neither ever waits for the other.

    Positions, the loop included, are in quarter notes (PPQ) from the start of the
    song, so a loop can start and end anywhere on the grid. Bars are counted from 0
    inside the engine; the page shows them from 1.
*/
class Transport final
{
public:
    //==============================================================================
    struct State
    {
        bool playing = false;
        double ppq = 0.0;
        double bpm = 120.0;
        int numerator = 4;
        int denominator = 4;
        bool loopEnabled = false;
        double loopStart = 0.0;    // where the loop starts, in quarter notes
        double loopEnd = 16.0;     // where it ends (and jumps back to loopStart)
        bool metronomeEnabled = false;
        float metronomeVolume = 0.6f;
        bool recording = false;
    };

    /** A stretch of song that one block plays without jumping. */
    struct Segment
    {
        double from = 0.0, to = 0.0;     // song positions, quarter notes
        int offset = 0, length = 0;      // where in the block, in samples
    };

    static constexpr int maxSegments = 32;

    static constexpr double minTempo = 20.0;
    static constexpr double maxTempo = 300.0;
    static constexpr double minLoopLength = 1.0 / 16.0;   // a 64th note
    static constexpr double maxPosition = 1.0e6;          // quarter notes; far past any song

    Transport() = default;

    //==============================================================================
    // Any thread (normally the message thread)
    void setPlaying (bool shouldPlay) noexcept;
    void togglePlaying() noexcept;
    void locate (double ppq) noexcept;
    void setTempo (double bpm) noexcept;
    void setTimeSignature (int numerator, int denominator) noexcept;
    void setLoop (bool enabled, double startPpq, double endPpq) noexcept;
    void setMetronome (bool enabled, float volume) noexcept;

    /** Recording happens while playing; stopping ends it. */
    void setRecording (bool shouldRecord) noexcept;

    State getState() const noexcept;

    /** True for the denominators the transport accepts: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32. */
    static bool isValidDenominator (int denominator) noexcept;

    //==============================================================================
    // Audio thread
    void prepare (double sampleRate) noexcept;

    /** Applies pending requests, plans the block, and describes its start for plugins. */
    void beginBlock (clap_event_transport_t& transportForPlugins, int numSamples) noexcept;

    /** The stretches of song this block plays, in order; none while stopped.
        Valid from beginBlock() until endBlock(). */
    int getNumSegments() const noexcept                       { return numSegments; }
    const Segment& getSegment (int index) const noexcept      { return segments[static_cast<size_t> (index)]; }
    double getPpqPerSample() const noexcept                   { return ppqPerSample; }
    bool isRecordingNow() const noexcept                      { return playing && recording; }

    /** Where this block starts in the song (quarter notes), playing or not. */
    double getBlockStart() const noexcept                     { return position; }

    /** Moves to where the plan ends and adds the metronome to the output (either may be null). */
    void endBlock (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept;

private:
    //==============================================================================
    struct Click
    {
        int sample = 0;
        bool accent = false;
    };

    void planBlock (int numSamples) noexcept;
    void collectClicks (double from, double to, int offset, int length) noexcept;
    void renderClicks (float* left, float* right, int numSamples) noexcept;
    void startClick (bool accent) noexcept;

    double beatLength() const noexcept      { return 4.0 / denominator; }
    double barLength() const noexcept       { return numerator * beatLength(); }
    bool loopActive() const noexcept        { return loopEnabled && loopEnd > loopStart; }

    //==============================================================================
    // Requests and settings, written by the message thread
    std::atomic<int> requestedPlaying { -1 };      // -1 none, 0 stop, 1 play
    std::atomic<double> requestedLocate { std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN() };
    std::atomic<double> tempoSetting { 120.0 };
    std::atomic<int> numeratorSetting { 4 }, denominatorSetting { 4 };
    std::atomic<bool> loopSetting { false };
    std::atomic<double> loopStartSetting { 0.0 }, loopEndSetting { 16.0 };
    std::atomic<bool> metronomeSetting { false };
    std::atomic<float> metronomeVolumeSetting { 0.6f };
    std::atomic<bool> recordSetting { false };

    // Published by the audio thread
    std::atomic<bool> playingNow { false };
    std::atomic<double> positionNow { 0.0 };

    // Audio thread only
    double sampleRate = 0.0;
    bool playing = false;
    double position = 0.0;
    double bpm = 120.0;
    int numerator = 4, denominator = 4;
    bool loopEnabled = false;
    double loopStart = 0.0, loopEnd = 16.0;
    bool metronomeEnabled = false;
    float metronomeVolume = 0.6f;
    bool recording = false;

    std::array<Segment, maxSegments> segments {};
    int numSegments = 0;
    double ppqPerSample = 0.0;
    double plannedEnd = 0.0;

    static constexpr int maxClicksPerBlock = 64;
    std::array<Click, maxClicksPerBlock> clicks {};
    int numClicks = 0;

    int clickSamplesLeft = 0;
    double clickTime = 0.0, clickPhase = 0.0, clickPhaseStep = 0.0;
    float clickGain = 0.0f;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Transport)
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Vst3Plugin.cpp

#include "Vst3Plugin.h"

#include <map>

namespace
{
    /** JUCE's plugin formats: made when first needed, on the message thread, and let go
        by shutdownFormats() (not left to static destruction, which comes too late for
        JUCE's leak checks). */
    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioPluginFormatManager>& formatHolder()
    {
        static std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioPluginFormatManager> manager;
        return manager;
    }

    juce::AudioPluginFormatManager& formats()
    {
        auto& manager = formatHolder();

        if (manager == nullptr)
        {
            manager = std::make_unique<juce::AudioPluginFormatManager>();
           #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
            manager->addFormat (std::make_unique<juce::VST3PluginFormat>());   // with plugin windows
           #else
            manager->addFormat (std::make_unique<juce::VST3PluginFormatHeadless>());
           #endif
        }

        return *manager;
    }

    juce::AudioPluginFormat& vst3()
    {
        return *formats().getFormat (0);
    }

    /** VST3 categories as CLAP feature words, so both kinds of plugin sort alike. */
    juce::StringArray featuresFor (const juce::PluginDescription& description)
    {
        static const std::map<juce::String, const char*> words {
            { "synth", "synthesizer" }, { "sampler", "sampler" }, { "drum", "drum-machine" }, { "piano", "synthesizer" },
            { "generator", "synthesizer" }, { "external", "synthesizer" }, { "reverb", "reverb" }, { "delay", "delay" },
            { "eq", "equalizer" }, { "dynamics", "compressor" }, { "distortion", "distortion" }, { "filter", "filter" },
            { "modulation", "chorus" }, { "analyzer", "analyzer" }, { "tools", "utility" }, { "mastering", "mastering" },
            { "pitch shift", "pitch-shifter" }, { "restoration", "restoration" }, { "spatial", "utility" }, { "surround", "surround" }
        };

        juce::StringArray features;
        features.add (description.isInstrument ? "instrument" : "audio-effect");

        for (const auto& part : juce::StringArray::fromTokens (description.category, "|", ""))
            if (const auto found = words.find (part.trim().toLowerCase()); found != words.end())
                features.addIfNotAlreadyThere (found->second);

        return features;
    }

    Plugin::Descriptor descriptorFor (const juce::PluginDescription& description)
    {
        return { description.createIdentifierString(), description.name,
                 description.manufacturerName.isNotEmpty() ? description.manufacturerName : juce::String ("Unknown vendor"),
                 description.version, featuresFor (description) };
    }
}

//==============================================================================
juce::FileSearchPath Vst3Plugin::getDefaultFolders()
{
    // A format of its own for the question, so asking doesn't keep JUCE's VST3 host alive.
    return juce::VST3PluginFormatHeadless().getDefaultLocationsToSearch();
}

void Vst3Plugin::shutdownFormats()
{
    formatHolder().reset();
}

std::vector<Plugin::Descriptor> Vst3Plugin::describe (const juce::File& file, juce::String& error)
{
    juce::OwnedArray<juce::PluginDescription> found;
    vst3().findAllTypesForFile (found, file.getFullPathName());

    std::vector<Descriptor> list;

    for (const auto* description : found)
        list.push_back (descriptorFor (*description));

    if (list.empty())
        error = file.getFileName() + " has no VST3 plugin the Hub can load.";

    return list;
}

std::unique_ptr<Vst3Plugin> Vst3Plugin::load (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error)
{
    juce::OwnedArray<juce::PluginDescription> found;
    vst3().findAllTypesForFile (found, file.getFullPathName());

    if (found.isEmpty())
    {
        error = file.getFileName() + " has no VST3 plugin the Hub can load.";
        return nullptr;
    }

    const juce::PluginDescription* chosen = found.getFirst();

    if (pluginId.isNotEmpty())
    {
        chosen = nullptr;

        for (const auto* description : found)
            if (description->createIdentifierString() == pluginId)
                chosen = description;

        if (chosen == nullptr)
        {
            error = file.getFileName() + " no longer has that plugin.";
            return nullptr;
        }
    }

    std::vector<Descriptor> inFile;

    for (const auto* description : found)
        inFile.push_back (descriptorFor (*description));

    juce::String message;
    auto instance = formats().createPluginInstance (*chosen, 48000.0, 512, message);

    if (instance == nullptr)
    {
        error = message.isNotEmpty() ? message : "Couldn't load " + chosen->name + ".";
        return nullptr;
    }

    return std::unique_ptr<Vst3Plugin> (new Vst3Plugin (std::move (instance), *chosen, std::move (inFile), file));
}

Vst3Plugin::Vst3Plugin (std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioPluginInstance> pluginInstance, const juce::PluginDescription& description,
                        std::vector<Descriptor> inFile, const juce::File& file)
    : instance (std::move (pluginInstance)),
      descriptor (descriptorFor (description)),
      pluginsInFile (std::move (inFile)),
      sourceFile (file),
      role (description.isInstrument ? Role::instrument : Role::effect)
{
    // A sidechain input (compressors, duckers) is switched on, so tracks can send to it.
    if (instance->getBusCount (true) > 1)
        if (auto* bus = instance->getBus (true, 1); bus != nullptr && ! bus->isEnabled())
            bus->enable (true);

    inputChannels = instance->getMainBusNumInputChannels();
    outputChannels = instance->getTotalNumOutputChannels();

    const auto& all = instance->getParameters();

    for (int i = 0; i < all.size(); ++i)
    {
        auto* parameter = all[i];
        Parameter info;
        info.id = static_cast<uint32_t> (i);

        // The VST3 id, not the list position: it stays the same when a plugin is updated.
        if (auto* withId = dynamic_cast<juce::HostedAudioProcessorParameter*> (parameter))
            info.id = static_cast<uint32_t> (withId->getParameterID().getLargeIntValue());

        info.name = parameter->getName (64);
        info.minValue = 0.0;
        info.maxValue = 1.0;
        info.defaultValue = parameter->getDefaultValue();
        info.stepped = parameter->isDiscrete() || parameter->isBoolean();

        // Out of sight: what a plugin keeps from automation (JUCE-built instruments carry
        // 2,080 hidden MIDI controller parameters), and Bypass, since inserts have their own.
        info.hidden = ! parameter->isAutomatable() || parameter == instance->getBypassParameter();
        parameters.push_back (info);
        hosted.push_back (parameter);
    }

    instance->addListener (this);
    instance->setPlayHead (&playHead);
}

        : DocumentWindow (title, juce::Colour (0xff2b2d31), DocumentWindow::closeButton)

        setContentOwned (editor, true);
        setResizable (editor->isResizable(), false);

Plugin::ScreenKind Vst3Plugin::getScreenKind() const noexcept
{
   #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
    return instance->hasEditor() ? ScreenKind::native : ScreenKind::none;
   #else
    return ScreenKind::none;
   #endif
}

bool Vst3Plugin::showNativeScreen (const juce::String& title)
{
   #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
    if (screenWindow == nullptr)
    {
        auto* editor = instance->hasEditor() ? instance->createEditorAndMakeActive() : nullptr;

        if (editor == nullptr)
            return false;

        screenWindow = std::make_unique<ScreenWindow> (title, editor);
    }

    screenWindow->setName (title);
    screenWindow->setVisible (true);
    screenWindow->toFront (true);
    return true;
   #else
    juce::ignoreUnused (title);
    return false;
   #endif
}

void Vst3Plugin::hideNativeScreen()
{
   #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
    if (screenWindow != nullptr)
        screenWindow->setVisible (false);
   #endif
}

Vst3Plugin::~Vst3Plugin()
{
   #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
    screenWindow.reset();   // the editor goes before the plugin it shows
   #endif

    instance->removeListener (this);
    instance->setPlayHead (nullptr);
    deactivate();
    instance.reset();
}

//==============================================================================
bool Vst3Plugin::saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination)
{
    destination.reset();
    instance->getStateInformation (destination);
    return true;
}

bool Vst3Plugin::loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source)
{
    instance->setStateInformation (source.getData(), static_cast<int> (source.getSize()));
    return true;
}

int Vst3Plugin::findParameter (uint32_t id) const noexcept
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < parameters.size(); ++i)
        if (parameters[i].id == id)
            return static_cast<int> (i);

    return -1;
}

double Vst3Plugin::getParameterValue (int index) const noexcept
{
    return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (hosted.size())) ? hosted[static_cast<size_t> (index)]->getValue() : 0.0;
}

juce::String Vst3Plugin::getParameterText (int index, double value)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (hosted.size())))
        return {};

    auto* parameter = hosted[static_cast<size_t> (index)];
    const auto text = parameter->getText (static_cast<float> (value), 64);
    const auto label = parameter->getLabel();
    return label.isEmpty() || text.endsWith (label) ? text : text + " " + label;
}

double Vst3Plugin::queueParameter (int index, double value)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (hosted.size())))
        return 0.0;

    value = juce::jlimit (0.0, 1.0, value);
    hosted[static_cast<size_t> (index)]->setValueNotifyingHost (static_cast<float> (value));   // JUCE carries it to the audio thread
    return value;
}

void Vst3Plugin::setParameterFromAudio (uint32_t paramId, int& indexHint, double value) noexcept
{
    const auto count = static_cast<int> (parameters.size());

    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (indexHint, count) || parameters[static_cast<size_t> (indexHint)].id != paramId)
    {
        indexHint = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            if (parameters[static_cast<size_t> (i)].id == paramId)
                indexHint = i;

        if (indexHint < 0)
            return;
    }

    // JUCE's VST3 host takes it from the audio thread into the next processBlock.
    hosted[static_cast<size_t> (indexHint)]->setValue (static_cast<float> (juce::jlimit (0.0, 1.0, value)));
}

//==============================================================================
bool Vst3Plugin::activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize)
{
    if (active.load() && juce::exactlyEqual (activeRate, sampleRate) && activeBlockSize >= maxBlockSize)
        return true;

    deactivate();
    instance->setRateAndBufferSizeDetails (sampleRate, maxBlockSize);
    instance->prepareToPlay (sampleRate, maxBlockSize);

    inputChannels = instance->getMainBusNumInputChannels();
    totalInputChannels = instance->getTotalNumInputChannels();
    outputChannels = instance->getTotalNumOutputChannels();

    // Where the sidechain's channels sit in the block the plugin is given.
    sidechainOffset = -1;
    sidechainChannels = 0;

    if (instance->getBusCount (true) > 1)
    {
        if (auto* bus = instance->getBus (true, 1); bus != nullptr && bus->isEnabled() && bus->getNumberOfChannels() > 0)
        {
            sidechainOffset = instance->getChannelIndexInProcessBlockBuffer (true, 1, 0);
            sidechainChannels = juce::jmin (2, bus->getNumberOfChannels());
            prepareSidechain (maxBlockSize);
        }
    }

    buffer.setSize (juce::jmax (2, totalInputChannels, outputChannels), juce::jmax (1, maxBlockSize));
    makesMidi = instance->producesMidi();
    midiOutput.ensureSize (8192);
    midiBuffer.ensureSize (8192);

    activeRate = sampleRate;
    activeBlockSize = maxBlockSize;
    playHead.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    active.store (true);
    return true;
}

void Vst3Plugin::deactivate()
{
    if (active.exchange (false))
        instance->releaseResources();
}

void Vst3Plugin::process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                          int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t* transport) noexcept
{
    // Not ready for this block: effects leave the sound as it is, instruments stay silent.
    if (! active.load (std::memory_order_relaxed) || numSamples <= 0 || numSamples > buffer.getNumSamples())
        return;

    const auto channels = buffer.getNumChannels();

    for (int channel = 0; channel < channels; ++channel)
        buffer.clear (channel, 0, numSamples);

    if (inLeft != nullptr && inputChannels > 0)
        buffer.copyFrom (0, 0, inLeft, numSamples);

    if (inputChannels > 1 && (inRight != nullptr || inLeft != nullptr))
        buffer.copyFrom (1, 0, inRight != nullptr ? inRight : inLeft, numSamples);

    // What tracks send to its sidechain (silence when nothing does).
    if (sidechainChannels > 0 && numSamples <= sidechain.getNumSamples()
        && sidechainOffset + sidechainChannels <= buffer.getNumChannels())
    {
        for (int channel = 0; channel < sidechainChannels; ++channel)
            buffer.copyFrom (sidechainOffset + channel, 0, sidechain, channel, 0, numSamples);
    }

    // A copy: a plugin may change the MIDI it's given.
    midiBuffer.clear();

    if (! midi.isEmpty())
        midiBuffer.addEvents (midi, 0, numSamples, 0);

    playHead.transport = transport;
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> block (buffer.getArrayOfWritePointers(), channels, numSamples);
    instance->processBlock (block, midiBuffer);

    // A plugin that plays notes itself hands them back in the same buffer.
    midiOutput.clear();

    if (makesMidi)
        midiOutput.addEvents (midiBuffer, 0, numSamples, 0);

    if (outLeft != nullptr && outputChannels > 0)
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (outLeft, buffer.getReadPointer (0), numSamples);

    if (outRight != nullptr && outputChannels > 0)
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (outRight, buffer.getReadPointer (outputChannels > 1 ? 1 : 0), numSamples);
}

juce::Optional<juce::AudioPlayHead::PositionInfo> Vst3Plugin::PlayHead::getPosition() const
{
    PositionInfo info;
    info.setTimeInSamples (0);   // VST3 requires it, so it's always given

    if (transport == nullptr)
        return info;

    const auto& t = *transport;
    info.setIsPlaying ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_IS_PLAYING) != 0);
    info.setIsRecording ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_IS_RECORDING) != 0);
    info.setIsLooping ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_IS_LOOP_ACTIVE) != 0);

    if ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_TEMPO) != 0)
        info.setBpm (t.tempo);

    if ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_TIME_SIGNATURE) != 0)
        info.setTimeSignature (TimeSignature { t.tsig_num, t.tsig_denom });

    if ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_BEATS_TIMELINE) != 0)
    {
        info.setPpqPosition (static_cast<double> (t.song_pos_beats) / CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR);
        info.setPpqPositionOfLastBarStart (static_cast<double> (t.bar_start) / CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR);
        info.setBarCount (t.bar_number);
        info.setLoopPoints (LoopPoints { static_cast<double> (t.loop_start_beats) / CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR,
                                         static_cast<double> (t.loop_end_beats) / CLAP_BEATTIME_FACTOR });
    }

    if ((t.flags & CLAP_TRANSPORT_HAS_SECONDS_TIMELINE) != 0)
    {
        const auto seconds = static_cast<double> (t.song_pos_seconds) / CLAP_SECTIME_FACTOR;
        info.setTimeInSeconds (seconds);
        info.setTimeInSamples (static_cast<juce::int64> (std::llround (seconds * sampleRate)));
    }

    return info;
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\Vst3Plugin.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_processors_headless/juce_audio_processors_headless.h>

// With JUCE's GUI in the build (the app), VST3 plugins can show their own windows; the
// headless host (the engine tests) has none.
#if JUCE_MODULE_AVAILABLE_juce_audio_processors && JUCE_MODULE_AVAILABLE_juce_gui_basics
 #include <juce_audio_processors/juce_audio_processors.h>
 #define FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS 1
#else
 #define FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS 0
#endif

#include "Plugin.h"

#include <atomic>

//==============================================================================
/**
    A native VST3 plugin, hosted through JUCE's headless VST3 host (no plugin window
    yet; those come with the plugin screens).

    Audio goes through one buffer sized at activation, so process() never allocates.
    VST3 parameters run from 0 to 1 and keep their VST3 ids, so songs find them again.
    VST3 categories ("Fx|Reverb", "Instrument|Synth") become the same feature words
    WCLAP plugins use, so the Browser sorts both kinds alike.
*/
class Vst3Plugin final : public Plugin,
                         private juce::AudioProcessorListener
{
public:
    static std::unique_ptr<Vst3Plugin> load (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error);
    static std::vector<Descriptor> describe (const juce::File& file, juce::String& error);

    /** Where VST3 plugins are installed (on Windows, Program Files\Common Files\VST3). */
    static juce::FileSearchPath getDefaultFolders();

    /** Lets go of JUCE's VST3 host. Called last at shutdown, when no plugin is left. */
    static void shutdownFormats();

    ~Vst3Plugin() override;

    juce::String getFormatName() const override                          { return "VST3"; }
    const Descriptor& getDescriptor() const noexcept override            { return descriptor; }
    const std::vector<Descriptor>& getPluginsInFile() const noexcept override { return pluginsInFile; }
    const juce::File& getSourceFile() const noexcept override            { return sourceFile; }
    Role getRole() const noexcept override                               { return role; }
    int getMainInputChannels() const noexcept override                   { return inputChannels; }
    bool hasSidechain() const noexcept override                          { return sidechainChannels > 0; }
    bool producesMidi() const noexcept override                          { return makesMidi; }
    int getMainOutputChannels() const noexcept override                  { return outputChannels; }

    bool canSaveState() const noexcept override                          { return true; }
    bool saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination) override;
    bool loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source) override;
    bool consumeStateChanged() noexcept override                         { return stateChanged.exchange (false); }

    const std::vector<Parameter>& getParameters() const noexcept override { return parameters; }
    int findParameter (uint32_t id) const noexcept override;
    double getParameterValue (int index) const noexcept override;
    double readParameterValue (int index) override                       { return getParameterValue (index); }
    juce::String getParameterText (int index, double value) override;
    double queueParameter (int index, double value) override;
    void setParameterFromAudio (uint32_t paramId, int& indexHint, double value) noexcept override;

    bool activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize) override;
    void deactivate() override;
    bool isActive() const noexcept override                              { return active.load(); }

    void process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight, float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                  int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, const clap_event_transport_t* transport) noexcept override;

    ScreenKind getScreenKind() const noexcept override;
    bool showNativeScreen (const juce::String& title) override;
    void hideNativeScreen() override;

private:
   #if FANAN_PLUGIN_WINDOWS
    class ScreenWindow;
    std::unique_ptr<ScreenWindow> screenWindow;   // before instance: it goes first
   #endif

    Vst3Plugin (std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioPluginInstance> instance, const juce::PluginDescription& description,
                std::vector<Descriptor> pluginsInFile, const juce::File& file);

    /** The song's position, tempo and loop, as the plugin asks for them. */
    struct PlayHead final : juce::AudioPlayHead
    {
        const clap_event_transport_t* transport = nullptr;
        double sampleRate = 48000.0;   // VST3 wants the position in samples too
        juce::Optional<PositionInfo> getPosition() const override;
    };

    void audioProcessorParameterChanged (juce::AudioProcessor*, int, float) override   { stateChanged.store (true); }
    void audioProcessorChanged (juce::AudioProcessor*, const ChangeDetails&) override    { stateChanged.store (true); }

    std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioPluginInstance> instance;
    Descriptor descriptor;
    std::vector<Descriptor> pluginsInFile;
    juce::File sourceFile;
    Role role = Role::effect;

    std::vector<Parameter> parameters;
    std::vector<juce::AudioProcessorParameter*> hosted;

    juce::AudioBuffer<float> buffer;
    juce::MidiBuffer midiBuffer;
    PlayHead playHead;
    std::atomic<bool> active { false }, stateChanged { false };
    double activeRate = 0.0;
    int activeBlockSize = 0;
    int inputChannels = 0, outputChannels = 0;   // inputChannels: the main bus
    int totalInputChannels = 0;                  // with the sidechain's
    int sidechainOffset = -1, sidechainChannels = 0;
    bool makesMidi = false;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (Vst3Plugin)
};

# C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\WclapBridge.cmake
#
# Builds WebCLAP's wclap-bridge (loads a WCLAP through Wasmtime and hands back an
# ordinary CLAP plugin factory) as the static library FananWclapBridge.
#
# Everything is downloaded once into <build>/deps at pinned versions - no Git
# needed, nothing installed outside the build folder. On Windows, Wasmtime is
# linked as a DLL and FANAN_WASMTIME_DLL names the file to copy next to the app.

include_guard(GLOBAL)

set(FANAN_WCLAP_BRIDGE_COMMIT "cd11d22afbe2af350f24cd56e6e0536e5ca86452")
set(FANAN_WCLAP_CPP_COMMIT    "4ad30038a25162e18183d28fa293a9e613b6f593")
set(FANAN_CLAP_COMMIT         "29ffcc273be7c7c651f6c9953b99e69700e2387a")   # CLAP 1.2.7, as pinned by wclap-bridge
set(FANAN_WASMTIME_VERSION    "39.0.1")

set(FANAN_DEPS_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/deps")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Download + unpack an archive once. Returns the single top-level folder inside it.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function(fanan_fetch_archive name url sha256 out_var)
    set(dest "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/${name}")
    set(stamp "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/${name}.done")

    if(NOT EXISTS "${stamp}")
        file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${dest}")

        get_filename_component(archive_name "${url}" NAME)
        set(archive "${FANAN_DEPS_DIR}/downloads/${name}-${archive_name}")

        message(STATUS "Downloading ${name}")

        if(sha256)
            file(DOWNLOAD "${url}" "${archive}" STATUS status TLS_VERIFY ON EXPECTED_HASH SHA256=${sha256})
        else()
            file(DOWNLOAD "${url}" "${archive}" STATUS status TLS_VERIFY ON)
        endif()

        list(GET status 0 code)

        if(NOT code EQUAL 0)
            file(REMOVE "${archive}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Download of ${name} failed: ${status}")
        endif()

        file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${archive}" DESTINATION "${dest}")
        file(WRITE "${stamp}" "${url}\n")
    endif()

    file(GLOB children LIST_DIRECTORIES true "${dest}/*")
    list(LENGTH children count)

    if(NOT count EQUAL 1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected layout after unpacking ${name} into ${dest}")
    endif()

    set(${out_var} "${children}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Replace one exact piece of source text. Safe to run on every configure: a file
# that already carries the replacement is left alone.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function(fanan_patch_source file old new)
    file(READ "${file}" content)

    string(FIND "${content}" "${new}" already_patched)

    if(NOT already_patched EQUAL -1)
        return()
    endif()

    string(FIND "${content}" "${old}" found)

    if(found EQUAL -1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Patch target not found in ${file} - the pinned source changed?")
    endif()

    string(REPLACE "${old}" "${new}" content "${content}")
    file(WRITE "${file}" "${content}")
endfunction()

# 1. MSVC crash on the first WCLAP load: the arena was dereferenced and moved inside
#    one braced list. Sequencing the dereference first fixes it (found by pdwclap).
fanan_patch_source("${WCLAP_CPP_DIR}/include/wclap/memory-arena.hpp"
    "return {*arena, std::move(arena)};"
    "Arena &arenaRef = *arena;\n\t\treturn {arenaRef, std::move(arena)};")

# 2. Give the plugin a real host identity and CLAP version. Without it, plugins that
#    check the host version refuse to instantiate (wclap-bridge pull request #8).
fanan_patch_source("${WCLAP_BRIDGE_DIR}/source/_generic/wclap-plugin-factory.h"
    "auto hostPtr = scoped.copyAcross(module.hostTemplate);"
    "auto wclapHost = module.hostTemplate;\n\t\twclapHost.clap_version = WCLAP_VERSION_INIT;\n\t\twclapHost.name = scoped.writeString(host && host->name ? host->name : \"\");\n\t\twclapHost.vendor = scoped.writeString(host && host->vendor ? host->vendor : \"\");\n\t\twclapHost.url = scoped.writeString(host && host->url ? host->url : \"\");\n\t\twclapHost.version = scoped.writeString(host && host->version ? host->version : \"\");\n\t\tauto hostPtr = scoped.copyAcross(wclapHost);")

# 3. Wasmtime's compile cache (turns a 1 s plugin reload into ~20 ms) defaults to the
#    user profile. The app supplies the cache settings instead - a folder next to the
#    executable - through fanan_wasmtime_cache_config(), defined in WclapPlugin.cpp.
#    A null result turns the cache off.
fanan_patch_source("${WCLAP_BRIDGE_DIR}/source/wclap-instance-wasmtime/wclap-instance-wasmtime.cpp"
    "static std::atomic<bool> globalEpochRunning = false;"
    "extern \"C\" const char *fanan_wasmtime_cache_config(void); // provided by Fanan Web Hub\nstatic std::atomic<bool> globalEpochRunning = false;")

fanan_patch_source("${WCLAP_BRIDGE_DIR}/source/wclap-instance-wasmtime/wclap-instance-wasmtime.cpp"
    "auto error = wasmtime_config_cache_config_load(config, nullptr);"
    "const char *fananCacheConfig = fanan_wasmtime_cache_config();\n\tauto error = fananCacheConfig ? wasmtime_config_cache_config_load(config, fananCacheConfig) : nullptr;")

target_include_directories(FananWclapBridge
    PUBLIC
        "${WCLAP_BRIDGE_DIR}/include"
        "${FANAN_CLAP_DIR}/include"
    PRIVATE
        "${WCLAP_CPP_DIR}/include"
        "${WASMTIME_DIR}/include"
        # Stand-in for the webview-gui module: the Hub shows plugin UIs in its own web view.
        "${FANAN_WEBVIEW_STUB_DIR}")

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(FananWclapBridge PRIVATE /bigobj)
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(FananWclapBridge PRIVATE -Wno-changes-meaning)
endif()

if(WIN32)
    # Linked as a DLL: the static wasmtime.lib is a known source of runtime crashes on Windows.
    target_link_libraries(FananWclapBridge PUBLIC "${WASMTIME_DIR}/lib/wasmtime.dll.lib")
    set(FANAN_WASMTIME_DLL "${WASMTIME_DIR}/lib/wasmtime.dll")
elseif(APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(FananWclapBridge PUBLIC "${WASMTIME_DIR}/lib/libwasmtime.a")
else()
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(FananWclapBridge PUBLIC "${WASMTIME_DIR}/lib/libwasmtime.a" Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} m)
endif()

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\WclapPlugin.cpp

#include "WclapPlugin.h"

#include "wclap-bridge.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>

#ifndef JUCE_APPLICATION_VERSION_STRING
 #define JUCE_APPLICATION_VERSION_STRING "0.0.0"
#endif

namespace
{
    //==============================================================================
    // A single WCLAP call running longer than this is stopped by the engine, so a plugin
    // stuck in a loop can't freeze the audio thread. Wasmtime quotes about 10% speed cost.
    constexpr unsigned int callTimeLimitMs = 1000;

    std::mutex engineMutex;
    bool engineStarted = false;
    std::string compileCacheConfig;

    // Wasmtime keeps compiled plugins in a cache, so reloading one is near-instant.
    // It lives next to the executable, like everything else the pilot writes.
    void prepareCompileCache()
    {
        const auto folder = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile).getParentDirectory();
        const auto cacheFolder = folder.getChildFile ("FananWebHub-wasmtime-cache");
        const auto configFile = folder.getChildFile ("FananWebHub-wasmtime.toml");

        const auto quotedPath = "\"" + cacheFolder.getFullPathName().replace ("\\", "\\\\").replace ("\"", "\\\"") + "\"";

        if (cacheFolder.createDirectory() && configFile.replaceWithText ("[cache]\ndirectory = " + quotedPath + "\n"))
            compileCacheConfig = configFile.getFullPathName().toStdString();
        else
            compileCacheConfig.clear();   // no cache rather than one outside the build folder
    }

    bool startEngine()
    {
        const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock (engineMutex);

        if (! engineStarted)
        {
            prepareCompileCache();
            engineStarted = wclap_global_init (callTimeLimitMs);
        }

        return engineStarted;
    }

    //==============================================================================
    // Text coming from a plugin or an archive: stops at the terminator or the buffer end,
    // and never trusts it to be valid UTF-8.
    juce::String fromFixed (const char* text, size_t capacity)
    {
        if (text == nullptr)
            return {};

        size_t length = 0;

        while (length < capacity && text[length] != 0)
            ++length;

        if (juce::CharPointer_UTF8::isValidString (text, static_cast<int> (length)))
            return juce::String::fromUTF8 (text, static_cast<int> (length));

        std::string cleaned (text, length);

        for (auto& c : cleaned)
            if (static_cast<unsigned char> (c) > 127)
                c = '?';

        return juce::String (cleaned);
    }

    juce::String fromPlugin (const char* text)
    {
        return fromFixed (text, 4096);
    }

    bool isAscii (const juce::String& text)
    {
        for (const auto c : text.toStdString())
            if (static_cast<unsigned char> (c) > 127)
                return false;

        return true;
    }

    juce::String makeSafeName (const juce::String& name)
    {
        juce::String result;

        for (const auto c : name.toStdString())
        {
            const bool keep = (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
                              || c == '.' || c == '-' || c == '_';
            result << (keep ? juce::String::charToString (static_cast<juce::juce_wchar> (c)) : juce::String ("_"));
        }

        return result.isEmpty() ? juce::String ("plugin") : result;
    }

    juce::File getBundleCache()
    {
        // Next to the executable, so the pilot writes nothing outside its build folder.
        return juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::currentExecutableFile)
                   .getSiblingFile ("FananWebHub-plugins");
    }

    //==============================================================================
    // Minimal .tar.gz reader for .wclap.tar.gz bundles.
    bool readFully (juce::InputStream& in, void* destination, juce::int64 numBytes)
    {
        auto* bytes = static_cast<char*> (destination);

        while (numBytes > 0)
        {
            const auto chunk = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin<juce::int64> (numBytes, 1 << 20));
            const auto got = in.read (bytes, chunk);

            if (got <= 0)
                return false;

            bytes += got;
            numBytes -= got;
        }

        return true;
    }

    juce::int64 parseOctal (const char* field, int length)
    {
        juce::int64 value = 0;
        int i = 0;

        while (i < length && field[i] == ' ')
            ++i;

        for (; i < length && field[i] >= '0' && field[i] <= '7'; ++i)
            value = value * 8 + (field[i] - '0');

        return value;
    }

    // pax records look like "<length> <key>=<value>\n". Values of other keys can be binary
    // (macOS stores extended attributes there), so only the path record is decoded.
    juce::String pathFromPaxHeader (const juce::MemoryBlock& data)
    {
        const auto* bytes = static_cast<const char*> (data.getData());
        const auto size = data.getSize();
        size_t position = 0;

        while (position < size)
        {
            size_t recordLength = 0;
            auto cursor = position;

            while (cursor < size && bytes[cursor] >= '0' && bytes[cursor] <= '9')
                recordLength = recordLength * 10 + static_cast<size_t> (bytes[cursor++] - '0');

            if (recordLength == 0 || cursor >= size || bytes[cursor] != ' ' || position + recordLength > size)
                break;

            const auto* keyValue = bytes + cursor + 1;
            const auto keyValueLength = position + recordLength - (cursor + 1);   // includes the newline

            if (keyValueLength > 6 && std::memcmp (keyValue, "path=", 5) == 0)
                return fromFixed (keyValue + 5, keyValueLength - 6);

            position += recordLength;
        }

        return {};
    }

    bool isSafeRelativePath (const juce::String& path)
    {
        if (path.isEmpty() || path.startsWithChar ('/') || path.containsChar ('\\') || path.containsChar (':'))
            return false;

        for (const auto& part : juce::StringArray::fromTokens (path, "/", ""))
            if (part == "..")
                return false;

        return true;
    }

    bool isMacMetadata (const juce::String& path)
    {
        for (const auto& part : juce::StringArray::fromTokens (path, "/", ""))
            if (part.startsWith ("._") || part == "__MACOSX" || part == ".DS_Store")
                return true;

        return false;
    }

    bool extractTarGz (const juce::File& archive, const juce::File& destination, juce::String& error)
    {
        constexpr juce::int64 maxTotalBytes = juce::int64 { 512 } * 1024 * 1024;

        juce::FileInputStream fileStream (archive);

        if (! fileStream.openedOk())
        {
            error = "Couldn't open " + archive.getFileName() + ".";
            return false;
        }

        juce::GZIPDecompressorInputStream tar (&fileStream, false, juce::GZIPDecompressorInputStream::gzipFormat);

        destination.deleteRecursively();

        if (! destination.createDirectory())
        {
            error = "Couldn't create " + destination.getFullPathName() + ".";
            return false;
        }

        juce::int64 totalBytes = 0;
        juce::String pendingName;
        int filesWritten = 0;
        char header[512];

        while (readFully (tar, header, 512))
        {
            if (std::all_of (header, header + 512, [] (char c) { return c == 0; }))
                break;   // end-of-archive marker

            const auto size = parseOctal (header + 124, 12);
            const auto type = header[156];
            totalBytes += size;

            if (size < 0 || totalBytes > maxTotalBytes)
            {
                error = archive.getFileName() + " is too large to unpack.";
                return false;
            }

            juce::MemoryBlock content;

            if (size > 0)
            {
                content.setSize (static_cast<size_t> (size));
                char padding[512];
                const auto paddingBytes = (512 - size % 512) % 512;

                if (! readFully (tar, content.getData(), size) || ! readFully (tar, padding, paddingBytes))
                {
                    error = archive.getFileName() + " is damaged or incomplete.";
                    return false;
                }
            }

            if (type == 'L')   // GNU long name for the next entry
            {
                pendingName = fromFixed (static_cast<const char*> (content.getData()), content.getSize());
                continue;
            }

            if (type == 'x')   // pax header: may carry a long path for the next entry
            {
                const auto paxPath = pathFromPaxHeader (content);

                if (paxPath.isNotEmpty())
                    pendingName = paxPath;

                continue;
            }

            if (type == 'g')
                continue;

            auto name = pendingName;
            pendingName.clear();

            if (name.isEmpty())
            {
                name = fromFixed (header, 100);

                if (std::memcmp (header + 257, "ustar", 5) == 0)
                {
                    const auto prefix = fromFixed (header + 345, 155);

                    if (prefix.isNotEmpty())
                        name = prefix + "/" + name;
                }
            }

            while (name.startsWith ("./"))
                name = name.substring (2);

            name = name.trimCharactersAtEnd ("/");

            if (name.isEmpty() || name == ".")
                continue;

            if (! isSafeRelativePath (name))
            {
                error = archive.getFileName() + " contains an unsafe path (" + name + ").";
                return false;
            }

            if (isMacMetadata (name))
                continue;

            const auto target = destination.getChildFile (name);

            if (type == '5')
            {
                target.createDirectory();
                continue;
            }

            if (type != '0' && type != 0)
                continue;   // links and special files are not needed by a plugin bundle

            target.getParentDirectory().createDirectory();

            if (! target.replaceWithData (content.getData(), content.getSize()))
            {
                error = "Couldn't write " + target.getFullPathName() + ".";
                return false;
            }

            ++filesWritten;
        }

        if (filesWritten == 0)
        {
            error = archive.getFileName() + " isn't a .tar.gz bundle.";
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    //==============================================================================
    // The bridge opens files with narrow-character paths, so anything outside plain ASCII
    // is copied into the plugin cache first.
    juce::File ensureAsciiPath (const juce::File& location, juce::String& error)
    {
        if (isAscii (location.getFullPathName()))
            return location;

        const auto copy = getBundleCache().getChildFile (makeSafeName (location.getFileName()));
        copy.deleteRecursively();
        getBundleCache().createDirectory();

        const bool copied = location.isDirectory() ? location.copyDirectoryTo (copy) : location.copyFileTo (copy);

        if (! copied)
        {
            error = "Couldn't copy the plugin to " + copy.getFullPathName() + ".";
            return {};
        }

        return copy;
    }

    juce::File prepareLocation (const juce::File& chosen, juce::String& error)
    {
        const auto fileName = chosen.getFileName();
        const auto lowerName = fileName.toLowerCase();

        if (lowerName.endsWith (".tar.gz") || lowerName.endsWith (".tgz"))
        {
            const auto baseName = fileName.dropLastCharacters (lowerName.endsWith (".tgz") ? 4 : 7);
            const auto destination = getBundleCache().getChildFile (makeSafeName (baseName));

            if (! extractTarGz (chosen, destination, error))
                return {};

            if (destination.getChildFile ("module.wasm").existsAsFile())
                return destination;

            // Some bundles wrap everything in a single folder.
            const auto folders = destination.findChildFiles (juce::File::findDirectories, false);

            if (folders.size() == 1 && folders.getFirst().getChildFile ("module.wasm").existsAsFile())
                return folders.getFirst();

            error = fileName + " has no module.wasm inside.";
            return {};
        }

        if (chosen.isDirectory())
        {
            if (chosen.getChildFile ("module.wasm").existsAsFile())
                return ensureAsciiPath (chosen, error);

            error = fileName + " has no module.wasm inside.";
            return {};
        }

        if (! chosen.existsAsFile())
        {
            error = fileName + " doesn't exist.";
            return {};
        }

        // module.wasm picked from inside a .wclap folder: open the whole folder, so the
        // plugin can reach its own resources.
        if (lowerName == "module.wasm")
            return ensureAsciiPath (chosen.getParentDirectory(), error);

        return ensureAsciiPath (chosen, error);
    }

    //==============================================================================
    clap_event_header_t makeHeader (uint32_t size, int time, uint16_t type) noexcept
    {
        clap_event_header_t header {};
        header.size = size;
        header.time = static_cast<uint32_t> (time);
        header.space_id = CLAP_CORE_EVENT_SPACE_ID;
        header.type = type;
        header.flags = 0;
        return header;
    }
}
