// Called by the patched wclap-bridge while the engine starts (see WclapBridge.cmake).
extern "C" const char* fanan_wasmtime_cache_config (void);

extern "C" const char* fanan_wasmtime_cache_config (void)
{
    return compileCacheConfig.empty() ? nullptr : compileCacheConfig.c_str();
}

//==============================================================================
std::unique_ptr<WclapPlugin> WclapPlugin::load (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error)
{
    error.clear();

    if (! startEngine())
    {
        error = "The WebAssembly engine couldn't start.";
        return nullptr;
    }

    const auto location = prepareLocation (file, error);

    if (location == juce::File())
        return nullptr;

    std::unique_ptr<WclapPlugin> result (new WclapPlugin());
    result->sourceFile = file;

    if (! result->initialise (location, pluginId, error))
        return nullptr;

    return result;
}

void WclapPlugin::shutdownEngine()
{
    const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock (engineMutex);

    if (engineStarted)
    {
        wclap_global_deinit();
        engineStarted = false;
    }
}

WclapPlugin::~WclapPlugin()
{
    if (plugin != nullptr)
    {
        if (initialised)
            deactivate();

        plugin->destroy (plugin);
        plugin = nullptr;
    }

    if (module != nullptr)
    {
        wclap_close (module);
        module = nullptr;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
bool WclapPlugin::initialise (const juce::File& location, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error)
{
    const auto displayName = sourceFile.getFileName();

    module = wclap_open (location.getFullPathName().toRawUTF8());

    if (module == nullptr)
    {
        error = displayName + " couldn't be read as a WCLAP.";
        return false;
    }

    juce::String bridgeError;

    if (getError (bridgeError))
    {
        error = displayName + ": " + bridgeError;
        return false;
    }

    factory = static_cast<const clap_plugin_factory_t*> (wclap_get_factory (module, CLAP_PLUGIN_FACTORY_ID));

    if (factory == nullptr)
    {
        error = displayName + " has no CLAP plugin factory.";
        return false;
    }

    const clap_plugin_descriptor_t* chosen = nullptr;
    const auto count = factory->get_plugin_count (factory);

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        const auto* desc = factory->get_plugin_descriptor (factory, i);

        if (desc == nullptr || desc->id == nullptr)
            continue;

        Descriptor info;
        info.id = fromPlugin (desc->id);
        info.name = fromPlugin (desc->name != nullptr ? desc->name : desc->id);
        info.vendor = fromPlugin (desc->vendor);
        info.version = fromPlugin (desc->version);

        for (auto* const* feature = desc->features; feature != nullptr && *feature != nullptr; ++feature)
            info.features.add (fromPlugin (*feature));

        pluginsInFile.push_back (info);

        if (chosen == nullptr && (pluginId.isEmpty() || info.id == pluginId))
        {
            chosen = desc;
            descriptor = info;
        }
    }

    if (pluginsInFile.empty())
    {
        error = displayName + " contains no plugins.";
        return false;
    }

    if (chosen == nullptr)
    {
        error = displayName + " doesn't contain " + pluginId + ".";
        return false;
    }

    host.clap_version = CLAP_VERSION;
    host.host_data = this;
    host.name = "Fanan Web Hub";
    host.vendor = "Fanan";
    host.url = "";
    host.version = JUCE_APPLICATION_VERSION_STRING;
    host.get_extension = hostGetExtension;
    host.request_restart = hostRequestRestart;
    host.request_process = hostRequestProcess;
    host.request_callback = hostRequestCallback;

    plugin = factory->create_plugin (factory, &host, chosen->id);

    if (plugin == nullptr)
    {
        error = descriptor.name + " couldn't be created.";

        if (getError (bridgeError))
            error << " " << bridgeError;

        return false;
    }

    if (! plugin->init (plugin))
    {
        error = descriptor.name + " failed to start.";

        if (getError (bridgeError))
            error << " " << bridgeError;

        return false;
    }

    initialised = true;

    paramsExt = static_cast<const clap_plugin_params_t*> (plugin->get_extension (plugin, CLAP_EXT_PARAMS));
    stateExt = static_cast<const clap_plugin_state_t*> (plugin->get_extension (plugin, CLAP_EXT_STATE));
    audioPortsExt = static_cast<const clap_plugin_audio_ports_t*> (plugin->get_extension (plugin, CLAP_EXT_AUDIO_PORTS));
    notePortsExt = static_cast<const clap_plugin_note_ports_t*> (plugin->get_extension (plugin, CLAP_EXT_NOTE_PORTS));
    webviewExt = static_cast<const clap_plugin_webview_t*> (plugin->get_extension (plugin, CLAP_EXT_WEBVIEW));
    guiExt = static_cast<const clap_plugin_gui_t*> (plugin->get_extension (plugin, CLAP_EXT_GUI));

    events.resize (static_cast<size_t> (maxEvents));
    inputEvents.ctx = this;
    inputEvents.size = inputEventsSize;
    inputEvents.get = inputEventsGet;
    outputEvents.ctx = this;
    outputEvents.try_push = outputEventsTryPush;

    scanPorts();
    rescanParameters();

    return true;
}

void WclapPlugin::scanPorts()
{
    inputPorts.clear();
    outputPorts.clear();
    mainInputPort = -1;
    mainOutputPort = -1;

    if (audioPortsExt != nullptr)
    {
        for (const bool isInput : { true, false })
        {
            auto& ports = isInput ? inputPorts : outputPorts;
            auto& mainPort = isInput ? mainInputPort : mainOutputPort;
            const auto count = juce::jmin (audioPortsExt->count (plugin, isInput), 16u);

            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            {
                clap_audio_port_info_t info {};
                Port port;

                if (audioPortsExt->get (plugin, i, isInput, &info))
                    port.channels = static_cast<int> (juce::jmin (info.channel_count, 32u));

                ports.push_back (std::move (port));

                if (mainPort < 0 && (info.flags & CLAP_AUDIO_PORT_IS_MAIN) != 0)
                    mainPort = static_cast<int> (i);
            }

            if (mainPort < 0 && ! ports.empty())
                mainPort = 0;
        }
    }
    else if (! descriptor.features.contains (CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_NOTE_EFFECT))
    {
        // CLAP requires the audio-ports extension, but plugins without it usually still
        // expect a stereo pair.
        Port output;
        output.channels = 2;
        outputPorts.push_back (std::move (output));
        mainOutputPort = 0;

        if (descriptor.features.contains (CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_AUDIO_EFFECT))
        {
            Port input;
            input.channels = 2;
            inputPorts.push_back (std::move (input));
            mainInputPort = 0;
        }
    }

    mainInputChannels = mainInputPort >= 0 ? inputPorts[static_cast<size_t> (mainInputPort)].channels : 0;

    // A second input port is a sidechain (a compressor's key input, say): tracks can send to it.
    sidechainPort = -1;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < inputPorts.size(); ++i)
        if (static_cast<int> (i) != mainInputPort && inputPorts[i].channels > 0 && sidechainPort < 0)
            sidechainPort = static_cast<int> (i);
    mainOutputChannels = mainOutputPort >= 0 ? outputPorts[static_cast<size_t> (mainOutputPort)].channels : 0;

    hasNoteInput = false;
    hasNoteOutput = notePortsExt != nullptr && notePortsExt->count (plugin, false) > 0;

    if (notePortsExt != nullptr && notePortsExt->count (plugin, true) > 0)
    {
        clap_note_port_info_t info {};

        if (notePortsExt->get (plugin, 0, true, &info))
        {
            hasNoteInput = true;
            notePortIndex = 0;
            sendClapNotes = (info.supported_dialects & CLAP_NOTE_DIALECT_CLAP) != 0;
            sendMidi = (info.supported_dialects & CLAP_NOTE_DIALECT_MIDI) != 0;

            if (! sendClapNotes && ! sendMidi)
                sendClapNotes = true;
        }
    }

    // The plugin's own features decide first: some instruments also declare an audio input.
    if (mainOutputChannels == 0)
        role = Role::noAudio;
    else if (descriptor.features.contains (CLAP_PLUGIN_FEATURE_INSTRUMENT) || mainInputChannels == 0)
        role = Role::instrument;
    else
        role = Role::effect;
}

//==============================================================================
bool WclapPlugin::activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize)
{
    if (! initialised || sampleRate <= 0.0)
        return false;

    const auto frames = juce::jmax (maxBlockSize, 256);

    if (active.load() && juce::exactlyEqual (sampleRate, currentSampleRate) && frames <= maxFrames)
        return true;

    deactivate();

    maxFrames = frames;
    allocateBuffers();
    midiOutput.ensureSize (8192);

    if (sidechainPort >= 0)
        prepareSidechain (maxBlockSize);

    if (! plugin->activate (plugin, sampleRate, 1, static_cast<uint32_t> (maxFrames)))
        return false;

    currentSampleRate = sampleRate;
    steadyTime = 0;
    active.store (true);
    return true;
}

void WclapPlugin::deactivate()
{
    stopProcessing();

    if (active.exchange (false))
        plugin->deactivate (plugin);
}

void WclapPlugin::stopProcessing()
{
    if (processing.exchange (false))
        plugin->stop_processing (plugin);

    for (auto& channel : heldNotes)
        channel = {};
}

void WclapPlugin::allocateBuffers()
{
    const auto setUp = [this] (std::vector<Port>& ports, std::vector<clap_audio_buffer_t>& buffers)
    {
        buffers.clear();

        for (auto& port : ports)
        {
            port.storage.assign (static_cast<size_t> (port.channels), std::vector<float> (static_cast<size_t> (maxFrames), 0.0f));
            port.pointers.clear();

            for (auto& channel : port.storage)
                port.pointers.push_back (channel.data());

            clap_audio_buffer_t buffer {};
            buffer.data32 = port.pointers.empty() ? nullptr : port.pointers.data();
            buffer.data64 = nullptr;
            buffer.channel_count = static_cast<uint32_t> (port.channels);
            buffer.latency = 0;
            buffer.constant_mask = 0;
            buffers.push_back (buffer);
        }
    };

    setUp (inputPorts, inputBuffers);
    setUp (outputPorts, outputBuffers);
}

//==============================================================================
void WclapPlugin::process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight,
                           float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                           int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi,
                           const clap_event_transport_t* transport) noexcept
{
    // The notes it plays in this block (an arpeggiator's), collected as it puts them out.
    midiOutput.clear();
    inProcess = true;
    const juce::ScopeGuard notProcessing { [this] { inProcess = false; } };

    const auto clearOutputs = [&]
    {
        if (outLeft != nullptr)
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (outLeft, numSamples);

        if (outRight != nullptr && outRight != outLeft)
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (outRight, numSamples);
    };

    const auto frames = juce::jmin (numSamples, maxFrames);

    if (frames <= 0 || ! active.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
    {
        clearOutputs();
        return;
    }

    if (! processing.load (std::memory_order_relaxed))
    {
        if (! plugin->start_processing (plugin))
        {
            processErrorSeen.store (true);
            clearOutputs();
            return;
        }

        processing.store (true);
    }

    // Inputs: the engine's stereo signal goes to the main port, other ports get silence.
    for (size_t portIndex = 0; portIndex < inputPorts.size(); ++portIndex)
    {
        auto& port = inputPorts[portIndex];
        const bool isMain = static_cast<int> (portIndex) == mainInputPort;

        for (int channel = 0; channel < port.channels; ++channel)
        {
            auto* destination = port.pointers[static_cast<size_t> (channel)];
            const float* source = nullptr;

            if (isMain)
                source = channel == 0 ? inLeft : (channel == 1 ? (inRight != nullptr ? inRight : inLeft) : nullptr);
            else if (static_cast<int> (portIndex) == sidechainPort && frames <= sidechain.getNumSamples())
                source = sidechain.getReadPointer (juce::jmin (channel, 1));   // what tracks send to it

            if (source == nullptr)
            {
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (destination, frames);
            }
            else if (isMain && port.channels == 1 && inRight != nullptr && inRight != inLeft)
            {
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::copyWithMultiply (destination, inLeft, 0.5f, frames);
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::addWithMultiply (destination, inRight, 0.5f, frames);
            }
            else
            {
                juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (destination, source, frames);
            }
        }
    }

    for (auto& port : outputPorts)
        for (auto* channel : port.pointers)
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (channel, frames);

    buildInputEvents (midi, frames);

    clap_process_t processData {};
    processData.steady_time = steadyTime;
    processData.frames_count = static_cast<uint32_t> (frames);
    processData.transport = transport;
    processData.audio_inputs = inputBuffers.empty() ? nullptr : inputBuffers.data();
    processData.audio_inputs_count = static_cast<uint32_t> (inputBuffers.size());
    processData.audio_outputs = outputBuffers.empty() ? nullptr : outputBuffers.data();
    processData.audio_outputs_count = static_cast<uint32_t> (outputBuffers.size());
    processData.in_events = &inputEvents;
    processData.out_events = &outputEvents;

    const auto status = plugin->process (plugin, &processData);
    steadyTime += frames;
    numEvents = 0;

    if (status == CLAP_PROCESS_ERROR)
    {
        processErrorSeen.store (true);
        clearOutputs();
        return;
    }

    if (mainOutputPort < 0 || outLeft == nullptr)
    {
        clearOutputs();
        return;
    }

    const auto& port = outputPorts[static_cast<size_t> (mainOutputPort)];
    const float* left = port.channels > 0 ? port.pointers[0] : nullptr;
    const float* right = port.channels > 1 ? port.pointers[1] : left;

    if (left != nullptr)
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (outLeft, left, frames);
    else
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (outLeft, frames);

    if (outRight != nullptr && outRight != outLeft)
    {
        if (right != nullptr)
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::copy (outRight, right, frames);
        else
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (outRight, frames);
    }

    if (frames < numSamples)
    {
        juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (outLeft + frames, numSamples - frames);

        if (outRight != nullptr && outRight != outLeft)
            juce::FloatVectorOperations::clear (outRight + frames, numSamples - frames);
    }
}

//==============================================================================
bool WclapPlugin::pushEvent (const EventSlot& slot) noexcept
{
    if (numEvents >= maxEvents)
        return false;

    events[static_cast<size_t> (numEvents++)] = slot;
    return true;
}

void WclapPlugin::addParameterEvent (int index, double value) noexcept
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (parameters.size())))
        return;

    const auto& parameter = parameters[static_cast<size_t> (index)];

    EventSlot slot {};
    slot.param.header = makeHeader (static_cast<uint32_t> (sizeof (clap_event_param_value_t)), 0, CLAP_EVENT_PARAM_VALUE);
    slot.param.param_id = parameter.id;
    slot.param.cookie = parameter.cookie;
    slot.param.note_id = -1;
    slot.param.port_index = -1;
    slot.param.channel = -1;
    slot.param.key = -1;
    slot.param.value = value;
    pushEvent (slot);
}

void WclapPlugin::addParameterEvents() noexcept
{
    int start1 = 0, size1 = 0, start2 = 0, size2 = 0;
    const auto ready = paramFifo.getNumReady();
    paramFifo.prepareToRead (ready, start1, size1, start2, size2);

    for (int i = 0; i < size1; ++i)
        addParameterEvent (paramQueue[static_cast<size_t> (start1 + i)].index, paramQueue[static_cast<size_t> (start1 + i)].value);

    for (int i = 0; i < size2; ++i)
        addParameterEvent (paramQueue[static_cast<size_t> (start2 + i)].index, paramQueue[static_cast<size_t> (start2 + i)].value);

    paramFifo.finishedRead (size1 + size2);

    // Automation's changes come last: they win over a knob moved in the same block.
    for (int i = 0; i < numAutomationChanges; ++i)
        addParameterEvent (automationChanges[static_cast<size_t> (i)].index, automationChanges[static_cast<size_t> (i)].value);

    numAutomationChanges = 0;
}

void WclapPlugin::setParameterFromAudio (uint32_t paramId, int& indexHint, double value) noexcept
{
    const auto count = static_cast<int> (parameters.size());

    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (indexHint, count) || parameters[static_cast<size_t> (indexHint)].id != paramId)
    {
        indexHint = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            if (parameters[static_cast<size_t> (i)].id == paramId)
                indexHint = i;

        if (indexHint < 0)
            return;
    }

    const auto& parameter = parameters[static_cast<size_t> (indexHint)];
    value = juce::jlimit (parameter.minValue, parameter.maxValue, value);

    if (parameter.stepped)
        value = std::round (value);

    parameterValues[static_cast<size_t> (indexHint)].store (value);

    if (numAutomationChanges < automationQueueSize)
        automationChanges[static_cast<size_t> (numAutomationChanges++)] = { indexHint, value };
}

void WclapPlugin::addNoteEvent (uint16_t type, int time, int channel, int key, double velocity) noexcept
{
    auto& word = heldNotes[static_cast<size_t> (channel)][static_cast<size_t> (key >> 6)];
    const auto bit = juce::uint64 { 1 } << (key & 63);

    if (type == CLAP_EVENT_NOTE_ON)
        word |= bit;
    else
        word &= ~bit;

    EventSlot slot {};
    slot.note.header = makeHeader (static_cast<uint32_t> (sizeof (clap_event_note_t)), time, type);
    slot.note.note_id = -1;
    slot.note.port_index = static_cast<int16_t> (notePortIndex);
    slot.note.channel = static_cast<int16_t> (channel);
    slot.note.key = static_cast<int16_t> (key);
    slot.note.velocity = velocity;
    pushEvent (slot);
}

void WclapPlugin::releaseHeldNotes (int time, int channel) noexcept
{
    for (int key = 0; key < 128; ++key)
        if (((heldNotes[static_cast<size_t> (channel)][static_cast<size_t> (key >> 6)] >> (key & 63)) & 1u) != 0)
            addNoteEvent (CLAP_EVENT_NOTE_OFF, time, channel, key, 0.0);
}

void WclapPlugin::buildInputEvents (const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, int numFrames) noexcept
{
    numEvents = 0;
    addParameterEvents();

    if (! hasNoteInput)
        return;

    for (const auto metadata : midi)
    {
        const auto size = metadata.numBytes;

        if (size < 1 || size > 3)
            continue;   // SysEx is not forwarded

        const auto* data = metadata.data;
        const auto time = juce::jlimit (0, numFrames - 1, metadata.samplePosition);
        const auto status = data[0] & 0xf0;
        const auto channel = data[0] & 0x0f;

        if (sendClapNotes && size == 3)
        {
            const auto key = data[1] & 0x7f;
            const auto value = data[2] & 0x7f;

            if (status == 0x90 && value > 0)
            {
                addNoteEvent (CLAP_EVENT_NOTE_ON, time, channel, key, value / 127.0);
                continue;
            }

            if (status == 0x80 || status == 0x90)
            {
                addNoteEvent (CLAP_EVENT_NOTE_OFF, time, channel, key, status == 0x80 ? value / 127.0 : 0.0);
                continue;
            }

            if (status == 0xb0 && (key == 120 || key == 123))
                releaseHeldNotes (time, channel);
        }

        if (sendMidi)
        {
            EventSlot slot {};
            slot.midi.header = makeHeader (static_cast<uint32_t> (sizeof (clap_event_midi_t)), time, CLAP_EVENT_MIDI);
            slot.midi.port_index = static_cast<uint16_t> (notePortIndex);

            for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i)
                slot.midi.data[i] = data[i];

            pushEvent (slot);
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void WclapPlugin::rescanParameters()
{
    parameters.clear();
    parameterLookup.clear();

    if (paramsExt != nullptr)
    {
        const auto count = juce::jmin (paramsExt->count (plugin), 4096u);

        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            clap_param_info_t info {};

            if (! paramsExt->get_info (plugin, i, &info))
                continue;

            Parameter parameter;
            parameter.id = info.id;
            parameter.cookie = info.cookie;
            parameter.name = fromFixed (info.name, CLAP_NAME_SIZE);
            parameter.minValue = info.min_value;
            parameter.maxValue = juce::jmax (info.max_value, info.min_value);
            parameter.defaultValue = juce::jlimit (parameter.minValue, parameter.maxValue, info.default_value);
            parameter.stepped = (info.flags & CLAP_PARAM_IS_STEPPED) != 0;
            parameter.hidden = (info.flags & CLAP_PARAM_IS_HIDDEN) != 0;
            parameter.readOnly = (info.flags & CLAP_PARAM_IS_READONLY) != 0;
            parameters.push_back (parameter);
        }
    }

    parameterValues.reset (new std::atomic<double>[juce::jmax<size_t> (parameters.size(), 1)]);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < parameters.size(); ++i)
    {
        auto value = parameters[i].defaultValue;

        if (paramsExt != nullptr && ! paramsExt->get_value (plugin, parameters[i].id, &value))
            value = parameters[i].defaultValue;

        parameterValues[i].store (value);
        parameterLookup.emplace_back (parameters[i].id, static_cast<int> (i));
    }

    std::sort (parameterLookup.begin(), parameterLookup.end());
    paramFifo.reset();
}

int WclapPlugin::findParameterIndex (clap_id id) const noexcept
{
    const auto found = std::lower_bound (parameterLookup.begin(), parameterLookup.end(), std::make_pair (id, 0),
                                         [] (const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.first < b.first; });

    return found != parameterLookup.end() && found->first == id ? found->second : -1;
}

double WclapPlugin::getParameterValue (int index) const noexcept
{
    return juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (parameters.size()))
               ? parameterValues[static_cast<size_t> (index)].load()
               : 0.0;
}

juce::String WclapPlugin::getParameterText (int index, double value)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (parameters.size())))
        return {};

    const auto& parameter = parameters[static_cast<size_t> (index)];

    if (paramsExt != nullptr && paramsExt->value_to_text != nullptr)
    {
        char text[128] = {};

        if (paramsExt->value_to_text (plugin, parameter.id, value, text, static_cast<uint32_t> (sizeof (text))))
            return fromFixed (text, sizeof (text));
    }

    return parameter.stepped ? juce::String (juce::roundToInt (value)) : juce::String (value, 3);
}

double WclapPlugin::queueParameter (int index, double value)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (parameters.size())))
        return 0.0;

    const auto& parameter = parameters[static_cast<size_t> (index)];
    value = juce::jlimit (parameter.minValue, parameter.maxValue, value);

    if (parameter.stepped)
        value = std::round (value);

    parameterValues[static_cast<size_t> (index)].store (value);

    int start1 = 0, size1 = 0, start2 = 0, size2 = 0;
    paramFifo.prepareToWrite (1, start1, size1, start2, size2);

    if (size1 > 0)
    {
        paramQueue[static_cast<size_t> (start1)] = { index, value };
        paramFifo.finishedWrite (1);
    }

    return value;
}

void WclapPlugin::flushQueuedParameters()
{
    numEvents = 0;
    addParameterEvents();

    if (numEvents > 0 && paramsExt != nullptr && paramsExt->flush != nullptr)
        paramsExt->flush (plugin, &inputEvents, &outputEvents);

    numEvents = 0;
}

//==============================================================================
WclapPlugin::Requests WclapPlugin::takeRequests() noexcept
{
    Requests requests;
    requests.callback = callbackRequested.exchange (false);
    requests.rescan = rescanRequested.exchange (false);
    requests.restart = restartRequested.exchange (false);
    requests.flush = flushRequested.exchange (false);
    requests.processError = processErrorSeen.exchange (false);
    return requests;
}

void WclapPlugin::runOnMainThread()
{
    if (initialised)
        plugin->on_main_thread (plugin);
}

bool WclapPlugin::getError (juce::String& message) const
{
    if (module == nullptr)
        return false;

    char text[512] = {};

    if (! wclap_get_error (module, text, static_cast<uint32_t> (sizeof (text))))
        return false;

    message = fromFixed (text, sizeof (text));
    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
const void* CLAP_ABI WclapPlugin::hostGetExtension (const clap_host_t*, const char* extensionId)
{
    static const clap_host_log_t logExtension { hostLog };
    static const clap_host_params_t paramsExtension { hostParamsRescan, hostParamsClear, hostParamsRequestFlush };
    static const clap_host_note_ports_t notePortsExtension { hostNotePortsDialects, hostNotePortsRescan };
    static const clap_host_state_t stateExtension { hostStateMarkDirty };
    static const clap_host_latency_t latencyExtension { hostLatencyChanged };
    static const clap_host_webview_t webviewExtension { hostWebviewSend };

    if (extensionId == nullptr)
        return nullptr;

    if (std::strcmp (extensionId, CLAP_EXT_LOG) == 0)          return &logExtension;
    if (std::strcmp (extensionId, CLAP_EXT_PARAMS) == 0)       return &paramsExtension;
    if (std::strcmp (extensionId, CLAP_EXT_NOTE_PORTS) == 0)   return &notePortsExtension;
    if (std::strcmp (extensionId, CLAP_EXT_STATE) == 0)        return &stateExtension;
    if (std::strcmp (extensionId, CLAP_EXT_LATENCY) == 0)      return &latencyExtension;
    if (std::strcmp (extensionId, CLAP_EXT_WEBVIEW) == 0)      return &webviewExtension;

    return nullptr;
}

namespace
{
    // The streams the plugin writes its state into and reads it back from.
    int64_t CLAP_ABI writeState (const clap_ostream_t* stream, const void* buffer, uint64_t size)
    {
        auto* out = static_cast<juce::MemoryOutputStream*> (stream->ctx);
        return out->write (buffer, static_cast<size_t> (size)) ? static_cast<int64_t> (size) : -1;
    }

    struct StateReader
    {
        const juce::MemoryBlock* block = nullptr;
        size_t position = 0;
    };

    int64_t CLAP_ABI readState (const clap_istream_t* stream, void* buffer, uint64_t size)
    {
        auto* reader = static_cast<StateReader*> (stream->ctx);
        const auto available = reader->block->getSize() - reader->position;
        const auto count = static_cast<size_t> (juce::jmin<uint64_t> (size, available));

        if (count > 0)
            std::memcpy (buffer, static_cast<const char*> (reader->block->getData()) + reader->position, count);

        reader->position += count;
        return static_cast<int64_t> (count);   // 0 once it has all been read
    }
}

bool WclapPlugin::saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination)
{
    if (stateExt == nullptr || plugin == nullptr)
        return false;

    juce::MemoryOutputStream out;
    const clap_ostream_t stream { &out, writeState };

    if (! stateExt->save (plugin, &stream))
        return false;

    destination = out.getMemoryBlock();
    return true;
}

bool WclapPlugin::loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source)
{
    if (stateExt == nullptr || plugin == nullptr)
        return false;

    StateReader reader { &source, 0 };
    const clap_istream_t stream { &reader, readState };
    const auto loaded = stateExt->load (plugin, &stream);

    // The values the page shows are read from here, so take the restored ones.
    for (size_t i = 0; i < parameters.size(); ++i)
    {
        auto value = parameters[i].defaultValue;

        if (paramsExt != nullptr && paramsExt->get_value (plugin, parameters[i].id, &value))
            parameterValues[i].store (value);
    }

    return loaded;
}

double WclapPlugin::readParameterValue (int index)
{
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, static_cast<int> (parameters.size())))
        return 0.0;

    auto value = parameterValues[static_cast<size_t> (index)].load();
    double current = value;

    if (paramsExt != nullptr && plugin != nullptr && paramsExt->get_value (plugin, parameters[static_cast<size_t> (index)].id, &current))
        value = current;

    return value;
}

int WclapPlugin::findParameter (clap_id id) const noexcept
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < parameters.size(); ++i)
        if (parameters[i].id == id)
            return static_cast<int> (i);

    return -1;
}

// Web screens
bool CLAP_ABI WclapPlugin::hostWebviewSend (const clap_host_t* h, const void* buffer, uint32_t size)
{
    auto& self = fromHost (h);

    // As CLAP asks: it fails while the screen isn't open.
    if (! self.screenOpen.load() || buffer == nullptr)
        return false;

    const juce::ScopedLock lock (self.screenLock);

    if (self.screenMessages.size() >= 4096)   // a page that stopped listening doesn't grow this forever
        self.screenMessages.erase (self.screenMessages.begin());

    self.screenMessages.emplace_back (buffer, static_cast<size_t> (size));
    return true;
}

juce::String WclapPlugin::getScreenUri()
{
    if (webviewExt == nullptr || webviewExt->get_uri == nullptr)
        return {};

    const auto length = webviewExt->get_uri (plugin, nullptr, 0);   // with the terminating zero

    if (length <= 0)
        return {};

    std::vector<char> uri (static_cast<size_t> (length) + 1, 0);
    webviewExt->get_uri (plugin, uri.data(), static_cast<uint32_t> (uri.size()));
    return juce::String::fromUTF8 (uri.data());
}

bool WclapPlugin::getScreenResource (const juce::String& path, juce::String& mime, juce::MemoryBlock& data)
{
    if (webviewExt == nullptr || webviewExt->get_resource == nullptr)
        return false;

    data.reset();
    clap_ostream_t stream {};
    stream.ctx = &data;
    stream.write = [] (const clap_ostream_t* s, const void* buffer, uint64_t size) -> int64_t
    {
        static_cast<juce::MemoryBlock*> (s->ctx)->append (buffer, static_cast<size_t> (size));
        return static_cast<int64_t> (size);
    };

    char mimeType[256] = {};
    const auto found = webviewExt->get_resource (plugin, path.toRawUTF8(), mimeType, sizeof (mimeType) - 1, &stream);
    mime = juce::String::fromUTF8 (mimeType);
    return found;
}

void WclapPlugin::setScreenOpen (bool open)
{
    screenOpen.store (open);

    if (! open)
    {
        const juce::ScopedLock lock (screenLock);
        screenMessages.clear();
    }
}

bool WclapPlugin::sendToPlugin (const void* data, size_t size)
{
    return webviewExt != nullptr && webviewExt->receive != nullptr && screenOpen.load()
           && webviewExt->receive (plugin, data, static_cast<uint32_t> (size));
}

std::vector<juce::MemoryBlock> WclapPlugin::takeScreenMessages()
{
    const juce::ScopedLock lock (screenLock);
    return std::exchange (screenMessages, {});
}

bool WclapPlugin::getScreenSize (int& width, int& height)
{
    uint32_t w = 0, h = 0;

    if (guiExt == nullptr || guiExt->get_size == nullptr || ! guiExt->get_size (plugin, &w, &h) || w == 0 || h == 0)
        return false;

    width = static_cast<int> (w);
    height = static_cast<int> (h);
    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
uint32_t CLAP_ABI WclapPlugin::inputEventsSize (const clap_input_events_t* list)
{
    return static_cast<uint32_t> (static_cast<const WclapPlugin*> (list->ctx)->numEvents);
}

const clap_event_header_t* CLAP_ABI WclapPlugin::inputEventsGet (const clap_input_events_t* list, uint32_t index)
{
    const auto& self = *static_cast<const WclapPlugin*> (list->ctx);

    return index < static_cast<uint32_t> (self.numEvents) ? &self.events[index].header : nullptr;
}

bool CLAP_ABI WclapPlugin::outputEventsTryPush (const clap_output_events_t* list, const clap_event_header_t* event)
{
    auto& self = *static_cast<WclapPlugin*> (list->ctx);

    // Notes it plays itself, while it processes: they go on to the tracks taking MIDI from it.
    if (event != nullptr && event->space_id == CLAP_CORE_EVENT_SPACE_ID && self.inProcess)
    {
        const auto sample = static_cast<int> (event->time);

        if (event->type == CLAP_EVENT_NOTE_ON || event->type == CLAP_EVENT_NOTE_OFF)
        {
            const auto* note = reinterpret_cast<const clap_event_note_t*> (event);

            if (note->key >= 0 && note->key < 128)
            {
                const auto channel = juce::jlimit (1, 16, note->channel < 0 ? 1 : note->channel + 1);
                const auto velocity = static_cast<float> (juce::jlimit (0.0, 1.0, note->velocity));
                self.midiOutput.addEvent (event->type == CLAP_EVENT_NOTE_ON ? juce::MidiMessage::noteOn (channel, note->key, velocity)
                                                                            : juce::MidiMessage::noteOff (channel, note->key, velocity),
                                          sample);
            }

            return true;
        }

        if (event->type == CLAP_EVENT_MIDI)
        {
            const auto* midi = reinterpret_cast<const clap_event_midi_t*> (event);
            self.midiOutput.addEvent (midi->data, 3, sample);
            return true;
        }
    }

    if (event != nullptr && event->space_id == CLAP_CORE_EVENT_SPACE_ID && event->type == CLAP_EVENT_PARAM_VALUE)
    {
        const auto* change = reinterpret_cast<const clap_event_param_value_t*> (event);
        const auto index = self.findParameterIndex (change->param_id);

        if (index >= 0)
            self.parameterValues[static_cast<size_t> (index)].store (change->value);
    }

    return true;
}

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\WclapPlugin.h

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h>
#include <juce_core/juce_core.h>

#include <clap/clap.h>
#include <clap/ext/draft/webview.h>   // web screens

#include "Plugin.h"

#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

//==============================================================================
/**
    Hosts one WCLAP plugin (a CLAP plugin compiled to WebAssembly).

    wclap-bridge loads the WebAssembly module through Wasmtime and hands back an
    ordinary CLAP factory, so everything here is plain CLAP hosting.

    Threads:
      - load, activate, deactivate, parameters and the destructor: message thread
      - process(): audio thread
    The owner (AudioEngine) guarantees the audio thread is never inside process()
    while the message thread activates, deactivates, rescans or destroys.
*/
class WclapPlugin final : public Plugin
{
public:




    //==============================================================================
    /** Loads a .wasm file, a .wclap.tar.gz bundle, or a .wclap folder (pick its module.wasm).
        An empty pluginId picks the first plugin in the file. Returns nullptr and fills
        error on failure. Message thread.
    */
    static std::unique_ptr<WclapPlugin> load (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error);

    /** Stops the WebAssembly engine. Call once at shutdown, after every plugin is gone. */
    static void shutdownEngine();

    juce::String getFormatName() const override                   { return "WCLAP"; }

    // Web screens (CLAP's webview extension, carried through the bridge).
    ScreenKind getScreenKind() const noexcept override            { return webviewExt != nullptr ? ScreenKind::web : ScreenKind::none; }
    juce::String getScreenUri() override;
    bool getScreenResource (const juce::String& path, juce::String& mime, juce::MemoryBlock& data) override;
    void setScreenOpen (bool open) override;
    bool sendToPlugin (const void* data, size_t size) override;
    std::vector<juce::MemoryBlock> takeScreenMessages() override;
    bool getScreenSize (int& width, int& height) override;

    ~WclapPlugin();

    //==============================================================================
    const Descriptor& getDescriptor() const noexcept override               { return descriptor; }
    const std::vector<Descriptor>& getPluginsInFile() const noexcept override { return pluginsInFile; }
    const juce::File& getSourceFile() const noexcept override               { return sourceFile; }

    //==============================================================================
    // Saving and restoring (songs), message thread.

    /** True when the plugin can save its whole state (the CLAP state extension). */
    bool canSaveState() const noexcept override                             { return stateExt != nullptr; }

    /** The plugin's own state, in its own format. False when it can't save or saving failed. */
    bool saveState (juce::MemoryBlock& destination) override;

    /** Hands a state from saveState() back to the plugin. */
    bool loadState (const juce::MemoryBlock& source) override;

    /** The index of the parameter with this CLAP id, or -1. */
    int findParameter (clap_id id) const noexcept override;

    /** A parameter's value as the plugin itself has it now (which may be rounded to its own
        precision), rather than the last value sent to it. For saving; message thread. */
    double readParameterValue (int index) override;

    /** True once after the plugin reports a change to its state. Any thread. */
    bool consumeStateChanged() noexcept override                            { return stateChanged.exchange (false); }
    Role getRole() const noexcept override                                  { return role; }
    int getMainInputChannels() const noexcept override                      { return mainInputChannels; }
    int getMainOutputChannels() const noexcept override                     { return mainOutputChannels; }

    //==============================================================================
    // Message thread
    bool activate (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize) override;
    bool hasSidechain() const noexcept override                             { return sidechainPort >= 0; }
    bool producesMidi() const noexcept override                             { return hasNoteOutput; }
    void deactivate() override;
    bool isActive() const noexcept override                                 { return active.load(); }
    void stopProcessing() override;

    const std::vector<Parameter>& getParameters() const noexcept override   { return parameters; }
    double getParameterValue (int index) const noexcept override;
    juce::String getParameterText (int index, double value) override;

    /** Queues a change for the next process() call. Returns the value actually used. */
    double queueParameter (int index, double value) override;
    void setParameterFromAudio (uint32_t paramId, int& indexHint, double value) noexcept override;

    /** Delivers queued changes with params.flush(). Only while nothing is processing. */
    void flushQueuedParameters() override;

    Requests takeRequests() noexcept override;
    void runOnMainThread() override;
    void rescanParameters() override;
    bool getError (juce::String& message) const override;

    //==============================================================================
    // Audio thread. Inputs may be null (silence); outputs may be null (discarded).
    // The transport describes the song at the start of the block (may be null).
    void process (const float* inLeft, const float* inRight,
                  float* outLeft, float* outRight,
                  int numSamples, const juce::MidiBuffer& midi,
                  const clap_event_transport_t* transport) noexcept override;

private:
    //==============================================================================
    union EventSlot
    {
        clap_event_header_t header;
        clap_event_note_t note;
        clap_event_midi_t midi;
        clap_event_param_value_t param;
    };

    struct Port
    {
        int channels = 0;
        std::vector<std::vector<float>> storage;
        std::vector<float*> pointers;
    };

    struct ParamChange
    {
        int index = 0;
        double value = 0.0;
    };

    WclapPlugin() = default;

    bool initialise (const juce::File& location, const juce::String& pluginId, juce::String& error);
    void scanPorts();
    void allocateBuffers();
    void buildInputEvents (const juce::MidiBuffer& midi, int numFrames) noexcept;
    void addParameterEvents() noexcept;
    bool pushEvent (const EventSlot& slot) noexcept;
    void addNoteEvent (uint16_t type, int time, int channel, int key, double velocity) noexcept;
    void releaseHeldNotes (int time, int channel) noexcept;
    int findParameterIndex (clap_id id) const noexcept;

    // clap_host_t
    static const void* CLAP_ABI hostGetExtension (const clap_host_t*, const char* extensionId);
    static void CLAP_ABI hostRequestRestart (const clap_host_t*);
    static void CLAP_ABI hostRequestProcess (const clap_host_t*);
    static void CLAP_ABI hostRequestCallback (const clap_host_t*);
    static void CLAP_ABI hostLog (const clap_host_t*, clap_log_severity, const char* message);
    static void CLAP_ABI hostParamsRescan (const clap_host_t*, clap_param_rescan_flags);
    static void CLAP_ABI hostParamsClear (const clap_host_t*, clap_id, clap_param_clear_flags);
    static void CLAP_ABI hostParamsRequestFlush (const clap_host_t*);
    static uint32_t CLAP_ABI hostNotePortsDialects (const clap_host_t*);
    static void CLAP_ABI hostNotePortsRescan (const clap_host_t*, uint32_t);
    static void CLAP_ABI hostStateMarkDirty (const clap_host_t*);
    static void CLAP_ABI hostLatencyChanged (const clap_host_t*);

    // clap_input_events_t / clap_output_events_t
    static uint32_t CLAP_ABI inputEventsSize (const clap_input_events_t*);
    static const clap_event_header_t* CLAP_ABI inputEventsGet (const clap_input_events_t*, uint32_t index);
    static bool CLAP_ABI outputEventsTryPush (const clap_output_events_t*, const clap_event_header_t*);

    static WclapPlugin& fromHost (const clap_host_t* clapHost) noexcept { return *static_cast<WclapPlugin*> (clapHost->host_data); }

    //==============================================================================
    static constexpr int maxEvents = 1024;
    static constexpr int paramQueueSize = 512;

    juce::File sourceFile;
    void* module = nullptr;
    const clap_plugin_factory_t* factory = nullptr;
    const clap_plugin_t* plugin = nullptr;
    bool initialised = false;
    clap_host_t host {};

    const clap_plugin_params_t* paramsExt = nullptr;
    const clap_plugin_state_t* stateExt = nullptr;
    std::atomic<bool> stateChanged { false };
    const clap_plugin_audio_ports_t* audioPortsExt = nullptr;
    const clap_plugin_note_ports_t* notePortsExt = nullptr;

    Descriptor descriptor;
    std::vector<Descriptor> pluginsInFile;
    Role role = Role::instrument;

    std::vector<Port> inputPorts, outputPorts;
    std::vector<clap_audio_buffer_t> inputBuffers, outputBuffers;
    int mainInputPort = -1, mainOutputPort = -1;
    int sidechainPort = -1;   // the first input port besides the main one
    int mainInputChannels = 0, mainOutputChannels = 0;

    bool hasNoteInput = false, sendClapNotes = true, sendMidi = false;
    bool hasNoteOutput = false;   // it plays notes itself (an arpeggiator)
    bool inProcess = false;       // audio thread: notes it puts out now belong to this block
    int notePortIndex = 0;
    std::array<std::array<juce::uint64, 2>, 16> heldNotes {};

    std::vector<Parameter> parameters;
    std::vector<std::pair<clap_id, int>> parameterLookup;     // sorted by id
    std::unique_ptr<std::atomic<double>[]> parameterValues;

    juce::AbstractFifo paramFifo { paramQueueSize };
    std::array<ParamChange, (size_t) paramQueueSize> paramQueue {};

    std::vector<EventSlot> events;
    int numEvents = 0;
    clap_input_events_t inputEvents {};
    clap_output_events_t outputEvents {};

    std::atomic<bool> active { false }, processing { false };
    double currentSampleRate = 0.0;
    int maxFrames = 0;
    int64_t steadyTime = 0;

    std::atomic<bool> callbackRequested { false }, rescanRequested { false }, restartRequested { false },
                      flushRequested { false }, processErrorSeen { false };

    // Automation's changes for the next process(): set and used on the audio thread only.
    static constexpr int automationQueueSize = 256;
    std::array<ParamChange, (size_t) automationQueueSize> automationChanges {};
    int numAutomationChanges = 0;
    void addParameterEvent (int index, double value) noexcept;

    // The web screen: the plugin's side of it, and what it has said to the page.
    const clap_plugin_webview_t* webviewExt = nullptr;
    const clap_plugin_gui_t* guiExt = nullptr;
    std::atomic<bool> screenOpen { false };
    juce::CriticalSection screenLock;
    std::vector<juce::MemoryBlock> screenMessages;
    static bool CLAP_ABI hostWebviewSend (const clap_host_t* host, const void* buffer, uint32_t size);

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (WclapPlugin)
};

// C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\src\wclap-stub\webview-gui\helpers.h

#pragma once

// Stand-in for webview-gui's helpers. wclap-bridge only needs guessMediaType(), used
// when a plugin serves a web UI file without naming its type.

#include <cstring>
#include <string>

namespace webview_gui
{
namespace helpers
{

inline std::string guessMediaType (const char* path)
{
    struct Entry { const char* extension; const char* type; };

    static constexpr Entry types[] = {
        { "html", "text/html;charset=utf-8" },       { "htm",  "text/html;charset=utf-8" },
        { "js",   "text/javascript;charset=utf-8" }, { "mjs",  "text/javascript;charset=utf-8" },
        { "css",  "text/css;charset=utf-8" },        { "json", "application/json" },
        { "txt",  "text/plain;charset=utf-8" },      { "svg",  "image/svg+xml" },
        { "png",  "image/png" },                     { "jpg",  "image/jpeg" },
        { "jpeg", "image/jpeg" },                    { "gif",  "image/gif" },
        { "webp", "image/webp" },                    { "ico",  "image/x-icon" },
        { "wasm", "application/wasm" },              { "woff", "font/woff" },
        { "woff2", "font/woff2" },                   { "ttf",  "font/ttf" },
        { "otf",  "font/otf" },                      { "wav",  "audio/wav" },
        { "mp3",  "audio/mpeg" },                    { "ogg",  "audio/ogg" },
    };

    std::string name (path != nullptr ? path : "");
    name = name.substr (0, name.find_first_of ("?#"));

    const auto slash = name.find_last_of ('/');
    const auto dot = name.find_last_of ('.');

    if (dot == std::string::npos || (slash != std::string::npos && dot < slash))
        return "text/html;charset=utf-8";

    auto extension = name.substr (dot + 1);

    for (auto& c : extension)
        if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z')
            c = static_cast<char> (c - 'A' + 'a');

    for (const auto& entry : types)
        if (extension == entry.extension)
            return entry.type;

    return "application/octet-stream";
}

} // namespace helpers
} // namespace webview_gui

(() => {
  "use strict";

  const backend = window.__JUCE__ && window.__JUCE__.backend;
  const send = (eventId, payload = {}) => { if (backend) backend.emitEvent(eventId, payload); };
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  const NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"];
  const noteName = (n) => NAMES[n % 12] + (Math.floor(n / 12) - 1);
  const clamp01 = (x) => Math.min(Math.max(x, 0), 1);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- keyboard
  const keyboard = $("keyboard");
  const RANGE = 36;                 // three octaves, C to C
  const LOWEST_BASE = 12, HIGHEST_BASE = 84;
  let base = 48;                    // C3

  const held = new Map();           // note -> number of local holders
  const pointerNotes = new Map();   // pointerId -> note
  const keyNotes = new Map();       // KeyboardEvent.code -> note
  let engineNotes = new Set();      // notes the engine reports as sounding (includes hardware MIDI)

  function paintKeys() {
    for (const key of keyboard.children) {
      const note = Number(key.dataset.note);
      key.classList.toggle("down", held.has(note) || engineNotes.has(note));
    }
  }

  function hold(note, velocity) {
    held.set(note, (held.get(note) || 0) + 1);
    send("noteOn", { note, velocity });
    paintKeys();
  }

  function unhold(note) {
    const count = (held.get(note) || 0) - 1;
    if (count > 0) held.set(note, count); else held.delete(note);
    send("noteOff", { note });
    paintKeys();
  }

  function releaseAll() {
    for (const note of pointerNotes.values()) unhold(note);
    for (const note of keyNotes.values()) unhold(note);
    pointerNotes.clear();
    keyNotes.clear();
  }

  function buildKeyboard() {
    keyboard.textContent = "";
    let whiteIndex = 0;

    for (let note = base; note <= base + RANGE; note++) {
      const isBlack = [1, 3, 6, 8, 10].includes(note % 12);
      const key = document.createElement("div");
      key.className = "key " + (isBlack ? "black" : "white");
      key.dataset.note = String(note);

      if (isBlack) {
        key.style.left = `calc(${whiteIndex} * var(--w) - var(--bw) / 2)`;
      } else {
        key.style.left = `calc(${whiteIndex} * var(--w))`;
        whiteIndex++;

        if (note % 12 === 0) {
          const label = document.createElement("span");
          label.className = "label";
          label.textContent = noteName(note);
          key.appendChild(label);
        }
      }

      keyboard.appendChild(key);
    }

    $("octave-range").textContent = `${noteName(base)}–${noteName(base + RANGE)}`;
    paintKeys();
  }

  function shiftOctave(direction) {
    const next = base + direction * 12;
    if (next < LOWEST_BASE || next > HIGHEST_BASE) return;
    releaseAll();
    base = next;
    buildKeyboard();
  }

  // Lower on the key plays louder, like a real key.
  function velocityAt(event, key) {
    const r = key.getBoundingClientRect();
    return 0.35 + 0.65 * clamp01((event.clientY - r.top) / r.height);
  }

  keyboard.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
    const key = event.target.closest(".key");
    if (!key) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const note = Number(key.dataset.note);
    pointerNotes.set(event.pointerId, note);
    hold(note, velocityAt(event, key));
  });

  // Dragging across keys plays each one in turn.
  keyboard.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
    if (!pointerNotes.has(event.pointerId)) return;
    const hit = document.elementFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    const key = hit && hit.closest ? hit.closest(".key") : null;
    const note = key ? Number(key.dataset.note) : null;
    const current = pointerNotes.get(event.pointerId);
    if (note === current) return;

    unhold(current);

    if (note === null) {
      pointerNotes.delete(event.pointerId);
      return;
    }

    pointerNotes.set(event.pointerId, note);
    hold(note, velocityAt(event, key));
  });

  const endPointer = (event) => {
    const note = pointerNotes.get(event.pointerId);
    if (note === undefined) return;
    pointerNotes.delete(event.pointerId);
    unhold(note);
  };
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", endPointer);
  window.addEventListener("pointercancel", endPointer);

  // Physical key positions, so it works with any keyboard layout (Hebrew included).
  const KEY_OFFSETS = {
    KeyA: 0, KeyW: 1, KeyS: 2, KeyE: 3, KeyD: 4, KeyF: 5, KeyT: 6, KeyG: 7, KeyY: 8,
    KeyH: 9, KeyU: 10, KeyJ: 11, KeyK: 12, KeyO: 13, KeyL: 14, KeyP: 15, Semicolon: 16, Quote: 17
  };

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    if (event.repeat || event.ctrlKey || event.altKey || event.metaKey) return;
    if (event.target instanceof HTMLSelectElement) return;   // letters pick options there
    if (event.code === "KeyZ") { shiftOctave(-1); return; }
    if (event.code === "KeyX") { shiftOctave(1); return; }

    const offset = KEY_OFFSETS[event.code];
    if (offset === undefined || keyNotes.has(event.code)) return;
    event.preventDefault();

    const note = base + 12 + offset;   // computer keys start at the middle octave
    keyNotes.set(event.code, note);
    hold(note, 0.8);
  });

  window.addEventListener("keyup", (event) => {
    const note = keyNotes.get(event.code);
    if (note === undefined) return;
    keyNotes.delete(event.code);
    unhold(note);
  });

  window.addEventListener("blur", releaseAll);

  $("settings").addEventListener("click", () => send("openAudioSettings"));
  $("panic").addEventListener("click", () => { releaseAll(); send("allNotesOff"); });
  $("oct-down").addEventListener("click", () => shiftOctave(-1));
  $("oct-up").addEventListener("click", () => shiftOctave(1));

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- status
  const meters = [$("meter-l"), $("meter-r")].map((cover) => ({ cover, level: 0 }));
  const METER_FALL = 0.022;         // per update at 20 updates a second, about 26 dB/s
  let lastNoteOns = null;
  let ledTimer = 0;

  function flashLed() {
    const led = $("midi-led");
    led.classList.add("on");
    clearTimeout(ledTimer);
    ledTimer = setTimeout(() => led.classList.remove("on"), 150);
  }

  function formatRate(hz) {
    const khz = hz / 1000;
    return (Number.isInteger(khz) ? khz.toFixed(0) : khz.toFixed(1)) + " kHz";
  }

  function render(s) {
    document.body.classList.toggle("no-device", !s.deviceOpen);

    if (s.deviceOpen) {
      $("latency-number").textContent = s.outputLatencyMs.toFixed(1);
      $("ruler-fill").style.width = clamp01(s.outputLatencyMs / 40) * 100 + "%";
      $("driver").textContent = s.typeName;
      $("device").textContent = s.deviceName;
      $("device").title = s.deviceName;
      $("rate").textContent = formatRate(s.sampleRate);
      $("buffer").textContent = `${s.bufferSize} samples (${s.bufferMs.toFixed(1)} ms)`;
      $("state").textContent = s.running ? "" : "The device is open but not running. Check it in Audio settings.";
    } else {
      $("empty-message").textContent = "No audio device is open. Choose a driver and device in Audio settings.";
    }

    [s.peakLeft, s.peakRight].forEach((peak, i) => {
      const db = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(peak, 1e-6));
      const meter = meters[i];
      meter.level = Math.max(clamp01((db + 60) / 60), meter.level - METER_FALL);
      meter.cover.style.width = (1 - meter.level) * 100 + "%";
    });

    $("cpu").textContent = Math.round(s.cpu * 100) + " %";
    $("xruns").textContent = s.xruns < 0 ? "Not reported by this driver" : String(s.xruns);
    $("midi-inputs").textContent = s.midiInputs.length ? s.midiInputs.join(", ") : "None enabled";
    $("midi-inputs").title = $("midi-inputs").textContent;

    if (lastNoteOns !== null && s.hardwareNoteOns !== lastNoteOns) flashLed();
    lastNoteOns = s.hardwareNoteOns;

    engineNotes = new Set(s.notes);
    paintKeys();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- plugin
  const ROLE_LABELS = { instrument: "Instrument", effect: "Effect", noAudio: "Note effect, no audio" };
  let plugin = { status: "empty" };
  let paramRows = new Map();        // parameter index -> { input, value }

  function channelsText(count) {
    return count === 1 ? "mono" : count === 2 ? "stereo" : `${count} channels`;
  }

  function setFill(input) {
    const min = Number(input.min), max = Number(input.max);
    const fraction = max > min ? (Number(input.value) - min) / (max - min) : 0;
    input.style.setProperty("--fill", clamp01(fraction) * 100 + "%");
  }

  function buildParams(params) {
    const list = $("plugin-params");
    list.textContent = "";
    paramRows = new Map();

    if (plugin.status === "loaded" && params.length === 0) {
      const none = document.createElement("p");
      none.className = "param-none";
      none.textContent = "This plugin has no parameters.";
      list.appendChild(none);
      return;
    }

    for (const p of params) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "param";

      const name = document.createElement("span");
      name.className = "param-name";
      name.textContent = p.name;
      name.title = p.name;

      const input = document.createElement("input");
      input.type = "range";
      input.min = String(p.min);
      input.max = String(p.max);
      input.step = p.stepped ? "1" : String((p.max - p.min) / 1000 || 0.001);
      input.value = String(p.value);
      input.disabled = p.readOnly;
      input.setAttribute("aria-label", p.name);
      input.addEventListener("input", () => {
        setFill(input);
        send("setParam", { index: p.index, value: Number(input.value) });
      });

      const value = document.createElement("span");
      value.className = "param-value";
      value.textContent = p.text;
      value.title = p.text;

      row.append(name, input, value);
      list.appendChild(row);
      paramRows.set(p.index, { input, value });
      setFill(input);
    }
  }

  function renderRoute() {
    let route = "Test synth";

    if (plugin.status === "loaded" && plugin.role === "instrument") route = plugin.name;
    if (plugin.status === "loaded" && plugin.role === "effect") route = `Test synth → ${plugin.name}`;

    $("route").textContent = "→ " + route;
    $("route").title = route;
  }

  function renderPlugin(state) {
    plugin = state;
    const loaded = state.status === "loaded";
    const loading = state.status === "loading";

    $("plugin-load").textContent = loaded ? "Replace…" : "Load plugin…";
    $("plugin-load").disabled = loading;
    $("plugin-unload").hidden = !loaded;
    $("plugin-info").hidden = !(loaded || loading);
    $("plugin-empty").hidden = loaded || loading;
    $("plugin-choice").hidden = true;

    if (loading) {
      $("plugin-name").textContent = "Loading…";
      $("plugin-meta").textContent = state.message;
      $("plugin-meta").title = state.message;
      $("plugin-message").textContent = "";
      buildParams([]);
      renderRoute();
      return;
    }

    $("plugin-message").textContent = state.message || "";

    if (loaded) {
      $("plugin-name").textContent = state.name;
      $("plugin-name").title = state.name;

      const details = [state.vendor, ROLE_LABELS[state.role] || state.role];
      if (state.outputs > 0) details.push(channelsText(state.outputs));
      $("plugin-meta").textContent = details.filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      $("plugin-meta").title = state.file + (state.version ? ` · version ${state.version}` : "");

      const choice = $("plugin-choice");
      choice.textContent = "";

      for (const entry of state.plugins) {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = entry.id;
        option.textContent = entry.name;
        option.selected = entry.id === state.id;
        choice.appendChild(option);
      }

      choice.hidden = state.plugins.length < 2;
    }

    buildParams(loaded ? state.params : []);
    renderRoute();
  }

  function renderParam(reply) {
    const row = paramRows.get(reply.index);
    if (!row) return;
    row.value.textContent = reply.text;
    row.value.title = reply.text;
  }

  $("plugin-load").addEventListener("click", () => send("loadPlugin"));
  $("plugin-unload").addEventListener("click", () => send("unloadPlugin"));
  $("plugin-choice").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
    event.target.blur();
    send("selectPlugin", { id: event.target.value });
  });

  buildKeyboard();

  if (backend) {
    backend.addEventListener("status", render);
    backend.addEventListener("plugin", renderPlugin);
    backend.addEventListener("param", renderParam);
    send("uiReady");
  } else {
    $("empty-message").textContent = "Open this page inside Fanan Web Hub to connect it to the audio engine.";
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

# C:\workspace\Fanan_web_hub\CMakeLists.txt

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

project(FananWebHub VERSION 0.2.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# JUCE 9
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(JUCE_DIR "C:/workspace/JUCE" CACHE PATH "JUCE 9 root folder")

if(NOT EXISTS "${JUCE_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "JUCE not found at ${JUCE_DIR}")
endif()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WebView2 SDK (Windows)
# JUCE links WebView2 statically and needs the Microsoft.Web.WebView2 NuGet
# package. It is downloaded once into this build folder - nothing is installed
# anywhere else on the system.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(WIN32)
    set(FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION "1.0.3485.44")
    set(FANAN_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGES "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/nuget")
    set(FANAN_WEBVIEW2_DIR "${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGES}/Microsoft.Web.WebView2.${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}")

    if(NOT EXISTS "${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_DIR}/build/native/include/WebView2.h")
        set(_webview2_archive "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/nuget-download/webview2-${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}.zip")

        message(STATUS "Downloading WebView2 SDK ${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}")

        file(DOWNLOAD
            "https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/microsoft.web.webview2/${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}/microsoft.web.webview2.${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}.nupkg"
            "${_webview2_archive}"
            STATUS _webview2_status
            TLS_VERIFY ON)

        list(GET _webview2_status 0 _webview2_code)

        if(NOT _webview2_code EQUAL 0)
            file(REMOVE "${_webview2_archive}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "WebView2 SDK download failed: ${_webview2_status}")
        endif()

        file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${_webview2_archive}" DESTINATION "${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_DIR}")
    endif()

    set(JUCE_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGE_LOCATION "${FANAN_WEBVIEW2_PACKAGES}")
endif()

add_subdirectory("${JUCE_DIR}" JUCE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WCLAP hosting: wclap-bridge + Wasmtime, downloaded once into build/deps.
# Brings its own CLAP 1.2.7 headers, so no separate CLAP folder is needed.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(src/WclapBridge.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
juce_add_gui_app(FananWebHub
    PRODUCT_NAME "Fanan Web Hub"
    COMPANY_NAME "Fanan"
    BUNDLE_ID "com.fanan.webhub"
    VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}"
    NEEDS_WEB_BROWSER TRUE
    NEEDS_WEBVIEW2 TRUE)

target_sources(FananWebHub PRIVATE
    src/Main.cpp
    src/MainComponent.h
    src/MainComponent.cpp
    src/AudioEngine.h
    src/AudioEngine.cpp
    src/WclapPlugin.h

    src/AiTools.h
    src/AiTools.cpp
    src/AiAgent.h

# The web UI is compiled into the executable and served to the WebView from memory.
juce_add_binary_data(FananWebHubWeb SOURCES
    src/index.html

target_compile_definitions(FananWebHub PRIVATE
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_PLUGINHOST_VST3=1
    JUCE_APPLICATION_NAME_STRING="$<TARGET_PROPERTY:FananWebHub,JUCE_PRODUCT_NAME>"

if(WIN32)
